articles.title: Which came first: black holes or galaxies?
articles.author: Olivia Maule

paras.en: Nearly every large galaxy is thought to have a supermassive black hole at its center. The Milky Way's black hole, known as Sagittarius A*, is enormous, weighing over 4 million times as much as the sun. But which came first: the black holes or the galaxies around them?
paras.zh: 人们认为几乎每个大星系的中心都有一个超大质量黑洞。银河系的黑洞被称为人马座 A*，非常巨大，重量超过太阳的 400 万倍。但哪个先出现：黑洞还是它们周围的星系？

paras.en: Astronomers told Live Science that they thought they knew, but new observations mean they're no longer sure.
paras.zh: 天文学家告诉《生活科学》杂志，他们以为自己知道，但新的观察结果意味着他们不再确定。

paras.en: For decades, the prevailing idea was that galaxies came first: Dying massive stars leave behind black holes that can merge and feed until they swell to millions of times the sun's mass, said Joseph Silk, an astrophysicist and professor at Johns Hopkins University.
paras.zh: 约翰·霍普金斯大学天体物理学家兼教授约瑟夫·西尔克（Joseph Silk）表示，几十年来，普遍的观点是星系先出现：垂死的大质量恒星会留下黑洞，这些黑洞可以合并和吞噬，直到膨胀到太阳质量的数百万倍。

paras.en: Then, in recent years, the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) began peering back at the early universe. "Recent observations are challenging this picture, or at least showing us that it cannot be the whole story," Roberto Maiolino, a professor of astrophysics at the University of Cambridge, told Live Science in an email. "We are finding extremely massive black holes just a few hundred million years after the Big Bang."
paras.zh: 近年来，詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜 (JWST) 开始回望早期宇宙。剑桥大学天体物理学教授罗伯托·麦奥利诺（Roberto Maiolino）在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》杂志：“最近的观察对这一情况提出了挑战，或者至少向我们表明，这不可能是故事的全部。” “我们在大爆炸后几亿年就发现了极其巨大的黑洞。”

paras.en: Stranger still, some of these black holes look too big for their hosts. In nearby galaxies, a central black hole is typically about a thousand times less massive than its galaxy, Maiolino said, but some early ones "appear to be almost as massive as the stars in their host galaxies." In a study in the journal Nature, Maiolino and colleagues measured one such black hole's mass directly in an object called Abell2744-QSO1 and found that it holds most of the object's mass.
paras.zh: 更奇怪的是，其中一些黑洞对于它们的宿主来说看起来太大了。麦奥利诺说，在附近的星系中，中心黑洞的质量通常比其星系小一千倍左右，但一些早期的黑洞“似乎几乎与宿主星系中的恒星一样大”。在《自然》杂志上的一项研究中，Maiolino 和同事直接测量了一个名为 Abell2744-QSO1 的物体中的一个此类黑洞的质量，发现它拥有该物体的大部分质量。

paras.en: So where could such giants come from? Maiolino outlined several possibilities, and more than one may be correct. Some supermassive black holes may be ordinary stellar remnants that grew much faster than usual. Others may have been "born big," forming from the direct collapses of enormous gas clouds, which "would give the black hole a head start in its growth," Maiolino explained. Another idea is that these monsters were seeded by primordial black holes that formed "shortly after the Big Bang, before the first stars and galaxies existed."
paras.zh: 那么这样的巨人从何而来呢？马伊利诺概述了几种可能性，而且可能不止一种是正确的。一些超大质量黑洞可能是普通的恒星残骸，其生长速度比平常快得多。其他黑洞可能“生来就很大”，是由巨大气体云的直接塌缩形成的，这“将使黑洞在其生长过程中抢占先机”，麦奥利诺解释道。另一个想法是，这些怪物是由“大爆炸后不久，第一批恒星和星系存在之前”形成的原始黑洞播下的种子。

paras.en: Further complicating the question is that black holes and galaxies also push and pull on each other. A growing black hole can release an enormous amount of energy that heats or expels gas, which, in turn, curbs or shuts down star formation, Maiolino said.
paras.zh: 使问题进一步复杂化的是，黑洞和星系也会相互推拉。马伊利诺说，不断增长的黑洞可以释放大量能量，加热或排出气体，从而抑制或阻止恒星形成。

paras.en: Feed your curiosity with an exclusive mystery every week, solved with science and delivered direct to your inbox before it's seen anywhere else.
paras.zh: 每周都会有一个独家谜题来满足您的好奇心，这些谜题将通过科学解决，并在其他地方看到之前直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: However, it can also compress gas and potentially trigger new stars. "Black holes and galaxies influence one another throughout their evolution, and neither can be understood entirely in isolation," he said.
paras.zh: 然而，它也可以压缩气体并有可能引发新的恒星。 “黑洞和星系在整个演化过程中相互影响，两者都不能完全孤立地理解，”他说。

paras.en: Silk said the balance varies. In giant, elliptical galaxies, black holes weighing billions of suns can have "histories of extreme violence" that helped limit their hosts' growth, while in spirals like the Milky Way, feedback from stars tends to dominate.
paras.zh: Silk表示，平衡情况各不相同。在巨大的椭圆星系中，重量达数十亿个太阳的黑洞可能有“极端暴力的历史”，这有助于限制其宿主的生长，而在像银河系这样的螺旋星系中，来自恒星的反馈往往占主导地位。

paras.en: So which came first? Answering that question will take far more data from JWST. Right now, "we have samples of tens of objects, maybe 20, 30, 40," Silk said, and astronomers need far more data to tell whether oversize black holes are typical.
paras.zh: 那么哪个先出现呢？回答这个问题需要 JWST 提供更多的数据。现在，“我们有数十个物体的样本，也许是 20、30、40 个，”Silk 说，天文学家需要更多的数据来判断超大黑洞是否是典型的。

paras.en: If black holes outweigh their galaxies the farther back astronomers look, that would strongly suggest black holes formed first, Silk said; if stars dominate, it would point the other way.
paras.zh: 西尔克说，如果天文学家在更远的地方观察到黑洞比星系还要重，那就强烈表明黑洞首先形成。如果明星占主导地位，它就会指向相反的方向。

paras.en: Maiolino suggested the question itself may need rethinking. "Asking which came first may be too simplistic," he said. "The more interesting question may be how black holes and galaxies formed, grew and influenced one another at different stages of cosmic history."
paras.zh: Maiolino 表示，这个问题本身可能需要重新思考。 “问哪个先出现可能太简单化了，”他说。 “更有趣的问题可能是黑洞和星系在宇宙历史的不同阶段是如何形成、生长和相互影响的。”

paras.en: There may be no single sequence. "Different black holes, in different environments and at different cosmic epochs, may have formed and evolved through different pathways," Maiolino added.
paras.zh: 可能不存在单一序列。 “不同的黑洞，在不同的环境和不同的宇宙时代，可能是通过不同的途径形成和演化的，”麦奥利诺补充道。

paras.en: For now, the cosmic chicken-and-egg puzzle remains open. As Maiolino put it, astronomers are "beginning to explore a period of cosmic history for which we still have many unanswered questions."
paras.zh: 目前，宇宙先有鸡还是先有蛋的谜题仍然悬而未决。正如麦奥利诺所说，天文学家“开始探索一段宇宙历史，对此我们仍有许多未解之谜。”

paras.en: Is your knowledge of the universe supermassive? Find out with our black hole quiz!
paras.zh: 你对宇宙的了解是海量的吗？通过我们的黑洞测验找出答案！

paras.en: Olivia Maule is a former Live Science intern and science journalist whose beats include space, biotechnology and the environment. She holds a B.A. in biology and a B.S. in anthropology from the University of Florida and completed a master's degree in science communication at U.C. Santa Cruz. A 2025 AAAS Mass Media Fellow, she wrote stories and produced videos during a summer at El Nuevo Día, Puerto Rico's largest newspaper, and has written for Eos, Mongabay, Science magazine and Stanford Report. Olivia is a native Spanish and English speaker.
paras.zh: 奥利维亚·莫尔 (Olivia Maule) 是《Live Science》前实习生和科学记者，关注领域包括太空、生物技术和环境。她拥有学士学位。生物学学士学位和学士学位获得佛罗里达大学人类学博士学位，并在加州大学获得科学传播硕士学位。圣克鲁斯。作为 2025 年 AAAS 大众媒体研究员，她在一个夏天为波多黎各最大的报纸 El Nuevo Día 撰写故事并制作视频，并为《Eos》、《Mongabay》、《科学》杂志和《斯坦福报告》撰稿。奥利维亚的母语是西班牙语和英语。

articles.title: Scientists investigate 2 'peculiar' galaxies pulling each other apart
articles.author: Jamie Carter

paras.en: What it is: NGC 7253 (also called Arp 278), a pair of interacting spiral galaxies
paras.zh: 它是什么：NGC 7253（也称为 Arp 278），一对相互作用的螺旋星系

paras.en: Where it is: 200 million light-years away, in the constellation Pegasus
paras.zh: 它在哪里：2亿光年外，位于飞马座

paras.en: Picture a spiral galaxy, and you'll probably imagine a swirl of stars. But some galaxies appear to be the complete opposite. One is NGC 7253, which looks more like a bizarre balloon animal than a cosmic coil. In reality, it's two spiral galaxies caught in each other's gravity. As shown in this recent image from the Gemini North telescope on Mauna Kea in Hawaii, the galaxies' once-ordered shapes are being disturbed and disrupted as their mutual gravitational pull stretches and distorts their spiral arms into a tangled arrangement of stars, gas and dust. It sounds and looks chaotic and destructive, but encounters between galaxies don't mean stars are physically colliding; the distances between individual stars are too great. Instead, something extraordinarily productive can happen.
paras.zh: 想象一个螺旋星系，你可能会想象一个恒星漩涡。但有些星系似乎完全相反。其中之一是NGC 7253，它看起来更像是一种奇怪的气球动物，而不是宇宙线圈。事实上，它是两个相互引力的螺旋星系。正如这张来自夏威夷莫纳克亚山双子座望远镜的最新图像所示，星系曾经有序的形状正在被扰乱和破坏，因为它们相互的引力拉伸并扭曲它们的旋臂，形成恒星、气体和尘埃的纠缠排列。听起来、看起来都很混乱且具有破坏性，但星系之间的相遇并不意味着恒星之间发生物理碰撞；而是意味着星系之间的碰撞。个别恒星之间的距离太大。相反，一些非常富有成效的事情可能会发生。

paras.en: Spiral galaxies contain huge clouds of cold gas and dust, particularly within their arms. When galaxies interact, gravitational forces can disturb and compress those clouds. If enough material is squeezed together and becomes dense enough to collapse under its own gravity, it can produce bursts of new star formation.
paras.zh: 螺旋星系含有巨大的冷气体和尘埃云，尤其是在旋臂内。当星系相互作用时，引力会扰乱并压缩这些云。如果足够多的物质被挤压在一起并变得足够稠密，足以在自身重力作用下塌陷，它就可以产生新恒星的爆发。

paras.en: Evidence of just that can be seen in this image. Scattered through the galaxies are concentrations of bright pink light. These are H II regions — enormous clouds of hydrogen gas energized by intense ultraviolet radiation from hot, young stars.
paras.zh: 从这张图片中可以看出这一点的证据。明亮的粉红色光散布在星系中。这些是 H II 区域——巨大的氢气云，由炽热的年轻恒星发出的强烈紫外线辐射提供能量。

paras.en: The gravitational encounter is rearranging two structures containing billions of stars while simultaneously helping to create new ones. These interactions radically alter the shapes of the galaxies involved and, in time, can ultimately cause them to merge into a single galaxy. For now, NGC 7253 is listed as Arp 278 in the Atlas of Peculiar Galaxies, a catalog of galaxies that are neither perfectly symmetrical spirals nor smooth, spherical ellipticals.
paras.zh: 引力相遇正在重新排列两个包含数十亿颗恒星的结构，同时帮助创建新的结构。这些相互作用从根本上改变了所涉及星系的形状，并最终导致它们合并成一个星系。目前，NGC 7253 在《奇特星系图集》中被列为 Arp 278，这是一份既不是完全对称的螺旋星系也不是光滑的椭圆形星系的目录。

paras.en: - The Milky Way is one galaxy — but it used to be thousands, new simulations reveal
paras.zh: - 新的模拟显示，银河系是一个星系，但它曾经有数千个

paras.en: - James Webb telescope discovers ultra-rare ring galaxy just 2 billion years after the Big Bang
paras.zh: - 詹姆斯·韦伯望远镜在大爆炸后仅 20 亿年就发现了极其罕见的环形星系

paras.en: - 'Far more than beautiful pictures': Euclid space telescope images 900 million galaxies on its quest to make the largest 3D map of the universe
paras.zh: -“不仅仅是美丽的图片”：欧几里得太空望远镜拍摄了 9 亿个星系的图像，以绘制最大的宇宙 3D 地图

paras.en: The new image has another story much closer to Earth. It's just been given the Hawaiian name Nā 'Uhane Māhoe Huki Pū i ke Ola, meaning "The Twin Spirits Pulling Together Creating Life." Hawaii high school students participating in the 2026 Project Hōkūlani internship program chose the name. One reason was its position within Ka Lupe o Kawelo, the Hawaiian constellation corresponding to Pegasus.
paras.zh: 新图像有另一个更接近地球的故事。它刚刚被命名为 Nā 'Uhane Māhoe Huki Pū i ke Ola，意思是“双生灵魂齐心协力创造生命”。参加 2026 年 Project Hōkūlani 实习计划的夏威夷高中生选择了这个名字。原因之一是它在夏威夷星座 Ka Lupe o Kawelo 中的位置，与飞马座相对应。

paras.en: The "twin spirits" represent both the two galaxies and the twin telescopes of the Gemini Observatory — one in Hawaii and the other in Chile.
paras.zh: “双胞胎灵魂”代表两个星系和双子座天文台的双望远镜——一台位于夏威夷，另一台位于智利。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Jamie Carter is a Cardiff, U.K.-based freelance science journalist and a regular contributor to Live Science. He is the author of A Stargazing Program For Beginners and co-author of The Eclipse Effect, and leads international stargazing and eclipse-chasing tours. His work appears regularly in Space.com, Forbes, New Scientist, BBC Sky at Night, Sky & Telescope, and other major science and astronomy publications. He is also the editor of WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com.
paras.zh: 杰米·卡特 (Jamie Carter) 是英国卡迪夫的一名自由科学记者，也是《Live Science》的定期撰稿人。他是《初学者观星计划》一书的作者，也是《日食效应》一书的合著者，并领导国际观星和日食追逐之旅。他的作品经常出现在 Space.com、福布斯、新科学家、BBC 夜间天空、天空与望远镜以及其他主要科学和天文学出版物上。他还是 WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com 的编辑。

articles.title: Impossible volcanic eruption spotted in deepest part of the ocean, perplexing scientists
articles.author: Stephanie Pappas

paras.en: A submersible mission to the deepest ocean trench on Earth has made a shocking discovery: the deepest pyroclastic volcanic flow ever found on the planet, in a place geologists didn't expect to see any volcanic activity.
paras.zh: 一次对地球最深海沟的潜水任务有了一个令人震惊的发现：地球上发现的最深的火山碎屑火山流，而地质学家并没有想到在这个地方会看到任何火山活动。

paras.en: This evidence of a violent undersea eruption was found 20,000 feet (6,000 meters) below the ocean surface on the walls of the Challenger Deep, the deepest point of the Mariana Trench and the deepest part of the ocean. It was a "complete surprise," said Robert Stern, a professor emeritus of geosciences at the University of Texas at Dallas and first author of a new study describing the discovery.
paras.zh: 这一剧烈海底喷发的证据是在海面以下 20,000 英尺（6,000 米）处的挑战者深渊（马里亚纳海沟的最深点和海洋最深部分）的岩壁上发现的。德克萨斯大学达拉斯分校地球科学名誉教授、描述这一发现的新研究的第一作者罗伯特·斯特恩说，这“完全令人惊讶”。

paras.en: Typically, volcanic activity doesn't occur that close to an ocean trench, Stern told Live Science. And given the site's extreme depth, the lava that made the flow must have had some very strange chemistry. Normally, the intense pressure of seawater at these depths would prevent an explosive eruption, instead favoring a goopier, seeping type of flow. But the flows seen on the edge of the Challenger Deep were similar to the explosive, roiling gases that coated Pompeii in ash in A.D. 79.
paras.zh: 斯特恩告诉《生活科学》杂志，通常情况下，火山活动不会发生在靠近海沟的地方。考虑到该地点的极端深度，流动的熔岩一定具有某种非常奇怪的化学成分。通常情况下，这些深度海水的巨大压力会阻止爆炸性喷发，反而有利于粘稠的渗透型水流。但在挑战者深渊边缘看到的气流与公元 79 年庞贝古城被火山灰覆盖的爆炸性翻滚气体类似。

paras.en: "It's not something that as a geoscientist I would have said would be predicted," said Sune Nielsen, a geochemist at the University of Lorraine in France who was not involved in the study. "Very far from it."
paras.zh: 法国洛林大学地球化学家苏尼·尼尔森（Sune Nielsen）没有参与这项研究，他说：“作为一名地球科学家，我不会说会预测到这一点。” “离它很远。”

paras.en: The Challenger Deep is in the remote western Pacific at the southern end of the Mariana Trench. There, the Pacific oceanic plate pushes under the Mariana oceanic plate in a process called subduction. At the trench where the two plates meet, the ocean floor plunges down 6.8 miles (10.9 kilometers). Mount Everest could fit in the chasm, with room to spare.
paras.zh: 挑战者深渊位于遥远的西太平洋马里亚纳海沟南端。在那里，太平洋板块向马里亚纳板块下方推进，这一过程称为俯冲。在两个板块相遇的海沟处，海底下降 6.8 英里（10.9 公里）。珠穆朗玛峰可以塞进这个裂缝，而且还有剩余空间。

paras.en: Geoscientists aren't sure why the trench is so dizzyingly deep, but they have turned up some clues. For instance, there is a tear in the Pacific Plate that allows one narrow strip of the plate to subduct particularly rapidly. The curvature of the plate is also very steep, perhaps because the rocks of the Mariana and Pacific plates aren't very strongly connected to each other, allowing the Pacific Plate to dive steeply and flex freely.
paras.zh: 地球科学家不确定为什么海沟如此深，但他们已经找到了一些线索。例如，太平洋板块上有一个裂缝，使得板块的一个狭窄地带能够特别迅速地俯冲。板块的曲率也非常陡峭，可能是因为马里亚纳板块和太平洋板块的岩石彼此之间的连接不是很牢固，使得太平洋板块能够急剧下潜并自由弯曲。

paras.en: The new findings, reported Monday (Nov. 23) in the journal Frontiers in Earth Science, suggest that volcanism and magma also may play a role, Stern said. The researchers were exploring a segment of the Challenger Deep's forearc, a roughly 120-mile-wide (200 km) expanse that sits between the trench itself and the volcanic arc created by the subduction zone. These volcanic arcs are standard subduction zone features; for example, Mount St. Helens and Mount Rainier are part of the volcanic arc of the Cascadia subduction zone in the Pacific Northwest.
paras.zh: 斯特恩说，周一（11 月 23 日）发表在《地球科学前沿》杂志上的新发现表明，火山活动和岩浆也可能发挥了作用。研究人员正在探索挑战者深渊前弧的一部分，这是一片大约 120 英里宽（200 公里）的区域，位于海沟本身和俯冲带形成的火山弧之间。这些火山弧是标准的俯冲带特征；例如，圣海伦火山和雷尼尔山是太平洋西北部卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带火山弧的一部分。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: But though there are some volcanoes north of Challenger Deep along the Mariana Trench, the Challenger Deep segment of the trench is odd in that there is not an organized volcanic arc there. Instead, there's an ocean ridge. Regardless, the space between this ridge and the trench was expected to be volcanically quiet because there is not usually enough heat in that region of a subduction zone to melt magma.
paras.zh: 尽管挑战者深渊以北沿马里亚纳海沟有一些火山，但海沟的挑战者深渊部分很奇怪，因为那里没有有组织的火山弧。相反，有一个洋脊。无论如何，预计该山脊和海沟之间的空间将是火山安静的，因为俯冲带的该区域通常没有足够的热量来熔化岩浆。

paras.en: Nevertheless, the cameras on the deep-diving remotely operated vehicle Jason/Medea, which went to the site in 2014, caught strange, pancake-like rock features at three different spots in a 60-mile (100 km) stretch of the trench. Samples brought on board the ship revealed rock embedded with volcanic glass and a pyroclastic flow texture.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，2014 年前往该地点的深潜遥控潜水器杰森/美狄亚 (Jason/Medea) 上的摄像机在 60 英里（100 公里）长的海沟中的三个不同地点捕捉到了奇怪的煎饼状岩石特征。船上的样本显示岩石内嵌有火山玻璃和火山碎屑流纹理。

paras.en: The researchers are currently getting the rock dated, but volcanic glass usually erodes quickly in the ocean, Stern said, so the presence of glass suggests the eruptions were fairly recent. "They're not yesterday," he said, "but I don't think they're a million years old."
paras.zh: 斯特恩说，研究人员目前正在对岩石进行年代测定，但火山玻璃通常在海洋中很快就会被侵蚀，因此玻璃的存在表明火山喷发是最近发生的。 “它们不是昨天的了，”他说，“但我不认为它们已经有一百万年了。”

paras.en: The pressure of the water at the depths of the flows is equivalent to 592 atmospheres of Earth stacked on top of one another. Typically, that kind of pressure keeps a lid on the dissolved water and carbon dioxide in magma that expands rapidly to cause explosive eruptions. Thus, Stern said, the eruptions by the Challenger Deep may have been driven by a supercritical fluid — a weird state sort of in between a gas and a liquid.
paras.zh: 水流深处的水压相当于地球上 592 个大气压相互叠加的压力。通常，这种压力会限制岩浆中溶解的水和二氧化碳，使岩浆迅速膨胀，从而引起爆炸性喷发。因此，斯特恩说，挑战者深渊的喷发可能是由超临界流体驱动的——一种介于气体和液体之间的奇怪状态。

paras.en: "We just don’t know how those magmas will behave at those water depths," said Stephen Self, a volcanologist at the University of California, Berkeley, who was not involved in the study.
paras.zh: “我们只是不知道这些岩浆在这些水深处会如何表现，”加州大学伯克利分校的火山学家斯蒂芬·塞尔夫（Stephen Self）说，他没有参与这项研究。

paras.en: The mission's observations also suggest that the crust of this region is extending, or stretching, in two different ways. To the east, the stretch is caused by a mechanical pulling apart of the crust. To the west, volcanic eruptions are stretching the crust. It's a perplexing finding, Nielsen said, without a clear explanation.
paras.zh: 该任务的观察结果还表明，该地区的地壳正在以两种不同的方式延伸或拉伸。在东部，拉伸是由地壳的机械拉开引起的。在西边，火山喷发正在拉伸地壳。尼尔森说，这是一个令人困惑的发现，但没有明确的解释。

paras.en: Stern and his colleagues suspect that the two plates are starting a new subduction zone in this western part. That would be an exciting finding; subduction zones move around over tens of millions of years, and researchers don't know much about how new ones start. The geochemical studies of the rocks that Stern and his team pulled up could answer questions about where the lava that made the pyroclastic flows came from and why this bizarre region can generate magma where none should be.
paras.zh: 斯特恩和他的同事怀疑这两个板块正在西部地区开始一个新的俯冲带。这将是一个令人兴奋的发现；俯冲带移动了数千万年，研究人员不太了解新的俯冲带是如何开始的。斯特恩和他的团队对岩石的地球化学研究可以回答以下问题：造成火山碎屑流的熔岩从何而来，以及为什么这个奇怪的地区会在不应该出现的地方产生岩浆。

paras.en: "This region is really, really unusual for our planet, and there is quite a bit of, 'What, really? Wait, how is that? OK, yeah, I guess maybe.'" Nielsen said. "So obviously, I find it super interesting."
paras.zh: “这个地区对于我们的星球来说真的非常不寻常，而且有很多人，‘什么，真的吗？等等，怎么样？好吧，是的，我想也许吧。’”尼尔森说。 “很明显，我发现它非常有趣。”

paras.en: Stern, R. J., Pujana, I., Anderson, M. K., Chin, E., Dygert, N., Harigane, Y., Le Roux, V., Leybourne, M., Ohara, Y., Okumura, T., Segee-Wright, G., & Etheridge, E. (n.d.). ROVing in the deep: Tectonic and magmatic complexities of the challenger deep forearc segment, southern mariana convergent margin. Frontiers in Earth Science, 14, 1929806. https://doi.org/10.3389/feart.2026.1929806
paras.zh: Stern, R. J.、Pujana, I.、Anderson, M.K.、Chin, E.、Dygert, N.、Harigane, Y.、Le Roux, V.、Leybourne, M.、Ohara, Y.、Okumura, T.、Segee-Wright, G. 和 Etheridge, E.（日期不详）。深海漫游：挑战者深部弧前段、南马里亚纳会聚边缘的构造和岩浆复杂性。地球科学前沿，14, 1929806。 https://doi.org/10.3389/feart.2026.1929806

paras.en: What do you know about the deepest place on Earth? Find out with our Mariana Trench quiz!
paras.zh: 你对地球最深处了解多少？通过我们的马里亚纳海沟测验找出答案！

paras.en: Stephanie Pappas is a contributing writer for Live Science, covering topics ranging from geoscience to archaeology to the human brain and behavior. She was previously a senior writer for Live Science but is now a freelancer based in Denver, Colorado, and regularly contributes to Scientific American and The Monitor, the monthly magazine of the American Psychological Association. Stephanie received a bachelor's degree in psychology from the University of South Carolina and a graduate certificate in science communication from the University of California, Santa Cruz.
paras.zh: 斯蒂芬妮·帕帕斯 (Stephanie Pappas) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，涵盖的主题从地球科学到考古学，再到人脑和行为。她曾是《Live Science》的高级撰稿人，但现在是科罗拉多州丹佛市的自由职业者，并定期为《科学美国人》和美国心理学协会的月刊《监视器》撰稿。斯蒂芬妮获得了南卡罗来纳大学的心理学学士学位和加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的科学传播研究生证书。

articles.title: For the First Time, Astronomers Witnessed a Giant Star Gobble Up Its Smaller Stellar Companion

paras.en: In 2023, astronomers realized that a red giant star in our neighboring Andromeda galaxy was doing something strange. Sure enough, two years later, the astronomical object exploded.
paras.zh: 2023 年，天文学家意识到邻近仙女座星系中的一颗红巨星正在做一些奇怪的事情。果然，两年后，这个天文物体爆炸了。

paras.en: The researchers rushed to observe the phenomenon, and they sifted through older data to piece together what had happened. Analyses suggest the huge star had gobbled up its smaller stellar companion, marking the first direct observation of this kind of star merger. The findings were described November 18 in the journal Nature.
paras.zh: 研究人员急忙观察这一现象，并筛选较旧的数据以拼凑出发生的情况。分析表明，这颗巨大的恒星吞噬了其较小的恒星伴星，这标志着首次直接观察到这种恒星合并。 11 月 18 日的《自然》杂志描述了这一发现。

paras.en: The eruption, called AT 2025abao, occurred because the two stars shared what’s called a common envelope. Some stars approaching the end of their lives balloon to a huge size, entering a giant phase. As an object expands, its outer layer of gas—or envelope—engulfs anything orbiting it, resulting in odd interactions.
paras.zh: 这次名为 AT 2025abao 的喷发之所以发生，是因为两颗恒星共享一个所谓的共同信封。一些接近生命终点的恒星体积膨胀到巨大，进入巨相。当物体膨胀时，其外层气体（或包膜）会吞没绕其运行的任何物体，从而产生奇怪的相互作用。

paras.en: However, common envelopes are tough to observe because they happen over relatively short timescales of months to years, and usually, just a few stars exist in this phase at a time within a galaxy, writes Jason Nordhaus, an astrophysicist at the Rochester Institute of Technology who did not participate in the work, in commentary accompanying the study.
paras.zh: 然而，普通包层很难观察到，因为它们发生的时间尺度相对较短，从几个月到几年，而且通常，星系内一次只有几颗恒星处于这个阶段，罗切斯特理工学院的天体物理学家杰森·诺德豪斯（Jason Nordhaus）在该研究附带的评论中写道，他没有参与这项工作。

paras.en: Experts estimate that nearly a third of all stars go through a common envelope phase at some point during their lives, reports New Scientist.
paras.zh: 据《新科学家》报道，专家估计，近三分之一的恒星在其一生中的某个时刻会经历一个共同的包络阶段。

paras.en: To investigate the strange event, which occurred in October 2025, researchers obtained data captured just 47 days later by NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope. They also had follow-up observations from other ground- and space-based instruments, as well as data from roughly the past 30 years, which revealed the big star had started brightening in 2018.
paras.zh: 为了调查 2025 年 10 月发生的奇怪事件，研究人员获得了美国宇航局詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜仅 47 天后捕获的数据。他们还通过其他地面和太空仪器进行了后续观测，以及大约过去 30 年的数据，这些数据显示这颗大恒星在 2018 年开始变亮。

paras.en: Using all that data, the team was able to “reconstruct what happened with quite significant confidence,” Sven Buder, an astrophysicist at the Australian National University who did not participate in the study, tells the Australian Broadcasting Corporation’s Jacinta Bowler.
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的澳大利亚国立大学天体物理学家斯文·布德 (Sven Buder) 告诉澳大利亚广播公司的杰辛塔·鲍勒 (Jacinta Bowler)，利用所有这些数据，该团队能够“非常有信心地重建所发生的事情”。

paras.en: Computer simulations hinted that the two stars had orbited each other for millennia. Before the eye-catching explosion, the primary star—dubbed “Big Bao” after the eruption’s name—had become enormous. It was seven times more massive, 350 times the radius and 18,000 times brighter than our sun. Its companion, “Little Bao,” on the other hand, probably contained 0.7 times the mass of our sun and was smaller and fainter.
paras.zh: 计算机模拟表明这两颗恒星已经相互绕转了数千年。在这场引人注目的爆炸之前，主星——根据这次喷发的名字被称为“大宝”——已经变得非常巨大。它的质量是太阳的 7 倍，半径是太阳的 350 倍，亮度是太阳的 18,000 倍。另一方面，它的伴星“小包”的质量可能是太阳的 0.7 倍，而且更小、更暗。

paras.en: The smaller star spiraled into the bigger one’s envelope, and the two objects took about seven years to unite, which is quite quick in astronomical terms. The merger occurred when the red giant dragged its companion into its core, resulting in a dramatic event resembling “a bomb exploding inside a living star,” study co-author Kishalay De, an astrophysicist at Columbia University, says in a statement.
paras.zh: 较小的恒星盘旋进入较大恒星的包层，两个物体花了大约七年的时间才结合在一起，这从天文学角度来看是相当快的。研究合著者、哥伦比亚大学天体物理学家基沙拉伊·德在一份声明中表示，当红巨星将其伴星拖入其核心时，合并发生了，导致了一场类似“炸弹在活恒星内部爆炸”的戏剧性事件。

paras.en: “We were able to see all different phases of this process—we were able to see the quiescent system, we were able to see the moment the stars touched each other, we were able to see the inspiral, and we were able to see the big outburst in 2025,” lead author Viraj Karambelkar, also an astrophysicist at Columbia University, tells New Scientist’s Leah Crane. “So we now know how this process works far better than we ever had before.”
paras.zh: “我们能够看到这个过程的所有不同阶段——我们能够看到静止的系统，我们能够看到恒星相互接触的那一刻，我们能够看到螺旋，我们能够看到 2025 年的大爆发，”主要作者、哥伦比亚大学天体物理学家 Viraj Karambelkar 告诉《新科学家》杂志的 Leah Crane。 “所以我们现在知道这个过程是如何比以前更好地运作的。”

paras.en: Now, however, the system is too dusty for scientists to observe the aftermath directly, and it will likely remain so for years, reports Science News’ Meghan Bartels. In the meantime, Karambelkar says they can work to “catch more of these systems even before they erupt.”
paras.zh: 然而，据《科学新闻》的梅根·巴特尔斯报道，现在该系统灰尘太多，科学家无法直接观察其后果，而且这种情况可能会持续多年。与此同时，卡拉姆贝尔卡表示，他们可以努力“在这些系统爆发之前捕获更多”。

articles.title: Rembrandt's 'Night Watch' Is Teeming With Life. Researchers Reveal a Hidden World of Microbes All Over the Masterpiece

paras.en: For nearly four centuries, viewers have admired the bustling militia figures frozen in oil paint on Rembrandt van Rijn’s 1642 masterpiece, The Night Watch. Now, scientists in Amsterdam have revealed that the iconic canvas is teeming with an invisible, living world of its own.
paras.zh: 近四个世纪以来，观众一直欣赏伦勃朗·凡·赖恩 (Rembrandt van Rijn) 1642 年的杰作《夜巡》(The Night Watch) 中凝固在油画中的熙熙攘攘的民兵人物。现在，阿姆斯特丹的科学家们发现，这幅标志性的画布上充满了一个看不见的、活生生的世界。

paras.en: Researchers from the Rijksmuseum and ARTIS-Micropia (which claims to be the world’s only museum dedicated to microbes) are collecting 60 samples from 10 different areas of the painting to catalog its surface microbiome. Early laboratory cultures have turned up myriads of common bacteria and one puzzling outlier: Microbacterium saccharophilum, a bacterial species first identified in 2013 at a sugar refinery in Japan.
paras.zh: 来自国立博物馆和 ARTIS-Micropia（据称是世界上唯一一家专门研究微生物的博物馆）的研究人员正在从这幅画的 10 个不同区域收集 60 个样本，以对其表面微生物组进行编目。早期的实验室培养发现了无数常见细菌和一个令人费解的异常细菌：嗜糖微杆菌，这是 2013 年在日本一家糖精炼厂首次发现的一种细菌物种。

paras.en: “This is the first time The Night Watch, or any work of art, has been analyzed in this way, and we’ve found bacteria that appear on human skin and in soil, and are even associated with plants,” Eline van Bloois, a microbiologist at Artis-Micropia tells El País’ Isabel Ferrer.
paras.zh: Artis-Micropia 的微生物学家 Eline van Bloois 告诉 El País 的 Isabel Ferrer：“这是《夜巡》或任何艺术作品第一次以这种方式进行分析，我们发现了人类皮肤和土壤中出现的细菌，甚至与植物有关。”

paras.en: The ongoing investigation is featured in “The Night Watch Lives,” an exhibition at ARTIS-Micropia running through May 2027. Centered around a life-size reproduction of Rembrandt’s painting marked with numbered sampling dates, the display showcases living bacterial colonies growing inside glass-encased Petri dishes.
paras.zh: 正在进行的调查在 ARTIS-Micropia 举办的展览“The Night Watch Lives”中进行了展示，该展览将持续到 2027 年 5 月。展览以伦勃朗画作的真人大小复制品为中心，并标有编号的采样日期，展示了玻璃包裹培养皿内生长的活细菌菌落。

paras.en: “To get that close to the painting was very scary,” van Bloois tells Hyperallergic's Noëlle de Leeuw. “After all, it's a piece of art that is so well-known to so many people.”
paras.zh: “如此接近这幅画是非常可怕的，”范布卢瓦告诉 Hyperallergic 的 Noëlle de Leeuw。 “毕竟，这是一件为很多人所熟知的艺术品。”

paras.en: The microbial census forms a new chapter of “Operation Night Watch,” the Rijksmuseum’s sweeping research and conservation initiative launched in 2019. Inside a glass chamber in the museum’s Gallery of Honor, conservators are currently working in full view of visitors to painstakingly remove a yellowed layer of varnish applied in the 1970s. It’s a delicate process, using organic-fabric gauze, small tissues and tiny amounts of solvent that will take years to complete.
paras.zh: 此次微生物普查构成了国家博物馆于 2019 年启动的全面研究和保护计划“夜巡行动”的新篇章。在博物馆荣誉画廊的一个玻璃室内，保护人员目前正在游客众目睽睽之下，煞费苦心地清除 1970 年代涂抹的泛黄清漆层。这是一个微妙的过程，需要使用有机织物纱布、小纸巾和微量溶剂，需要数年时间才能完成。

paras.en: Decades before Dutch microbiologist Antonie van Leeuwenhoek first described microorganisms in the 1670s, Rembrandt was already using chemistry to protect his work against microscopic threats. Previous Operation Night Watch analyses revealed that Rembrandt had applied a layer of lead-laden oil beneath the primer to shield the painting from moisture and mold in Amsterdam’s damp buildings. The canvas was later trimmed in 1715 to fit inside Amsterdam City Hall and has suffered numerous conservation treatments and deep cleanings roughly once every 50 years.
paras.zh: 早在 1670 年代荷兰微生物学家安东尼·范·列文虎克 (Antonie van Leeuwenhoek) 首次描述微生物的几十年前，伦勃朗就已经在使用化学来保护他的作品免受微观威胁。之前的《守夜人行动》分析显示，伦勃朗在底漆下涂了一层含铅油，以保护画作免受阿姆斯特丹潮湿建筑中的湿气和霉菌影响。这幅画后来于 1715 年进行了修剪，以适应阿姆斯特丹市政厅的需要，并经历了多次保护处理和大约每 50 年一次的深度清洁。

paras.en: Since 2019, Operation Night Watch has made several other breakthroughs. Researchers restored the trimmed edges of the painting with artificial intelligence and discovered a hidden sketch beneath the paint with advanced X-ray imaging.
paras.zh: 自 2019 年以来，“守夜人行动”还取得了其他几项突破。研究人员利用人工智能恢复了画作的修剪边缘，并通过先进的 X 射线成像发现了画作下方隐藏的草图。

paras.en: “Thirty or 40 years ago, nobody could have imagined you’d be talking to a chemist or biologist about The Night Watch,” Rijksmuseum director Taco Dibbits said during a press conference, Hyperallergic reports. “And I think precisely because this research is broadening—the fact that the humanities and the exact sciences are collaborating—it also leads to it becoming more widely embraced.”
paras.zh: 据《Hyperallergic》报道，国家博物馆馆长 Taco Dibbits 在新闻发布会上表示：“三十或四十年前，没有人能想象你会与化学家或生物学家谈论《夜巡》。” “我认为正是因为这项研究正在拓宽——人文学科和精确科学正在合作这一事实——它也导致它得到更广泛的接受。”

paras.en: To sample the 400-year-old surface safely, conservators and lab technicians gently pressed small, sterile cellulose discs against both varnished and unvarnished sections of the canvas. Those discs were transferred to Petri dishes and incubated in ARTIS-Micropia’s laboratory until invisible microbes multiplied into visible colonies, which an external lab then identified.
paras.zh: 为了安全地对 400 年历史的表面进行采样，修复人员和实验室技术人员将小的无菌纤维素圆盘轻轻压在画布的涂漆和未涂漆部分上。这些圆盘被转移到培养皿中，并在 ARTIS-Micropia 的实验室中孵育，直到看不见的微生物繁殖成可见的菌落，然后由外部实验室进行鉴定。

paras.en: The team has completed only half of its six planned sampling trips to the Rijksmuseum so far, with 20 identified microbes currently on display and another 10 still incubating. Researchers expect to collect all 60 samples by February.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，该团队仅完成了国家博物馆六次计划采样之旅的一半，目前有 20 种已鉴定的微生物正在展出，另外 10 种仍在孵化中。研究人员预计在 2 月份之前收集完所有 60 个样本。

paras.en: Among the familiar microbial residents detected so far are Staphylococcus epidermidis and Micrococcus luteus, harmless bacteria routinely found on human skin that help hydrate it and defend against pathogens, Amsterdamian’s Dana Marin reports. The team also isolated plant-root and soil species, including Kocuria palustris, Kocuria rhizophila and Lysinibacillus sphaericus, a resilient bacterium capable of surviving harsh environments rich in heavy metals.
paras.zh: 阿姆斯特丹航空的 Dana Marin 报道称，迄今为止检测到的常见微生物包括表皮葡萄球菌和藤黄微球菌，它们是人类皮肤上常见的无害细菌，有助于滋润皮肤并抵御病原体。研究小组还分离出了植物根部和土壤物种，包括沼泽库库菌（Kocuria palustris）、根瘤库库菌（Kocuria rhizophila）和球形赖氨酸芽孢杆菌（Lysinibacillus sphaericus），这是一种能够在富含重金属的恶劣环境中生存的有弹性的细菌。

paras.en: None of those, however, baffled scientists quite like Microbacterium saccharophilum, which turned up on a section where old varnish had already been stripped away. Originally isolated from soil at the Ensuiko Sugar Refining plant in Yokohama, Japan, the microbe has no obvious connection to a Dutch Golden Age canvas.
paras.zh: 然而，这些都不像嗜糖微杆菌那样让科学家感到困惑，它出现在旧清漆已经被剥掉的部分。这种微生物最初是从日本横滨 Ensuiko 糖精炼厂的土壤中分离出来的，与荷兰黄金时代的画布没有明显的联系。

paras.en: “We’ve seen very little sugar in Rembrandt’s painting so far, and it’s best not to speculate, but it’s possible that the Saccharophilum isn’t as old as the canvas,” van Bloois tells El País, adding that scientists currently have no way to determine when any of the bacteria arrived.
paras.zh: 范布卢瓦告诉《国家报》：“到目前为止，我们在伦勃朗的画作中看到的糖分很少，最好不要猜测，但嗜糖菌可能没有画布那么古老。”他补充说，科学家目前无法确定任何细菌何时到达。

paras.en: Museum visitors often wonder whether any microbes lingering on the paint might date back to Rembrandt himself. “Ideally, you want to have the bacteria of Rembrandt: this is the Holy Grail,” Katrien Keune, the Rijksmuseum’s head of science, tells the Art Newspaper’s Senay Boztas. Yet Keune tells Amsterdamian that centuries of restoration make finding traces of the master unlikely, noting that the surface largely reflects museum staff and visitors shedding skin cells and saliva droplets.
paras.zh: 博物馆参观者经常想知道画上残留的微生物是否可以追溯到伦勃朗本人。 “理想情况下，你想要伦勃朗的细菌：这是圣杯，”国立博物馆的科学主管 Katrien Keune 告诉《艺术报》的 Senay Boztas。然而，科恩告诉《阿姆斯特丹人》，经过几个世纪的修复，不太可能找到大师的痕迹，并指出表面很大程度上反映了博物馆工作人员和游客脱落的皮肤细胞和唾液液滴。

paras.en: Even without a direct biological link to Rembrandt, researchers hope the project helps rehabilitate the public image of microbes, pointing out that far less than 1 percent of known species cause disease in humans or animals. “It's good to give microbes some love as well,” van Bloois tells the Art Newspaper.
paras.zh: 即使与伦勃朗没有直接的生物学联系，研究人员也希望该项目有助于恢复微生物的公众形象，并指出，已知物种中只有不到 1% 会导致人类或动物患病。 “给予微生物一些关爱也很好，”范布鲁伊斯告诉《艺术报》。

paras.en: “The Night Watch Lives” is on view at ARTIS-Micropia in Amsterdam through May 2027.
paras.zh: “守夜人的生命”将于 2027 年 5 月在阿姆斯特丹 ARTIS-Micropia 展出。

articles.title: A Roman Cup and Hundreds of Other Treasures Unearthed in This 2,000-Year-Old Tomb Reveal the Rich Exchange Network of an Ancient Asian Empire

paras.en: Some 2,000 years ago, an elite individual associated with the nomadic Xiongnu Empire was buried in style in what is now northeastern Mongolia. Their tomb, measuring nearly 240 feet in length (about four-fifths the height of the Statue of Liberty), is the largest of its kind discovered in the East Asian country to date.
paras.zh: 大约2000年前，一位与游牧民族匈奴帝国有关的精英被优雅地埋葬在现在的蒙古东北部。他们的坟墓长近 240 英尺（约为自由女神像高度的五分之四），是迄今为止在东亚国家发现的最大的此类坟墓。

paras.en: Despite this impressive exterior, the tomb’s interior is surprisingly small and shallow. But it was packed with treasures that shed new light on the Xiongnu people’s links to such far-flung foreign powers as the Roman Empire and the Lelang Commandery, an administrative division of China’s Han dynasty that was based in what is now Korea.
paras.zh: 尽管有着令人印象深刻的外观，但坟墓的内部却出人意料地小而浅。但它充满了宝藏，为了解匈奴人与罗马帝国和乐浪郡（中国汉朝的一个行政区划，位于现在的朝鲜）等遥远的外国列强的联系提供了新的线索。

paras.en: The National Museum of Korea, the Institute of Archaeology at the Mongolian Academy of Sciences and the National Museum of Mongolia recently completed a four-year excavation of the burial, which is known officially as Tomb 160. It’s located in Duurlig Nars, a Xiongnu burial ground with some 300 graves.
paras.zh: 韩国国家博物馆、蒙古科学院考古研究所和蒙古国家博物馆最近完成了对墓葬的为期四年的发掘，该墓葬的正式名称为160号墓。它位于杜尔利格纳尔斯，这是一个拥有约300座坟墓的匈奴墓地。

paras.en: - UNESCO added the Duurlig Nars complex to its World Heritage List earlier this year.
paras.zh: - 联合国教科文组织今年早些时候将 Duurlig Nars 建筑群列入世界遗产名录。

paras.en: - The United Nations agency recognized the site’s tombs for highlighting “the engineering and organizational skills of this predominantly nomadic culture.”
paras.zh: - 联合国机构认可该遗址的坟墓突显了“这种以游牧为主的文化的工程和组织技能”。

paras.en: Archaeologists recovered 413 artifacts from the tomb, including a glass cup believed to be of Roman origin, a gourd-shaped silver pendant that once adorned a horse’s harness, a lacquered chariot and 15 jade pieces modeled after Han funerary goods.
paras.zh: 考古学家从该墓中发现了 413 件文物，包括一个据信源自罗马的玻璃杯、一个曾装饰马具的葫芦形银吊坠、一辆漆车和 15 件仿制汉族陪葬品的玉器。

paras.en: The pendant resembles accessories found in Lelang tombs in modern-day North Korea, but unlike those ornaments, it boasts a crystal at its center. The jade objects, meanwhile, were fashioned in irregular shapes with intricate designs carved onto their surfaces, setting them apart from the disc-shaped bi prized by the Han as symbols of heaven.
paras.zh: 该吊坠类似于现代朝鲜乐浪古墓中发现的配饰，但与这些装饰品不同的是，它的中心有一颗水晶。与此同时，这些玉器被制成不规则形状，表面刻有复杂的图案，与汉族视为天国象征的圆盘形璧不同。

paras.en: “This excavation clearly shows that the Xiongnu of 2,000 years ago were linked to a broad exchange network reaching from Rome to the Korean Peninsula,” the National Museum of Korea says in a statement, per a translation by Seoul Economic Daily. “We expect it to serve as a turning point in expanding the field of Korean archaeology into Eurasia.”
paras.zh: 据《首尔经济日报》报道，韩国国家博物馆在一份声明中表示：“这次发掘清楚地表明，2000 年前的匈奴与从罗马到朝鲜半岛的广泛交流网络有关。” “我们希望它将成为韩国考古学领域扩展到欧亚大陆的转折点。”

paras.en: The rich range of objects buried alongside the deceased testifies to their high status. Although the researchers have yet to identify the grave’s occupant, they plan to conduct a DNA analysis of teeth and hair recovered from the individual’s coffin to determine their sex and age.
paras.zh: 与死者一起埋葬的丰富物品证明了他们的崇高地位。尽管研究人员尚未确定坟墓主人的身份，但他们计划对从坟墓中找到的牙齿和头发进行 DNA 分析，以确定他们的性别和年龄。

paras.en: To construct the tomb, ancient laborers built an elevated terrace enclosed by nine layers of stacked stones. The central chamber of the grave extends to a depth of nearly 50 feet, making it significantly smaller than comparable Xiongnu tombs in central Mongolia, whose depths reach more than 70 feet. The excavation team suggests that this downsized interior reflects societal shifts in the late first and second centuries C.E., when the tomb was built. At the time, the Xiongnu Empire was declining, with internal disagreements and external pressure from the Han military weakening the once-great pastoral confederation.
paras.zh: 为了建造这座坟墓，古代劳动者建造了一个由九层石块围成的高台。墓室的中央墓室深度近50英尺，明显小于蒙古中部同类匈奴墓葬的深度70多英尺。发掘团队认为，这种缩小的内部空间反映了公元一世纪末和二世纪坟墓建造时的社会变迁。当时，匈奴帝国正在衰落，内部分歧和汉族军事的外部压力削弱了曾经伟大的游牧联邦。

paras.en: The Xiongnu thrived in Central Asia between the third century B.C.E. and the second century C.E., wielding control over vast swaths of territory “without building cities, forming central bureaucracies, devising a writing system or mobilizing masses of farmers to produce food,” Bruce Bower wrote for Science News in 2023. In recent years, scholars have revealed an array of insights on the Xiongnu that challenge long-held perceptions of the group as “barbaric” invaders.
paras.zh: 公元前三世纪之间，匈奴在中亚繁荣发展。布鲁斯·鲍尔 (Bruce Bower) 在 2023 年《科学新闻》上撰文称，公元二世纪，“没有建造城市、没有组建中央官僚机构、没有设计文字系统或动员大量农民生产粮食”，就控制了大片领土。近年来，学者们揭示了一系列关于匈奴的见解，挑战了长期以来将该群体视为“野蛮”入侵者的看法。

paras.en: In 2023, for example, a paper published in the journal Science Advances suggested that elite Xiongnu women traveled to the empire’s frontiers to shore up alliances with powerful locals. “They are representatives of the imperial clan that ruled the empire,” study co-author Bryan Miller, an archaeologist at the University of Michigan, told Live Science’s Tom Metcalfe. “You’ve got these marriage alliances spanning the whole empire, even in these local communities.”
paras.zh: 例如，2023 年《科学进展》杂志上发表的一篇论文表明，匈奴女性精英前往帝国边境，以巩固与当地有权势的人的联盟。 “他们是统治帝国的皇室的代表，”研究合著者、密歇根大学考古学家布莱恩·米勒告诉《生活科学》杂志的汤姆·梅特卡夫。 “这些婚姻联盟遍布整个帝国，甚至在这些当地社区也是如此。”

paras.en: Speaking with Science News, Miller added, “This must have been an empire organized around moving populations. Xiongnu elites were savvy politicians who delegated power to keep the empire together.”
paras.zh: 米勒在接受《科学新闻》采访时补充道，“这一定是一个围绕流动人口组织起来的帝国。匈奴精英是精明的政治家，他们下放权力来维持帝国的团结。”

articles.title: How This Year’s Super El Niño Will Worsen Global Hunger
articles.author: Nicola Jones

paras.en: This story originally appeared on Yale E360 and is part of the Climate Desk collaboration.
paras.zh: 这个故事最初出现在耶鲁 E360 上，是气候桌面合作的一部分。

paras.en: The world is now in the grip of a super El Niño: a Godzilla-sized version of a natural climate phenomenon that has already shriveled rivers, upended aquaculture, and flattened crops with drought. But the global organizations that keep an eye on food security are warning of even tougher times ahead.
paras.zh: 世界现在正遭受超级厄尔尼诺现象的影响：这是一种哥斯拉大小的自然气候现象，已经导致河流干涸、水产养殖业崩溃、农作物因干旱而被夷为平地。但关注粮食安全的全球组织警告称，未来的日子将更加艰难。

paras.en: The impacts of an El Niño can be far-reaching and catastrophic. In the late 19th century, one of the strongest El Niños on record helped to fuel multiyear droughts across Asia, Brazil, and Africa that spurred a global famine: Some 50 million people, or 3 percent of the global population, died. Thankfully, the ways we plan for bad weather and move food around the planet have improved massively since then, with organizations working hard to provide relief where it’s needed. But the impacts of bad weather on crops are still hard to avoid. After a strong El Niño hit in 2015, cereal yields across Southern Africa were 20 percent below normal; crop yields in parts of Ethiopia dropped by 90 percent.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象的影响可能是深远的和灾难性的。 19 世纪末，有记录以来最强烈的厄尔尼诺现象之一加剧了亚洲、巴西和非洲的多年干旱，引发了全球饥荒：约 5000 万人（占全球人口的 3%）死亡。值得庆幸的是，自那时以来，我们应对恶劣天气和在全球范围内运送食物的方式已经有了很大改善，各组织努力在需要的地方提供救援。但恶劣天气对农作物的影响仍然难以避免。 2015 年厄尔尼诺现象强烈袭击后，整个南部非洲的谷物产量比正常水平低 20%；埃塞俄比亚部分地区的农作物产量下降了 90%。

paras.en: This year’s El Niño has already, by one measure, topped those previous record holders in strength. And it’s still growing. By the time the phenomenon peaks in early winter, sea-surface warming in the tropical Pacific could be higher than anything seen in a millennium. In August, the World Food Programme warned that this El Niño might push an additional 49 million people into acute food insecurity by the end of 2027, taking the total number to 274 million. Worryingly, this year’s event comes as global aid dollars are pinched and wars are making it hard to plug holes in global food systems.
paras.zh: 从一项指标来看，今年的厄尔尼诺现象的强度已经超过了之前的记录保持者。而且还在增长。到初冬这种现象达到顶峰时，热带太平洋海面变暖程度可能会比千年来最高。 8月，世界粮食计划署警告称，到2027年底，厄尔尼诺现象可能会使另外4900万人陷入严重粮食不安全，使总人数达到2.74亿。令人担忧的是，今年的活动发生之际，全球援助资金捉襟见肘，战争导致全球粮食系统的漏洞难以填补。

paras.en: “It’s a triple whammy of high fertilizer costs, high energy costs, and now massive droughts across the tropics,” says Berkeley Earth climatologist Zeke Hausfather, who is watching the situation unfold. “It’s not a great story.”
paras.zh: 伯克利地球气候学家泽克·豪斯法瑟（Zeke Hausfather）正在关注事态的发展，他说：“这是高化肥成本、高能源成本和热带地区大规模干旱的三重打击。” “这不是一个伟大的故事。”

paras.en: El Niño is one phase of a natural climate pattern called the El Niño–Southern Oscillation, which has a dramatic impact on global rainfall patterns. El Niño years are marked by unusually warm waters in the tropical Pacific, which weaken winds across that patch and alter global patterns of rising and falling air pressure. The results are complicated and variable, but they tend to bring dry conditions to some tropical areas—including the Amazon and parts of Australia and Africa—and rain to other places, including Florida. The other side of the oscillation, La Niña, is marked by cooler ocean temperatures and a different pattern of wet and dry. The planet swings between the two in irregular intervals of years, sometimes with neutral periods in between.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象是称为厄尔尼诺-南方涛动的自然气候模式的一个阶段，它对全球降雨模式产生巨大影响。厄尔尼诺年的特点是热带太平洋的海水异常温暖，这削弱了该地区的风力，并改变了全球气压上升和下降的模式。结果复杂多变，但它们往往会给一些热带地区（包括亚马逊地区以及澳大利亚和非洲的部分地区）带来干旱，并给包括佛罗里达州在内的其他地方带来降雨。振荡的另一面是拉尼娜现象，其特点是海洋温度较低，干湿模式不同。行星以不规则的年份间隔在两者之间摆动，有时中间会出现中性周期。

paras.en: Both sides of this cycle can harm crops, though one prominent 2014 study found that El Niño affects a larger swath of the globe’s harvested land. While some places get more water, and some crops thrive, in many spots drought withers production. That same study found that an El Niño tends to improve global soybean production by up to 5 percent but suppresses maize, rice, and wheat by up to 4 percent. The numbers in any one country can be much more dramatic than that: Since 1980, South Africa’s maize output, for example, has averaged about 28 percent below normal during El Niño years.
paras.zh: 尽管 2014 年一项著名研究发现厄尔尼诺现象影响了全球更大范围的耕地，但这一周期的双方都会损害农作物。虽然有些地方获得了更多的水，一些作物生长茂盛，但许多地方的干旱导致产量枯竭。同一项研究还发现，厄尔尼诺现象往往会使全球大豆产量提高高达 5%，但会抑制玉米、水稻和小麦产量高达 4%。任何一个国家的数字都可能比这个数字更加惊人：例如，自 1980 年以来，南非的玉米产量在厄尔尼诺现象期间平均比正常水平低 28% 左右。

paras.en: Cereal disruptions, even if small, can hit hard if they come on top of other economic strains, says Stanford agricultural economist David Lobell. “When markets are tight, then if there’s a drought somewhere, that’s a much bigger deal.”
paras.zh: 斯坦福大学农业经济学家大卫·洛贝尔表示，谷物中断即使很小，如果再加上其他经济压力，也可能造成严重打击。 “当市场紧张时，如果某个地方发生干旱，那就更严重了。”

paras.en: And the markets are, indeed, tight. Global average food prices have been trending upwards for about 20 years, says Lobell, thanks to climate blows stacking on top of each other. And this year has brought additional strains. When the U.S. and Israel launched an attack on Iran at the end of February, marine traffic through the Strait of Hormuz ground to a near halt for months. The transport of oil was choked, energy prices spiked, and the supply of fertilizer, which is most often made with hydrogen sourced from cheap natural gas, was severely pinched. The Middle East usually produces a quarter of the world’s fertilizer. Meanwhile, the ongoing war in Ukraine continues to play havoc with the cost of fuel and restrict the transport of wheat from a major hub on the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 市场确实很紧张。洛贝尔表示，由于气候因素相互叠加，全球平均食品价格近 20 年来一直呈上涨趋势。今年还带来了额外的压力。当美国和以色列二月底对伊朗发动袭击时，霍尔木兹海峡的海上交通几乎陷入停滞数月。石油运输受阻，能源价格飙升，化肥（通常由廉价天然气中的氢气制成）的供应也受到严重限制。中东通常生产世界上四分之一的化肥。与此同时，乌克兰持续不断的战争继续对燃料成本造成严重破坏，并限制了黑海主要枢纽的小麦运输。

paras.en: As of October, the warming in the mid-tropical Pacific that’s used to measure the strength of an El Niño hit 3.5 degrees Celsius—breaking the previous record of about 2.75 degrees Celsius—and is on its way to an unprecedented peak of around 4 degrees, according to Hausfather. “That’s scary,” he says. Broadly speaking, he says, the more powerful the El Niño, the more powerful its effects on weather events, including droughts.
paras.zh: Hausfather 表示，截至 10 月，用于测量厄尔尼诺现象强度的中热带太平洋气温升高了 3.5 摄氏度，打破了之前约 2.75 摄氏度的记录，并且正在达到前所未有的峰值，约为 4 摄氏度。 “这太可怕了，”他说。他说，从广义上讲，厄尔尼诺现象越强烈，对包括干旱在内的天气事件的影响就越大。

paras.en: Unusually, this year’s El Niño is the third “strong” El Niño event to hit within a relatively short span of 11 years, which means some areas have been hit repeatedly with drought. The higher-than-usual frequency of El Niños may itself be caused by climate change, some researchers have suggested—though this is still an area of hot debate, Hausfather says.
paras.zh: 不同寻常的是，今年的厄尔尼诺现象是11年来相对较短的时间内发生的第三次“强”厄尔尼诺事件，这意味着一些地区反复遭遇干旱。豪斯法瑟表示，一些研究人员认为，厄尔尼诺现象发生频率高于平常的现象本身可能是由气候变化引起的，尽管这仍然是一个热门争论领域。

paras.en: All these factors act together, with cascading impacts that can take months to develop and last for years. “The confluence of drought and conflict drives some of the worst outcomes we see,” says Richard Choularton, director of climate and resilience for the World Food Programme in Rome. A farmer can’t afford fertilizer; then his fields face drought. In anticipation of a bad year, he plants less and hires fewer people. The river used to transport his crop dries up, and the port that takes it overseas has been bombed out of commission. His cows have little to eat. A year later, he can’t afford to buy groceries or fuel his farming equipment. The lack of rain allows seawater to seep into aquifers, so fresh water gets rationed. Hydropower plants sputter. And on it goes.
paras.zh: 所有这些因素共同作用，产生级联影响，可能需要数月的时间才能形成并持续数年。 “干旱和冲突的共同作用导致了我们所看到的一些最糟糕的结果，”罗马世界粮食计划署气候和复原力主任理查德·乔拉顿(Richard Choularton)说。农民买不起化肥；然后他的田地就会面临干旱。由于预计今年的情况会不好，他减少了种植面积并减少了雇用人员。用于运输农作物的河流已经干涸，将农作物运往海外的港口也被炸毁。他的牛几乎没有东西吃。一年后，他买不起杂货，也买不起农用设备的燃料。由于缺乏降雨，海水会渗入含水层，因此淡水需要定量供应。水力发电厂溅射。就这样继续下去。

paras.en: While any year brings its own spates of bad weather—some of it random, and some made more likely by the pressures of climate change—plenty of events this year have been attributed to El Niño. Among the first to be hit was the Peruvian anchovy fishery, which was closed dramatically early this year to give anchovies a fighting chance in the face of warm waters and less plankton, one of their main food sources. This industry, typically worth between $2 billion and $3 billion, is a huge contributor to global feed for livestock and aquaculture. As of September, global fishmeal output was about half what it was the year before; fishmeal prices have spiked, with some European salmon farmers turning to cheaper chicken byproducts.
paras.zh: 虽然每年都会出现一系列恶劣天气——有些是随机的，有些是由于气候变化的压力而更有可能发生——但今年的很多事件都归因于厄尔尼诺现象。最先受到打击的是秘鲁的凤尾鱼渔业，今年早些时候，该渔业大幅关闭，为凤尾鱼提供了在面临温暖海水和浮游生物减少（其主要食物来源之一）的情况下的生存机会。该行业的价值通常在 20 亿至 30 亿美元之间，是全球牲畜和水产养殖饲料的巨大贡献者。截至9月份，全球鱼粉产量约为上年同期的一半；鱼粉价格飙升，一些欧洲鲑鱼养殖者转向更便宜的鸡肉副产品。

paras.en: In Indonesia, palm oil mills stopped buying fruit from farmers because an ongoing drought shriveled the area’s main transportation artery, the Kapuas River. In Cambodia, a delayed rainy season is drying out rice fields. Panama has declared a national state of emergency (as it did for the 2023 and 2015 El Niños), and the Panama Canal is carrying less ship traffic and transporting less food in the face of dwindling rainfall. In northern Sudan, rainfall totals have been less than half of normal, which is expected to take a toll on both crops and livestock from March to August next year. El Niño-induced drought alongside record summer temperatures in Central America has eaten away at crop yields and threatens that region’s second planting cycle: The E.U.’s Joint Research Centre projects an 83 percent spike in people suffering from acute food insecurity in that area.
paras.zh: 在印度尼西亚，棕榈油厂停止从农民那里购买水果，因为持续的干旱导致该地区的主要交通动脉卡普阿斯河干涸。在柬埔寨，雨季推迟导致稻田干旱。巴拿马已宣布全国进入紧急状态（就像在 2023 年和 2015 年厄尔尼诺现象期间所做的那样），由于降雨量减少，巴拿马运河的船舶运输量和食品运输量都减少了。苏丹北部的降雨量低于正常水平的一半，预计明年 3 月至 8 月将对农作物和牲畜造成影响。厄尔尼诺现象引发的干旱以及中美洲创纪录的夏季气温已经侵蚀了农作物产量，并威胁到该地区的第二个种植周期：欧盟联合研究中心预计，该地区遭受严重粮食不安全的人口将增加 83%。

paras.en: Perhaps surprisingly, the global food production outlook for this growing season isn’t as bad as one might think: The Famine Early Warning Systems Network (FEWS NET) notes that the USDA projects worldwide production of maize, wheat, and rice for 2026-2027 to be just 2.7 percent below the previous year’s production, which will still make it the second-largest annual crop on record.
paras.zh: 也许令人惊讶的是，这个生长季节的全球粮食生产前景并不像人们想象的那么糟糕：饥荒预警系统网络 (FEWS NET) 指出，美国农业部预计 2026 年至 2027 年全球玉米、小麦和稻米产量仅比上一年低 2.7%，但这仍将使其成为有记录以来的第二大年度作物。

paras.en: “Globally, food supply is not of high concern,” says FEWS NET advisor Amy Ostrander. “The concerns are production changes in some specific regions, such as Southern Africa, and food access.” Even if sufficient crops are harvested in those regions, in other words, some food won’t make it to market, and some people won’t be able to afford it.
paras.zh: FEWS NET 顾问艾米·奥斯特兰德 (Amy Ostrander) 表示：“从全球范围来看，粮食供应并不是一个令人高度关注的问题。” “令人担忧的是一些特定地区（例如南部非洲）的生产变化以及粮食获取。”换句话说，即使这些地区收获了足够的农作物，有些食物也无法进入市场，有些人也买不起。

paras.en: An analysis by the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization concludes that the highest risks from El Niño–prompted droughts will be in the Sahel, Southern Africa, South and Southeast Asia, and in Central America’s Dry Corridor and the Caribbean.
paras.zh: 联合国粮食及农业组织的一项分析得出的结论是，厄尔尼诺现象引发的干旱风险最高的地区将是萨赫勒、南部非洲、南亚和东南亚以及中美洲的干旱走廊和加勒比地区。

paras.en: One good thing about an El Niño is that meteorologists can see it coming almost a year in advance, unlike freak weather events, which are harder to forecast. This gives agencies a fighting chance to protect people by distributing drought-resistant seeds, for example, securing deals for future emergency food supplies and transport, or setting up income assistance for struggling farmers.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象的一个好处是，气象学家可以提前几乎一年预见到它的到来，这与难以预测的反常天气事件不同。这为各机构提供了通过分发抗旱种子来保护人们的斗争机会，例如，确保未来紧急粮食供应和运输的交易，或为陷入困境的农民提供收入援助。

paras.en: The World Food Programme first tested its forecast-based financing program in Zimbabwe during the 2015 El Niño: Delivering cash to families in one district facing drought helped them to sustain their quantity and quality of food, while a neighboring district that didn’t receive cash aid saw a massive drop. This year, the WFP has been delivering cash and other assistance, including, for example, more than 3,000 airtight silos for farmers in Guatemala to help them safely store grain. As of October, the program says it has reached 28 million people across 15 countries with early warning information and assistance.
paras.zh: 2015年厄尔尼诺现象期间，世界粮食计划署首次在津巴布韦测试了基于预测的融资计划：向面临干旱的一个地区的家庭提供现金帮助他们维持粮食数量和质量，而邻近的一个没有获得现金援助的地区的粮食数量和质量却大幅下降。今年，粮食计划署一直在提供现金和其他援助，包括为危地马拉农民提供 3000 多个密封筒仓，帮助他们安全储存粮食。截至 10 月，该计划表示已向 15 个国家的 2800 万人提供了预警信息和援助。

paras.en: Cash is strapped for such programs, though. Funds for global aid were down 30 percent in 2025 from their 2022 peak and are still falling, making it hard for the WFP and others to do their work. In Somalia, the WFP helped 10 million people during a drought in 2022; today, in the face of similar conditions, says Choularton, they can afford to reach fewer than a million.
paras.zh: 不过，此类项目的现金短缺。 2025 年全球援助资金较 2022 年的峰值减少了 30%，并且仍在下降，这使得粮食计划署和其他机构难以开展工作。在索马里，粮食计划署在 2022 年的干旱期间为 1000 万人提供了帮助；乔拉顿说，如今，面对类似的情况，他们能负担得起的人数还不到 100 万。

paras.en: Advanced warning is good, says Lobell, but challenges will still abound, and even harder times may lie ahead as El Niños pile on top of climate change. The peaks of strong El Niños are almost always followed by record-breaking years for the global average temperature. The anomalously hot years of 1998, 2016, and 2024 (the current record holder) all followed hot on the heels of El Niño peaks the year before. While 2026 is warm, “2027 is going to be the record-shattering year,” says Hausfather.
paras.zh: 洛贝尔表示，提前预警固然很好，但挑战仍然会比比皆是，而且随着厄尔尼诺现象与气候变化的叠加，未来的日子可能会更加艰难。强烈厄尔尼诺现象的峰值几乎总是伴随着全球平均气温破纪录的年份。 1998 年、2016 年和 2024 年（目前的纪录保持者）异常炎热的年份都紧随前年厄尔尼诺现象的高峰之后。虽然 2026 年很温暖，但“2027 年将是破纪录的一年，”豪斯法瑟说。

paras.en: Global warming, of course, also has impacts on food supply. Last year, Lobell published a paper showing that total wheat, barley, maize, rice, and soybean yields are now altogether about 5 percent lower overall than they would have been in a world without climate change. “To a lot of people, that sounds like a small number. But the kind of shocks that we talk about can be far smaller than that,” he says. “It doesn’t take much of a supply shift to have an important effect on people’s lives.”
paras.zh: 当然，全球变暖也会对粮食供应产生影响。去年，洛贝尔发表的一篇论文显示，小麦、大麦、玉米、水稻和大豆的总产量现在比没有气候变化的世界低约 5%。 “对于很多人来说，这听起来像是一个很小的数字。但我们谈论的那种冲击可能远小于这个数字，”他说。 “不需要太多的供应转移就能对人们的生活产生重要影响。”

paras.en: Because the specific places that get warmer and drier during El Niños are different from the specific places that get warmer and drier from climate change, researchers caution that what we see in 2026 won’t be a precise forerunner of things to come. But how we deal with this temporary challenge does say something about the resilience of our food systems, says Lobell, and it will reveal how we might cope in the future with other climate disruptions to crops. “That’s one of the big questions,” he says. “How much can you adapt when the conditions are bad?”
paras.zh: 由于厄尔尼诺现象期间变得更加温暖和干燥的具体地区与因气候变化而变得更加温暖和干燥的具体地区不同，研究人员警告说，我们在 2026 年看到的情况不会是未来情况的精确预兆。但洛贝尔说，我们如何应对这一暂时的挑战确实说明了我们粮食系统的恢复能力，并且它将揭示我们未来如何应对其他气候对农作物的破坏。 “这是最大的问题之一，”他说。 “当条件恶劣时，你能适应多少？”

articles.title: Scientists Tried to Kill This Dirt, but It Wouldn’t Die
articles.author: Siddhant Pusdekar

paras.en: The original version of this story appeared in Quanta Magazine.
paras.zh: 这个故事的原始版本出现在广达杂志上。

paras.en: For 15 years, Sébastien Fontaine has been trying to kill dirt. The biochemist, who runs a lab at the French National Institute for Agriculture, Food, and Environment, wanted to know how much carbon is released by soil—just dirt alone, completely devoid of life. His team sealed dirt into jars and blasted them with sterilizing gamma radiation. Then they waited for the carbon dioxide released by the soil—a sign of ongoing microbial respiration—to drop.
paras.zh: 15 年来，Sébastien Fontaine 一直致力于消除污垢。这位生物化学家在法国国家农业、食品和环境研究所经营一个实验室，他想知道土壤（只是泥土，完全没有生命）释放了多少碳。他的团队将泥土密封在罐子里，并用伽马射线进行消毒。然后他们等待土壤释放的二氧化碳（微生物正在进行呼吸的迹象）下降。

paras.en: They waited and waited and waited some more: weeks, then months. Under a microscope, the irradiated soil showed no signs of life, but it continued to emit carbon dioxide. The soil wouldn’t stop breathing.
paras.zh: 他们等了又等，又等了几个星期，然后是几个月。在显微镜下观察，受辐射的土壤没有任何生命迹象，但仍不断排放二氧化碳。土壤不会停止呼吸。

paras.en: Fontaine’s lab repeated the experiments and produced the same results. Finally, convinced that they weren’t dealing with an artifact of the experimental setup, they set out to find the source of breath in dead soil.
paras.zh: 方丹的实验室重复了这些实验并得出了相同的结果。最后，他们确信自己处理的不是实验装置的产物，于是开始在死土中寻找呼吸的来源。

paras.en: Now, Fontaine and his colleagues have reported that their soil samples continued to consume oxygen and spew carbon dioxide for six years. In a 2025 paper in Science Advances, they proposed that a metabolic process that powers much of life is also possible outside living cells. Their experiments point to how it could work in dirt, absent the living proteins that would typically organize it. If they’re right, some biochemical reactions, such as those that release the energy of carbon-rich sugar molecules, may not be unique to living things. Such reactions—known as metabolism when performed by cells—could even predate life on Earth, Fontaine said.
paras.zh: 现在，方丹和他的同事报告说，他们的土壤样本六年来持续消耗氧气并喷出二氧化碳。在 2025 年《科学进展》杂志上的一篇论文中，他们提出，为大部分生命提供动力的代谢过程在活细胞外也是可能的。他们的实验表明，在没有通常组织它的活蛋白质的情况下，它如何在污垢中发挥作用。如果他们是对的，那么一些生化反应，例如释放富含碳的糖分子能量的反应，可能并不是生物所独有的。方丹说，这种反应（由细胞进行时被称为新陈代谢）甚至可能早于地球上的生命。

paras.en: The experiments show “what happens to biomolecules when they’re left to their own devices,” said Joseph Moran, an organic chemist at the University of Ottawa who was not involved with the research. They’re finding that the chemistry of life is not exclusive to life, he added. “It’s the chemistry of geology.”
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的渥太华大学有机化学家约瑟夫·莫兰 (Joseph Moran) 表示，这些实验展示了“当生物分子留在自己的设备中时，它们会发生什么”。他补充说，他们发现生命的化学反应并不是生命所独有的。 “这是地质学的化学。”

paras.en: When he made this accidental discovery, Fontaine was trying to establish a baseline for carbon in lifeless soil. Using a sterile syringe, the researchers periodically sampled the air in a hermetically sealed jar containing soil and measured its carbon content using a mass spectrometer. After radiation wiped out the soil microbes, the carbon emission rate declined quickly but didn’t disappear. It remained stable for over 100 days.
paras.zh: 当他偶然发现这一点时，方丹正试图建立无生命土壤中碳的基线。研究人员使用无菌注射器定期对装有土壤的密封罐中的空气进行采样，并使用质谱仪测量其碳含量。辐射消灭了土壤微生物后，碳排放率迅速下降，但并没有消失。 100多天以来一直保持稳定。

paras.en: When he shared the results with other researchers, they advised him to treat it as an experimental artifact—a source of error not worth ferreting out—and move on. But he couldn’t. He needed to understand whether a metabolic process only known to occur in biological cells—a precisely orchestrated sequence of chemical reactions, requiring several molecules and enzymes—was unfolding in sterile soil. To see what was happening, his team added a dash of enzymes extracted from yeast cultures. Immediately, the soil’s carbon emissions spiked. This, they speculated, was because the enzymes had ramped up a reaction that was already happening.
paras.zh: 当他与其他研究人员分享结果时，他们建议他将其视为实验制品（不值得找出的错误来源）并继续前进。但他不能。他需要了解一种已知只发生在生物细胞中的代谢过程（精确协调的化学反应序列，需要多种分子和酶）是否正在无菌土壤中展开。为了了解发生了什么，他的团队添加了少量从酵母培养物中提取的酶。土壤的碳排放量立即激增。他们推测，这是因为酶增强了已经发生的反应。

paras.en: Convincing the scientific community, however, was an uphill battle. When Fontaine submitted the manuscript to journals for publication, some reviewers “were highly positive, and others were really suspicious, especially concerning the sterility of the soil,” he recalled. In 2013 the results were published in the journal Biogeosciences. Still, Fontaine could not rest. Bruised by the harsh reviews, he decided to definitively prove that his irradiated soil samples remained free of life. Over the following decade, his lab would, in fits and starts, chip away at their obsession.
paras.zh: 然而，说服科学界是一场艰苦的战斗。当方丹将手稿提交给期刊出版时，一些审稿人“非常积极，而其他人则非常怀疑，特别是关于土壤的贫瘠”，他回忆道。 2013年，研究结果发表在《生物地球科学》杂志上。尽管如此，方丹仍无法休息。受到严厉评论的打击，他决定明确证明他的经过辐照的土壤样本仍然没有生命。在接下来的十年里，他的实验室断断续续地削弱了他们的痴迷。

paras.en: They considered the possibility that the soil wasn’t really dead and tried to kill it harder with more radiation, pressure, and heat. Still, the soil continued to emit carbon for months.
paras.zh: 他们考虑了土壤并没有真正死亡的可能性，并试图通过更多的辐射、压力和热量来更有效地杀死它。尽管如此，土壤仍持续排放碳数月。

paras.en: Through an electron microscope, Benoit Kéraval, then a graduate student in Fontaine’s lab, found cells in the irradiated soil. But staining showed no RNA or DNA molecules, indicating that the cells were definitely dead. When they experimentally added microbes to simulate contamination, the cells rapidly recolonized the soil microcosm and released much more carbon dioxide. So what they were observing in the sterilized sample likely wasn’t a result of inadequate antiseptic measures.
paras.zh: 时任方丹实验室研究生的伯努瓦·克拉瓦尔 (Benoit Kéraval) 通过电子显微镜在受辐射的土壤中发现了细胞。但染色显示没有 RNA 或 DNA 分子，表明细胞肯定已经死亡。当他们通过实验添加微生物来模拟污染时，细胞迅速在土壤微观世界中重新定居，并释放出更多的二氧化碳。因此，他们在灭菌样本中观察到的情况很可能不是防腐措施不充分的结果。

paras.en: By 2018, when Clémentin Bouquet joined the lab, the team was confident in its findings and ready to dig into the underlying mechanisms.
paras.zh: 2018 年，当 Clémentin Bouquet 加入实验室时，团队对其发现充满信心，并准备深入研究潜在机制。

paras.en: For six years, Bouquet and Kéraval studied two sets of sealed, irradiated soil samples—one of normal soil and one that was supplemented with glucose. For 142 days, they took regular air samples and saw the daily rate of carbon dioxide emissions decline but not disappear, just as they had before. Then the samples sat in an incubator for over 1,000 days, as the researchers focused on their other experiments into how microbes process and store carbon in soil.
paras.zh: 六年来，布凯和凯拉瓦尔研究了两组密封的、经过辐照的土壤样本——一组是普通土壤，一组是补充了葡萄糖的土壤。在 142 天的时间里，他们定期采集空气样本，发现每天的二氧化碳排放量有所下降，但并没有像以前一样消失。然后，这些样本在培养箱中放置了 1000 多天，研究人员则专注于微生物如何处理和储存土壤中的碳的其他实验。

paras.en: When they measured the samples again, at days 1,606 and 2,442, the emissions had slowed further, but the soil was still breathing. The glucose-augmented samples showed higher emission rates, which strengthened Fontaine’s suspicion that nonbiological catalysts in soil can induce reactions that resemble the metabolic breakdown of sugar.
paras.zh: 当他们在第 1,606 天和第 2,442 天再次测量样本时，排放量进一步减慢，但土壤仍在呼吸。葡萄糖增强的样品显示出更高的排放率，这加强了方丹的怀疑，即土壤中的非生物催化剂可以诱发类似于糖代谢分解的反应。

paras.en: During metabolism, sugar is broken down into smaller carbon molecules, which feed the Krebs cycle—a series of reactions in which high-energy electrons are stripped from carbon-rich molecules. Electrons liberated by the Krebs cycle then pass through another set of reactions that consume oxygen. For some researchers, it was a stretch to suggest that this process could unfold outside a cell. Fontaine would need to show that soil can play the same role.
paras.zh: 在新陈代谢过程中，糖被分解成更小的碳分子，为克雷布斯循环提供能量，这是一系列反应，其中高能电子从富含碳的分子中被剥离。克雷布斯循环释放的电子然后通过另一组消耗氧气的反应。对于一些研究人员来说，认为这一过程可以在细胞外展开有些牵强。方丹需要证明土壤也能发挥同样的作用。

paras.en: He devised a fuel cell that could detect electrons zipping through soil in the form of a current. His team added soil that had been irradiated almost five years earlier and then closed the circuit. A current passed through the soil that was several times higher than in a control setup involving a saltwater solution. According to Fontaine, the experiment demonstrated that sterile soil supports a flow of electrons indicative of processes that resemble the oxygen-dependent metabolism of the Krebs cycle.
paras.zh: 他设计了一种燃料电池，可以检测以电流形式穿过土壤的电子。他的团队添加了近五年前经过辐射的土壤，然后关闭了电路。通过土壤的电流比涉及盐水溶液的控制装置高几倍。方丹表示，实验证明，无菌土壤支持电子流，这表明类似于克雷布斯循环的氧依赖性代谢过程。

paras.en: It was once thought that the Krebs cycle cannot occur outside the controlled confines of a cell, which teems with enzymes that keep everything ticking along and increases the chances that biomolecules will bump into each other. In a 2025 preprint on biorxiv.org, Fontaine and colleagues reported observing four of the eight intermediate molecules known to be part of the Krebs cycle in 6-month-old sterile soil samples. Many of these molecules formed after the irradiation.
paras.zh: 人们曾经认为克雷布斯循环不能在细胞的受控范围之外发生，细胞中充满了使一切保持运转并增加生物分子相互碰撞的机会的酶。在 biorxiv.org 上的 2025 年预印本中，Fontaine 及其同事报告称，在 6 个月大的无菌土壤样本中观察到了已知属于克雷布斯循环一部分的八种中间分子中的四种。许多这些分子是在辐射后形成的。

paras.en: According to the authors, their results suggest that clods of earth can indeed catalyze these reactions without the presence of life.
paras.zh: 这组作者说，他们的结果表明，土块确实可以在没有生命存在的情况下催化这些反应。

paras.en: For Joshua Schimel, a soil ecologist at the University of California, Santa Barbara, Fontaine’s findings were not too surprising. “Glucose naturally, in the process of being oxidized, is going to form some of these Krebs-cycle intermediates,” he said. Many soils are rich in iron oxides and aluminum oxides, which can catalyze this conversion, he added.
paras.zh: 对于加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校的土壤生态学家约书亚·希梅尔（Joshua Schimel）来说，方丹的发现并不令人意外。 “葡萄糖在被氧化的过程中自然会形成一些克雷布斯循环中间体，”他说。他补充说，许多土壤富含铁氧化物和铝氧化物，可以催化这种转化。

paras.en: The idea that metals can catalyze biochemical reactions is central to a theory about the origins of life that has emerged over the last decade. Metals such as iron and zinc sit at the core of many of the most ancient enzymes found across life forms. Some researchers, including Moran, believe they might have catalyzed these reactions before life emerged. Studies, including his, suggest that the chemical reactions that break down and construct glucose derivatives, which are normally associated with life, might have existed before the enzymes and genes that enable them in living cells.
paras.zh: 金属可以催化生化反应的想法是过去十年出现的生命起源理论的核心。铁和锌等金属是生命形式中发现的许多最古老酶的核心。包括莫兰在内的一些研究人员认为，他们可能在生命出现之前就催化​​了这些反应。包括他在内的研究表明，分解和构建通常与生命相关的葡萄糖衍生物的化学反应可能早于在活细胞中启用它们的酶和基因就已经存在。

paras.en: “There’s a handful of researchers like myself that think, actually, we should organize our thoughts about life in a different way—that we actually should put metabolism at the base of what life is doing and then genes are a way of controlling that at a higher level,” Moran said.
paras.zh: “有一些像我这样的研究人员认为，实际上，我们应该以不同的方式组织我们对生命的思考——我们实际上应该将新陈代谢置于生命正在发生的事情的基础上，然后基因是在更高水平上控制新陈代谢的一种方式，”莫兰说。

paras.en: Cell-free metabolic reactions could be more common than previously thought and don’t need special conditions to get started, said Markus Ralser, a biochemist at Charité University Hospital in Berlin, who found some of the first enzyme-free metabolic reactions.
paras.zh: 柏林夏里特大学医院的生物化学家马库斯·拉瑟 (Markus Ralser) 发现了一些第一个无酶代谢反应，他说，无细胞代谢反应可能比以前想象的更常见，并且不需要特殊条件即可开始。

paras.en: “This fits a bit into my thinking about how metabolism started in evolution,” he said of the new work. “If it would be very hard to do, then the planet would not be full of life now.” This idea is complicated, however, by the low-oxygen conditions in which life arose.
paras.zh: “这有点符合我对新陈代谢如何在进化中开始的思考，”他在谈到这项新工作时说道。 “如果这很难做到，那么这个星球现在就不会充满生命了。”然而，由于生命诞生的低氧条件，这个想法变得复杂。

paras.en: Another explanation for the observed results could be that enzymes, loosed from the irradiated cells, might be hanging around in the soil and continuing their biochemical jobs. Even when degraded, enzymes have stable backbones that might be capable of catalyzing reactions, said Sudha Rajamani, an astrobiologist at the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Pune who wasn’t involved in the study.
paras.zh: 对观察到的结果的另一种解释可能是，从受辐射的细胞中释放出来的酶可能徘徊在土壤中并继续其生化工作。浦那印度科学教育与研究学院的天体生物学家苏达·拉贾马尼（Sudha Rajamani）表示，即使酶被降解，也具有稳定的骨架，可能能够催化反应。他没有参与这项研究。

paras.en: Ralser agrees with her. “My gut feeling is they still have a lot of enzymes there [in Fontaine’s irradiated soil], even after six years,” he said. To know whether metals and minerals in soil could spontaneously carry out these reactions, the researchers would have to eliminate enzymes from the mixture. But that’s really hard: They would have to get the soil so hot that it would damage the soil structure itself.
paras.zh: 拉瑟同意她的观点。 “我的直觉是，即使六年过去了，[方丹受辐射的土壤]仍然含有大量酶，”他说。为了了解土壤中的金属和矿物质是否可以自发地进行这些反应，研究人员必须从混合物中消除酶。但这确实很难：他们必须使土壤变得非常热，以至于会损坏土壤结构本身。

paras.en: However, the activity of such enzymes diminishes “exponentially” after they spill out of cells, Bouquet said. Plus, no enzyme is known to last six years, Fontaine added. He doesn’t doubt that enzymes released by living and recently dead cells contribute to carbon emissions in real-world soils, but the long-term experimental results make it “very unlikely that the respiration we observed is due to enzymes,” he said.
paras.zh: 然而，布凯说，这些酶的活性在溢出细胞后“呈指数级”减弱。此外，方丹补充说，目前还没有已知的酶可以持续六年。他并不怀疑活细胞和最近死亡的细胞释放的酶会导致现实世界土壤中的碳排放，但长期实验结果表明“我们观察到的呼吸作用不太可能是由酶引起的”，他说。

paras.en: For Bouquet, chasing this years-long obsession has highlighted that “even in a context as close and familiar to us as terrestrial soil, we are not always able to distinguish or recognize processes that indicate the presence or absence of living organisms.” Now a researcher at the Collège de France and the National Museum of Natural History in Paris, he is looking for prebiotic origins of other biochemical cascades.
paras.zh: 对于 Bouquet 来说，对这种长达数年的痴迷的追求突显了“即使在我们像陆地土壤这样接近和熟悉的环境中，我们并不总是能够区分或识别表明生物体存在或不存在的过程。”现在，他是法兰西学院和巴黎国家自然历史博物馆的研究员，正在寻找其他生化级联的益生元起源。

paras.en: “I find it particularly interesting to imagine the survival of processes that may predate life itself,” Bouquet said, “right there under our feet.”
paras.zh: 布凯说：“我发现想象可能早于生命本身的过程的生存特别有趣，就在我们脚下。”

paras.en: Original story reprinted with permission from Quanta Magazine, an editorially independent publication of the Simons Foundation whose mission is to enhance public understanding of science by covering research developments and trends in mathematics and the physical and life sciences.
paras.zh: 原创故事经广达杂志 (Quanta Magazine) 许可转载，该杂志是西蒙斯基金会 (Simons Foundation) 的独立编辑出版物，其使命是通过报道数学、物理和生命科学的研究进展和趋势来增强公众对科学的理解。

articles.title: Banks Have Had It Up to Here With Your AI Agent
articles.author: Reece Rogers

paras.en: Wells Fargo is set to enact an updated agreement with millions of customers, specifically about AI agents, starting on Tuesday. The bank’s warning to early adopters could not be clearer. “Your use of any AI Agent is AT YOUR OWN RISK,” read Wells Fargo’s new terms.
paras.zh: 富国银行将于周二开始与数百万客户签署更新后的协议，特别是关于人工智能代理的协议。该银行对早期采用者的警告再明确不过了。富国银行的新条款中写道：“使用任何人工智能代理的风险由您自行承担。”

paras.en: AI agents, which automate online tasks and click on your behalf, have stumbled through 2026. They remain nascent technology, but a growing subset of power users latched onto the personal bots this year. Sometimes these early adopters enjoyed the efficient help of automation, and other times they publicly embarrassed themselves when the AI agents made major mistakes, like posting bank details for everyone at work to see.
paras.zh: 人工智能代理可以自动执行在线任务并代表您进行点击，但在 2026 年仍举步维艰。它们仍然是新兴技术，但今年越来越多的高级用户开始使用个人机器人。有时，这些早期采用者享受自动化的高效帮助，而有时，当人工智能代理犯下重大错误时，他们会公开感到尴尬，比如发布银行详细信息供工作中的每个人查看。

paras.en: Builders of these AI tools often market agents as the ultimate tool for shopping decisions, whether that’s putting together a grocery order, finding accommodations for a vacation, or discovering specific holiday gifts for your parents. I’ve used an agent to help shop for a new couch, comparing options within a specific budget and tracking price drops.
paras.zh: 这些人工智能工具的开发者经常将代理作为购物决策的终极工具来营销，无论是整理杂货订单、寻找假期住宿，还是为父母寻找特定的节日礼物。我曾聘请代理商帮助购买新沙发，比较特定预算内的选项并跟踪价格下降情况。

paras.en: Some users value these agents so much that they are oblivious to the overarching security concerns, pairing account credentials and granting permissions for the agents to take sweeping actions without forethought. Although the segment of online transactions completed by these autonomous tools remains minuscule, US-based banking institutions are already sick of third-party AI agents.
paras.zh: 一些用户非常重视这些代理，以至于他们忽视了首要的安全问题，配对帐户凭据并授予代理未经深思熟虑地采取全面行动的权限。尽管这些自主工具完成的在线交易部分仍然很小，但美国的银行机构已经厌倦了第三方人工智能代理。

paras.en: It’s not just banks; AI agents are igniting turf wars around the web. Amazon, one of the largest online retailers, blocked Meta’s Muse, one of the most widely used AI agents, from making purchases on its platform. Travel companies are also pushing back—United recently announced that personal bots would be blocked from purchasing flights on your behalf.
paras.zh: 不仅仅是银行；还有银行。人工智能代理正在引发网络地盘争夺战。最大的在线零售商之一亚马逊阻止了 Meta 的 Muse（使用最广泛的人工智能代理之一）在其平台上进行购物。旅游公司也在反击——美联航最近宣布将禁止个人机器人代表你购买航班。

paras.en: As the end of the year approaches, multiple banks have enacted new policies around agents or sent warnings. In late October, JPMorgan Chase changed its terms to ban third-party agents that log in with your credentials. That same day, Bank of America warned its customers not to share login info with agents. Along with the announced change coming from Wells Fargo, Citibank and PNC have also changed their terms to include warnings about agents.
paras.zh: 随着年底的临近，多家银行针对代理商出台了新政策或发出了警告。 10 月下旬，摩根大通更改了条款，禁止使用您的凭据登录的第三方代理。同一天，美国银行警告其客户不要与代理分享登录信息。随着富国银行宣布这一变化，花旗银行和 PNC 也更改了条款，纳入对代理人的警告。

paras.en: The automation, which remains a central selling point of always-on agents, is exactly what may get users in trouble. “Consumers authorize goals, not every click,” says Kacy Kim, an associate professor of marketing at Bryant University who studies consumer behavior and emerging tech. While Kim expects some consumers to feel like it's unfair to be held accountable for their agent’s mistakes, she doesn’t expect these policy moves by financial institutions to scare off the early-adopter crowd already in deep and using the tools as part of everyday life.
paras.zh: 自动化仍然是永远在线代理的核心卖点，但也可能会给用户带来麻烦。 “消费者授权目标，而不是每次点击，”布莱恩特大学营销学副教授凯西·金（Kacy Kim）说，他研究消费者行为和新兴技术。虽然 Kim 预计一些消费者会觉得为其代理人的错误承担责任是不公平的，但她并不认为金融机构的这些政策举措会吓跑已经深入使用这些工具并将其作为日常生活一部分的早期采用者群体。

paras.en: Banks appear to be trying to get ahead of major issues, in case agentic tools stick around and don’t just disappear as another tech fad. “All of our data shows that most people don't even know what agents are, much less use them,” says Sucharita Kodali, a Forrester analyst who focuses on ecommerce and consumer behavior. She sees banks as fundamentally risk-averse, so taking proactive measures now makes sense, even if most agentic issues remain edge cases.
paras.zh: 银行似乎正在努力解决重大问题，以防代理工具继续存在，而不会作为另一种科技时尚而消失。 “我们所有的数据都表明，大多数人甚至不知道代理是什么，更不用说使用它们了，”专注于电子商务和消费者行为的 Forrester 分析师 Sucharita Kodali 表示。她认为银行从根本上规避风险，因此现在采取积极措施是有意义的，即使大多数代理问题仍然是边缘案例。

paras.en: “The banks see risks with everything,” she says. “From the security of transactions to automated withdrawals that could happen to the detriment of account holders.”
paras.zh: “银行看到一切都有风险，”她说。 “从交易安全到自动提款，都可能损害账户持有人的利益。”

paras.en: Even though outliers exist, many users are aware of the risks and are only comfortable handing over so much control to an AI agent, and only for certain shopping tasks. “People are very comfortable with AI buying toilet paper,” says Luca Cian, a professor at the University of Virginia who studies consumer psychology and AI.
paras.zh: 尽管存在异常值，但许多用户都意识到了风险，并且只愿意将如此多的控制权交给人工智能代理，而且仅限于某些购物任务。 “人们对人工智能购买卫生纸感到非常满意，”弗吉尼亚大学研究消费者心理学和人工智能的教授卢卡·西安 (Luca Cian) 说。

paras.en: He sees consumers as increasingly comfortable turning to AI tools for shopping advice but often only automating boring buys, like household supplies. Shoppers are less comfortable automating away dynamic, big-ticket purchases that require additional care and discretion.
paras.zh: 他认为消费者越来越习惯使用人工智能工具来获取购物建议，但通常只会自动进行无聊的购买，例如家居用品。购物者不愿意自动进行动态的大额购买，因为这些购买需要额外的谨慎和谨慎。

paras.en: Cian gives a hypothetical scenario where a customer’s AI agent accidentally buys 10 roasted chickens from the supermarket. Who’s to blame? The retailer would likely argue that they completed a valid order that you placed. The AI builder may claim that they just provided the software, and even included disclaimers about potential mistakes. And now your bank is making it clear they don’t want to be held responsible either. Hope you need the protein, because it looks like you just bought 10 hot chickens.
paras.zh: Cian 假设了一个场景，客户的 AI 代理不小心从超市购买了 10 只烤鸡。谁该受责备？零售商可能会辩称他们完成了您下的有效订单。人工智能构建者可能会声称他们只是提供了软件，甚至还包含了有关潜在错误的免责声明。现在你的银行明确表示他们也不想承担责任。希望你需要蛋白质，因为看起来你刚刚买了 10 只热鸡。

paras.en: Certain credit cards, though, are looking into limited protections for shoppers. Mainly, American Express announced that some agentic mistakes, like ordering too many of a certain item, may be eligible for reimbursement in the future through the card provider if you can't get your money back from the original retailer.
paras.zh: 不过，某些信用卡正在考虑对购物者提供有限的保护。主要是，美国运通宣布，如果您无法从原始零售商那里取回退款，那么一些代理错误（例如订购过多的某种商品）可能有资格在未来通过信用卡提供商获得补偿。

paras.en: Banks are pumping out reasonable warnings about third-party agents, but don’t get it twisted. These banks are all-in on first-party tools. “Banks are doing two things at once,” Cian says. “They're locking the door to outside agents and building their own.” Users have interacted with Wells Fargo’s tool that answers questions using generative AI over a billion times. Bank of America revamped its new EricaAssist agent this year to help employees. Citigroup even launched an internal development platform specifically centered on agents.
paras.zh: 银行对第三方代理发出了合理的警告，但不要曲解。这些银行全力使用第一方工具。 “银行同时做两件事，”希安说。 “他们对外部特工关闭了大门，并建立了自己的特工。”用户已与富国银行的工具进行交互，该工具使用生成式人工智能回答问题超过十亿次。美国银行今年改进了新的 EricaAssist 代理以帮助员工。花旗集团甚至推出了专门针对代理商的内部发展平台。

paras.en: Despite all the hype, Kodali remains skeptical about whether all of this hoopla is even necessary. “The issue with agents and shopping is that, first of all, it is not difficult to buy on Amazon or Walmart or anywhere else,” she says. “In most of those transactions, you don't need an agent.” Agentic shopping often seems to be a solution in search of a problem. Or at least an attempt by AI builders to find a way to earn affiliate revenue, eventually, from their software tools.
paras.zh: 尽管大肆宣传，科达利仍然怀疑所有这些喧嚣是否有必要。 “代理和购物的问题在于，首先，在亚马逊、沃尔玛或其他任何地方购买并不困难，”她说。 “在大多数交易中，你不需要代理人。”代理购物似乎常常是寻找问题的解决方案。或者至少是人工智能开发者试图找到一种最终从他们的软件工具中赚取附属收入的方法。

paras.en: Whether AI agents grow in popularity for shopping automation or slowly fade into the digital graveyard, banks are already resolute on the matter. It’s your bot, and your problem.
paras.zh: 无论人工智能代理在购物自动化中越来越受欢迎，还是慢慢淡入数字坟墓，银行都已经在这个问题上态度坚决。这是你的机器人，也是你的问题。

articles.title: Molly Meldrum, Australian Music Broadcaster and ‘Countdown’ Host, Dies at 83
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Ian “Molly” Meldrum, the Australian broadcaster, journalist and record producer whose weekly television show made stars of international and local acts alike, died Monday (Nov. 23) at Epworth Hospital in Richmond, Melbourne. He was 83.
paras.zh: 伊恩·“莫莉”·梅尔德鲁姆 (Ian “Molly” Meldrum) 于周一（11 月 23 日）在墨尔本里士满的 Epworth 医院去世。他83岁了。

paras.en: His family said he died peacefully after a long period of ill health. “Affectionately dubbed ‘The Guru,’ Molly was the heartbeat, the champion and the spirit of Australian music,” they said in a statement. “He shaped not only the sound of a nation but also the dreams of generations who grew up with his voice guiding them.” He is survived by his long-term partner, Yan Wongngam.
paras.zh: 他的家人表示，他在长期健康状况不佳后平静地去世。他们在一份声明中表示：“莫莉被亲切地称为‘大师’，她是澳大利亚音乐的心跳者、冠军和精神。” “他不仅塑造了一个国家的声音，也塑造了在他的声音指导下长大的几代人的梦想。”他的长期伴侣 Yan Wongngam 去世了。

paras.en: From 1974 to 1987, Meldrum presented Countdown, the ABC’s Sunday-evening music program, which he co-created with executive producer Michael Shrimpton and producer-director Robbie Weekes.
