paras.zh: 关于 DHV 技术 https://dhvtechnology.com/

articles.title: Cosmo Bee to flight-test Honeybee Hall thruster with D-Orbit in 2027
articles.author: Cosmo Bee

paras.en: Daejeon, Republic of Korea – October 14, 2026: South Korean space electric propulsion startup Cosmo Bee plans to conduct an in-orbit flight test of its 10 mN-class Honeybee Hall thruster system in October 2027 through a service agreement with D-Orbit.
paras.zh: 韩国大田 – 2026 年 10 月 14 日：韩国太空电力推进初创公司 Cosmo Bee 计划通过与 D-Orbit 签订的服务协议，于 2027 年 10 月对其 10 mN 级 Honeybee Hall 推进器系统进行在轨飞行测试。

paras.en: Honeybee is a 10 mN-class Hall thruster system under development by Cosmo Bee for small satellites operating in LEO constellations.
paras.zh: Honeybee 是 Cosmo Bee 正在为在 LEO 星座运行的小型卫星开发的 10 mN 级霍尔推进器系统。

paras.en: “In-orbit validation is an essential step as we prepare to bring Honeybee to the commercial market,” said Dongha Park, co-founder and CEO of Cosmo Bee. “D-Orbit is an ideal partner to help us achieve that goal.”
paras.zh: Cosmo Bee 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Dongha Park 表示：“在轨验证是我们准备将 Honeybee 推向商业市场的重要一步。” “D-Orbit 是帮助我们实现这一目标的理想合作伙伴。”

paras.en: “Hosting in-orbit demonstrations is one of the core services we offer aboard ION,” said Matteo Lorenzoni, Director of the Orbital Access Business Unit at D-Orbit. “Honeybee will operate in the real space environment, with our mission operations team supporting the test throughout, so Cosmo Bee comes away with the performance data it needs to take the thruster to market.” This test will evaluate Honeybee’s key performance parameters, including thrust and specific impulse, under various operating conditions.
paras.zh: “举办在轨演示是我们在 ION 上提供的核心服务之一，”D-Orbit 轨道接入业务部总监 Matteo Lorenzoni 说道。 “Honeybee 将在真实的太空环境中运行，我们的任务运营团队全程支持测试，因此 Cosmo Bee 可以获得将推进器推向市场所需的性能数据。”该测试将评估 Honeybee 在各种操作条件下的关键性能参数，包括推力和比冲量。

paras.en: “For satellite operators choosing a propulsion system, flight heritage is often what decides the purchase”, commented Matteo Zeni, Head of Sales of D-Orbit’s Orbital Access Business Unit. “Our in-orbit demonstration service gives technology developers like Cosmo Bee a direct route to space and the data they need to move from qualification to a commercial product. We look forward to flying Honeybee next year.”
paras.zh: “对于选择推进系统的卫星运营商来说，飞行传统往往是决定购买的因素”，D-Orbit 轨道接入业务部销售主管 Matteo Zeni 评论道。 “我们的在轨演示服务为 Cosmo Bee 等技术开发人员提供了直接进入太空的途径，以及他们从资格认证转向商业产品所需的数据。我们期待明年让 Honeybee 飞行。”

paras.en: Through the partnership, Cosmo Bee plans to establish flight heritage for Honeybee while preparing for the system’s commercial introduction in 2027. The company intends to make Honeybee available to satellite operators and mission developers seeking electric propulsion systems for small spacecraft.
paras.zh: 通过此次合作，Cosmo Bee 计划为 Honeybee 建立飞行遗产，同时为 2027 年该系统的商业推出做准备。该公司打算将 Honeybee 提供给卫星运营商和寻求小型航天器电力推进系统的任务开发商。

paras.en: Cosmo Bee was founded in July 2023 as a spin-off from the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), building on electric propulsion research conducted by Professor Wonho Choe’s team since 2003.
paras.zh: Cosmo Bee 成立于 2023 年 7 月，是韩国科学技术院 (KAIST) 的一个衍生公司，其基础是 Wonho Choe 教授团队自 2003 年以来进行的电力推进研究。

paras.en: In November 2025, the company launched its first space mission, K-HERO, a 3U CubeSat designed to demonstrate the operation of a 150 W-class Hall thruster in orbit. The spacecraft was launched aboard South Korea’s KSLV-2 launch vehicle.
paras.zh: 2025 年 11 月，该公司发射了其首次太空任务 K-HERO，这是一颗 3U 立方体卫星，旨在演示 150 W 级霍尔推进器在轨道上的运行。该航天器是由韩国的 KSLV-2 运载火箭发射升空的。

paras.en: In June 2026, the Korea AeroSpace Administration (KASA) designated Cosmo Bee’s 10 mN-class Hall thruster and hollow cathode technologies as “New Space Technologies.” The company also raised $5 million in a Series A funding round that month.
paras.zh: 2026 年 6 月，韩国宇宙航空管理局 (KASA) 将 Cosmo Bee 的 10 mN 级霍尔推进器和空心阴极技术指定为“新空间技术”。该公司还在当月的 A 轮融资中筹集了 500 万美元。

paras.en: “Cosmo Bee is growing alongside the rapidly expanding demand for LEO satellite constellations in South Korea,” Park said. “We hope Honeybee can support customers developing the next generation of small satellite constellations.”
paras.zh: Park 表示：“随着韩国对 LEO 卫星星座需求的快速增长，Cosmo Bee 也在不断发展。” “我们希望 Honeybee 能够支持客户开发下一代小型卫星星座。”

articles.title: Flexell Space and ALATYR Sign MoU to Explore Solar Power Solutions for Orbital Data Centers
articles.author: Flexell Space

paras.en: – Collaboration to assess next-generation ultralight solar cells for space-based computing infrastructure
paras.zh: – 合作评估用于天基计算基础设施的下一代超轻太阳能电池

paras.en: – Partnership brings together Korean space energy technology and French orbital infrastructure expertise
paras.zh: – 合作伙伴关系汇集了韩国空间能源技术和法国轨道基础设施专业知识

paras.en: Bremen, Germany – Flexell Space, a space energy company, announced that it has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with ALATYR, a French company developing orbital data centers, to explore solar power solutions for space-based computing infrastructure.
paras.zh: 德国不来梅 – 空间能源公司 Flexell Space 宣布与开发轨道数据中心的法国公司 ALATYR 签署了一份谅解备忘录 (MoU)，共同探索用于天基计算基础设施的太阳能解决方案。

paras.en: The collaboration will assess the potential application of Flexell Space’s next-generation solar cell technology to orbital infrastructure designed for large-scale computing and data storage. The companies intend to exchange technical requirements relating to power demand and operating conditions and explore opportunities for future joint development and validation.
paras.zh: 此次合作将评估 Flexell Space 的下一代太阳能电池技术在专为大规模计算和数据存储而设计的轨道基础设施中的潜在应用。两家公司打算交换有关电力需求和运行条件的技术要求，并探索未来联合开发和验证的机会。

paras.en: ALATYR develops orbital data centers designed to support artificial intelligence (AI) computing and mission-critical workloads. Its CITADEL modular infrastructure architecture and BYLD robotic system are designed to enable assembly, maintenance, and upgrades in orbit. The architecture separates the service life of the supporting infrastructure from the replacement cycle of computing hardware, enabling computing modules to be renewed in orbit while retaining the infrastructure that powers, cools, and supports them.
paras.zh: ALATYR 开发轨道数据中心，旨在支持人工智能 (AI) 计算和关键任务工作负载。其 CITADEL 模块化基础设施架构和 BYLD 机器人系统旨在实现在轨组装、维护和升级。该架构将支持基础设施的使用寿命与计算硬件的更换周期分开，使计算模块能够在轨道上更新，同时保留为其供电、冷却和支持的基础设施。

paras.en: Reliable power generation is essential to making orbital data centers viable. As these facilities grow, solar power systems must address not only electrical performance but also mass, launch and deployment efficiency, manufacturing costs, and long-term reliability.
paras.zh: 可靠的发电对于轨道数据中心的可行性至关重要。随着这些设施的发展，太阳能系统不仅必须解决电气性能问题，还必须解决质量、发射和部署效率、制造成本和长期可靠性问题。

paras.en: Flexell Space is developing next-generation space solar cells based on CIGS (copper indium gallium selenide) and perovskite technologies. With a focus on lightweight, flexible designs and large-area manufacturing, the company aims to provide power solutions for satellites and larger space infrastructure. Through the collaboration, Flexell Space intends to gain a clearer understanding of orbital data center requirements and assess how its technology could support this emerging application.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 正在开发基于 CIGS（铜铟镓硒）和钙钛矿技术的下一代太空太阳能电池。该公司专注于轻量化、灵活设计和大面积制造，旨在为卫星和更大的空间基础设施提供电源解决方案。通过此次合作，Flexell Space 打算更清楚地了解轨道数据中心的要求，并评估其技术如何支持这一新兴应用。

paras.en: “This MoU marks an important milestone in strengthening cooperation between Korea and Europe, particularly France, in space energy and infrastructure,” said Kyumin Lee, Business Development Manager at Flexell Space. “By combining our next-generation solar cell technology with ALATYR’s orbital infrastructure expertise, we aim to build a lasting partnership and lay the groundwork for joint development and validation of power solutions for future orbital data centers.”
paras.zh: Flexell Space 业务开发经理 Kyumin Lee 表示：“这份谅解备忘录标志着韩国与欧洲（特别是法国）在空间能源和基础设施领域加强合作的一个重要里程碑。” “通过将我们的下一代太阳能电池技术与 ALATYR 的轨道基础设施专业知识相结合，我们的目标是建立持久的合作伙伴关系，并为未来轨道数据中心电力解决方案的联合开发和验证奠定基础。”

paras.en: He added, “By bringing together our complementary capabilities, we aim to establish a practical foundation for future development and validation.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“通过整合我们的互补能力，我们的目标是为未来的开发和验证奠定实用的基础。”

paras.en: “Our orbital infrastructure is designed to serve successive generations of computing hardware,” said Emeric Lhomme, Chief Executive Officer of ALATYR. “That makes solar cell efficiency and longevity central to our approach: our power systems must continue to deliver reliable performance as computing modules are replaced and upgraded. With Flexell Space, we will explore how next-generation lightweight solar technologies could meet the demands of that extended service life.”
paras.zh: ALATYR 首席执行官埃默里克·洛姆 (Emeric Lhomme) 表示：“我们的轨道基础设施旨在为连续几代的计算硬件提供服务。” “这使得太阳能电池的效率和寿命成为我们方法的核心：随着计算模块的更换和升级，我们的电力系统必须继续提供可靠的性能。通过 Flexell Space，我们将探索下一代轻型太阳能技术如何满足延长使用寿命的需求。”

paras.en: The companies plan to begin by exchanging information on their technologies and development priorities, followed by a phased assessment of solar cell and power system compatibility. Specific development activities and validation approaches will be discussed through subsequent technical consultations.
paras.zh: 两家公司计划首先交换有关技术和开发优先事项的信息，然后对太阳能电池和电力系统的兼容性进行分阶段评估。具体的开发活动和验证方法将通过后续技术磋商进行讨论。

paras.en: Flexell Space is a space energy company that originated as an internal venture at Hanwha Systems. The company develops next-generation space solar cells and power solutions based on CIGS and perovskite technologies, with a focus on low-cost, large-area, ultralight products. Through collaboration with global partners, Flexell Space is advancing the commercialization of solar cell technologies for satellites and a broad range of space infrastructure.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 是一家空间能源公司，最初是韩华系统公司的内部合资企业。该公司开发基于CIGS和钙钛矿技术的下一代空间太阳能电池和电源解决方案，重点是低成本、大面积、超轻产品。通过与全球合作伙伴的合作，Flexell Space 正在推进卫星太阳能电池技术和广泛的空间基础设施的商业化。

paras.en: ALATYR is a French company developing a new layer of critical digital infrastructure in space. The company designs orbital data centers that evolve with computing technology, rather than being replaced with each hardware generation. Its infrastructure is designed to remain productive over the long term and expand with demand, creating a lasting extension of the cloud in orbit to increase computing capacity and strengthen the resilience of essential digital services worldwide.
paras.zh: ALATYR 是一家法国公司，正在开发太空关键数字基础设施的新层。该公司设计的轨道数据中心随着计算技术的发展而发展，而不是随着每一代硬件的发展而更换。其基础设施旨在长期保持生产力并根据需求进行扩展，在轨道上创建云的持久扩展，以提高计算能力并增强全球基本数字服务的弹性。

articles.title: New NASA Seed Funding Primes Small Businesses for Innovation
articles.author: Abby Tabor

paras.en: Awards to small businesses around the country are addressing some of NASA’s most crucial technology needs for exploration of the Moon and Mars while fueling the U.S. space economy.
paras.zh: 向全国各地小企业颁发的奖项正在解决美国宇航局探索月球和火星的一些最关键的技术需求，同时推动美国太空经济。

paras.en: NASA’s Small Business Innovation Research/Small Business Technology Transfer (SBIR/STTR) program recently selected 302 innovative projects, for a total investment of up to $171 million in seed funding.
paras.zh: NASA 的小型企业创新研究/小型企业技术转让 (SBIR/STTR) 计划最近选出了 302 个创新项目，种子资金总投资高达 1.71 亿美元。

paras.en: This early-stage research and development work will tackle an array of topics, including those related to Artemis and the establishment of a U.S. Moon Base. Selected projects include next-generation battery solutions, robotic systems with sensing capabilities for the extreme lunar environment, and tools to prepare for construction of critical infrastructure, such as lunar landing pads.
paras.zh: 这项早期研发工作将解决一系列主题，包括与阿耳忒弥斯和建立美国月球基地相关的主题。选定的项目包括下一代电池解决方案、具有针对极端月球环境的传感能力的机器人系统，以及为建造月球着陆场等关键基础设施做准备的工具。

paras.en: NASA’s SBIR/STTR program provides support for entrepreneurs, startups, and small businesses to advance and commercialize technologies that can advance the agency’s missions. Working with the program, a company’s path toward commercialization or infusion into NASA missions occurs in phases. The latest awards involved two of these phases.
paras.zh: NASA 的 SBIR/STTR 计划为企业家、初创公司和小型企业提供支持，以推进可推进该机构使命的技术并将其商业化。通过该项目，公司的商业化或融入 NASA 任务的道路是分阶段进行的。最新的奖项涉及其中两个阶段。

paras.en: The new Phase I contracts will receive up to $225,000 each to establish the merit and feasibility of their proposed innovation. A portion of the projects selected are STTR awards, provided to small businesses partnered with research institutions.
paras.zh: 新的第一阶段合同每份将获得高达 225,000 美元的资金，以确定其拟议创新的优点和可行性。选定的部分项目是 STTR 奖项，提供给与研究机构合作的小型企业。

paras.en: The Phase II awards, with 98 contracts valued at up to $1.3 million each, will continue work begun in Phase I projects selected in 2025, targeting demonstration and delivery of the innovative technologies.
paras.zh: 第二阶段授予的 98 份合同每份价值高达 130 万美元，将继续在 2025 年选定的第一阶段项目中开始的工作，旨在示范和交付创新技术。

paras.en: Following are a few examples of research supported through these recent awards:
paras.zh: 以下是最近这些奖项支持的一些研究示例：

paras.en: An SBIR Phase II award for Opterus Research and Development Inc. supports a project focused on bringing power to the surface of the Moon and Mars by developing a modular system of rollable solar arrays. The arrays can be handled robotically, are compatible with various support structures, and work even in dusty surface conditions. The technology could be scaled up to 50 kilowatts, and it could provide a reliable power source to help both NASA and commercial space companies develop infrastructure on the Moon.
paras.zh: Opterus Research and Development Inc. 获得的 SBIR 第二阶段奖项支持了一个项目，该项目的重点是通过开发可卷曲太阳能电池阵列的模块化系统为月球和火星表面提供电力。该阵列可以由机器人处理，与各种支撑结构兼容，甚至可以在多尘的表面条件下工作。该技术可以扩展到 50 千瓦，并且可以提供可靠的电源来帮助 NASA 和商业航天公司在月球上开发基础设施。

paras.en: - Rovers With Reach: Vision and Tactile Sensing in Robotic Arm
paras.zh: - Rovers With Reach：机械臂中的视觉和触觉感知

paras.en: This SBIR Phase I award, led by Intelligent Fiber Optic Systems Corporation, aims to help lunar rovers perform complex tasks independently on the Moon. The firm’s 10-foot, extendable robotic arm can both “see” and has a sense of touch, combining a camera with sensors to detect and measure surface textures, contact forces, and temperature. The technology could help automate many lunar surface tasks, such as cleaning solar panels, positioning habitat structures, and collecting scientific samples from hard-to-reach locations. On Earth, the same instrumented robotic arms could be used to inspect and repair power lines, nuclear reactors, or other infrastructure in hazardous environments.
paras.zh: 该 SBIR 第一阶段奖项由智能光纤系统公司牵头，旨在帮助月球车在月球上独立执行复杂的任务。该公司的 10 英尺可伸缩机械臂既可以“看到”又具有触觉，将摄像头与传感器结合起来，检测和测量表面纹理、接触力和温度。该技术可以帮助许多月球表面任务实现自动化，例如清洁太阳能电池板、定位栖息地结构以及从难以到达的地点收集科学样本。在地球上，同样的仪器化机械臂可用于检查和修复危险环境中的电线、核反应堆或其他基础设施。

paras.en: - Cold-Friendly Battery for Long Lunar Night
paras.zh: - 寒冷友好型电池，适合漫长的农历夜晚

paras.en: Elementium Materials Inc., selected for an SBIR Phase I award, is developing an ultra-cold-tolerant battery module for space applications and cold-climate uses on Earth. The technology can operate down to minus 76 degrees Fahrenheit without active heating, reducing the need for heaters and insulating layers to work on the Moon. With the space and mass that’s saved, NASA missions can launch other tools and science experiments, instead. This battery technology could help keep rovers, habitats, and other infrastructure running through the frigid, 14-day lunar night and potentially on Mars.
paras.zh: Elementium Materials Inc. 荣获 SBIR 第一阶段奖，正在开发一种用于太空应用和地球寒冷气候用途的超耐寒电池模块。该技术可以在低至-76华氏度的温度下运行，无需主动加热，从而减少了在月球上工作时对加热器和绝缘层的需求。通过节省的空间和质量，美国宇航局的任务可以发射其他工具和科学实验。这种电池技术可以帮助火星车、栖息地和其他基础设施在寒冷的 14 天月球夜晚以及可能在火星上保持运行。

paras.en: - Prepare for Landing — Repeatedly — on Moon
paras.zh: - 反复准备登陆月球

paras.en: A collaboration between Slate Geotechnical Consultants Inc. and the Colorado School of Mines will evaluate two approaches to preparing lunar regolith for repeated lunar landings, so that routine mission activities can have sturdy, reusable landing pads. Without such pads, the force generated by a rocket can blast out loose, gravel-like regolith from the surface, throw up dust, or create craters, potentially damaging spacecraft and nearby infrastructure. The project, supported by an STTR Phase I award, will also investigate ways to use rovers to repair and maintain future lunar landing pads.
paras.zh: Slate Geotechnical Consultants Inc. 和科罗拉多矿业学院之间的合作将评估两种为重复月球着陆准备月球风化层的方法，以便日常任务活动可以拥有坚固、可重复使用的着陆垫。如果没有这样的垫，火箭产生的力可能会从表面炸出松散的砾石状风化层，扬起灰尘，或形成陨石坑，可能会损坏航天器和附近的基础设施。该项目得到了 STTR 第一阶段奖项的支持，还将研究使用漫游车修复和维护未来月球着陆场的方法。

paras.en: Complete lists of the selected proposals are available on the SBIR/STTR program’s website:
paras.zh: 所选提案的完整列表可在 SBIR/STTR 计划的网站上找到：

paras.en: NASA’s SBIR/STTR program is part of the agency’s Research and Technology Mission Directorate and is managed by NASA’s Ames Research Center in California’s Silicon Valley.
paras.zh: NASA 的 SBIR/STTR 计划是该机构研究和技术任务理事会的一部分，由位于加州硅谷的 NASA 艾姆斯研究中心管理。

articles.title: 65 Years of Human Spaceflight at NASA Johnson
articles.author: Sumer Loggins

paras.en: For 65 years, NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston has helped shape human spaceflight, from the Gemini missions that demonstrated rendezvous and docking techniques needed for Apollo to the research conducted aboard the International Space Station, which has supported a continuous human presence for more than 26 years. Today, Johnson teams are preparing crews and systems for NASA’s next chapter: returning astronauts to the lunar surface and building the capabilities needed for a long-term human presence at the Moon.
paras.zh: 65 年来，NASA 位于休斯敦的约翰逊航天中心帮助塑造了人类太空飞行，从展示阿波罗计划所需的交会对接技术的双子座任务，到在国际空间站上进行的研究，该研究支持了人类连续存在超过 26 年。今天，约翰逊团队正在为美国宇航局的下一章准备人员和系统：将宇航员送回月球表面，并建立人类在月球长期存在所需的能力。

paras.en: Across those missions, generations of flight controllers, engineers, scientists, instructors, medical specialists, and other experts have helped crews live and work beyond Earth. Johnson is home to NASA’s Orion and Moon Base programs, and its teams continue to support space station operations, astronaut training, spacecraft development, mission operations, and human health.
paras.zh: 在这些任务中，一代又一代的飞行控制员、工程师、科学家、教官、医学专家和其他专家帮助机组人员在地球以外的生活和工作。约翰逊是美国宇航局猎户座和月球基地项目的所在地，其团队继续支持空间站运营、宇航员培训、航天器开发、任务运营和人类健康。

paras.en: Mercury and Gemini: Preparing for Apollo
paras.zh: 水星和双子座：为阿波罗做准备

paras.en: When the Manned Spacecraft Center officially opened on Nov. 1, 1961, NASA had already flown two suborbital Mercury missions, with the first orbital flight just months away. Most Project Mercury activities remained at Cape Canaveral in Florida to maintain continuity, but the new Project Gemini took up residence in Houston, housed in temporary leased facilities across the city while construction of the new Clear Lake campus continued. The new Mission Control Center became NASA’s primary flight control center in June 1965, with the Gemini IV mission that included the first American spacewalk. Houston became the nerve center for American human spaceflight, overseeing the remaining eight Gemini missions before transitioning to the Apollo program. Following the tragic Apollo 1 fire in January 1967, managers, engineers, and astronauts at the Manned Spacecraft Center applied lessons learned to make the spacecraft safer and ensure the safety of its astronauts, resuming crewed missions in October 1968. Managers in Houston devised a daring plan to send Apollo 8 on a circumlunar flight.
paras.zh: 当载人航天器中心于 1961 年 11 月 1 日正式开放时，美国宇航局已经执行了两次亚轨道水星任务，距离第一次轨道飞行只有几个月的时间。大多数水星计划活动仍留在佛罗里达州的卡纳维拉尔角以保持连续性，但新的双子座计划在休斯顿定居，在整个城市的临时租赁设施中安置，同时新的克利尔湖园区建设仍在继续。 1965 年 6 月，新的任务控制中心成为 NASA 的主要飞行控制中心，其中包括美国首次太空行走的双子座 IV 任务。休斯顿成为美国载人航天的神经中枢，在过渡到阿波罗计划之前监督剩余的八次双子座任务。 1967 年 1 月发生悲惨的阿波罗 1 号火灾后，载人航天器中心的管理人员、工程师和宇航员吸取经验教训，使航天器更安全并确保宇航员的安全，并于 1968 年 10 月恢复载人任务。休斯敦的管理人员制定了一项大胆的计划，将阿波罗 8 号送上环月飞行。

paras.en: In December 1968, Apollo 8 made its historic trip around the Moon, and seven months later Apollo 11 astronauts Neil Armstrong and Edwin “Buzz” Aldrin landed on the lunar surface. Their first voice transmission back to Earth after their arrival began with the word “Houston.” Five more Moon landings completed the Apollo program and humanity’s first phase of lunar exploration in December 1972.
paras.zh: 1968 年 12 月，阿波罗 8 号进行了历史性的绕月之旅，七个月后，阿波罗 11 号宇航员尼尔·阿姆斯特朗和埃德温·“巴兹”·奥尔德林登陆月球表面。他们到达地球后第一次传回地球的声音以“休斯顿”这个词开始。 1972 年 12 月，又五次登月完成了阿波罗计划和人类月球探索的第一阶段。

paras.en: Following the Moon landings, scientists at the Manned Spacecraft Center’s Lunar Receiving Laboratory conducted initial analyses of Apollo lunar samples and prepared them for researchers around the world. After the building was demolished in March 2024, the Lunar Receiving Park was dedicated to honor the laboratory’s history in 2026. Today, Johnson’s Astromaterials Research and Exploration Science (ARES) division continues to analyze and curate the Apollo collection at the Lunar Sample Laboratory Facility.
paras.zh: 登月后，载人航天器中心月球接收实验室的科学家对阿波罗月球样本进行了初步分析，并为世界各地的研究人员准备了这些样本。该建筑于 2024 年 3 月被拆除后，月球接收公园致力于纪念该实验室在 2026 年的历史。如今，约翰逊的天体材料研究和探索科学 (ARES) 部门继续分析和整理月球样品实验室设施中的阿波罗收集品。

paras.en: Skylab and Apollo-Soyuz: Learning to Live and Work in Space
paras.zh: 天空实验室和阿波罗-联盟号：学习在太空中生活和工作

paras.en: Skylab, America’s first space station, ran into trouble during its launch in May 1973, losing its thermal shield, jamming one solar array and losing the other one. In less than 10 days, engineers in Houston designed and built a sun shield and generated procedures to free the jammed array, followed by the first extensive in-orbit repair activities by the first Skylab crew. The three missions lasting 28, 59, and 84 days accomplished more research than planned, demonstrated the value of humans on long-duration missions, and provided operators in mission control with round-the-clock experience monitoring long duration human spaceflights.
paras.zh: 美国第一个空间站天空实验室在 1973 年 5 月发射期间遇到了麻烦，失去了隔热罩，干扰了一个太阳能电池板，并失去了另一个。在不到 10 天的时间里，休斯顿的工程师设计并建造了一个遮阳罩，并生成了释放堵塞阵列的程序，随后第一批天空实验室机组人员进行了首次广泛的在轨维修活动。持续 28 天、59 天和 84 天的三项任务完成了比计划更多的研究，展示了人类在长期任务中的价值，并为任务控制操作员提供了全天候监控长期载人航天飞行的经验。

paras.en: In July 1975, after several joint training sessions in Houston and Moscow, American astronauts and Soviet cosmonauts met in space for the first time during the Apollo-Soyuz Test Project. Approved as a project in 1972, five approach and landing tests of the space shuttle using orbiter Enterprise paved the way for the first orbital mission of Columbia in 1981.
paras.zh: 1975 年 7 月，在休斯敦和莫斯科进行了几次联合训练后，美国宇航员和苏联宇航员在阿波罗-联盟号测试项目中首次在太空相遇。 1972 年作为一个项目获得批准，使用企业号轨道飞行器对航天飞机进行了五次进场和着陆测试，为 1981 年哥伦比亚号的首次轨道任务铺平了道路。

paras.en: The Space Shuttle: Setting the Stage for Long-Duration Spaceflight
paras.zh: 航天飞机：为长期太空飞行奠定基础

paras.en: Engineers in Houston began designs for a reuseable space plane in the late 1960s, with the space shuttle receiving formal approval in 1972. During the 1970s, Johnson Space Center put in place the training and simulation facilities that astronauts used for the life of the program. Upgrades to mission control enabled the use of the latest technologies to support ever more complex space shuttle missions. The April 1981 launch of space shuttle Columbia inaugurated a new era of reusable spacecraft. The program’s 135 missions flew 355 individuals from 16 nations. Missions included satellite deployments and retrievals, dedicated Department of Defense flights, a variety of science missions including deployment of planetary spacecraft, ferrying crews and cargo to two different space stations, and doing the heavy lifting in the assembly of the orbiting laboratory. The program recovered from the tragic losses of the Challenger and Columbia crews with renewed emphasis on crew safety. The final space shuttle mission, STS-135, closed out the 30-year program in July 2011.
paras.zh: 休斯顿的工程师在 20 世纪 60 年代末开始设计可重复使用的太空飞机，航天飞机于 1972 年获得正式批准。在 1970 年代，约翰逊航天中心建立了宇航员在整个项目期间使用的训练和模拟设施。任务控制的升级使得能够使用最新技术来支持更加复杂的航天飞机任务。 1981 年 4 月哥伦比亚号航天飞机的发射开启了可重复使用航天器的新时代。该计划执行了 135 次飞行任务，共有来自 16 个国家的 355 名乘客。任务包括卫星部署和回收、国防部专用飞行、各种科学任务，包括部署行星航天器、向两个不同的空间站运送人员和货物，以及组装轨道实验室的繁重工作。该计划从挑战者号和哥伦比亚号机组人员的悲惨损失中恢复过来，并重新强调机组人员的安全。最后一次航天飞机任务 STS-135 于 2011 年 7 月结束了为期 30 年的计划。

paras.en: The Space Station: 26 Years of Continuous Human Presence
paras.zh: 空间站：人类连续存在 26 年

paras.en: An Earth orbiting space station, first approved by President Ronald Reagan in 1984, underwent many modifications before taking on its current form as the International Space Station in 1993. Overall management of the program resides at Johnson. The first element launch took place in November 1998, followed one month later by the first U.S. element, the Node 1 Unity module. The first expedition crew took up residence on Nov. 2, 2000, and for more than 26 years, rotating crews of astronauts and cosmonauts have lived and worked aboard the orbiting laboratory, establishing a permanent human presence in low Earth orbit.
paras.zh: 地球轨道空间站最初由罗纳德·里根总统于 1984 年批准，在 1993 年形成目前的国际空间站形式之前经历了许多修改。该项目的总体管理由约翰逊负责。第一个元素于 1998 年 11 月发布，一个月后，第一个美国元素 Node 1 Unity 模块发布。第一批探险队于 2000 年 11 月 2 日入住，26 年多来，轮换的宇航员和宇航员在轨道实验室上生活和工作，在近地轨道上建立了永久的人类存在。

paras.en: To date, 298 individuals from 26 countries have visited the space station, conducting more than 4,000 science experiments and educational activities to enable exploration missions and improve life on Earth.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，已有来自 26 个国家的 298 人访问了空间站，进行了 4000 多项科学实验和教育活动，以实现探索任务并改善地球上的生活。

paras.en: Life aboard the space station depends on a global team on the ground. Crews conduct research and maintain equipment in microgravity, while Johnson teams at the Mission Control Center coordinate the agency’s station operations with international partners. Johnson’s Space Vehicle Mockup Facility supports training for NASA astronauts and international crews on station systems, science operations, and emergency procedures. At the Neutral Buoyancy Laboratory, crews rehearse spacewalks around full-scale station mockups in one of the world’s largest indoor pools. Johnson’s Human Research Program also supports health investigations aboard the station, helping researchers understand how spaceflight affects the body so crews can thrive on future deep space missions.
paras.zh: 空间站上的生活取决于地面上的全球团队。工作人员在微重力下进行研究和维护设备，而任务控制中心的约翰逊团队则与国际合作伙伴协调该机构的空间站运营。约翰逊的航天器模型设施支持美国宇航局宇航员和国际机组人员进行空间站系统、科学操作和应急程序方面的培训。在中性浮力实验室，工作人员在世界上最大的室内游泳池之一的全尺寸空间站模型周围排练太空行走。约翰逊的人类研究计划还支持空间站上的健康调查，帮助研究人员了解太空飞行如何影响身体，以便机组人员能够在未来的深空任务中茁壮成长。

paras.en: What began as a framework of modules has evolved into a springboard for international cooperation, advanced scientific research and technology demonstrations, the development of a low Earth orbit economy, and NASA’s next giant leaps in exploration. The space station continues to be a proving ground for NASA’s Artemis program and human exploration of Mars.
paras.zh: 最初的模块框架现已发展成为国际合作、先进科学研究和技术示范、低地球轨道经济发展以及美国宇航局下一次探索巨大飞跃的跳板。该空间站仍然是美国宇航局阿尔忒弥斯计划和人类火星探索的试验场。

paras.en: Artemis and Moon Base: Building a Sustained Lunar Presence
paras.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯和月球基地：建立可持续的月球存在

paras.en: The Artemis II mission marked the first crewed flight of NASA’s Orion spacecraft. The four-person crew launched April 1, on a nearly 10-day trip around the Moon. At its farthest point, Orion traveled 252,756 miles from Earth, farther than any humans had traveled before. The mission demonstrated Orion’s capabilities with astronauts aboard and tested crew operations in deep space, setting the stage for future lunar missions.
paras.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯二号任务标志着美国宇航局猎户座飞船的首次载人飞行。这支四人宇航员于 4 月 1 日发射升空，开始了为期近 10 天的绕月之旅。在最远点，猎户座距离地球 252,756 英里，比任何人类之前走过的距离都要远。这次任务展示了猎户座搭载宇航员的能力，并测试了宇航员在深空的操作，为未来的月球任务奠定了基础。

paras.en: Building on Artemis II, NASA’s Artemis III mission will test integrated operations in low Earth orbit between Orion and test versions of one or both commercial human landing systems under development by SpaceX and Blue Origin. Astronauts will demonstrate the rendezvous and docking capabilities needed to transfer crews between spacecraft for the lunar landing planned for Artemis IV.
paras.zh: NASA 的 Artemis III 任务以 Artemis II 为基础，将测试猎户座和 SpaceX 和 Blue Origin 正在开发的一个或两个商业载人着陆系统的测试版本之间在近地轨道上的集成操作。宇航员将展示在阿耳忒弥斯四号计划登月的航天器之间转移宇航员所需的交会对接能力。

paras.en: NASA’s Moon Base Program is planning a phased effort to support a sustained human presence near the Moon’s South Pole. The first phase will focus on robotic exploration, technology demonstrations, and preparations for future surface operations. Later phases will add infrastructure to support astronauts living and working on the Moon. Lunar terrain vehicles will help crews explore farther, transport equipment, and conduct science.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的月球基地计划正在计划分阶段努力支持人类在月球南极附近的持续存在。第一阶段将重点关注机器人探索、技术演示以及未来地面作业的准备工作。后期阶段将增加基础设施，以支持宇航员在月球上生活和工作。月球地形车将帮助宇航员进行更远的探索、运输设备和开展科学研究。

paras.en: At Johnson, teams are drawing on decades of experience in astronaut training, mission control, spacecraft development, and human health to prepare for these missions. From training crews for lunar operations to developing the systems that will support them, Johnson is building on 65 years of human spaceflight experience for humanity’s return to the lunar surface through the Artemis and Moon Base Programs.
paras.zh: 在约翰逊，团队正在利用数十年在宇航员训练、任务控制、航天器开发和人类健康方面的经验，为这些任务做好准备。从培训月球操作人员到开发支持他们的系统，约翰逊正在利用 65 年的载人航天经验，通过阿尔忒弥斯计划和月球基地计划让人类重返月球表面。

articles.title: Laser Focus at the Top of the World

paras.en: More than 60 years ago, scientists at NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center aimed a laser skyward and fired a pulse of light at an orbiting satellite equipped with special reflectors. By measuring the time it took for the light to return, they demonstrated a new, more precise method for tracking satellites.
paras.zh: 60 多年前，美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心的科学家将激光瞄准天空，并向一颗配备特殊反射器的轨道卫星发射光脉冲。通过测量光线返回所需的时间，他们展示了一种新的、更精确的卫星跟踪方法。

paras.en: Since then, satellite laser ranging (SLR) has grown more precise and more widely used. The technique now underpins many aspects of Earth observation, such as validating satellite orbits and mapping subtle changes to Earth’s surface. Pioneered at the Goddard Optical Research Facility—now the Goddard Geophysical and Astronomical Observatory—laser ranging is performed at more than 40 stations worldwide.
paras.zh: 从那时起，卫星激光测距（SLR）变得更加精确并且应用更加广泛。该技术现在支撑着地球观测的许多方面，例如验证卫星轨道和绘制地球表面的微妙变化。激光测距由戈达德光学研究设施（现为戈达德地球物理和天文台）首创，在全球 40 多个观测站进行。

paras.en: In 2026, the next generation of SLR, developed by NASA scientists and tested at Goddard, began to come online. On October 12, a faster, even more precise SLR system officially debuted at the Ny-Ålesund Geodetic Observatory in Svalbard, Norway, operated by the Norwegian Mapping Authority, a NASA partner. The observatory’s remote location in the Arctic archipelago is shown in this image, acquired with the OLI (Operational Land Imager) on Landsat 9 in July 2026. It is the first NASA next-generation SLR system in operation and the northernmost SLR facility on Earth.
paras.zh: 2026年，由NASA科学家开发并在戈达德进行测试的下一代单反相机开始上线。 10 月 12 日，更快、更精确的 SLR 系统在挪威斯瓦尔巴特群岛的尼奥勒松大地观测站正式首次亮相，该观测站由 NASA 合作伙伴挪威测绘局运营。这张图像显示了该天文台位于北极群岛的偏远位置，该图像是 2026 年 7 月通过 Landsat 9 上的 OLI（运行陆地成像仪）获取的。它是第一个运行中的 NASA 下一代 SLR 系统，也是地球上最北端的 SLR 设施。

paras.en: While the systems developed decades ago have been “workhorses” of the global laser tracking network, their age and the growing number of satellites have necessitated updates, said Stephen Merkowitz, project manager for NASA’s Space Geodesy Project. “We wanted newer systems that could track more objects, and track them more accurately and precisely,” he said.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局太空大地测量项目的项目经理斯蒂芬·默科维茨说，虽然几十年前开发的系统一直是全球激光跟踪网络的“主力”，但它们的年龄和不断增加的卫星数量需要更新。 “我们想要更新的系统能够跟踪更多物体，并且更准确地跟踪它们，”他说。

paras.en: Years of development, testing, and careful calibration produced the Space Geodesy Satellite Laser Ranging system now running at Ny-Ålesund. Among its features are lasers that can fire pulses thousands of times per second, up from tens of times per second, and sensors that can detect single photons, meaning that less light needs to be reflected back from a satellite.
paras.zh: 经过多年的开发、测试和仔细校准，太空大地测量卫星激光测距系统现已在纽约奥勒松运行。其特点之一是激光器可以每秒发射数千次脉冲，而传感器可以检测单个光子，这意味着需要从卫星反射回来的光更少。

paras.en: Along with determining the orbits of satellites, SLR is critical for establishing the terrestrial reference frame, the foundation of modern coordinate systems and a common standard that allows measurements to be compared with one another. “If you want to know where your satellite observation is on a map, you need to have it in the proper reference frame,” Merkowitz said. In addition, tracking Earth’s center of mass, measuring changes in sea level and ice mass, studying the motion of tectonic plates, and maintaining global navigation satellite systems such as GPS, all rely on an accurate reference frame.
paras.zh: 除了确定卫星轨道之外，SLR 对于建立地面参考系也至关重要，地面参考系是现代坐标系的基础，也是允许测量结果相互比较的通用标准。 “如果你想知道你的卫星观测结果在地图上的位置，你需要将其置于正确的参考系中，”默科维茨说。此外，追踪地球质心、测量海平面和冰块的变化、研究构造板块的运动以及维护GPS等全球导航卫星系统，都依赖于精确的参考系。

paras.en: The far-north location of the Ny-Ålesund facility improves the distribution of SLR stations across the planet, making the whole network more robust. The location also allows the system to gather more data about polar-orbiting satellites, which include ICESat-2, GRACE-FO, and other Earth observation satellites. “From the station at Goddard [in Greenbelt, Maryland], we’ll catch the polar-orbiting satellites maybe two or three times a day,” Merkowitz said. “But from Ny-Ålesund, you’ll see them almost every orbit.”
paras.zh: 尼奥勒松设施位于最北端，改善了全球 SLR 站的分布，使整个网络更加稳健。该位置还允许系统收集更多有关极轨卫星的数据，其中包括 ICESat-2、GRACE-FO 和其他地球观测卫星。 “从戈达德空间站（马里兰州格林贝尔特），我们每天可能会捕获两到三次极地轨道卫星，”默科维茨说。 “但从新奥勒松出发，你几乎在每个轨道上都能看到它们。”

paras.en: Certain satellite missions may especially benefit from the Arctic location, he added. Take ICESat-2, designed to make precise observations of ice surface heights. Having a station tracking the satellite from an icy polar region could lead to more accurate measurements there. “When it’s over the ice, we want the calibration to be as good as possible,” Merkowitz said.
paras.zh: 他补充说，某些卫星任务可能特别受益于北极的位置。以 ICESat-2 为例，它旨在精确观测冰面高度。在冰冷的极地地区建立一个跟踪卫星的站可能会导致在那里进行更准确的测量。 “当它在冰上时，我们希望校准尽可能好，”默科维茨说。

paras.en: Innovations and lessons learned from the Svalbard installation will carry over to future ones, Merkowitz said. In particular, the Ny-Ålesund facility drove improvements in automation because the site is located next to a bird sanctuary. Access restrictions require the station to be remotely operated at certain times, such as during the summer breeding season for migratory birds. These capabilities can be refined and applied at other stations. NASA is currently building two more next-generation SLR systems to replace legacy instruments at Goddard and the McDonald Geodetic Observatory in Texas.
paras.zh: 默科维茨说，从斯瓦尔巴群岛安装中获得的创新和经验教训将延续到未来的安装中。特别是，新奥勒松工厂毗邻鸟类保护区，因此推动了自动化水平的提高。访问限制要求该站在特定时间进行远程操作，例如在候鸟的夏季繁殖季节。这些功能可以在其他站进行完善和应用。美国宇航局目前正在建造另外两个下一代单反系统，以取代戈达德和德克萨斯州麦克唐纳大地测量站的传统仪器。

paras.en: NASA Earth Observatory images by Lauren Dauphin, using Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey. NASA photo by Julie Horvath (KBR). Story by Lindsey Doermann.
paras.zh: NASA 地球观测站图像由 Lauren Dauphin 使用美国地质调查局的陆地卫星数据拍摄。 NASA 照片由 Julie Horvath (KBR) 拍摄。林赛·杜尔曼的故事。

articles.title: ‘We escaped with only our lives’: Fighting to give birth in war-torn Yemen

paras.en: ‘We escaped with only our lives’: Fighting to give birth in war-torn Yemen
paras.zh: “我们只带着生命逃了出来”：在饱受战争蹂躏的也门为分娩而战

paras.en: When fighting suddenly escalated around Taiz, in southwestern Yemen two months ago, midwife Anisa Fadhl had no time to pack a bag before she fled, leaving behind her home and her clinic. Both were later looted and destroyed.
paras.zh: 两个月前，也门西南部塔伊兹周围的战斗突然升级，助产士阿尼萨·法德尔 (Anisa Fadhl) 来不及收拾行李，就离开了家和诊所。两者后来都被抢劫和摧毁。

paras.en: “I would have packed my medical equipment and belongings, but the entire village fled the same day,” she explained. “No transportation was available, and we escaped with only our lives.”
paras.zh: “我本想收拾好医疗设备和物品，但当天整个村庄的人都逃走了，”她解释道。 “没有交通工具，我们只能逃命。”

paras.en: Talking about her clinic, she says that “everything was looted.”
paras.zh: 谈到她的诊所，她说“一切都被洗劫一空”。

paras.en: “They stole chairs, mattresses and all electronic medical equipment – looters even carried away the examination beds,” the midwife told UNFPA, the UN’s sexual and reproductive health agency.
paras.zh: “他们偷走了椅子、床垫和所有电子医疗设备——抢劫者甚至拿走了检查床，”助产士告诉联合国性健康和生殖健康机构联合国人口基金。

paras.en: In Yemen, surges in conflict have displaced over 320,000 people since August – and more than 80,000 in October alone – while more than 22 million people were already estimated to need humanitarian assistance this year, according to the UN’s migration organisation IOM.
paras.zh: 据联合国移民组织国际移民组织称，自 8 月以来，也门冲突激增已导致超过 32 万人流离失所，仅 10 月就有超过 8 万人流离失所，而今年估计已有超过 2200 万人需要人道主义援助。

paras.en: Women have been particularly vulnerable in these surges of fighting and displacement, with widespread reports of sexual violence.
paras.zh: 在这些激增的战斗和流离失所中，妇女尤其容易受到伤害，性暴力的报道广泛存在。

paras.en: Pregnant women and mothers also face particularly serious challenges.
paras.zh: 孕妇和母亲也面临着特别严峻的挑战。

paras.en: Amongst those displaced, over 6,400 are mothers-to-be. This month, around 600 women are expected to give birth without basic sanitary or medical infrastructure, UNFPA estimates.
paras.zh: 在流离失所者中，超过 6,400 人是准妈妈。联合国人口基金估计，本月预计将有约 600 名妇女在没有基本卫生或医疗基础设施的情况下分娩。

paras.en: Around 1,500 women may require emergency obstetric and newborn care for potential complications, while fewer than two-thirds of health facilities are fully functional.
paras.zh: 大约 1,500 名妇女可能因潜在并发症而需要紧急产科和新生儿护理，而只有不到三分之二的卫生设施能够充分发挥作用。

paras.en: Yemen has one of the highest maternal mortality rates in the region, with three women dying every day from preventable pregnancy complications.
paras.zh: 也门是该地区孕产妇死亡率最高的国家之一，每天有三名妇女死于可预防的妊娠并发症。

paras.en: Despite the heat, lack of transport and shortage of safe drinking water, Ms. Fadhl continued caring for vulnerable people as she fled.
paras.zh: 尽管天气炎热、缺乏交通且缺乏安全饮用水，法德尔女士在逃离过程中仍继续照顾弱势群体。

paras.en: “My priority was providing rest for the children and pregnant women,” she recalled. “While walking, a cargo truck passed by; we loaded some pregnant women, elderly women and children onto it."
paras.zh: “我的首要任务是为儿童和孕妇提供休息，”她回忆道。 “走路时，一辆货车经过，我们载了一些孕妇、老年妇女和儿童。”

paras.en: Just two days after escaping her village and settling down in Aden, she returned to work.
paras.zh: 逃离村庄并在亚丁定居仅两天后，她就重返工作岗位。

paras.en: Moving between displacement sites with severe shortages of essential medicines and minimal medical supplies, she helps deliver babies, conducts prenatal and postnatal checkups, and advises mothers on breastfeeding, infant nutrition and hygiene.
paras.zh: 她在基本药品和医疗用品严重短缺的流离失所地点之间往返，帮助接生婴儿，进行产前和产后检查，并就母乳喂养、婴儿营养和卫生向母亲提供建议。

paras.en: She also delivers psychosocial support and family planning services to women and girls whose access to healthcare was severed long before the latest escalation.
paras.zh: 她还为妇女和女孩提供心理社会支持和计划生育服务，这些妇女和女孩在最近的升级之前很久就无法获得医疗保健。

paras.en: “Early marriage is widespread,” Ms. Fadhl explained. “Girls aged 20 often already have two children without ever receiving birth spacing counselling or family planning services.”
paras.zh: “早婚现象很普遍，”法德尔女士解释道。 “20 岁的女孩通常已经有了两个孩子，但从未接受过生育间隔咨询或计划生育服务。”

paras.en: Among those Ms. Fadhl helped was Um Mohammed, who fled the fighting in Taiz while heavily pregnant, walking under the scorching sun with her young children.
paras.zh: 法德尔女士帮助的人中有乌姆·穆罕默德（Um Mohammed），她在怀孕期间逃离了塔伊兹的战斗，带着年幼的孩子在烈日下行走。

paras.en: “I was terrified of losing my [pregnancy], getting injured by shelling, or having something terrible happen to my children,” she told UNFPA.
paras.zh: “我害怕失去[怀孕]、因炮击而受伤，或者我的孩子会发生可怕的事情，”她告诉联合国人口基金。

paras.en: After reaching safety, the family found shelter with a host family. But just hours later, Ms. Mohammed went into labour.
paras.zh: 到达安全地点后，一家人在寄宿家庭找到了庇护所。但仅仅几个小时后，穆罕默德女士就分娩了。

paras.en: Ms. Fadhl, who was among the crowd of displaced people sheltering nearby, stepped up.
paras.zh: 法德尔女士是附近避难的流离失所者之一，她走上前来。

paras.en: “She delivered my baby smoothly with zero tools,” Ms. Mohammed recalled. “She tied my baby's cord with a flour-sack thread and cut it with a razor blade borrowed from a neighbour.”
paras.zh: “她用零工具顺利生下了我的孩子，”穆罕默德女士回忆道。 “她用面粉袋线绑住我孩子的脐带，然后用从邻居那里借来的刀片将其割断。”

paras.en: “It was the hardest delivery of my life,” Ms. Mohammed told UNFPA. “Not just because of the physical pain, but because of fear and anxiety.”
paras.zh: “这是我一生中最艰难的分娩，”穆罕默德女士告诉联合国人口基金。 “不仅仅是因为身体上的疼痛，还因为恐惧和焦虑。”

paras.en: Years prior, UNFPA had trained Ms. Fadhl as a midwife and helped provide the initial medical equipment she needed to establish her practice.
paras.zh: 几年前，人口基金将法德尔女士培训为助产士，并帮助提供她开展执业所需的初始医疗设备。

paras.en: As of 30 October, the agency had reached nearly 180,000 people with emergency reproductive healthcare and protection services, deploying mobile health teams, arranging referrals to specialist facilities and mobilising community midwives.
paras.zh: 截至 10 月 30 日，该机构已为近 18 万人提供了紧急生殖保健和保护服务，部署了流动医疗队，安排转诊到专业设施，并动员社区助产士。

paras.en: In 2026, UNFPA is appealing for $71.9 million to maintain its critical support for women and girls, but to date only one-quarter is funded.
paras.zh: 人口基金呼吁到 2026 年筹集 7190 万美元，以维持对妇女和女童的重要支持，但迄今为止，只有四分之一得到资助。

articles.title: COP31 ends without climate pact as UN chief warns there is ‘no ambiguity in the science’

paras.en: COP31 ends without climate pact as UN chief warns there is ‘no ambiguity in the science’
paras.zh: COP31在没有达成气候协议的情况下结束，联合国秘书长警告称“科学上没有含糊之处”

paras.en: COP31 ended on Sunday without a climate pact after negotiators failed to overcome divisions over fossil fuels, bringing two weeks of talks and two days of overtime to a close that UN Secretary-General António Guterres described as a “deeply disappointing” setback.
paras.zh: 由于谈判人员未能克服化石燃料问题上的分歧，COP31于周日结束，但没有达成气候协议，为期两周的谈判和两天的加班最终结束，联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯称这是“令人深感失望”的挫折。

paras.en: Reacting to the collapse of COP31, the Secretary-General said he was “deeply disappointed” that governments meeting in Antalya, Türkiye, had failed to reach consensus, but stressed that the outcome did not alter the realities of the climate crisis.
paras.zh: 针对第三十一届缔约方大会的失败，秘书长表示，他对在土耳其安塔利亚举行的各国政府会议未能达成共识感到“深感失望”，但强调会议结果并没有改变气候危机的现实。

paras.en: - COP31 closed without a final climate pact after two weeks of negotiations and two days of overtime talks.
paras.zh: - 经过两周的谈判和两天的加班谈判后，第三十一届缔约方大会在没有达成最终气候协议的情况下结束。

paras.en: - Disagreement over fossil fuel language proved the main obstacle to consensus.
paras.zh: - 对化石燃料语言的分歧被证明是达成共识的主要障碍。

paras.en: - Several countries formally objected to the final text, saying it weakened previous commitments and failed to meet the urgency of the climate crisis.
paras.zh: - 一些国家正式反对最终文本，称其削弱了之前的承诺，并且未能满足气候危机的紧迫性。

paras.en: - António Guterres called the outcome a setback but insisted there remains “no ambiguity in the science” and urged faster climate action.
paras.zh: - 安东尼奥·古特雷斯称这一结果是一次挫折，但坚称“科学上没有歧义”，并敦促加快气候行动。

paras.en: - Antalya has become the longest-running UN climate summit on record.
paras.zh: - 安塔利亚成为有记录以来持续时间最长的联合国气候峰会。

paras.en: “There may be no consensus in the negotiating room. There is no ambiguity in the science,” the UN chief said in a statement.
paras.zh: “谈判室里可能没有达成共识。科学上没有任何含糊之处，”联合国秘书长在一份声明中表示。

paras.en: He warned that global temperatures continue to break records, climate impacts are intensifying and greenhouse gas emissions remain dangerously high, while the world is now on course to exceed the internationally agreed 1.5°C warming limit.
paras.zh: 他警告说，全球气温继续打破记录，气候影响不断加剧，温室气体排放量仍然处于危险的高位，而世界目前正在超过国际商定的1.5°C升温限制。

paras.en: “The take-home message from COP31 is clear: the world must do much more to confront the climate crisis – and it must do it now,” he said.
paras.zh: 他表示：“第三十一届缔约方大会传达的重要信息很明确：世界必须采取更多行动来应对气候危机 — — 而且必须现在就采取行动。”

paras.en: Mr. Guterres argued that fossil fuels remain the primary driver of global warming and cautioned against efforts to delay the transition to cleaner energy.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生认为，化石燃料仍然是全球变暖的主要驱动因素，并警告不要推迟向清洁能源过渡。

paras.en: “We can’t put out the fire while pouring fuel on it,” he said, accusing powerful fossil fuel interests of obstructing climate action while continuing to profit.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们不能一边火上浇油一边灭火。”他指责强大的化石燃料利益集团在继续获利的同时阻碍气候行动。

paras.en: The Secretary-General noted that governments had already agreed at COP28 in Dubai to transition away from fossil fuels and said the priority now must be to accelerate and finance that shift.
paras.zh: 秘书长指出，各国政府已在迪拜举行的第 28 届缔约方会议上同意放弃化石燃料，并表示现在的首要任务必须是加速这一转变并为其提供资金。

paras.en: He also called for deeper emissions cuts this decade, stronger support for vulnerable countries and substantially increased adaptation finance, stressing that those least responsible for climate change should not be left to bear its heaviest consequences alone.
paras.zh: 他还呼吁本十年进一步削减排放，为脆弱国家提供更有力的支持，并大幅增加适应资金，并强调不应让那些对气候变化责任最小的国家独自承担最严重的后果。

paras.en: Looking beyond the negotiating halls, Mr. Guterres said the real measure of progress would be whether countries reduce fossil fuel dependence, expand clean energy, cut methane emissions, restore forests and deliver climate finance to developing nations.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生表示，展望谈判大厅之外，真正衡量进展的标准是各国是否减少对化石燃料的依赖、扩大清洁能源、减少甲烷排放、恢复森林以及向发展中国家提供气候融资。

paras.en: Addressing civil society, young people, Indigenous Peoples, scientists and frontline communities, he urged campaigners to keep pressing for action and accountability.
paras.zh: 他向民间社会、年轻人、原住民、科学家和前线社区发表讲话，敦促活动人士继续敦促采取行动和问责。

paras.en: “The climate crisis will not wait for governments to find common ground. Neither can we,” he said. “Keep spreading the facts. Keep demanding action. Keep turning up the heat.”
paras.zh: “气候危机不会等待各国政府找到共同点。我们也不能，”他说。 “继续传播事实。继续要求采取行动。继续升温。”

paras.en: COP31 President Murat Kurum, Türkiye’s environment minister, acknowledged the impasse, saying: “I understand that there is no agreement on this text. For that reason, these decisions have not been adopted.”
paras.zh: COP31 主席、土耳其环境部长穆拉特·库鲁姆 (Murat Kurum) 承认陷入僵局，他表示：“据我所知，各方尚未就该文本达成一致。因此，这些决定尚未获得通过。”

paras.en: The inconclusive talks followed days of deadlock over fossil fuels, with negotiators unable to bridge differences between a coalition of climate-vulnerable nations and countries pushing for a stronger commitment to move away from coal, oil and gas, and those seeking to protect economies heavily dependent on fossil fuel exports.
paras.zh: 此次谈判没有结果，此前化石燃料问题陷入僵局，谈判代表无法弥合气候脆弱国家联盟和推动更强有力承诺摆脱煤炭、石油和天然气的国家与寻求保护严重依赖化石燃料出口的经济体之间的分歧。

paras.en: Multiple compromise drafts circulated by COP31 co-presidents Australia and Türkiye sought to win consensus, including by acknowledging that global warming is now on course to exceed the 1.5°C threshold while calling for expanded carbon-removal technologies.
paras.zh: COP31 联合主席澳大利亚和土耳其分发的多份妥协草案试图赢得共识，包括承认全球变暖目前正在超过 1.5°C 阈值，同时呼吁扩大碳去除技术。

paras.en: But the effort ultimately failed, with critics arguing the text weakened previous commitments and fell far short of the action required to address the climate crisis.
paras.zh: 但这一努力最终失败了，批评者认为该文本削弱了之前的承诺，并且远远没有达到解决气候危机所需的行动。

paras.en: Focus now shifts to COP32 in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, where governments will face many of the questions left unanswered in Antalya, from the transition away from fossil fuels to mobilizing climate finance for developing countries.
paras.zh: 现在的焦点转移到在埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴举行的第三十二次缔约方大会，各国政府将面临安塔利亚尚未解答的许多问题，从摆脱化石燃料到为发展中国家动员气候融资。

paras.en: Countries back climate cooperation but lament weakened ambition
paras.zh: 各国支持气候合作，但遗憾雄心减弱

paras.en: While reaffirming their commitment to multilateral climate action, delegations warned against “mistaking the drama of negotiations for impact”, describing the final draft pact as “the lowest common denominator” and saying it failed to meet the moment.
paras.zh: 各代表团在重申对多边气候行动的承诺的同时，警告不要“将谈判的戏剧性误认为是影响”，将最终协议草案描述为“最低共同标准”，并表示它未能满足这一要求。

paras.en: The European Union formally objected to the cover decision, saying it failed to “meet the moment” and warning that it risked widening the gap between climate commitments and real-world action. The bloc said it could not accept a text that omitted any reference to fossil fuels or a transition away from them, describing such an omission as “unconscionable.”
paras.zh: 欧盟正式反对这一封面决定，称其未能“及时应对”，并警告称，这可能会扩大气候承诺与现实世界行动之间的差距。欧盟表示，它不能接受省略任何提及化石燃料或放弃化石燃料的文本，称这种遗漏是“不合理的”。

paras.en: Panama also rejected the outcome, arguing that governments have a responsibility “not to negotiate the minimum threshold, but to act.” The delegation said the pact weakened previously agreed decisions and failed to reflect the urgency of keeping the 1.5°C goal within reach. Recalling a letter sent to the COP presidency outlining several non-negotiable priorities, Panama said its position remained unchanged and that it could not support the agreement as drafted.
paras.zh: 巴拿马也拒绝了这一结果，认为各国政府有责任“不是就最低门槛进行谈判，而是采取行动”。该代表团表示，该协议削弱了之前商定的决定，未能反映出保持 1.5°C 目标触手可及的紧迫性。回顾致缔约方会议主席国的一封信，其中概述了几个不可谈判的优先事项，巴拿马表示其立场保持不变，并且不能支持起草的协议。

paras.en: Pakistan urged delegates to continue working toward consensus, warning that climate action requires “bridges, not barriers.” The delegation said that while parts of the text remained problematic for some countries, the broader package should not be sacrificed and insisted that a way forward remained within reach.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦敦促代表们继续努力达成共识，并警告说，气候行动需要“桥梁，而不是障碍”。该代表团表示，虽然案文的部分内容对一些国家来说仍然存在问题，但不应牺牲更广泛的一揽子计划，并坚持认为前进的道路仍然是可以实现的。

paras.en: The Marshall Islands also withheld its support, warning that the deal failed countries on the front lines of climate change. The delegation said accepting the text would amount to a betrayal of its people, criticised what it called “false solutions”, and argued that faster movement away from fossil fuels, backed by stronger financial support, remained essential.
paras.zh: 马绍尔群岛也拒绝提供支持，警告说该协议让处于气候变化前线的国家失败了。该代表团表示，接受该文本将构成对其人民的背叛，批评所谓的“错误解决方案”，并认为在更强有力的财政支持的支持下，更快地摆脱化石燃料仍然至关重要。

paras.en: Speaking on behalf of the African Group, Ghana acknowledged shortcomings in areas including climate finance, loss and damage and the just transition, which it said received “a single generic sentence”. Nevertheless, it said the group would not stand in the way of consensus, arguing that the text still reflected the views of a wide range of parties.
paras.zh: 加纳代表非洲集团发言，承认在气候融资、损失和损害以及公正过渡等领域存在缺陷，并表示这些问题得到了“单一的一般性判决”。尽管如此，它表示该组织不会阻碍达成共识，认为文本仍然反映了广泛各方的观点。

paras.en: Representing the League of Arab States, Saudi Arabia defended references in the text to carbon capture and storage (CCS), rejecting suggestions that the technology constituted greenwashing. The delegation argued that scientific assessments have identified a role for CCS in limiting warming and said all viable climate solutions should remain on the table. Despite reservations over other aspects of the negotiations, it pledged to remain constructively engaged.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯代表阿拉伯国家联盟为文本中提到的碳捕获和封存（CCS）进行辩护，驳斥了该技术构成“绿色清洗”的说法。该代表团认为，科学评估已经确定了 CCS 在限制变暖方面的作用，并表示所有可行的气候解决方案都应保留在桌面上。尽管对谈判的其他方面持保留意见，但它承诺继续建设性地参与。

articles.title: ‘I had a better life in Iran’: Afghan women forced home struggle to rebuild

paras.en: ‘I had a better life in Iran’: Afghan women forced home struggle to rebuild
paras.zh: “我在伊朗过着更好的生活”：阿富汗妇女被迫为重建家园而奋斗

paras.en: For five years, Zahra cared for an elderly woman in Iran and earned enough to get by. Now back in Herat, western Afghanistan, the 28-year-old trained midwife is unemployed. She lives with her parents and siblings, apart from her six-year-old son, who lives with her ex-husband.
paras.zh: 扎赫拉在伊朗照顾一名老年妇女五年，赚的钱足以维持生计。这位 28 岁的受过训练的助产士现在回到阿富汗西部的赫拉特，失业了。她与父母和兄弟姐妹住在一起，除了她六岁的儿子与前夫住在一起。

paras.en: “Sometimes I can’t see him,” she said. “I only see him twice a month.”
paras.zh: “有时我看不到他，”她说。 “我每个月只见他两次。”

paras.en: Zahra is one of millions of Afghans forced back from Iran and Pakistan in recent years, as waves of deportations have driven people home in huge numbers.
paras.zh: 扎赫拉是近年来被迫从伊朗和巴基斯坦返回的数百万阿富汗人之一，因为一波又一波的驱逐浪潮迫使大量阿富汗人被迫返回家园。

paras.en: Many are women who left behind jobs, education and relative stability. They have come back to a country where opportunities are increasingly scarce.
paras.zh: 许多女性失去了工作、教育和相对稳定。他们回到了一个机会越来越稀缺的国家。

paras.en: Homa, 44, spent six years in Iran. Today she is her family’s only breadwinner. She shares a single room in her brother-in-law’s house with her husband, who has a disability and cannot work, and she cleans houses and sews clothes whenever she can find orders.
paras.zh: 44 岁的霍马在伊朗度过了六年。如今，她是家里唯一的养家糊口的人。她与身患残疾、无法工作的丈夫住在姐夫家的一个单间里，只要有订单，她就打扫房子、缝衣服。

paras.en: “I had a better life in Iran,” she said. “Unfortunately, we were deported.”
paras.zh: “我在伊朗过着更好的生活，”她说。 “不幸的是，我们被驱逐出境了。”

paras.en: Some days the pressure is overwhelming. “Some days,” she said, “I must beg in the street.”
paras.zh: 有些日子压力很大。 “有时候，”她说，“我必须在街上乞讨。”

paras.en: The two women took different paths to Iran but were driven by similar forces. Zahra left after finishing her midwifery training.
paras.zh: 这两名妇女走上了前往伊朗的不同道路，但受到相似力量的驱使。扎赫拉完成助产士培训后离开了。

paras.en: “It was because of the Taliban, and because of the bad economy, and because I was educated,” she said.
paras.zh: “这是因为塔利班，因为经济不景气，也因为我受过教育，”她说。

paras.en: In Iran she found steady work, despite troubles at home: her husband was addicted to drugs. “I had income,” she said. “I had a better life.”
paras.zh: 在伊朗，她找到了稳定的工作，尽管家里遇到了麻烦：她的丈夫吸毒成瘾。 “我有收入，”她说。 “我过上了更好的生活。”

paras.en: Homa cleaned apartments and collected recyclable plastic to sell. “It was a good income for my family,” she said. “We lived in a nice apartment building with a security guard. The neighbors helped me with food and sometimes with other things.”
paras.zh: 霍马清理公寓并收集可回收塑料出售。 “这对我的家庭来说是一笔不错的收入，”她说。 “我们住在一栋漂亮的公寓楼里，有保安。邻居们帮我提供食物，有时还帮我做其他事情。”

paras.en: Both women now describe lives shaped less by opportunity than by survival.
paras.zh: 两位女性现在描述的生活更多的是生存，而不是机会。

paras.en: Zahra’s father is blind and cannot work, so her younger brother is the family’s only steady earner. She has qualifications and has volunteered in clinics, but she still hasn’t found a job.
paras.zh: 扎赫拉的父亲双目失明，无法工作，所以她的弟弟是家里唯一稳定的经济来源。她有资格并在诊所做过志愿者，但她仍然没有找到工作。

paras.en: “I don’t have opportunities to work,” she said.
paras.zh: “我没有工作机会，”她说。

paras.en: Homa had surgery for appendicitis and is still in a lot of pain. Relations with her brother-in-law’s wife are strained, and Homa owes him money.
paras.zh: 霍马接受了阑尾炎手术，但仍然感到很痛苦。霍马与姐夫的妻子关系紧张，而且还欠他钱。

paras.en: “I have no support for my medical needs,” she said. “I borrowed money for my surgery from my brother-in-law.”
paras.zh: “我的医疗需求得不到支持，”她说。 “手术费是我向姐夫借的。”

paras.en: According to Charlie Goodlake of the UN refugee agency, UNHCR, more than 6.5 million Afghans have returned over the past three years, including nearly 3 million in 2025 alone. The returns have added more than 10 per cent to Afghanistan’s population, straining housing, jobs and public services.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署的查理·古德莱克 (Charlie Goodlake) 表示，过去三年已有超过 650 万阿富汗人返回，其中仅 2025 年就有近 300 万阿富汗人返回。回返使阿富汗人口增加了 10% 以上，导致住房、就业和公共服务紧张。

paras.en: Women and girls make up more than half of the people UNHCR assists. Women and children together account for nearly 82 per cent.
paras.zh: 妇女和女童占难民署援助人数的一半以上。妇女和儿童合计占近82%。

paras.en: “The primary needs of women and girls are, of course, immediate shelter or a place to live inside Afghanistan,” Mr. Goodlake said. He added that cash assistance, education, livelihoods and protection services are also critical, especially given the restrictions on women and girls.
paras.zh: “当然，妇女和女孩的首要需求是在阿富汗境内立即获得庇护所或居住地，”古德莱克先生说。他补充说，现金援助、教育、生计和保护服务也至关重要，特别是考虑到对妇女和女童的限制。

paras.en: Most returnees arrive with very little and rely on extended family or host communities while they try to start again.
paras.zh: 大多数回返者带着很少的东西抵达，在尝试重新开始时依靠大家庭或寄宿社区。

paras.en: Support from UNHCR and its partners has eased the transition a little for both women. After being referred to a UNHCR partner organization, Zahra became eligible for cash assistance, legal support and mental health and psychosocial services.
paras.zh: 难民署及其合作伙伴的支持为这两位女性的过渡带来了一些便利。在被转介给难民署合作伙伴组织后，扎赫拉有资格获得现金援助、法律支持以及心理健康和社会心理服务。

paras.en: Homa used her cash assistance to buy a tool she badly needed.
paras.zh: 霍玛用她的现金援助购买了她急需的工具。

paras.en: “When I received the cash assistance, I was able to buy a sewing machine,” she said. “Now I have an income, and I help my family.”
paras.zh: “当我收到现金援助时，我能够购买一台缝纫机，”她说。 “现在我有了收入，可以帮助家人了。”

paras.en: She can now work from home, which spares her heavy labour outside while she recovers from surgery. The money has also paid for essentials.
paras.zh: 她现在可以在家工作，这样在手术康复期间她就不用在外面做繁重的体力劳动了。这笔钱还用于购买必需品。

paras.en: “I bought rice and oil for my family because two months ago my family didn’t have any food to eat,” she said.
paras.zh: “我给家人买了米和油，因为两个月前我家人没有食物吃，”她说。

paras.en: Mr. Goodlake said this kind of support is meant to meet immediate needs and also help women build longer-term livelihoods. UNHCR runs more than 150 vocational training projects across Afghanistan and keeps looking for ways to help women earn money despite the obstacles.
paras.zh: 古德莱克先生表示，这种支持旨在满足当前需求，并帮助妇女建立长期生计。联合国难民署在阿富汗各地开展了 150 多个职业培训项目，并不断寻找帮助妇女赚钱的方法，尽管困难重重。

paras.en: Neither woman says much about long-term plans, because the future feels too uncertain.
paras.zh: 两位女士都没有过多谈论长期计划，因为未来感觉太不确定了。

paras.en: Asked what more she needs, Homa gives a simple answer: a place to live, food for the winter and stability. “I also need more food and oil and other things for the winter,” she said.
paras.zh: 当被问及她还需要什么时，霍玛给出了一个简单的答案：居住的地方、过冬的食物和稳定。 “冬天我还需要更多的食物、石油和其他东西，”她说。

paras.en: Zahra wants work, independence and more time with her son. Even so, she doesn’t expect to win custody. Her former husband is addicted to drugs, but she says the courts would not back her claim.
paras.zh: 扎赫拉想要工作、独立以及更多的时间陪伴儿子。即便如此，她也不指望赢得监护权。她的前夫吸毒成瘾，但她说法院不会支持她的主张。

paras.en: “The courts in Afghanistan always side with men,” she said.
paras.zh: “阿富汗的法庭总是站在男性一边，”她说。

paras.en: Both women are anxious about what lies ahead.
paras.zh: 两个女人都对未来的事情感到焦虑。

paras.en: “I am very worried about the future in Afghanistan,” Homa said.
paras.zh: “我非常担心阿富汗的未来，”霍马说。

articles.title: Purdy carves up Vikings defence as 49ers seal win in Mexico

paras.en: San Francisco 49ers 35-10 Minnesota Vikings: Brock Purdy dismantles Vikings defence with three touchdown passes
paras.zh: 旧金山 49 人队 35-10 明尼苏达维京人队：布洛克·珀迪以三次达阵传球瓦解了维京人队的防守

paras.en: Brock Purdy starred as San Francisco 49ers extended their season record to 9-1 with a 35-10 win against Minnesota Vikings in Mexico City; Purdy threw three touchdown passes and gained 255 yards; watch the 2026 NFL season live on Sky Sports
paras.zh: 布洛克·珀迪 (Brock Purdy) 主演的旧金山 49 人队 (San Francisco 49ers) 在墨西哥城以 35-10 战胜明尼苏达维京人队 (Minnesota Vikings)，将赛季战绩扩大到 9 胜 1 负； Purdy 传出 3 次达阵并推进 255 码；在天空体育频道观看 2026 年 NFL 赛季直播

paras.en: Brock Purdy and the San Francisco 49ers offence turned what was billed as a heavyweight clash between two of the NFL’s top units into a one-sided contest, as Kyle Shanahan’s side delivered a commanding 35–10 victory in Mexico City.
paras.zh: 布洛克·珀迪 (Brock Purdy) 和旧金山 49 人队的进攻将 NFL 两支顶级球队之间的重量级对决变成了一场一边倒的较量，凯尔·沙纳汉 (Kyle Shanahan) 的球队在墨西哥城以 35-10 取得了压倒性的胜利。

paras.en: Played in front of a raucous, pro-49ers crowd at Estadio Azteca, the game had been billed as a heavyweight showdown between one of the NFL's most dangerous offences, San Francisco (9ǃ), and a Minnesota Vikings (7ǅ) defence that had unsettled quarterbacks throughout the season with its aggressive blitz-heavy approach.
paras.zh: 这场比赛在阿兹台克球场，在喧闹的亲 49 人队观众面前进行，被认为是 NFL 最危险的进攻之一旧金山队 (9 点) 和明尼苏达维京人队 (7 点) 之间的重量级对决，明尼苏达维京人队的防守在整个赛季都以其激进的闪电战方式让四分卫感到不安。

paras.en: However, Purdy proved more than equal to the challenge, delivering an imperious performance and carving up the Minnesota defence with three touchdown passes in the first half alone.
paras.zh: 然而，珀迪证明自己完全能够应对挑战，他的表现非常霸道，仅在上半场就以三次达阵传球打破了明尼苏达队的防守。

paras.en: "You have to be aggressive and don't second-guess yourself," Purdy said.
paras.zh: “你必须积极进取，不要事后批评自己，”珀迪说。

paras.en: "Obviously, try to read it the best you can, but when you have players that can go get the ball, allow them to go and make plays.
paras.zh: “显然，尽你所能去阅读它，但是当你有可以拿球的球员时，就让他们去踢球。

paras.en: "I feel like our guys did that around me today. It wasn't a one-man show. It was a really good team effort."
paras.zh: “我觉得我们的球员今天在我身边做到了这一点。这不是一场个人表演。这是一次非常出色的团队努力。”

paras.en: Coordinator Brian Flores' schemes didn't work at all against the 49ers quarterback, who orchestrated three touchdown drives on the Niners' first four possessions.
paras.zh: 协调员布莱恩·弗洛雷斯的计划对这位 49 人队四分卫根本不起作用，他在 9 人队的前四回合中策划了 3 次达阵。

paras.en: "He was so good. He was quick, he was confident, he threw strikes," said tight end George Kittle, who caught two TD passes.
paras.zh: “他太棒了。他速度很快，他很自信，他投出了好球，”接住两次达阵传球的近端锋乔治·基特尔说道。

paras.en: "He's playing with confidence, he understands the offense, he is confident in the offense. He knows the offense. When he goes out there he has this aura in the huddle."
paras.zh: “他打球充满信心，他了解进攻，他对进攻充满信心。他知道进攻。当他上场时，他在人群中就有这种光环。”

paras.en: San Francisco headed into half-time with a commanding 28-10 lead, fuelled by Purdy's outstanding performance and a pick-six from Ji'Ayir Brown, who intercepted Kirk Cousins and returned it for a touchdown.
paras.zh: 半场结束时，在普迪的出色表现和吉艾尔·布朗的六号位拦截柯克·考辛斯并回传达阵的推动下，旧金山队以 28-10 领先。

paras.en: The 49ers set the tone from the outset, marching downfield on an impressive seven-play, 72-yard opening drive. Purdy completed all four of his passes for 55 yards, capping the possession with a 17-yard touchdown pass to George Kittle.
paras.zh: 49人队从一开始就定下了基调，在令人印象深刻的七场比赛、72码的开局进攻中向前推进。普迪完成了全部 4 次传球，推进 55 码，最后向乔治·基特尔 (George Kittle) 传球 17 码达阵，结束了控球。

paras.en: After being forced to punt on their second possession, San Francisco quickly regained momentum, with Purdy orchestrating touchdown drives on each of their next two possessions.
paras.zh: 在被迫在第二次进攻中弃踢后，旧金山队很快恢复了势头，珀迪在接下来的两次进攻中都精心策划了触地得分。

paras.en: He threw an eight-yard touchdown pass to Kittle to make it 14ǉ before connecting with Mike Evans for a four-yard score to extend the lead to 21.
paras.zh: 他向基特尔传出一记 8 码达阵传球，将球打成 14 码，然后与迈克·埃文斯 (Mike Evans) 取得 4 码得分，将领先优势扩大到 21 码。

paras.en: Brown then intercepted Cousins on the Vikings' next play from scrimmage and returned it 18 yards for a touchdown, further extending San Francisco's advantage.
paras.zh: 随后，布朗在维京人队的下一场混战中拦截了考辛斯，并回传 18 码达阵，进一步扩大了旧金山队的优势。

paras.en: The 49ers continued to impress after the break, producing a superb 98-yard touchdown drive that featured chants of "MVP!" for Purdy. The possession was capped off by Christian McCaffrey's six-yard touchdown run, effectively putting the game beyond doubt early in the fourth quarter.
paras.zh: 中场休息后，49 人队继续给人留下深刻印象，打出了精彩的 98 码达阵，高呼“MVP！”为了珀迪。克里斯蒂安·麦卡弗里 (Christian McCaffrey) 的六码达阵冲球终结了控球权，有效地让比赛在第四节初毫无悬念。

paras.en: Purdy finished 21 of 26 for 255 yards and a remarkable passer rating of 146, more than double the league-low 69.5 rating Minnesota's defence had allowed opponents entering the game.
paras.zh: 普迪 26 投 21 中，推进 255 码，传球评分高达 146，是联盟最低评分 69.5 的两倍多。明尼苏达队的防守允许对手进入比赛。

paras.en: Reflecting on his quarterback's performance, 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said: "Seemed like he played a lot better than a lot of other guys have versus them, because not many people play that good versus that defence.
paras.zh: 49人队主教练凯尔·沙纳汉在回顾他四分卫的表现时说道：“看起来他比其他很多人在对阵他们的比赛中打得好得多，因为没有多少人在防守时打得那么好。

paras.en: "There's a reason for that. It's a huge challenge. It was hard looking at it all week. Brock didn't get rattled, which he really never does. I think it says a lot about Brock."
paras.zh: “这是有原因的。这是一个巨大的挑战。整个星期都很难看着它。布罗克没有感到不安，他真的从来没有这样做过。我认为这说明了很多关于布罗克的事情。”

paras.en: However, the emphatic victory was overshadowed by a serious injury to right tackle Colton McKivitz, who broke and dislocated his left ankle during the second quarter.
paras.zh: 然而，右截锋科尔顿·麦基维茨在第二节左脚踝骨折并脱臼，严重受伤，给这场巨大的胜利蒙上了阴影。

paras.en: McKivitz was injured at the end of a four-yard run by McCaffrey, after being caught in a collision with opposing players. The severity of the injury was immediately apparent, with team-mates visibly distressed as medical staff rushed onto the field. Left tackle Trent Williams slammed his helmet to the ground, while several 49ers players took a knee as McKivitz received treatment.
paras.zh: 麦基维茨在麦卡弗里冲出四码时与对方球员发生碰撞后受伤。伤势的严重程度立即显现出来，当医务人员赶到场上时，队友们显然很痛苦。左截锋特伦特·威廉姆斯将头盔摔在地上，而麦基维茨接受治疗时，几名 49 人队球员单膝跪地。

paras.en: Head coach Shanahan later confirmed that the injury was similar to the one that brought linebacker Fred Warner's season to an end last October.
paras.zh: 主教练沙纳汉后来证实，这次伤病与去年十月导致线卫弗雷德·沃纳赛季结束的伤病类似。

paras.en: "That was really crushing," Shanahan said. "Colton has had an unbelievable year. It was tough to see him go down like that."
paras.zh: “这真的令人心碎，”沙纳汉说。 “科尔顿度过了令人难以置信的一年。看到他这样倒下真是很难受。”

paras.en: Despite the convincing victory, McKivitz's injury provided a sobering moment for San Francisco, with the team now facing the prospect of being without a key member of its offensive line.
paras.zh: 尽管取得了令人信服的胜利，但麦基维茨的受伤为旧金山队提供了一个清醒的时刻，球队现在面临着进攻线上失去关键成员的前景。

paras.en: It's the Vikings' second defeat in three weeks, with Cousins also throwing a pick-six in Week Nine for the Las Vegas Raiders, before he was traded back to Minnesota.
paras.zh: 这是维京人队三周内的第二场失利，考辛斯在第九周为拉斯维加斯突袭者队投出了第六顺位，然后被交易回明尼苏达州。

paras.en: He became the first player ever to throw a pick-six for two teams against the same opponent in a season.
paras.zh: 他成为第一个在一个赛季中为两支球队对同一对手投出六号位的球员。

paras.en: Cousins went 26 for 38 for 235 yards and was unable to follow up his winning performance last week at Green Bay.
paras.zh: 考辛斯38投26中推进235码，无法延续上周在绿湾的胜利表现。

paras.en: "There's no group that I have more confidence in than not only those players on defense and that coaching staff." Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell said.
paras.zh: “我对防守球员和教练组更有信心。”维京人队主教练凯文·奥康奈尔说道。

paras.en: "There's just no really other way to put it. We just got beat tonight.
paras.zh: “没有其他的说法了。我们今晚刚刚被击败了。

paras.en: "They made some plays. I think the quarterback [Purdy] is really good and they got a bunch of really good players and they execute at a really high level."
paras.zh: “他们打了一些比赛。我认为四分卫（珀迪）真的很棒，他们有一群非常优秀的球员，而且他们的执行水平非常高。”

paras.en: The 49ers will look to extend their 9-1 record as they welcome Seattle Seahawks on Sunday, while the Vikings face off against the Atlanta Falcons in Minneapolis on the same night.
paras.zh: 49 人队将在周日迎战西雅图海鹰队时寻求延续 9 胜 1 负的战绩，而维京人队则于同晚在明尼阿波利斯迎战亚特兰大猎鹰队。

articles.title: De Villiers: Ball tampering started in Durban Test

paras.en: Sandpapergate: AB de Villiers makes explosive claim about ball-tampering in 2018 Durban Test
paras.zh: Sandpapergate：AB de Villiers 对 2018 年德班测试中的球篡改做出了爆炸性声明

paras.en: AB de Villiers has claimed Australia were tampering with the ball during the first Test of their infamous 2018 tour of South Africa.
paras.zh: AB de Villiers 声称澳大利亚在臭名昭著的 2018 年南非之旅的第一次测试中对球进行了篡改。

paras.en: The former South African batter, who featured throughout the 2018 series, has also backed Usman Khawaja and Cameron Bancroft's explosive revelations about Sandpapergate, claiming that Australia's bowlers "knew" about the ball-tampering operation.
paras.zh: 这位在 2018 年系列赛中出场的前南非击球手还支持乌斯曼·卡瓦贾和卡梅伦·班克罗夫特对“沙纸门”事件的爆炸性揭露，声称澳大利亚的投球手“知道”篡改球的行为。

paras.en: "It started in Durban, by the way, not in PE [Port Elizabeth]," de Villiers said on his YouTube channel, AB de Villiers 360..
paras.zh: de Villiers 在他的 YouTube 频道 AB de Villiers 360 上说道：“顺便说一句，事情是从德班开始的，而不是在 PE [伊丽莎白港]。”

paras.en: "And I'm very happy for people to quote me on that. We lost that first Test match in Durban with the ball reversing at a very, very interesting time. Way too early for anyone to reverse a ball at Kingsmead.
paras.zh: “我很高兴有人引用我的话。我们在德班输掉了第一场测试赛，在一个非常非常有趣的时刻发生了逆转。对于任何人来说在金麦德逆转球都太早了。

paras.en: "Trust me, I've played a lot of cricket there. So whatever they did there, whether it was sandpaper or a nail or I don't care. I honestly do not care. The fact of the matter is they were caught and everyone knew.
paras.zh: “相信我，我在那里打了很多板球。所以无论他们在那里做了什么，无论是砂纸还是钉子，我都不在乎。老实说，我不在乎。事实是他们被抓住了，每个人都知道。

paras.en: "The bowlers in particular knew because the ball doesn't just reverse.
paras.zh: “投球手尤其知道，因为球不会简单地逆转。

paras.en: "It's not your first Test match for Australia. So just stand up and say, 'guys, we were wrong'."
paras.zh: “这不是你们第一次代表澳大利亚参加测试赛。所以，站起来说，‘伙计们，我们错了’。”

articles.title: Wolff: Russell-Verstappen provocations a good factor of F1 entertainment

paras.en: Max Verstappen rivalry with George Russell 'a good factor' of F1 entertainment, says Mercedes chief Toto Wolff
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯首席执行官托托·沃尔夫表示，马克斯·维斯塔潘与乔治·拉塞尔的竞争是F1娱乐的“一个很好的因素”

paras.en: A long-standing feud between Max Verstappen and George Russell was reignited at the Las Vegas Grand Prix; Russell criticised Verstappen following a collision between the pair in final practice; Verstappen taunted Russell after winning the race as the Mercedes driver crashed out
paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘和乔治·拉塞尔之间长期的不和在拉斯维加斯大奖赛上重新点燃。在最后一次练习中两人发生碰撞后，拉塞尔批评了维斯塔潘。维斯塔潘在赢得比赛后嘲笑拉塞尔，因为梅赛德斯车手撞车了

paras.en: Mercedes chief Toto Wolff says the "provocations" between his driver George Russell and Red Bull's Max Verstappen are a "good factor of the entertainment" in Formula 1.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯首席执行官托托·沃尔夫表示，他的车手乔治·拉塞尔和红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘之间的“挑衅”是一级方程式赛车中的“娱乐元素”。

paras.en: Hostilities between the pair were renewed at the Las Vegas Grand Prix as a collision in final practice was followed by a war of words that threatens to continue at next weekend's Qatar Grand Prix, live on Sky Sports F1 from Friday.
paras.zh: 两人之间的敌意在拉斯维加斯大奖赛上再次爆发，最终练习赛中发生碰撞，随后爆发了口水战，这场口水战可能会在下周末的卡塔尔大奖赛上继续下去，天空体育F1从周五开始直播。

paras.en: After Russell had criticised Verstappen ahead of Saturday night's race in Las Vegas, the pair battled for the lead for much of the race, with Verstappen claiming victory as Russell finished ninth after a late error - made as he tried to pass his team-mate Kimi Antonelli for second - dropped the Brit down the field.
paras.zh: 在拉塞尔在周六晚上的拉斯维加斯比赛前批评了维斯塔潘后，两人在比赛的大部分时间里都在为领先而战，维斯塔潘声称胜利，拉塞尔在试图超越队友基米·安东内利获得第二名时犯了一个后期错误，最终获得第九名，让英国人落后了。

paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: Verstappen poked fun at Russell at the time over team radio and then laid into the Mercedes driver during the post-race press conference, claiming that "he's so far below my level".
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘当时通过车队电台取笑拉塞尔，然后在赛后新闻发布会上对梅赛德斯车手进行了攻击，声称“他的水平远远低于我”。

paras.en: Wolff, who was speaking after the race but before Verstappen had spoken in the press conference, suggested the rivalry was good for the sport.
paras.zh: 沃尔夫在赛后、维斯塔潘在新闻发布会上发言之前发表了讲话，他表示这种竞争对这项运动有利。

paras.en: Asked whether it was a bad idea for Russell to engage in 'mind games' with Verstappen, Wolff replied: "They have known each other so long since karting.
paras.zh: 当被问及拉塞尔与维斯塔潘进行“心理游戏”是否是一个坏主意时，沃尔夫回答道：“他们从卡丁车比赛以来就认识了很久。

paras.en: "I think it's probably been a bit of cat and mouse.
paras.zh: “我认为这可能有点猫捉老鼠的感觉。

paras.en: "These provocations in either side is another good factor of the entertainment."
paras.zh: “双方的这些挑衅是娱乐的另一个好因素。”

paras.en: Their feud has reignited almost exactly two years on from a major blow up following the 2024 Qatar Grand Prix, which saw a remarkable war of words follow an incident in which Verstappen felt Russell had pushed unreasonably hard to get him penalised by the stewards.
paras.zh: 他们的不和在 2024 年卡塔尔大奖赛后发生重大冲突后几乎整整两年重新燃起，维斯塔潘认为拉塞尔为了让他受到赛会干事的处罚而采取了不合理的手段，随后发生了一场引人注目的口水战。

paras.en: The collision between the pair in final practice happened after Verstappen had overtaken Russell as the pair were both preparing for push laps, which Russell felt was in breach of a gentleman's agreement the drivers have.
paras.zh: 两人在最后练习中的碰撞发生在维斯塔潘超越拉塞尔之后，当时两人都在准备推圈，拉塞尔认为这违反了车手之间的君子协议。

paras.en: The stewards gave Verstappen a warning for causing the collision, which Russell accepted as an appropriate outcome, but he insisted that "somebody's got to stand up to that guy".
paras.zh: 赛会干事就维斯塔潘引发碰撞的问题向他发出了警告，拉塞尔接受了这一警告，认为这是一个适当的结果，但他坚持认为“必须有人站出来对抗那个家伙”。

paras.en: Asked if he knew whether the pair had exchanged words following the incident, Wolff said: "I guess in the stewards' room there was a bit of an exchange."
paras.zh: 当被问及他是否知道两人在事件发生后是否有过交谈时，沃尔夫说：“我猜在乘务室里有过一些交流。”

paras.en: Verstappen drove superbly to win the race, managing his deployment expertly to immediately regain the lead on several occasions.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘凭借出色的驾驶赢得了比赛，熟练地管理自己的部署，多次立即重新获得领先。

paras.en: Wolff, who publicly courted Verstappen after it was confirmed Lewis Hamilton was leaving Mercedes to join Ferrari, was impressed by the Dutchman's display.
paras.zh: 在刘易斯·汉密尔顿确认离开梅赛德斯加盟法拉利后，沃尔夫公开向维斯塔潘示好，荷兰人的表现给沃尔夫留下了深刻的印象。

paras.en: "I think Max is a deserving winner [of the race]. He made no mistakes, and that's why he won the race.
paras.zh: “我认为马克斯是当之无愧的（比赛）获胜者。他没有犯任何错误，这就是他赢得比赛的原因。

paras.en: "He always had a response. Some very good driving."
paras.zh: “他总是有回应。他的驾驶技术非常好。”
