articles.title: Iraqi security forces deploy in Iran-backed militia stronghold
articles.author: Reuters

paras.en: JURF AL-SAKHAR, Iraq — Iraqi security forces deployed in Jurf al-Sakhar, a stronghold of the Kataib Hezbollah armed group, on Friday under a deal that seeks to limit the reach of Iran’s most powerful Shi’ite militia ally in the country without provoking a confrontation.
paras.zh: 伊拉克尤尔夫萨哈尔——周五，伊拉克安全部队部署在真主党旅武装组织尤尔夫萨哈尔的据点，该协议旨在限制伊朗最强大的什叶派民兵盟友在该国的影响力，同时又不引发对抗。

paras.en: Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi this week ordered security forces to move against the heavily armed Kataib Hezbollah, which officials accused of running an oil smuggling network siphoning state-owned oil worth hundreds of millions of dollars in Jurf al-Sakhar.
paras.zh: 总理阿里·扎伊迪本周下令安全部队对全副武装的卡塔布真主党采取行动，该组织官员被指控在尤尔夫萨哈尔经营一个石油走私网络，窃取价值数亿美元的国有石油。

paras.en: The hardline Kataib Hezbollah (Battalions of the Party of God), branded a terrorist group by the United States, has rejected the smuggling accusations, which have led to arrests that prompted fears of an armed response. The group is among those that have claimed attacks on US forces in Gulf states since the start of the US-Israeli war on Iran.
paras.zh: 被美国称为恐怖组织的强硬派真主党旅否认了走私指控，这些指控导致了逮捕行动，引发了人们对武装回应的担忧。自美以对伊朗战争爆发以来，该组织是声称对驻海湾国家美军发动袭击的组织之一。

paras.en: A convoy of vehicles flying Iraqi flags headed into Jurf al-Sakhar on Friday and soldiers took up positions in the center after senior security officials told a press conference that government forces would protect the town.
paras.zh: 周五，一支悬挂伊拉克国旗的车队驶入尤尔夫萨哈尔，高级安全官员在新闻发布会上表示，政府部队将保护该城镇，士兵们在中心就位。

paras.en: Members of the Kataib Hezbollah group stood near their group’s flags.
paras.zh: 卡塔布真主党组织的成员站在该组织的旗帜附近。

paras.en: “From Jurf al-Sakhar, we begin asserting state authority across all of Iraq, confronting corruption and weapons beyond state control,” Zaidi told government troops who entered the town, speaking from a military operations center in Baghdad.
paras.zh: 扎伊迪在巴格达的军事行动中心对进入该镇的政府军说：“从尤尔夫·萨哈尔开始，我们开始在整个伊拉克维护国家权威，对抗腐败和国家无法控制的武器。”

paras.en: “Our decision is firm: No weapons outside state authority, no weapons but Iraq‘s, no decisions but Iraq‘s, and no flag shall fly higher than the Iraqi flag.”
paras.zh: “我们的决定是坚定的：没有国家权力之外的武器，没有伊拉克以外的武器，没有伊拉克以外的任何决定，没有任何旗帜可以飘扬得比伊拉克国旗更高。”

paras.en: Under the arrangement, brokered by Shi’ite politicians, Kataib members were expected to withdraw to other parts of Iraq, a major oil producer and ally of both the US and Iran.
paras.zh: 根据什叶派政界人士的安排，卡塔布成员预计将撤至伊拉克其他地区。伊拉克是主要石油生产国，也是美国和伊朗的盟友。

paras.en: “God willing, things will be safe and secure with the presence of the security forces,” said resident Mohamed Ali.
paras.zh: 居民穆罕默德·阿里说：“上帝保佑，有安全部队在场，一切都会安全无虞。”

paras.en: Senior Iranian representative visited Baghdad, sources say
paras.zh: 消息人士称，伊朗高级代表访问了巴格达

paras.en: The deal will include the opening of a security headquarters in Jurf al-Sakhar on Saturday to oversee the handover. Iraq‘s energy police have begun securing an oil pipeline in Jurf al-Sakhar, the state news agency reported.
paras.zh: 该协议将包括周六在尤尔夫萨哈尔开设安全总部，以监督移交工作。据国家通讯社报道，伊拉克能源警察已开始保护尤尔夫萨哈尔的一条石油管道。

paras.en: “Today is a historic moment in which the Iraqi Armed Forces prove that they are the nation’s shield, safety valve, and the guardian ensuring security stability for the Iraqi people,” Sabah al-Numan, spokesperson for the commander-in-chief of the Iraqi armed forces, told the press conference.
paras.zh: 伊拉克武装部队总司令发言人萨巴赫·努曼在新闻发布会上表示：“今天是一个历史性时刻，伊拉克武装部队证明了他们是国家的盾牌、安全阀和确保伊拉克人民安全稳定的守护者。”

paras.en: Reflecting the sensitivity of the situation, Iraqi Shi’ite political figures said Esmail Qaani, commander of Iran’s Revolutionary Guards’ Quds Force, arrived in Baghdad on Monday to help defuse tensions with Kataib Hezbollah.
paras.zh: 伊拉克什叶派政治人物表示，伊朗革命卫队圣城旅指挥官埃斯梅尔·卡尼周一抵达巴格达，以帮助缓和与真主党旅的紧张关系，这反映了局势的敏感性。

paras.en: So far, nine senior security and oil officials have been dismissed following an investigation focused on Jurf al-Sakhar in Babil province, about 50 km (30 miles) south of Baghdad.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，在针对巴比伦省（巴格达​​以南约 50 公里（30 英里））的 Jurf al-Sakhar 进行调查后，已有 9 名高级安全和石油官员被解雇。

paras.en: Any direct confrontation with Iran’s heavily armed militia allies in Iraq could be risky.
paras.zh: 与伊朗在伊拉克​​全副武装的民兵盟友的任何直接对抗都可能存在风险。

paras.en: After one of Zaidi’s predecessors ordered a similar crackdown on those armed groups five years ago, the prime minister’s Baghdad home was hit in a drone strike that authorities described at the time as an assassination attempt.
paras.zh: 五年前，扎伊迪的一位前任下令对这些武装团体进行类似的镇压，之后总理的巴格达住所遭到无人机袭击，当局当时称这是一次暗杀企图。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump has pressured Zaidi to disarm the militias that have struck US troops and facilities in Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates in solidarity with Tehran since the US and Israel launched attacks on Iran in February.
paras.zh: 自美国和以色列二月份对伊朗发动袭击以来，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普向扎伊迪施压，要求其解除袭击美国驻沙特阿拉伯和阿拉伯联合酋长国军队和设施的民兵武装，以声援德黑兰。

paras.en: Kataib Hezbollah and other militias, all of whom report directly to Iran’s Revolutionary Guards, have refused to hand over their weapons to the state.
paras.zh: 卡塔布真主党和其他民兵都直接向伊朗革命卫队报告，但拒绝将武器交给国家。

paras.en: Founded in the aftermath of the 2003 US-led invasion of Iraq, Kataib is among the most influential members of the Islamic Resistance in Iraq, the umbrella group of hardline Shi’ite armed organisations supported by Iran.
paras.zh: 卡塔布成立于 2003 年美国领导的入侵伊拉克之后，是伊拉克伊斯兰抵抗组织最有影响力的成员之一，该组织是伊朗支持的强硬什叶派武装组织的伞形组织。

paras.en: Kataib Hezbollah quickly developed a reputation for deadly attacks against military and diplomatic targets during the US-led counterinsurgency war and sectarian conflict of the 2000s, using snipers, rockets, mortars and roadside bombs.
paras.zh: 在 2000 年代美国领导的平叛战争和教派冲突中，卡塔布真主党使用狙击手、火箭弹、迫击炮和路边炸弹对军事和外交目标发动致命袭击，从而迅速赢得了声誉。

paras.en: Since the 2003 US-led invasion toppled Iran’s arch-enemy, longtime Sunni leader Saddam Hussein, Tehran has steadily expanded its influence in Iraq through close ties with heavily armed Shi’ite militias and political parties.
paras.zh: 自2003年美国领导的入侵推翻了伊朗的宿敌、逊尼派长期领导人萨达姆·侯赛因以来，德黑兰通过与全副武装的什叶派民兵和政党的密切联系，稳步扩大了其在伊拉克的影响力。

paras.en: Iraqi security officials say the militias’ arsenals include assault rifles, machineguns, anti-tank guided missiles, mortars, precision-guided rockets, armed drones and some short-range ballistic and cruise missile capabilities.
paras.zh: 伊拉克安全官员表示，民兵的武器库包括突击步枪、机枪、反坦克制导导弹、迫击炮、精确制导火箭、武装无人机以及一些短程弹道导弹和巡航导弹能力。

paras.en: Kataib has its own political party, called Huquq, or Rights, with five lawmakers. An Iraqi official report said the group also generates cash through businesses such as construction, housing, trade, tourism and currency exchange, though Kataib denies this and says it is dedicated to security.
paras.zh: 卡塔布有自己的政党，称为“Huquq”或“权利”，有五名议员。伊拉克官方报告称，该组织还通过建筑、住房、贸易、旅游和货币兑换等业务赚取现金，但卡塔布否认这一点，并表示其致力于安全。

paras.en: Pro-Iranian militias, including Kataib, enjoy a semi-official status in Iraq, which critics say encourages them to act with impunity. A shadowy group with no announced leadership structure, Kataib Hezbollah has thousands of hardened fighters.
paras.zh: 包括卡塔布在内的亲伊朗民兵在伊拉克享有半官方地位，批评者称这鼓励他们肆无忌惮地行事。卡塔布真主党是一个没有公布领导结构的神秘组织，拥有数千名顽强的战士。

paras.en: It forms several battalions in Iraq‘s Popular Mobilization Forces (PMF), a grouping of armed factions set up in 2014 to fight Islamic State and subsequently recognized as an official security force.
paras.zh: 它在伊拉克人民动员部队 (PMF) 中组建了多个营，该部队是 2014 年为打击伊斯兰国而成立的武装派别组织，随后被承认为官方安全部队。

paras.en: Fighters receive state salaries and Kataib Hezbollah members, including some designated as terrorists by the US, hold senior positions in the PMF. While it is technically under the command of Iraq‘s prime minister as part of the PMF, the group often operates outside the chain of command.
paras.zh: 战士们领取国家工资，卡塔布真主党成员，包括一些被美国认定为恐怖分子的成员，在 PMF 中担任高级职务。虽然从技术上讲，该组织是伊拉克总理的指挥下，属于人民动员部队的一部分，但该组织经常在指挥系统之外开展活动。

articles.title: Managers fined for failings in lead-up to deadly wedding bus crash
articles.author: Giselle Wakatama

paras.en: Rodney Parker, 42, and Katie Parker, 39, were convicted today and fined after pleading guilty to heavy vehicle safety breaches.
paras.zh: 42 岁的罗德尼·帕克 (Rodney Parker) 和 39 岁的凯蒂·帕克 (Katie Parker) 在承认严重违反车辆安全规定后于今天被定罪并处以罚款。

paras.en: Katie Parker admitted to failures relating to a disclosure about substance use by driver Brett Button, who crashed and killed 10 people in 2023.
paras.zh: 凯蒂·帕克 (Katie Parker) 承认，她未能披露司机布雷特·巴顿 (Brett Button) 的药物滥用情况，该司机于 2023 年发生车祸并造成 10 人死亡。

paras.en: Both faced a maximum fine of $59,000 but will only pay $7,000 due to guilty pleas and financial hardship.
paras.zh: 两人都面临最高 59,000 美元的罚款，但由于认罪和经济困难，只需要支付 7,000 美元。

paras.en: Two bus company managers have been convicted and fined for safety breaches stemming from the deadly Hunter wedding crash that killed 10 people.
paras.zh: 亨特婚礼事故造成 10 人死亡，两名巴士公司经理因违反安全规定而被定罪并处以罚款。

paras.en: Driver Brett Andrew Button was at the wheel when the Linq Buslines coach tipped and crashed in June 2023.
paras.zh: 2023 年 6 月，Linq Buslines 客车翻倒并坠毁时，司机布雷特·安德鲁·巴顿 (Brett Andrew Button) 正在驾驶。

paras.en: He is serving a maximum of 32 years in jail.
paras.zh: 他正在监狱服刑，最高刑期为 32 年。

paras.en: Former Linq Buslines manager Rodney Parker and former area manager Katie Parker both pleaded guilty to one offence in response to a prosecution launched by the National Heavy Vehicle Regulator (NHVR).
paras.zh: Linq Buslines 前经理罗德尼·帕克 (Rodney Parker) 和前区域经理凯蒂·帕克 (Katie Parker) 在国家重型车辆监管机构 (NHVR) 发起的起诉中均承认一项罪行。

paras.en: In Gosford Local Court today, Judge Kirralee Perry said each faced a fine of $59,000.
paras.zh: 今天在戈斯福德地方法院，法官 Kirralee Perry 表示，每人都面临 59,000 美元的罚款。

paras.en: But Judge Perry set fines of $7,000 each, noting they had limited means to pay more.
paras.zh: 但佩里法官对每人处以 7,000 美元的罚款，并指出他们支付更多费用的能力有限。

paras.en: Katie Parker pleaded guilty to one offence, admitting she failed to take reasonable actions or steps on "over speed" incidents, as well as admitting failures relating to substance-use disclosures.
paras.zh: 凯蒂·帕克承认了一项罪行，承认她未能对“超速”事件采取合理的行动或步骤，并承认未能披露与药物使用有关的信息。

paras.en: Button admitted during his sentencing he was dependent on the opioid Tramadol, and accepted it impaired his driving on the night he crashed.
paras.zh: 巴顿在宣判期间承认，他依赖阿片类药物曲马多，并承认它在撞车当晚影响了他的驾驶。

paras.en: During sentencing, Judge Perry said Katie Parker had been told about Button's use of an opioid four months before the deadly crash, but did not make further inquiries.
paras.zh: 佩里法官在判刑时表示，凯蒂·帕克在致命车祸发生前四个月被告知巴顿使用阿片类药物，但没有进行进一步调查。

paras.en: "She was the area manager, and she was responsible for the review and enforcement of the company drug and alcohol policy," Judge Perry said.
paras.zh: 佩里法官说：“她是区域经理，负责审查和执行公司的毒品和酒精政策。”

paras.en: "In February 2023, during random drug testing a driver [Button] disclosed he had taken Tramadol prescribed as a synthetic opioid in the 14 days prior."
paras.zh: “2023 年 2 月，在随机药物测试中，一名司机 [Button] 透露，他在 14 天前服用了作为合成阿片类药物的曲马多。”

paras.en: Judge Perry said Katie Parker, 39, failed to "take any further reasonable steps to investigate the medication and the effects it could have had on driving".
paras.zh: 佩里法官表示，39 岁的凯蒂·帕克未能“采取任何进一步的合理措施来调查药物及其可能对驾驶产生的影响”。

paras.en: "If such steps been taken it would have minimised or eliminated the public risk Button posed,"
paras.zh: “如果采取这些措施，就会最大限度地减少或消除巴顿造成的公共风险，”

paras.en: In terms of over-speeding, Judge Perry said Katie Parker's role was to monitor those incidents.
paras.zh: 在超速方面，佩里法官表示，凯蒂·帕克的职责是监控这些事件。

paras.en: "The company did not have a specific speed disciplinary policy separate to a vehicle monitoring device," she said.
paras.zh: “该公司没有与车辆监控设备分开的具体速度纪律政策，”她说。

paras.en: "Non-conforming reports were completed sometimes weeks after over-speeds."
paras.zh: “有时超速几周后就会完成不合格报告。”

paras.en: In New South Wales, the maximum speed limit for a vehicle with more than 4.5 tonnes gross vehicle mass (GVM) is 100 kilometres an hour.
paras.zh: 在新南威尔士州，车辆总质量 (GVM) 超过 4.5 吨的车辆的最高速度限制为每小时 100 公里。

paras.en: The court heard the bus Button was driving was 18 tonnes.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，巴顿驾驶的巴士重 18 吨。

paras.en: Rodney Parker, 42, pleaded guilty to one charge under the NHVR legislation.
paras.zh: 42 岁的罗德尼·帕克 (Rodney Parker) 承认根据 NHVR 立法提出的一项指控有罪。

paras.en: He admitted to failing to make adequate and relevant inquiries about Button's prior employment.
paras.zh: 他承认未能对巴顿之前的工作情况进行充分且相关的调查。

paras.en: The court heard he did a reference check via text message with a previous employer, and during the exchange referred to drivers as "steering wheel attendants".
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，他通过短信与前雇主进行了背景调查，并在交流过程中将司机称为“方向盘服务员”。

paras.en: The man texted Rodney Parker and said "Button was a good bloke who will keep it straight", adding that he "could get his rags on if he feels like he's been f****d over".
paras.zh: 该男子给罗德尼·帕克发短信说，“巴顿是一个好人，他会保持正直”，并补充说，“如果他觉得自己已经被搞砸了，他可以穿上破烂的衣服”。

paras.en: Judge Perry said the language used was "cavalier, irresponsible, flippant and careless".
paras.zh: 佩里法官表示，所使用的语言“傲慢、不负责任、轻率和粗心”。

paras.en: "In my view the language used in the [text message reference check] , fell well short of what the public would expect,"
paras.zh: “在我看来，[短信背景调查]中使用的语言远远低于公众的预期，”

paras.en: Judge Perry said there were recruitment failings at the time Button was employed in November 2022.
paras.zh: 佩里法官表示，巴顿于 2022 年 11 月受聘时存在招聘失败的情况。

paras.en: "The company had no policy or procedures that those applying undergo medical assessment or provide valid references from previous employers," she said.
paras.zh: “公司没有政策或程序要求申请者接受医疗评估或提供前雇主的有效推荐信，”她说。

paras.en: In August, Linq Buslines was fined $650,000 for heavy‑vehicle safety breaches, including over-speeding, poor recruitment checks, and employing a drug‑impaired driver
paras.zh: 8 月，Linq Buslines 因重型车辆安全违规被罚款 65 万美元，包括超速、招聘检查不力以及雇用吸毒司机

paras.en: Directors Christopher Fogg and Anthony Royle were convicted and each fined $12,000.
paras.zh: 董事克里斯托弗·福格 (Christopher Fogg) 和安东尼·罗伊尔 (Anthony Royle) 被定罪，各被罚款 12,000 美元。

paras.en: The pair are appealing their convictions.
paras.zh: 两人正在对自己的判决提出上诉。

paras.en: Linq Buslines has since collapsed, owing hundreds of thousands of dollars in fines.
paras.zh: Linq Buslines 自此倒闭，欠下数十万美元的罚款。

paras.en: A report by the corporate regulator ASIC said that, as of October 19, the company only had $265,000 in cash, which was expected to be depleted as administrators were paid.
paras.zh: 公司监管机构ASIC的一份报告称，截至10月19日，该公司仅有26.5万美元现金，预计随着管理人员的支付，现金将耗尽。

articles.title: Australia beats France in Billie Jean King Cup tie

paras.en: Australia beats France 4-0 in its Billie Jean King Cup play-off tie.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队在比利·简·金杯附加赛中以 4-0 击败法国队。

paras.en: Maya Joint beat Elsa Jacquemot 6-1, 6-3 in the final match.
paras.zh: 玛雅联合队在决赛中以6-1、6-3击败埃尔莎·雅克莫特。

paras.en: Australia will compete in the qualifiers for the 2027 Billie Jean King Cup finals in April.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队将于 4 月参加 2027 年比利·简·金杯决赛的预选赛。

paras.en: Sam Stosur's Australian team will be back for a crack at the Billie Jean King Cup crown next year after "unreal" Maya Joint joined the party with two victories to seal a crushing 4-0 win over France in their play-off tie at Le Portel.
paras.zh: 萨姆·斯托瑟 (Sam Stosur) 率领的澳大利亚队将于明年重返比利·吉恩·金杯 (Billie Jean King Cup) 的桂冠，此前“不真实的”玛雅·联合 (Maya Joint) 凭借两场胜利加入队伍，并在勒波特尔 (Le Portel) 的附加赛中以 4-0 碾压法国队。

paras.en: Joint had watched her teammates Storm Hunter and national number one Talia Gibson give the visitors a convincing lead in the French seaside town after the first day on Saturday, but was thrust into the action alongside Hunter to try to seal victory in the key doubles rubber on Sunday, local time.
paras.zh: 周六第一天后，联合目睹了她的队友斯托姆·亨特和国家排名第一的塔莉亚·吉布森在法国海滨小镇为客队取得了令人信服的领先优势，但她在当地时间周日的关键双打比赛中与亨特并肩作战，试图锁定胜利。

paras.en: Even on the Le Chaudron clay court chosen by the hosts, the Aussie duo were in a different league to the home pairing of world number 38 Diane Parry and world No.8 doubles player Kristina Mladenovic, racing to a tie-sealing 6-2 6-4 victory.
paras.zh: 即使在东道主选择的 Le Chaudron 红土球场上，这对澳大利亚组合也与世界排名第 38 的黛安·帕里和世界排名第 8 的双打选手克里斯蒂娜·姆拉德诺维奇的主场搭档处于不同的联赛，最终以 6-2 6-4 扳平比分获胜。

paras.en: Joint, who produced some spectacular tennis in that win, then got in on the singles action, swiftly outplaying Elsa Jacquemot 6-1 6-3 in under an hour. Victory in that "dead" rubber underlined the triumph before organisers scrapped the last scheduled match between Hunter and Clara Burel.
paras.zh: 在那场胜利中，联合打出了精彩的网球表现，随后进入单打比赛，在不到一个小时的时间里以 6-1 6-3 迅速击败了艾尔莎·雅克莫特。在组织者取消亨特和克拉拉·布雷尔之间最后一场预定的比赛之前，这场“死”橡胶的胜利突显了这场胜利。

paras.en: "Maya was unreal today. It was a really tough match against quality opponents," said Hunter, whose own game always seems to go up a notch when she wears the green and gold.
paras.zh: “玛雅今天的表现很不真实。这对优秀的对手来说是一场非常艰难的比赛，”亨特说，当她穿上绿色和金色的球衣时，她自己的比赛似乎总是会提高一个档次。

paras.en: Joint, delighted to be returning to her best at the end of a season when her Wimbledon triumph over Serena Williams proved the absolute highlight, added: "The vibes were high all week, we were just really happy and excited to all be here."
paras.zh: 联合很高兴能在赛季结束后恢复到最佳状态，她在温布尔登击败塞雷娜·威廉姆斯的胜利证明了绝对的亮点，她补充道：“整个星期气氛都很高，我们真的很高兴也很兴奋来到这里。”

paras.en: The three Australians, between them, had blasted through their four matches without dropping a set, and conceding just 20 games over the whole weekend of one-sided fare.
paras.zh: 这三名澳大利亚选手在四场比赛中表现出色，未丢一盘，整个周末只丢了 20 场比赛。

paras.en: It was also a moment of revenge for captain Stosur, who played in the 2019 final, which she lost 3-2 on home soil in Perth against a French team that included Mladenovic.
paras.zh: 这也是队长斯托瑟的复仇时刻，斯托瑟曾参加过 2019 年决赛，但她在珀斯主场以 3-2 输给了包括姆拉德诺维奇在内的法国队。

paras.en: If they had lost the tie, she knew Australia would have been condemned to relegation to its regional group next year, thus ruling it out of a chance to shoot for the 2027 title.
paras.zh: 如果他们输掉了这场比赛，她知道澳大利亚明年将注定降级到地区组，从而失去争夺 2027 年冠军的机会。

paras.en: Instead, they will be back in April's qualifiers amid what looks like a renaissance in the Australian women's game, looking to seal a place in the week-long finals in Shenzhen where they could pursue a first title since 1974, when the World Cup of women's tennis was known as the Federation Cup.
paras.zh: 相反，她们将在四月份的预选赛中回归，澳大利亚女子网球运动似乎正在复兴，希望在深圳为期一周的决赛中占据一席之地，在那里她们可以争夺自 1974 年以来的第一个冠军头衔，当时女子网球世界杯被称为联合会杯。

paras.en: "It's a fantastic feeling for us right now; we put in a lot of hard work to try and make this result happen," Stosur said.
paras.zh: “现在对我们来说这是一种奇妙的感觉；我们付出了很多努力来尝试实现这一结果，”斯托瑟说。

paras.en: "We put on these jackets in the green-and-gold, and it really does bring out the best in a lot of our players. If we can keep building the way we are, for sure we want to try and lift that trophy one day again."
paras.zh: “我们穿上了这些绿金相间的夹克，它确实激发了我们很多球员的最佳状态。如果我们能够继续保持现在的状态，我们肯定希望有一天能够再次举起奖杯。”

paras.en: The seven-time champions are looking to bounce back from a disappointing early exit in 2026 when they lost 3-1 in a home qualifier against Great Britain in Melbourne in April.
paras.zh: 这支七冠王球队希望从 2026 年令人失望的提前出局中恢复过来，当时他们在 4 月份在墨尔本举行的主场预选赛中以 3-1 输给了英国队。

paras.en: It's now four years since Australia last reached the final, losing 2-0 to Switzerland in Glasgow.
paras.zh: 距离澳大利亚上一次打入决赛已有四年了，当时澳大利亚在格拉斯哥以 2-0 输给了瑞士。

articles.title: Giddey's historic triple-double rewrites 60-year Chicago Bulls record

paras.en: Josh Giddey has had 23 points, 22 assists and 14 rebounds for the Chicago Bulls.
paras.zh: 乔什·吉迪为芝加哥公牛队贡献23分、22次助攻和14个篮板。

paras.en: It is the most assists for the Chicago Bulls since 1985.
paras.zh: 这是芝加哥公牛队自 1985 年以来助攻最多的一次。

paras.en: It is the first time since 1966 that a Bulls player has had at least 20 points, 20 assists and 10 rebounds in a single game.
paras.zh: 这是自1966年以来公牛队球员首次单场得到至少20分、20次助攻和10个篮板。

paras.en: Josh Giddey has broken his own NBA record and rewritten 60 years of Chicago Bulls history with a remarkable triple-double in an overtime loss to Denver.
paras.zh: 乔什·吉迪 (Josh Giddey) 在加时赛输给丹佛掘金队的比赛中拿下三双，打破了自己保持的 NBA 纪录，改写了芝加哥公牛队 60 年的历史。

paras.en: The point guard improved his own assist high for Australians in the NBA with 22, while adding 23 points and 14 rebounds in the Bulls' 151-145 loss to the Nuggets.
paras.zh: 这位控球后卫以22次助攻刷新了澳大利亚队在NBA的助攻纪录，同时在公牛队以151-145输给掘金队的比赛中贡献了23分和14个篮板。

paras.en: No Chicago player had notched more than 20 assists since 1985, and Guy Rodgers in 1966 was the last Bull to record at least 20 points, 20 assists and 10 rebounds in a game.
paras.zh: 自1985年以来，没有芝加哥球员的助攻数超过20次，1966年的盖伊·罗杰斯是最后一位在一场比赛中得到至少20分、20次助攻和10个篮板的公牛队球员。

paras.en: Giddey, who hit 10 of 17 field goals and scored seven late points to force overtime, recorded his 33rd NBA triple-double to move to 14th on the all-time list — equal with countryman Ben Simmons.
paras.zh: 吉迪 17 投 10 中，并在最后时刻拿下 7 分将比赛拖入加时赛，他取得了他的第 33 次 NBA 三双，在历史榜单上排名第 14 位，与同胞本·西蒙斯 (Ben Simmons) 持平。

paras.en: Remarkably, it came after he managed just two points and was benched by coach Tiago Splitter in the fourth quarter of a loss to Washington.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，在输给华盛顿的比赛中，他在第四节仅得到两分，并被教练蒂亚戈·斯普利特(Tiago Splitter)坐在替补席上。

paras.en: He had combined 18 points, 14 rebounds and nine assists in the game before that, rebounding from a four-point effort in the game prior to sum up a rollercoaster season for the battling 4-12 Bulls.
paras.zh: 在此之前的比赛中，他总共得到18分、14个篮板和9次助攻，在比赛前的四分球中反弹，为公牛队的战绩为4胜12负，结束了一个过山车般的赛季。

paras.en: "He [Splitter] can relate to us. He was good about it and doesn't sugar-coat it. I wasn't surprised or confused as to why I wasn't out there," Giddey said post-game of his recent struggles.
paras.zh: “他（斯普利特）能够与我们产生共鸣。他对此很擅长，并且不会粉饰它。对于我为什么不在场上，我并不感到惊讶或困惑，”吉迪在赛后谈到他最近的挣扎时说道。

paras.en: "You appreciate it a lot more after the fact. During the moment, you don't want to hear those things.
paras.zh: “事后你会更加感激。在那一刻，你不想听到这些事情。

paras.en: "I have learnt you've got to be able to move on. I can't come into practice still pissed off and dwelling on things."
paras.zh: “我知道你必须能够继续前进。我不能在仍然生气和沉迷于事情的情况下开始实践。”

paras.en: Nikola Jokić had 37 points, 18 rebounds and 11 assists for the 202nd triple-double of his career — closing the gap on NBA leader Russell Westbrook (209) — while Jamal Murray scored eight of his season-high 45 points in overtime.
paras.zh: 尼古拉·约基奇拿下 37 分、18 个篮板和 11 次助攻，这是他职业生涯的第 202 次三双，缩小了与 NBA 领袖拉塞尔·威斯布鲁克 (209 分) 的差距，而贾马尔·穆雷在加时赛中拿下赛季最高 45 分中的 8 分。

paras.en: Giddey's stat line came without their two leading scorers, the injured Norman Powell and Caleb Wilson (fractured metacarpal), who are averaging a combined 39.7 points per game this season.
paras.zh: 吉迪的数据显示，他们的两名主要得分手受伤了，诺曼·鲍威尔和凯莱布·威尔逊（掌骨骨折）缺席，他们本赛季场均得分合计为 39.7 分。

paras.en: "He played extremely well," Splitter said.
paras.zh: “他打得非常好，”斯普利特说。

paras.en: "We've got to give them flowers when they deserve and last game they didn't have it. Tonight they brought it."
paras.zh: “我们必须在他们应得的时候给他们鲜花，但上一场比赛他们没有得到。今晚他们带来了。”

paras.en: Earlier on Sunday (Monday AEDT), Giddey's Boomers teammate Dyson Daniels put the brakes on Detroit star Cade Cunningham to hand Atlanta a fourth-straight win.
paras.zh: 周日早些时候（澳大利亚东部时间周一），吉迪的婴儿潮一代队友戴森·丹尼尔斯给底特律球星凯德·坎宁安踩下刹车，让亚特兰大队取得了四连胜。

paras.en: Daniels had 14 rebounds to go with eight assists, five steals and five points in his 39 minutes on court in the 107-97 win.
paras.zh: 丹尼尔斯在上场 39 分钟内得到 14 个篮板、8 次助攻、5 次抢断和 5 分，帮助球队以 107-97 获胜。

paras.en: He kept Cunningham (five points) under wraps — the All-Star failed to hit double figures for the first time this season.
paras.zh: 他对坎宁安（5分）保密——这位全明星球员本赛季第一次未能得分上双。

paras.en: The 23-year-old leads the NBA in steals at three per game through 17 matches this season, and also tops the league in deflections and loose balls recovered.
paras.zh: 这位 23 岁的球员在本赛季的 17 场比赛中场均抢断 3 次，在 NBA 中名列前茅，并且在偏转和失球回收方面也位居联盟之首。

paras.en: The Hawks are now perched in third place in the Eastern Conference with an 11-6 record.
paras.zh: 老鹰目前以11胜6负的战绩排名东部第三。

paras.en: The Pistons led 85-74 at the start of the fourth quarter before the Hawks took a 92-85 lead with 18 unanswered points. Isiah Joe's three-pointer with 4 minutes and 52 seconds remaining ended Detroit's scoreless streak.
paras.zh: 第四节开始活塞队以85-74领先，老鹰队以92-85领先18分。比赛还剩 4 分 52 秒时，伊塞亚·乔的三分球终结了底特律队的不得分纪录。

paras.en: Nickeil Alexander-Walker posted 27 points, while Corey Kispert scored a season-high 18 points and Lu Dort 16 for the Hawks, who were without CJ McCollum (left calf strain) and Australian Jock Landale (right big toe strain).
paras.zh: 尼克尔·亚历山大·沃克 (Nickeil Alexander-Walker) 拿下 27 分，科里·基斯珀特 (Corey Kispert) 拿下赛季最高的 18 分，卢·多尔特 (Lu Dort) 为老鹰队拿下 16 分，而老鹰队没有 CJ·麦科勒姆 (左小腿拉伤) 和澳大利亚人乔克·兰代尔 (右大脚趾拉伤)。

articles.title: Allies are buying Canadian underwater surveillance drones. Canada is 'not there yet'
articles.author: Ashley Burke

paras.en: Allies are buying Canadian underwater surveillance drones. Canada is 'not there yet'
paras.zh: 盟国正在购买加拿大水下无人侦察机。加拿大“还没到那一步”

paras.en: NATO allies racing to protect critical underwater cables from sabotage
paras.zh: 北约盟国竞相保护重要的水下电缆免遭破坏

paras.en: Canada has a three-ocean, 243,000-kilometre coastline and about 20 underwater drones to help defend it.
paras.zh: 加拿大拥有横跨三大洋、长达24.3万公里的海岸线和大约20架水下无人机来帮助保卫它。

paras.en: Defence officials talked last year about the need for a short-term fix to assert Canada's sovereignty, according to an internal document obtained by CBC News.
paras.zh: 据加拿大广播公司新闻获得的一份内部文件显示，去年国防官员曾谈到需要采取短期解决方案来维护加拿大的主权。

paras.en: But the Royal Canadian Navy's commander, Vice-Admiral Dan Charlebois, confirms there isn't an interim solution ready.
paras.zh: 但加拿大皇家海军司令丹·查勒布瓦中将证实，目前还没有准备好临时解决方案。

paras.en: "We're still working very closely with industry to get there. We're just not there yet," said Charlebois in an interview with CBC News.
paras.zh: 查勒布瓦在接受 CBC 新闻采访时表示：“我们仍在与业界密切合作，以实现这一目标。我们只是还没有实现这一目标。”

paras.en: The navy wanted to see if Canadian underwater drones could help address surveillance gaps along the "sparsely" monitored coast until its first uncrewed underwater surveillance system is ready, the paper obtained through an access-to-information request said.
paras.zh: 通过信息获取请求获得的文件称，在其第一个无人水下监视系统准备就绪之前，海军希望了解加拿大水下无人机是否可以帮助解决“稀疏”监控海岸沿线的监视缺口。

paras.en: The navy's current small fleet of American underwater drones is equipped with tech built by Canadian company Kraken Robotics. But the navy uses those drones for mine hunting and testing, not surveillance.
paras.zh: 美国海军目前的小型水下无人机舰队配备了加拿大 Kraken Robotics 公司制造的技术。但海军使用这些无人机进行水雷搜寻和测试，而不是监视。

paras.en: Kraken, based in Newfoundland and Labrador, and Cellula Robotics in B.C. are viewed as world leaders in underwater drone technology and are already selling their systems to allies around the globe for surveillance. But not yet to Canada.
paras.zh: Kraken 总部位于纽芬兰和拉布拉多省，Cellula Robotics 总部位于不列颠哥伦比亚省。被视为水下无人机技术的世界领导者，并且已经将其系统出售给全球的盟友进行监视。但还没到加拿大。

paras.en: Other countries are racing to monitor and protect critical underwater cables from potential acts of sabotage by adversaries.
paras.zh: 其他国家正在竞相监控和保护重要的水下电缆免受对手潜在的破坏行为。

paras.en: A massive network of these communication cables runs along ocean floors, carrying more than 95 per cent of the world's internet traffic and trillions in financial transactions. Damage could cripple societies.
paras.zh: 这些通信电缆组成的庞大网络沿着海底延伸，承载着全球 95% 以上的互联网流量和数万亿美元的金融交易。损害可能会削弱社会。

paras.en: Hundreds of submarine cables run along ocean floors around the world. These fiber-optic cables have allegedly been targeted by adversaries. (Kevin Kirk/CBC)
paras.zh: 数百条海底电缆沿着世界各地的海底延伸。据称，这些光纤电缆已成为对手的目标。 （凯文·柯克/CBC）

paras.en: University of Calgary defence expert Rob Huebert said Canada has "very significant vulnerabilities" because it can't fully detect when adversaries are entering Canadian waters.
paras.zh: 卡尔加里大学国防专家罗布·休伯特表示，加拿大存在“非常重大的漏洞”，因为它无法完全检测到对手何时进入加拿大水域。

paras.en: Canada has long relied, Huebert said, on co-operation with the U.S. Navy as a safety net and allowed its fleets, submarines and satellites to age and deteriorate.
paras.zh: 休伯特说，加拿大长期以来依赖与美国海军的合作作为安全网，并允许其舰队、潜艇和卫星老化和恶化。

paras.en: "The backstop that I think Canadian governments have always counted on was of course, if we were slow, if we were late on any of these surveillance capabilities off our coastline, well the Americans would take care of it," Huebert said.
paras.zh: 休伯特说：“我认为加拿大政府一直指望的后盾当然是，如果我们行动缓慢，如果我们在海岸线附近的任何监视能力方面迟到，那么美国人会解决的。”

paras.en: The navy is undergoing its biggest peacetime fleet renewal since the Second World War. But some replacements aren't coming until the 2030s and 2040s.
paras.zh: 海军正在进行自第二次世界大战以来和平时期最大规模的舰队更新。但有些替代品要到 2030 年代和 2040 年代才会出现。

paras.en: Ottawa's in the initial procurement phase for a $250-million to $499-million underwater surveillance system that uses drones and sensors to detect, monitor and gather intelligence about threats. The system is expected to be used in Canadian waters, including the Arctic, and during deployments abroad.
paras.zh: Ottawa's in the initial procurement phase for a $250-million to $499-million underwater surveillance system that uses drones and sensors to detect, monitor and gather intelligence about threats.该系统预计将在包括北极在内的加拿大水域以及国外部署期间使用。

paras.en: "We expect to take delivery of some large autonomous vehicles in the early 2030s," Charlebois said. "That is just around the corner when you're talking about delivering a very advanced large-scale system."
paras.zh: Charlebois 表示：“我们预计将在 2030 年代初接收一些大型自动驾驶汽车。” “当你谈论提供一个非常先进的大型系统时，这一切就指日可待了。”

paras.en: The Royal Canadian Navy's commander, Vice-Admiral Dan Charlebois, says the navy is testing out drone technology. (Mathieu Theriault/CBC)
paras.zh: 加拿大皇家海军司令丹·查勒布瓦中将表示，海军正在测试无人机技术。 （马蒂厄·塞里奥 / CBC）

paras.en: The government wants the system fully delivered by 2043. But it isn't clear yet if foreign companies will be able to bid on the project.
paras.zh: 政府希望该系统在 2043 年之前全面交付。但目前尚不清楚外国公司是否能够投标该项目。

paras.en: When asked about the obstacles to finding an interim solution, Charlebois said the procurement system "can be challenging," but he's seen an appetite from Ottawa to cut down on red tape.
paras.zh: 当被问及寻找临时解决方案的障碍时，查勒布瓦表示，采购系统“可能具有挑战性”，但他看到渥太华有兴趣减少繁文缛节。

paras.en: "The products that the navy needs exist here in Canada," he said. "We just have to enable ourselves to actually procure them and procure them at pace."
paras.zh: “海军需要的产品就在加拿大这里，”他说。 “我们只需要让自己能够实际采购它们，并按节奏采购它们。”

paras.en: Prime Minister Mark Carney promised to speed up procurement through the Defence Investment Agency. He's also vowed to massively scale up drone production.
paras.zh: 马克·卡尼总理承诺加快通过国防投资局的采购。他还发誓要大规模扩大无人机生产规模。

paras.en: Canada has 2,000 drones or so in its inventory, Carney said earlier this fall. But he said the country will need millions in the years to come.
paras.zh: 卡尼今年秋天早些时候表示，加拿大库存约有 2,000 架无人机。但他表示，未来几年该国将需要数百万美元。

paras.en: Industry Minister Mélanie Joly said the government is creating a roster of preapproved companies for sole-source contracting. The navy says this will open up "new opportunities" to work with the industry on underwater drones.
paras.zh: 工业部长梅兰妮·乔利 (Mélanie Joly) 表示，政府正在创建一份预先批准的独家承包公司名册。海军表示，这将为与水下无人机行业合作开辟“新机会”。

paras.en: Allies using tech to monitor underwater cables
paras.zh: 盟友使用技术监控水下电缆

paras.en: Off the coast of Halifax, Dave Shea, the executive vice-president of strategy and growth at Kraken Robotics, said one of the biggest challenges his company has faced in Canada is the pace of procurement. But he is excited the government wants to speed it up.
paras.zh: 在哈利法克斯海岸附近，Kraken Robotics 战略与发展执行副总裁戴夫·谢伊 (Dave Shea) 表示，他的公司在加拿大面临的最大挑战之一是采购速度。但他很高兴政府希望加快进程。

paras.en: His company outfitted the navy's small fleet of drones with synthetic aperture sonar systems.
paras.zh: 他的公司为海军的小型无人机机队配备了合成孔径声纳系统。

paras.en: Those sonar systems, Shea said, scan the sea floor for objects of interest and take high-resolution images. Kraken's technology can also listen for any submarines or boats operating in the area, he said.
paras.zh: 谢伊说，这些声纳系统扫描海底寻找感兴趣的物体并拍摄高分辨率图像。他说，Kraken 的技术还可以侦听在该地区活动的任何潜艇或船只。

paras.en: The Kraken Robotics underwater drone Katfish is designed to be towed by a boat. It carries a synthetic aperture sonar system that can take high-resolution images of the seabed. The Royal Danish Navy, the Polish Navy and Royal Australian Navy use this technology. (David Laughlin/CBC)
paras.zh: Kraken Robotics 水下无人机“鲶鱼”设计为由船拖曳。它携带合成孔径声纳系统，可以拍摄海底的高分辨率图像。丹麦皇家海军、波兰海军和澳大利亚皇家海军都使用这项技术。 （大卫·劳克林/CBC）

paras.en: In recent years, Shea said allies have pivoted to use their technology to monitor if underwater cables or pipelines have been tampered with.
paras.zh: 谢伊表示，近年来，盟国已转向使用他们的技术来监控水下电缆或管道是否被篡改。

paras.en: Canada could too, he said, but would need a much bigger fleet and longer-range drones because the coastline is so vast.
paras.zh: 他说，加拿大也可以，但需要更大的机队和更远距离的无人机，因为海岸线如此广阔。

paras.en: "There's a lot of technologies that are being built and delivered by companies like Kraken … that could be deployed directly here in Canada to help understand what's actually happening, who's in our waterways, who's in our sovereign waters and what are the risks to be able to protect Canadian capabilities," Shea said.
paras.zh: “像 Kraken 这样的公司正在开发和交付很多技术……这些技术可以直接部署在加拿大，以帮助了解实际发生的情况、谁在我们的水道中、谁在我们的主权水域以及能够保护加拿大能力的风险是什么，”谢伊说。

paras.en: Cellula Robotics CEO Neil Manning says his company has sold its long-range drone to five NATO allies, but not Canada.
paras.zh: Cellula Robotics 首席执行官尼尔·曼宁 (Neil Manning) 表示，该公司已将其远程无人机出售给五个北约盟国，但不包括加拿大。

paras.en: Systems are on order and will be heading to Europe, the U.S. and Asia, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，系统已经订购，并将运往欧洲、美国和亚洲。

paras.en: Cellula Robotics says its Guardian drones can carry out long-endurance missions. (Submitted by Cellula Robotics)
paras.zh: Cellula Robotics 表示，其 Guardian 无人机可以执行长航时任务。 （Cellula Robotics 提交）

paras.en: Cellula uses hydrogen fuel cell technology, Manning said, that's been adapted from NASA's space launches to work in the water.
paras.zh: 曼宁说，Cellula 使用氢燃料电池技术，该技术是从美国宇航局的太空发射中改编而来的，可以在水中工作。

paras.en: The company's long-range drones can travel up to 5,000 kilometres or stay out at sea for up to 45 days, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，该公司的远程无人机可以飞行长达 5,000 公里或在海上停留长达 45 天。

paras.en: "I'm highly confident that we will see domestic spend as well," Manning said. "But at the moment we're still in that cycle of building trust with with our local governments."
paras.zh: “我非常有信心我们也会看到国内支出，”曼宁说。 “但目前我们仍处于与地方政府建立信任的循环中。”

paras.en: Charlebois is aware critical infrastructure is being challenged elsewhere in the world and said he's trying to get ahead of the problem.
paras.zh: 沙勒布瓦意识到世界其他地方的关键基础设施正在受到挑战，并表示他正在努力解决这个问题。

paras.en: "This is why we're working more closely with Canadian industry than I've seen in my 34 years in the navy because we know we need to get further ahead in this space than we are," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这就是为什么我们与加拿大工业界的合作比我在海军 34 年中所见过的更加密切，因为我们知道我们需要在这个领域取得比现在更进一步的进步。”

paras.en: The navy's fleet diving unit put an underwater drone in the water to practice looking for mines in 2021 off the coast of Halifax. (Master Cpl. Anthony Laviolette/Canadian Armed Forces)
paras.zh: 2021年，海军舰队潜水部队将一架水下无人机放入水中，练习在哈利法克斯海岸附近寻找水雷。 （安东尼·拉维奥莱特少尉/加拿大武装部队）

paras.en: Canada contributes to underwater surveillance capabilities with the U.S., Charlebois said, that deliver a "really high level" of awareness, but he wants to do more and is prioritizing sensors.
paras.zh: 查勒布瓦表示，加拿大与美国共同增强水下监视能力，提供“真正高水平”的意识，但他想做更多，并优先考虑传感器。

paras.en: Asked why Canada is lagging behind protecting underwater infrastructure, Defence Minister David McGuinty said the government is working on it.
paras.zh: 当被问及为什么加拿大在保护水下基础设施方面落后时，国防部长戴维·麦坚蒂表示，政府正在努力解决这个问题。

paras.en: "I say that we're rebuilding all of our capacity underwater, on land, in the air and connected to satellites," McGuinty said. "We're building a combined layered approach to being able to understand and identify what might be coming at Canada."
paras.zh: 麦坚蒂说：“我说我们正在重建水下、陆地、空中以及与卫星连接的所有能力。” “我们正在建立一种组合的分层方法，以便能够理解和确定加拿大可能会发生什么。”

paras.en: The navy said it has a layered network of capabilities to protect this infrastructure, but noted the government, owners and allies are also responsible.
paras.zh: 海军表示，它拥有一个分层的能力网络来保护这些基础设施，但指出政府、所有者和盟友也有责任。

articles.title: Israeli strike on vehicle in Gaza kills three, Gaza Health Ministry says

paras.en: Israeli strike on vehicle in Gaza kills three, Gaza Health Ministry says
paras.zh: 加沙卫生部称，以色列对加沙车辆的袭击造成三人死亡

paras.en: World Central Kitchen says the truck was unaffiliated with the charity
paras.zh: 世界中央厨房表示，这辆卡车与该慈善机构无关

paras.en: Israeli forces hit a truck in Gaza on Saturday that witnesses said was carrying food and papers bearing the logo of the World Central Kitchen charity, but the organization said the vehicle was not affiliated with it.
paras.zh: 周六，以色列军队在加沙袭击了一辆卡车，目击者称这辆卡车载有食品和带有世界中央厨房慈善机构标志的文件，但该组织表示该车辆与其无关。

paras.en: The Gaza Health Ministry said three people were killed in the strike in Gaza City.
paras.zh: 加沙卫生部表示，加沙城的袭击造成三人死亡。

paras.en: The Israeli military said its forces had been targeting Islamic Jihad militants in the area at the time and that the vehicle had been transporting food to members of the organization.
paras.zh: 以色列军方表示，其部队当时一直在瞄准该地区的伊斯兰圣战武装分子，并且该车辆一直在向该组织成员运送食物。

paras.en: Reuters was unable to independently verify the Israeli military's statement. Islamic Jihad did not immediately comment on the strike.
paras.zh: 路透社无法独立核实以色列军方的声明。伊斯兰圣战组织没有立即对这次袭击发表评论。

paras.en: World Central Kitchen said in a statement that the truck was unaffiliated with the charity, which distributes food in Gaza. It said a driver of the vehicle had previously worked for the charity and that the two others in the car were not WCK workers.
paras.zh: 世界中央厨房在一份声明中表示，这辆卡车与该在加沙分发食品的慈善机构无关。据称，该车的一名司机此前曾为该慈善机构工作过，车上的另外两人并非 WCK 工作人员。

paras.en: After the strike, witnesses said they had discovered papers with the WCK logo on meals of cooked rice in the vehicle, Reuters video footage showed.
paras.zh: 路透社视频显示，袭击发生后，目击者称他们在车内的米饭上发现了带有 WCK 标志的纸质文件。

paras.en: Palestinian children inspect the site of the Israeli airstrike on a vehicle on Saturday. (Dawoud Abu Alkas/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周六，巴勒斯坦儿童乘车检查以色列空袭现场。 （达乌德·阿布·阿尔卡斯/路透社）

paras.en: Israel briefly launched a ground operation in Gaza earlier this week and killed six people in a strike on a hospital that it said was targeting a commander of the Palestinian militant group Hamas.
paras.zh: 以色列本周早些时候在加沙短暂发动了地面行动，对一家医院发动袭击，造成六人死亡，据称这次袭击的目标是巴勒斯坦激进组织哈马斯的一名指挥官。

paras.en: An October 2025 U.S.-backed ceasefire halted major fighting in the shattered territory but has not stopped Israeli attacks on Gaza or secured Hamas's disarmament.
paras.zh: 2025 年 10 月美国支持的停火制止了这片破碎地区的重大战斗，但并没有阻止以色列对加沙的袭击，也没有确保哈马斯解除武装。

paras.en: At least 1,600 Palestinians and five Israeli soldiers have been killed since then, according to respective Palestinian and Israeli tallies.
paras.zh: 根据巴勒斯坦和以色列各自的统计，自那时以来，至少有 1,600 名巴勒斯坦人和 5 名以色列士兵被杀。

paras.en: Israeli troops now control around two-thirds of Gaza, up from more than half at the time of the ceasefire, with Hamas controlling a sliver of territory along Gaza's coast.
paras.zh: 以色列军队现在控制着加沙约三分之二的地区，高于停火时的一半以上，哈马斯控制着加沙沿岸的一小片领土。

paras.en: - Video Camps destroyed in 2 Israeli military strikes on Gaza City
paras.zh: - 视频营地在以色列对加沙城的两次军事打击中被摧毁

paras.en: - Video ‘Hospitals should not be targeted’: UN expert reacts to strike in Gaza
paras.zh: - 视频“医院不应成为攻击目标”：联合国专家对加沙袭击的反应

paras.en: Israel's three-year-long assault on Gaza has killed more than 74,000 Palestinians, health officials say. The attacks have also caused a hunger crisis, internally displaced Gaza's entire population and led to assessments of genocide from scholars and a United Nations inquiry.
paras.zh: 卫生官员称，以色列对加沙地带长达三年的袭击已造成超过 74,000 名巴勒斯坦人死亡。这些袭击还引发了饥饿危机，使加沙全体人民在国内流离失所，并导致学者和联合国调查对种族灭绝进行了评估。

paras.en: Israel says its actions are self-defence after Hamas-led militants killed 1,200 people and took more than 250 hostages in an October 2023 attack on Israel.
paras.zh: 哈马斯领导的武装分子在 2023 年 10 月对以色列发动袭击，造成 1,200 人死亡并劫持了 250 名人质，之后以色列表示，其行动是自卫。

articles.title: Why the U.S. midterms might have ended JD Vance's presidential hopes
articles.author: Mark Gollom

paras.en: Why the U.S. midterms might have ended JD Vance's presidential hopes
paras.zh: 为什么美国中期选举可能会终结 JD 万斯的总统希望

paras.en: Trump reportedly irked by vice-president's comments on Iran
paras.zh: 据报道，特朗普对副总统对伊朗的言论感到恼火

paras.en: JD Vance's presidential ambitions for 2028 could be among the most significant political casualties of the Democratic blue wave in this month's U.S. midterm elections.
paras.zh: JD Vance 的 2028 年总统野心可能是本月美国中期选举中民主党蓝色浪潮中最重大的政治牺牲品之一。

paras.en: His chances of becoming the Republican candidate in two years may have suffered a more recent blow, as reports suggest U.S. President Donald Trump has begun to sour on his vice-president.
paras.zh: 最近，他在两年内成为共和党候选人的机会可能遭受了打击，因为有报道称美国总统唐纳德·特朗普已经开始对其副总统产生不满。

paras.en: "Despite years of work to keep his feet glued to Trump’s MAGA coattails, [Vance] is probably losing any semblance of hope that he’ll get to be a GOP frontrunner in 2028," New York Intelligencer staff editor Chas Danner wrote in an article under the headline "JD Vance’s presidential dream is being snuffed out."
paras.zh: 《纽约情报》杂志编辑查斯·丹纳 (Chas Danner) 在题为“JD 万斯的总统梦想正在破灭”的文章中写道：“尽管多年来他一直努力追随特朗普的 MAGA 旗帜，但他可能已经失去了在 2028 年成为共和党领跑者的任何希望。”

paras.en: "At the beginning of the year, Vance was widely seen as the GOP’s presumptive 2028 nominee. He may end the year as the presumptive also-ran, if that."
paras.zh: “今年年初，万斯被广泛视为共和党 2028 年的推定提名人。如果是这样的话，他可能会在今年结束时成为推定的落选者。”

paras.en: Over at the conservative magazine National Review, senior writer Noah Rothman also weighed in on what he views as Vance's diminishing political fortunes, saying, "Those who invested in JD Vance’s political stock ... may be looking to offload their holdings."
paras.zh: 保守派杂志《国家评论》的资深作家诺亚·罗斯曼（Noah Rothman）也对万斯政治财富不断减少的观点发表了看法，他说：“那些投资 JD 万斯政治股票的人……可能正在寻求出售所持股份。”

paras.en: Vance hasn’t publicly said if he will run for president in 2028, but before the midterms, he was considered a front-runner, with perhaps the highest name recognition of any potential candidate.
paras.zh: 万斯尚未公开表示他是否会在 2028 年竞选总统，但在中期选举之前，他被认为是领先者，可能是所有潜在候选人中知名度最高的。

paras.en: However, since the midterms, Vance's aspirations "have suffered, because he's Donald Trump's vice-president," said Michael Traugott, a research professor emeritus at the University of Michigan's Center for Political Studies, in an interview with CBC News.
paras.zh: 然而，自中期选举以来，万斯的抱负“受到了影响，因为他是唐纳德·特朗普的副总统”，密歇根大学政治研究中心名誉研究教授迈克尔·特劳戈特在接受加拿大广播公司新闻采访时表示。

paras.en: Exit polls suggested Republicans lost the election over issues relating to inflation and the cost of living, government corruption and the war in Iran.
paras.zh: 出口民意调查显示，共和党因通货膨胀和生活成本、政府腐败和伊朗战争等问题而输掉了选举。

paras.en: "The problem is that the vice-president can't separate himself very easily from the administration's policies," Traugott said.
paras.zh: “问题在于副总统无法轻易地将自己与政府的政策分开，”特劳戈特说。

paras.en: According to the Wall Street Journal, after the Democrats' success in taking the House of Representatives and Senate in the midterms, some Republican donors began making calls to senior party members and expressing concerns that they couldn't back Vance, because he's too tied to an unpopular administration.
paras.zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，民主党在中期选举中成功拿下众议院和参议院席位后，一些共和党捐助者开始打电话给党内高级成员，表达了他们无法支持万斯的担忧，因为他与不受欢迎的政府关系太密切。

paras.en: This illustrates the challenge Vance faces: Do Republican primary voters want a candidate who has broader support among the general public but isn't directly connected to the president, or will they only support someone who has Trump's endorsement?
paras.zh: 这说明了万斯面临的挑战：共和党初选选民是否想要一位在公众中拥有更广泛支持但与总统没有直接关系的候选人，或者他们只会支持得到特朗普支持的人？

paras.en: There are reports that Trump has grown frustrated with Vance's position on Iran. (Mark Schiefelbein/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 有报道称，特朗普对万斯在伊朗问题上的立场感到沮丧。 （马克·席费尔宾/美联社）

paras.en: "There’s a real challenge of how you position yourself to be viable in a general election while winning a primary that still requires you to bow down and kiss the ring,” Igor Volsky, a Democratic strategist, told Reuters.
paras.zh: 民主党策略师伊戈尔·沃尔斯基（Igor Volsky）对路透社表示：“真正的挑战是如何在大选中定位自己，同时赢得初选，这仍然需要你鞠躬亲吻戒指。”

paras.en: Trump hasn’t endorsed Vance or anyone else. Reports have also emerged recently that Vance himself is not so sure about a run, particularly in the wake of the Republicans' disastrous showing in the midterms.
paras.zh: 特朗普尚未支持万斯或其他任何人。最近还有报道称，万斯本人对参选也不太确定，特别是在共和党在中期选举中表现糟糕之后。

paras.en: In Republican primaries, Trump still commands a lot of votes and a lot of respect, Martin Cohen, a political science professor with James Madison University, told CBC News.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·麦迪逊大学政治学教授马丁·科恩告诉加拿大广播公司新闻，在共和党初选中，特朗普仍然获得大量选票和尊重。

paras.en: "I would definitely think that the front-runner would be the candidate with Trump's endorsement, if he does give one," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果特朗普确实给出了一名候选人，我肯定认为领先者将是得到特朗普支持的候选人。”

paras.en: Vance blamed Iran war for midterm losses
paras.zh: 万斯将中期失败归咎于伊朗战争

paras.en: That means Vance will have to get his boss's approval, as well as the support of the MAGA base, while "trying to distance himself a little bit, at least," Cohen said.
paras.zh: 科恩说，这意味着万斯必须得到老板的批准，以及 MAGA 基地的支持，同时“至少要努力与自己保持一点距离”。

paras.en: Vance's attempt to distance himself from the administration may have already begun, with possible consequences. Following the midterms, Vance, in a lengthy post on X, levelled much of the blame for Republican losses on the war in Iran.
paras.zh: 万斯可能已经开始尝试与政府保持距离，并可能产生后果。 Following the midterms, Vance, in a lengthy post on X, levelled much of the blame for Republican losses on the war in Iran.

paras.en: "If you’d like to argue it was worth it, that losing the Senate for the next 6 years was worth it, then do so," Vance wrote. "Argue it was a worthwhile cost to pay. Agree or disagree, that’s at least honest."
paras.zh: 万斯写道：“如果你想说这是值得的，认为在接下来的六年里失去参议院是值得的，那就这么做吧。” “认为这是值得付出的代价。无论同意还是不同意，这至少是诚实的。”

paras.en: Vance, who according to reports has for a while privately expressed reservations about the war, has simultaneously argued that there's "no daylight" between him and the president on Iran.
paras.zh: 据报道，万斯曾一度私下对这场战争表示保留，但他同时辩称，他和总统在伊朗问题上“没有任何分歧”。

paras.en: In response to the X post, Trump agreed Iran may have been a factor in the midterm losses. But he also insisted that invading Iran was the right policy decision.
paras.zh: 在回应 X 帖子时，特朗普同意伊朗可能是中期选举失败的一个因素。但他也坚称入侵伊朗是正确的政策决定。

paras.en: Trump told reporters that Vance's post should have added, "'If you had it to do again, would you do it again?' The answer is yes."
paras.zh: 特朗普告诉记者，万斯的帖子应该加上“如果你再做一次，你会再做一次吗？”答案是肯定的。”

paras.en: Soon after the X post, the vice-president, who had been leading negotiations between the U.S. and Iran, was taken off the file.
paras.zh: X帖子发布后不久，这位一直领导美国和伊朗谈判的副总统就被从档案中除名。

paras.en: Posting on Truth Social, Trump said his administration no longer needed a deal with Iran and that he wanted Vance to focus "his complete and total attention" on alleged crime and corruption in Democratic-run cities and states.
paras.zh: 特朗普在《Truth Social》上发帖称，他的政府不再需要与伊朗达成协议，他希望万斯将“全部注意力”集中在民主党管理的城市和州涉嫌的犯罪和腐败问题上。

paras.en: - Why the war in Iran might cost Trump and the Republicans at the ballot box
paras.zh: - 为什么伊朗战争可能会让特朗普和共和党在投票箱上付出代价

paras.en: - What the Republican midterm defeat means for Trump, the U.S. and Canada
paras.zh: - 共和党中期选举失败对特朗普、美国和加拿大意味着什么

paras.en: Abe Greenwald, the executive editor of Commentary magazine, called Trump's sidelining of Vance a "remarkably skillful work of public humiliation."
paras.zh: 《评论》杂志执行主编阿贝·格林沃尔德称特朗普对万斯的边缘化是“非常巧妙的公开羞辱”。

paras.en: Karen Beckwith, a political science professor with Ohio-based Case Western Reserve University, said in an email to CBC News that Trump's removal of Vance from any responsibility for negotiating or interacting with Iranian counterparts "undermines Vance as a potential presidential nominee in 2028."
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州凯斯西储大学政治学教授凯伦·贝克威斯 (Karen Beckwith) 在给 CBC News 的一封电子邮件中表示，特朗普免除万斯与伊朗同行谈判或互动的任何责任，“削弱了万斯作为 2028 年潜在总统候选人的地位”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Fox News host Brian Kilmeade lashed out at Vance after his interview with Kilmeade's colleague Laura Ingraham, in which Vance said there were some who want the Iran war to go on indefinitely.
paras.zh: 与此同时，福克斯新闻主持人布莱恩·基尔米德(Brian Kilmeade)在接受基尔米德的同事劳拉·英格拉汉姆(Laura Ingraham)采访后猛烈抨击万斯，万斯在采访中表示，有些人希望伊朗战争​​无限期地继续下去。

paras.en: Kilmeade rejected that assertion, calling it "another straw man" argument from Vance, while adding that "he never should have been vice-president."
paras.zh: 基尔米德驳斥了这一说法，称这是万斯的“又一个稻草人”论点，同时补充说“他根本不应该担任副总统”。

paras.en: Beckwith said this could leave Vance without any substantive achievements on which to campaign for the 2028 nomination — unlike potential opponents like Secretary of State Marco Rubio or Republican governors and senators.
paras.zh: 贝克威斯表示，这可能会让万斯无法取得任何实质性成就来竞选 2028 年提名，这与国务卿马可·卢比奥或共和党州长和参议员等潜在对手不同。

paras.en: Asked about his social media post about Iran at a news conference on Friday, Vance, flanked by both Trump and Rubio, said the president makes the decision, that the president has said he would attack Iran again and that it's his job to support the president.
paras.zh: 在周五的新闻发布会上，当被问及他在社交媒体上发布的有关伊朗的帖子时，万斯在特朗普和卢比奥的陪同下表示，总统做出了决定，总统已经表示他将再次攻击伊朗，支持总统是他的工作。

paras.en: Vance's comments followed a New York Times report earlier this week that Trump has grown increasingly frustrated with how Vance has framed his assessment of what went wrong in Iran, complaining to aides and allies that Vance should have made a point of saying the president made the right decision in going to war with Iran.
paras.zh: 万斯发表此番言论之前，《纽约时报》本周早些时候报道称，特朗普对万斯对伊朗问题的评估方式越来越感到沮丧，他向助手和盟友抱怨说，万斯应该明确表示，总统在与伊朗开战方面做出了正确的决定。

paras.en: According to the Times, Trump has instead been praising Rubio, a strong supporter of the U.S. war against Iran, as a potential presidential candidate.
paras.zh: 据《泰晤士报》报道，特朗普反而称赞卢比奥是美国对伊朗战争的坚定支持者，是潜在的总统候选人。

paras.en: While Trump may have soured on Vance, he reportedly has been praising U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, right. (Mark Schiefelbein/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 虽然特朗普可能对万斯感到不满，但据报道他一直在赞扬美国国务卿马可·卢比奥，对吧。 （马克·席费尔宾/美联社）

paras.en: While past polls have shown Vance as the leading Republican candidate for 2028, a recent poll from Emerson College had Rubio as the top choice.
paras.zh: 虽然过去的民意调查显示万斯是 2028 年共和党的主要候选人，但艾默生学院最近的一项民意调查显示卢比奥是首选。

paras.en: Presidents in recent history, dating back to Ronald Reagan, have all publicly endorsed their vice-presidents who sought to be their party's candidate for the presidency. That includes Joe Biden's endorsement of Kamala Harris in 2024, despite Biden having been pressured by members of his own party to not run for second term.
paras.zh: 近代历史上的总统，可以追溯到罗纳德·里根，都曾公开支持寻求成为本党总统候选人的副总统。其中包括乔·拜登在 2024 年支持卡马拉·哈里斯，尽管拜登受到本党成员的压力，要求他不要竞选第二个任期。

paras.en: "I don't think that Donald Trump is going to be shy about endorsing somebody," Traugott said. "Ordinarily, we would think the vice-president would have an advantage ... so the fact that he may be souring on this relationship is very important. Even if they were to say that [Trump] was remaining neutral, that would be a slap in the face of that."
paras.zh: “我不认为唐纳德·特朗普会羞于支持某人，”特劳戈特说。 “通常情况下，我们会认为副总统会有优势......因此，他可能对这种关系感到不满这一事实非常重要。即使他们说（特朗普）保持中立，那也将是一记耳光。”

paras.en: Yet some political observers are cautious about writing Vance's political obituary just yet. Republican strategist Mark Bednar told CBC News that Vance has developed good connections to a large donor base within the Republican party over the past couple years.
paras.zh: 然而，一些政治观察家对撰写万斯的政治讣告持谨慎态度。共和党策略师马克·贝德纳 (Mark Bednar) 告诉 CBC 新闻，过去几年，万斯与共和党内的庞大捐助者基础建立了良好的联系。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Republican strategist Barrett Marson told CBC News that Trump may have actually done Vance a favour by taking him off the Iran file.
paras.zh: 与此同时，共和党策略师巴雷特·马森告诉加拿大广播公司新闻，特朗普将万斯从伊朗档案中删除实际上可能是帮了他一个忙。

paras.en: "That is an absolute blessing. The less one has to do with this immensely unpopular war, the better you are off politically."
paras.zh: “这绝对是一件幸事。与这场极不受欢迎的战争的关系越少，政治上的处境就越好。”

paras.en: Marson added that there's still a lot of time before 2028, meaning things could improve to Vance's benefit. For example, gas prices could come down significantly, interest rates for homes could drop and voters could start to view the economy in positive terms.
paras.zh: Marson 补充说，距离 2028 年还有很长的时间，这意味着情况可能会有所改善，对万斯有利。例如，天然气价格可能大幅下降，房屋利率可能下降，选民可能开始积极看待经济。

paras.en: "Two years is just an eternity," Marson said. "Especially in Donald Trump's America."
paras.zh: “两年就像永恒，”马森说。 “尤其是在唐纳德·特朗普领导下的美国。”

articles.title: Brazil ex-President Jair Bolsonaro taken to hospital over abdominal pain

paras.en: Convicted former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro, who is serving a 27-year sentence under house arrest over a coup attempt, has been hospitalized with abdominal pain.
paras.zh: 因政变未遂而被软禁 27 年的巴西前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗 (Jair Bolsonaro) 因腹痛入院治疗。

paras.en: Bolsonaro's son Carlos wrote on X that the former far-right leader was taken to the hospital on Friday and was found to have "a near-complete intestinal obstruction."
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗的儿子卡洛斯在 X 上写道，这位前极右翼领导人周五被送往医院，被发现患有“近乎完全性肠梗阻”。

paras.en: The DF Star Hospital in Brasília said that Bolsonaro was suffering from "abdominal distension" and was being examined.
paras.zh: 巴西利亚DF Star医院表示，博尔索纳罗患有“腹胀”，正在接受检查。

paras.en: Bolsonaro, who is 71 years old, has undergone several hospitalizations and surgeries since he was stabbed in the abdomen on the campaign trail for the 2018 elections.
paras.zh: 现年 71 岁的博索纳罗自从在 2018 年大选竞选期间腹部被刺伤以来，已经接受了多次住院治疗和手术。

paras.en: "He is being given medication for pain and an initial attempt to reverse the condition without the need for invasive intervention," Carlos said.
paras.zh: 卡洛斯说：“他正在接受止痛药物，并初步尝试在不需要侵入性干预的情况下扭转病情。”

paras.en: Son blames house arrest for Bolsonaro's health issues
paras.zh: 儿子将博尔索纳罗的健康问题归咎于软禁

paras.en: Bolsonaro was in power from 2019 to 2022. He was convicted last year for plotting a coup after his defeat to current President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in the 2022 election but claims being the victim of a left-wing judicial witch hunt.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗于 2019 年至 2022 年执政。去年，他在 2022 年选举中输给现任总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦后，因策划政变而被定罪，但他声称自己是左翼司法政治迫害的受害者。

paras.en: Bolsonaro was placed under humanitarian house arrest on medical grounds.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗因健康原因被软禁。

paras.en: Carlos on Friday railed against his father's detention, which he blamed for Bolsonaro's current health problems.
paras.zh: 卡洛斯周五谴责了他父亲的拘留，他将博尔索纳罗目前的健康问题归咎于父亲的拘留。

paras.en: Carlos said that the senior Bolsonaro's health was "deteriorating every day in prison due to his lack of mobility" and what he called "the psychological torture he suffers daily."
paras.zh: 卡洛斯表示，博尔索纳罗的健康状况“由于行动不便，在监狱里每天都在恶化”，他称之为“每天遭受的心理折磨”。

paras.en: Another one of Bolsonaro's sons, Flavio Bolsonaro, recently lost the October presidential election to incumbent President Lula. Flavio Bolsonaro left Brazil after the vote and now resides in Florida.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗的另一位儿子弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗最近在十月份的总统选举中输给了现任总统卢拉。弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗在投票后离开巴西，目前居住在佛罗里达州。

articles.title: Man convicted of arson over deadly 2025 Palisades fire in Los Angeles

paras.en: A US-French man has been convicted on federal arson charges connected with the 2025 Palisades fire in Los Angeles, California, which killed 12 people and devastated the seaside enclave of Pacific Palisades.
paras.zh: 一名美籍法国男子因与 2025 年加利福尼亚州洛杉矶帕利塞德火灾有关的联邦纵火罪被定罪，该火灾造成 12 人死亡，并摧毁了太平洋帕利塞德的海滨飞地。

paras.en: The weeks-long blaze destroyed some 6,800 homes and other structures, causing estimated property losses of $150 billion (€136.7 billion).
paras.zh: 长达数周的大火摧毁了约 6,800 栋房屋和其他建筑，造成的财产损失估计达 1,500 亿美元（1,367 亿欧元）。

paras.en: What was the man convicted of in the Palisades fire case?
paras.zh: 帕利塞兹火灾案中的男子被判什么罪？

paras.en: A US District Court jury in Los Angeles found the man guilty of starting a hilltop brush fire on January 1, 2025.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶美国地方法院陪审团裁定该男子于 2025 年 1 月 1 日引发山顶灌木丛火灾罪名成立。

paras.en: While the fire was initially suppressed, it continued smoldering underground and reignited days later amid fierce winds to become the highly destructive Palisades Fire.
paras.zh: 虽然大火最初被扑灭，但它继续在地下阴燃，几天后在狂风中重新点燃，成为极具破坏性的帕利塞兹大火。

paras.en: The man is set to be sentenced on March 17. First Assistant US Attorney Bill Essayli told reporters that he could face up to 40 years in prison.
paras.zh: 该男子将于 3 月 17 日被判刑。美国第一助理检察官 Bill Essayli 告诉记者，他可能面临最高 40 年的监禁。

paras.en: The man was arrested in October 2025, and already faced one trial five months ago that ended with a hung jury. The judge declared a mistrial in June, prompting federal prosecutors to retry the case under modified charges.
paras.zh: 该男子于 2025 年 10 月被捕，五个月前就已经面临过一次审判，但陪审团未能达成一致。法官于六月宣布审判无效，促使联邦检察官根据修改后的指控重审此案。

paras.en: Prosecutors said security camera footage and location data from the defendant's cellphone showed he was the only person nearby when the January 1 blaze began in the Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，监控录像和被告手机的位置数据显示，1 月 1 日圣莫尼卡山国家休闲区发生大火时，他是附近唯一的人。

paras.en: At both trials, they characterized the man, a former Uber driver, as a loner who held a deep resentment against society, and particularly the wealthy.
paras.zh: 在这两次审判中，他们都将这名前优步司机描述为一个孤独的人，对社会，尤其是富人抱有深深的怨恨。

paras.en: The defense argued that the initial blaze could have been caused by fireworks, while prosecutors said there was no evidence that any had been set off in the area.
paras.zh: 辩方辩称，最初的火灾可能是由烟花引起的，而检察官表示，没有证据表明该地区曾燃放烟花。

paras.en: In March, the man denied in a court declaration that he had willfully started any fire, though he declined to testify in his own defense at either trial.
paras.zh: 今年三月，该男子在法庭声明中否认他故意纵火，但他拒绝在两次审判中为自己辩护作证。

paras.en: The Palisades blaze erupted almost at the same time as another wildfire that broke out in Eaton Canyon, some 30 miles (48 km) to the east.
paras.zh: 帕利塞兹大火几乎与东边约 30 英里（48 公里）的伊顿峡谷 (Eaton Canyon) 爆发的另一场野火同时爆发。

paras.en: That fire, believed to have been ignited by sparks from an electrical transmission tower, killed 19 people and devastated the Los Angeles suburb of Altadena.
paras.zh: 这场大火据信是由一​​座输电塔的火花引起的，造成 19 人死亡，洛杉矶郊区阿尔塔迪纳 (Altadena) 遭到严重破坏。

paras.en: Together, the two blazes rank as the deadliest wildfire disaster ever seen in Los Angeles County.
paras.zh: 这两场大火一起成为洛杉矶县有史以来最致命的野火灾难。

paras.en: *Editor's note: DW follows the German press code, which stresses the importance of protecting the privacy of suspects, victims and those who are associated with a criminal case, and urges the media to refrain from publishing their full identities in most cases.
paras.zh: *编者注：德国之声遵循德国新闻守则，该守则强调保护嫌疑人、受害人和刑事案件相关人员隐私的重要性，并敦促媒体在大多数情况下不要公布他们的完整身份。

articles.title: Mexican special forces arrest drug kingpin 'Chapo Isidro'

paras.en: A gun battle between Mexican soldiers and alleged gang members in the city of Guasave, in the state of Sinaloa, ended with special forces detaining senior members of the Beltran Leyva drug trafficking network, Mexican officials said on Saturday.
paras.zh: 墨西哥官员周六表示，墨西哥士兵与锡那罗亚州瓜萨韦市疑似帮派成员之间的枪战最终以特种部队拘留了贝尔特兰·莱瓦贩毒网络的高级成员而告终。

paras.en: The gang is aligned with the Mayos, one of the factions of the powerful Sinaloa cartel.
paras.zh: 该团伙与梅奥家族结盟，梅奥家族是强大的锡那罗亚贩毒集团的派系之一。

paras.en: Authorities said the overnight raid resulted in the capture of the suspected drug kingpin Fausto Isidro Meza F., better known as "Chapo Isidro," who is believed to be the leader of Beltran Leyva.
paras.zh: 当局称，连夜突袭抓获了疑似毒枭福斯托·伊西德罗·梅萨·F.（Fausto Isidro Meza F.），他更广为人知的名字是“矮子伊西德罗”，据信他是贝尔特兰·雷瓦组织的领导人。

paras.en: The operation left at least 11 people dead. Seven alleged cartel gunmen and four Mexican soldiers were killed, Mexico’s Defense Ministry said on Saturday afternoon.
paras.zh: 这次行动造成至少11人死亡。墨西哥国防部周六下午表示，七名涉嫌贩毒集团的枪手和四名墨西哥士兵被打死。

paras.en: FBI offering millions for 'Chapo Isidro'
paras.zh: FBI 为“矮子伊西德罗”提供数百万美元

paras.en: The 44-year-old Mexican national is one of the FBI's ten most wanted fugitives. The US law enforcement agency claims his group is responsible for smuggling "large quantities of heroin, methamphetamine, cocaine, fentanyl, and marijuana into the United States," and has offered a $5 million (€4.56 million) reward for information leading to his arrest.
paras.zh: 这位 44 岁的墨西哥公民是 FBI 十大通缉犯之一。美国执法机构声称，该团伙负责向美国走私“大量海洛因、甲基苯丙胺、可卡因、芬太尼和大麻”，并悬赏 500 万美元（合 456 万欧元），以获取导致其被捕的信息。

paras.en: He is also wanted in Mexico on charges including organized crime. "Chapo Isidro" was once a rival of imprisoned drug kingpin Joaquin "El Chapo" Guzman.
paras.zh: 他还因有组织犯罪等罪名在墨西哥被通缉。 “矮子伊西德罗”曾经是被监禁的毒枭华金·“矮子”·古兹曼的竞争对手。

paras.en: The three detainees were transported to Mexico City "to be placed at the disposal of the competent prosecutorial authorities," the military said.
paras.zh: 军方表示，这三名被拘留者被送往墨西哥城“交由主管检察机关处理”。

paras.en: It was not immediately clear whether authorities would extradite "Chapo Isidro" to the US.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚当局是否会将“矮子伊西德罗”引渡到美国。

paras.en: On Saturday, Mexican authorities said the raid was conducted due to "intelligence coordination" between Mexico's military and US agencies. However, they offered few details about how authorities in both countries coordinated.
paras.zh: 墨西哥当局周六表示，这次袭击是由于墨西哥军方和美国机构之间的“情报协调”而进行的。然而，他们没有提供有关两国当局如何协调的细节。

paras.en: In a post on X, US Ambassador to Mexico Ronald Johnson wrote: "Results like these are not achieved overnight. They are the product of sustained cooperation and trust. This is what we can accomplish when we work together. We will continue pursuing criminals."
paras.zh: 美国驻墨西哥大使罗纳德·约翰逊在X上的一篇帖子中写道：“这样的结果不是一朝一夕就能实现的。它们是持续合作和信任的产物。这就是我们共同努力才能实现的目标。我们将继续追捕罪犯。”

paras.en: The troops used "stealth and surprise" to reach the area, establishing a perimeter around the drug dealer's location and then moving in from multiple directions, according to Mexico's US embassy.
paras.zh: 据墨西哥美国大使馆称，部队采用“秘密和突击”方式到达该地区，在毒贩所在位置周围建立了警戒线，然后从多个方向进攻。

paras.en: Unverified videos from Guasave, however, showed military helicopters firing at ground targets and sports fans scrambling for safety during a baseball game. Some of the violence in the western Mexican city seems to have taken place after "Chapo Isidro" was arrested, with drug cartels attempting to retaliate against the authorities and civilians for the move.
paras.zh: 然而，来自瓜萨夫的未经证实的视频显示，在一场棒球比赛中，军用直升机向地面目标开火，体育迷们争先恐后地寻求安全。墨西哥西部城市的一些暴力事件似乎是在“矮子伊西德罗”被捕后发生的，贩毒集团试图对当局和平民的这一举动进行报复。

paras.en: Mexico's Defense Ministry confirmed cartel members set up roadblocks in the area, but added that security forces were assisting local authorities in restoring order.
paras.zh: 墨西哥国防部证实卡特尔成员在该地区设置了路障，但补充说安全部队正在协助地方当局恢复秩序。

paras.en: The Guasave raid is only the latest in a string of high-profile moves against senior leaders of Mexico's illegal drug trade. Less than two weeks ago, the Mexican Navy announced the arrest of Rafael A., suspected of leading a cartel cell active in the states of Jalisco and Michoacan.
paras.zh: 瓜萨维的突袭只是针对墨西哥非法毒品贸易高级领导人的一系列引人注目的行动中的最新一起。不到两周前，墨西哥海军宣布逮捕拉斐尔·A.，他涉嫌领导活跃在哈利斯科州和米却肯州的卡特尔组织。

paras.en: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum is facing pressure from Donald Trump, who has threatened to take military action against cartels on Mexican territory.
paras.zh: 墨西哥总统克劳迪娅·辛鲍姆面临来自唐纳德·特朗普的压力，特朗普威胁要对墨西哥领土上的贩毒集团采取军事行动。

paras.en: Editor's note: DW follows the German press code, which stresses the importance of protecting the privacy of suspects, victims and those who are associated with a criminal case, and urges the media to refrain from publishing their full identities in most cases.
paras.zh: 编者注：德国之声遵循德国新闻守则，该守则强调保护嫌疑人、受害人和刑事案件相关人员隐私的重要性，并敦促媒体在大多数情况下不要公布他们的完整身份。

articles.title: Is the global far right really in retreat?

paras.en: Not too long ago, we were grappling with the surge of a global far-right alliance. And in early 2025, when United States President Donald Trump returned for a second term, members of this global alliance must have felt that they were on the brink of securing a global hegemony.
paras.zh: 不久前，我们正在努力应对全球极右翼联盟的崛起。 2025年初，当美国总统唐纳德·特朗普重返连任时，这个全球联盟的成员一定感到他们正处于确保全球霸权的边缘。

paras.en: Yet, less than two years in, this alliance seems to be losing its grip on power – and fast.
paras.zh: 然而，不到两年的时间，这个联盟似乎正在迅速失去对权力的控制。

paras.en: The first casualty was Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban, whose reign of 16 years ended earlier this year with a decisive loss in the parliamentary elections. He was somewhat of a “golden boy” of this movement, as Hungary under him had become the pinnacle of far-right state capture.
paras.zh: 第一个受害者是匈牙利总理欧尔班·维克托，他在今年早些时候的议会选举中惨败，结束了他16年的统治。他在某种程度上是这场运动的“金童”，因为在他领导下的匈牙利已成为极右翼国家占领的顶峰。

paras.en: In fact, Orban was so important to the global right that he received election endorsements from the likes of Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Alternative for Germany (AfD) leader Alice Weidel. Even US Vice President JD Vance showed up in Budapest five days before the elections to reiterate the Trump administration’s endorsement of Orban’s bid for a fifth consecutive term in office.
paras.zh: 事实上，欧尔班对全球右翼非常重要，以至于他获得了意大利总理乔治亚·梅洛尼、以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡和德国另类选择党（AfD）领导人爱丽丝·韦德尔等人的选举支持。就连美国副总统万斯也在选举前五天出现在布达佩斯，重申特朗普政府对欧尔班连任第五届的支持。

paras.en: In a tight race in late October, Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva secured a fourth term after defeating far-right Senator Flavio Bolsonaro in the run-off. Notably, Lula’s challenger was the son of former President Jair Bolsonaro. Bolsonaro senior is currently serving a 27-year prison sentence for attempting a coup following his loss to Lula in the 2022 presidential election.
paras.zh: 在十月下旬的一场激烈角逐中，巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦在决选中击败极右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗，获得了第四个任期。值得注意的是，卢拉的挑战者是前总统贾尔·博尔索纳罗的儿子。老博尔索纳罗因在 2022 年总统选举中输给卢拉后企图政变而被判处 27 年徒刑，目前正在服刑。

paras.en: Netanyahu has been a central figure in the global alliance of the far right. At a time of genocidal violence and pogroms targeting Palestinians in the Gaza Strip and across the occupied West Bank, Netanyahu’s far-right friends have remained unmoved in their support of Israel.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡一直是极右翼全球联盟的核心人物。在加沙地带和被占领的西岸针对巴勒斯坦人的种族灭绝暴力和大屠杀之际，内塔尼亚胡的极右翼朋友对以色列的支持仍然无动于衷。

paras.en: But on October 27, neither the Netanyahu-led bloc nor any opposition alliance secured the required 61 seats in the parliamentary elections. Because opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot received the endorsement of Arab-led parties, he has now been invited by President Isaac Herzog to form the next government.
paras.zh: 但10月27日，内塔尼亚胡领导的集团和任何反对派联盟都未能在议会选举中获得所需的61个席位。由于反对党领袖加迪·艾森科特得到了阿拉伯领导政党的支持，他现在已被总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格邀请组建下一届政府。

paras.en: In the 2026 Serbian parliamentary elections, the Student List defeated Aleksandar Vucic’s party. This was a resounding victory for the student-led anticorruption movement that took to the streets against the populist leader after a railway station canopy collapsed in Novi Sad in November 2024, killing 16 people.
paras.zh: 在2026年塞尔维亚议会选举中，学生党击败了亚历山大·武契奇的政党。这是学生领导的反腐败运动取得的巨大胜利，2024 年 11 月诺维萨德火车站顶篷倒塌，造成 16 人死亡，该运动走上街头反对这位民粹主义领导人。

paras.en: Of course, the most significant challenge to the far right’s bid for global capture came in the form of the “blue wave” in the 2026 US midterm elections. On their way to victory, many Democratic candidates openly embraced progressive agendas, publicly expressed support for the Palestinian cause, criticised Israel and the role of the American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) in US politics and blasted their establishment predecessors for their “middle of the road” stance on issues at home and abroad.
paras.zh: 当然，极右翼夺取全球影响力的最重大挑战来自2026年美国中期选举的“蓝色浪潮”。在胜利之路上，许多民主党候选人公开拥抱进步议程，公开表达对巴勒斯坦事业的支持，批评以色列和美国以色列公共事务委员会（AIPAC）在美国政治中的作用，并抨击他们的建制派前任在国内外问题上的“中间道路”立场。

paras.en: Following a damning critique of the Trump administration, the Democratic Party is now set to control both chambers of Congress from January.
paras.zh: 在对特朗普政府进行严厉批评之后，民主党现在准备从一月份开始控制国会参众两院。

paras.en: Already last year, Zohran Mamdani’s victory in New York City’s mayoral election showed that a progressive candidate could overcome opposition from both the right and the Democratic establishment. His run for office was marred by xenophobic and Islamophobic attacks coming from both Republicans and establishment Democrats.
paras.zh: 去年，佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 在纽约市市长选举中的胜利表明，进步的候选人可以克服右翼和民主党建制派的反对。他的公职竞选因来自共和党和民主党建制派的仇外和仇视伊斯兰教的攻击而受到损害。

paras.en: He was also accused of anti-Semitism for his criticism of Netanyahu and his past pro-Palestine organising. Yet, it was his unrelenting focus on making New York more affordable and liveable and his refusal to back down from his criticism of Israel during an ongoing genocide that gave him the win in the end.
paras.zh: 他还因批评内塔尼亚胡及其过去的亲巴勒斯坦组织而被指控为反犹太主义。然而，正是他坚持不懈地致力于让纽约变得更便宜、更宜居，并且在正在进行的种族灭绝期间他拒绝放弃对以色列的批评，这让他最终取得了胜利。

paras.en: Despite all this, I would say the demise of the far right is not yet a done deal.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，我想说极右翼的消亡尚未板上钉钉。

paras.en: Undoubtedly, far-right leaders everywhere will closely study the recent defeats of their political allies and learn from their mistakes. They will have noticed the fragility of the cult of personality of the likes of Orban in the face of years of repression and state-sanctioned corruption. They will also learn from Trump’s militarism and misadventures in the Middle East. Proclaiming a war thousands of miles away as an existential battle for the good of humanity cannot eclipse the everyday concerns of common citizens.
paras.zh: 毫无疑问，世界各地的极右领导人将密切研究其政治盟友最近的失败，并从他们的错误中吸取教训。他们会注意到，面对多年的镇压和国家批准的腐败，欧尔班等人的个人崇拜是多么脆弱。他们还将从特朗普的军国主义和中东的不幸经历中吸取教训。宣称千里之外的战争是一场关乎人类福祉的生存之战，并不能掩盖普通公民的日常关切。

paras.en: Most importantly, though, they will bank on the historical failings of the left. They know that without a systematic effort to remedy the conditions that led to the rise of the far right in the first place, the establishment liberals will not be able to convert these wins into long-term gains.
paras.zh: 但最重要的是，他们将寄希望于左派的历史失败。他们知道，如果不采取系统性的努力来纠正导致极右翼崛起的条件，建制自由派将无法将这些胜利转化为长期收益。

paras.en: It is, of course, easy to attribute the global rise of the far right to the machinations of individual leaders. The Netanyahus, Bolsonaros, Modis and the Trumps of the world are undoubtedly the mascots of this movement’s global ambitions. And so it is comforting to believe that the fall of an individual leader would bring about the demise of the political movement.
paras.zh: 当然，我们很容易将极右翼的全球崛起归因于个别领导人的阴谋。内塔尼亚胡、博尔索纳罗斯、莫迪和世界各地的特朗普无疑是这场运动全球野心的吉祥物。因此，令人欣慰的是，相信个别领导人的下台将导致政治运动的消亡。

paras.en: But to believe this would be to ignore the fact that their rise to power is only a symptom of wider structural malaise in politics and society. These leaders have weaponised legitimate public concerns regarding youth unemployment, the hollowing of the public sector, income inequality, neoliberalisation and “big money” in politics into fodder for repression, culture wars, militarism, racism and xenophobia.
paras.zh: 但相信这一点就等于忽视了这样一个事实：他们的崛起只是政治和社会更广泛的结构性问题的一个症状。这些领导人将公众对青年失业、公共部门空心化、收入不平等、新自由主义化和政治上的“巨额资金”的合法担忧武器化，成为镇压、文化战争、军国主义、种族主义和仇外心理的素材。

paras.en: The far right may have suffered losses at the ballot box because of its misadventures in power. But if progressives are to make significant gains, it cannot be business as usual.
paras.zh: 极右翼可能因其执政失误而在投票箱上遭受损失。但如果进步人士想要取得重大成果，就不能一切照旧。

paras.en: Concretely, in a place like the US, this means that we have to recognise that the “blue wave” was more of an assertive vote against Trump rather than a wholehearted embrace of the Democratic Party. Progressives have ridden this wave into office, but for the progressive agenda to see the light of day, establishment Democrats need to step aside.
paras.zh: 具体来说，在美国这样的地方，这意味着我们必须认识到“蓝色浪潮”更多的是对特朗普的坚决投票，而不是全心全意地拥抱民主党。进步派已经乘着这股浪潮入主白宫，但为了让进步议程得以实现，民主党建制派需要靠边站。

paras.en: Here I’m thinking of the likes of Hakeem Jeffries and Chuck Schumer. Throughout Trump’s second term, they have chosen to engage in symbolic acts of opposition, including “strongly worded letters” and “colour-coordinated outfits”. They have, thus far, refrained from directly confronting the Trump administration and even fumbled a crucial vote on an attempt to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, with 11 House Democrats absent. They have also been slow to support progressive candidates’ bids for office and slower to come to the aid of fellow Democratic leaders being bullied by the Trump administration.
paras.zh: 我想到的是哈基姆·杰弗里斯和查克·舒默这样的人。在特朗普的第二个任期内，他们选择采取象征性的反对行为，包括“措辞强硬的信件”和“颜色协调的服装”。到目前为止，他们没有直接对抗特朗普政府，甚至在弹劾国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯的一次关键投票中，在 11 名众议院民主党人缺席的情况下，他们也未能进行投票。他们在支持进步候选人竞选公职方面也进展缓慢，在帮助受到特朗普政府欺凌的民主党领导人方面也进展缓慢。

paras.en: So, if the “blue wave” has to mean anything, such leaders need to be expunged from the mainstream for more progressive agendas to take hold.
paras.zh: 因此，如果“蓝色浪潮”有什么意义的话，那么这些领导人就需要从主流中被清除，以便更进步的议程能够站稳脚跟。

paras.en: Magyar has certainly made headway in dismantling some of the structures of Orbanism. But for progressives to make any significant gains, they would need to use the opening provided by the elections to alter the political culture in Hungary.
paras.zh: 马扎尔在拆除欧尔班主义的一些结构方面无疑取得了进展。但进步派要想取得重大进展，就需要利用选举提供的机会来改变匈牙利的政治文化。

paras.en: For those of us who have closely followed Israeli politics, it is difficult not to shrug at the recent election results. The vote was against Netanyahu, but not for a progressive future.
paras.zh: 对于我们这些密切关注以色列政治的人来说，很难不对最近的选举结果耸耸肩。这次投票反对内塔尼亚胡，但并不是为了进步的未来。

paras.en: Removing Netanyahu – the architect of the genocide – would be a necessary step. But we must also remember that the erasure of Palestinians is a structural outgrowth of Zionism. This is why, in the lead-up to the recent elections, none of the leading Jewish-led opposition candidates campaigned on recognising a Palestinian state or offered a fundamental departure from Israel’s policies towards Palestinians.
paras.zh: 清除种族灭绝的策划者内塔尼亚胡将是必要的一步。但我们也必须记住，对巴勒斯坦人的消灭是犹太复国主义的结构性产物。这就是为什么在最近的选举之前，没有一个由犹太人领导的主要反对派候选人在竞选活动中承认巴勒斯坦国，也没有提出从根本上背离以色列对巴勒斯坦人的政策。

paras.en: The year 2026 has undoubtedly been a bad one for the global far right. But the current moment is far more critical for progressive forces than it is for the far right. How the left learns from the far right’s defeats, as well as the victories of unabashedly progressive candidates, will determine whether this year marks the beginning of the end of the global far right.
paras.zh: 2026年对于全球极右翼来说无疑是糟糕的一年。但当前时刻对于进步力量来说比对于极右翼来说更为关键。左翼如何从极右翼的失败以及毫不掩饰进步的候选人的胜利中吸取教训，将决定今年是否标志着全球极右翼终结的开始。

paras.en: The views expressed in this article are the author’s own and do not necessarily reflect Al Jazeera’s editorial stance.
paras.zh: 本文表达的观点是作者自己的观点，并不一定反映半岛电视台的编辑立场。

articles.title: India-Pakistan cricket fans want ‘dirty politics’ kept out of beloved sport

paras.en: India-Pakistan cricket rivalry brings World Cup atmosphere to Qatar
paras.zh: 印度与巴基斯坦板球比赛为卡塔尔带来世界杯气氛

paras.en: Doha, Qatar – Heated exchanges, scowling faces, body shoves, handshake controversies and trophy ceremony boycotts.
paras.zh: 卡塔尔多哈——激烈的交流、愁眉苦脸、身体推搡、握手争议和奖杯仪式抵制。

paras.en: Cricket fans from India and Pakistan are no strangers to seeing their teams throw childlike tantrums on the field. Some even believe it’s the fire that fuels sport’s fiercest rivalry.
paras.zh: 来自印度和巴基斯坦的板球迷对他们的球队在球场上发脾气并不陌生。有些人甚至认为，正是这股火焰助长了体育运动中最激烈的竞争。

paras.en: On Sunday, when the nations met in the Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 in Doha, the temperature on the pitch matched the typically hot Middle Eastern afternoon.
paras.zh: 周日，当各国在多哈举行 2026 年亚洲杯新星赛时，球场上的温度与典型的中东炎热下午相当。

paras.en: Not long after Pakistan opted to bat first, India’s fast bowler Harshit Rana and Pakistan’s top-order batters were involved in what did not seem like a friendly exchange. Verbal blows were exchanged and dismissed batters were given hostile send-offs.
paras.zh: 在巴基斯坦选择先击球后不久，印度的快速投球手哈希特·拉纳（Harshit Rana）和巴基斯坦的顶级击球手进行了一场看似不友好的交流。双方互相言语攻击，被驱逐的击球手也遭到敌意的送行。

paras.en: The trend continued during India’s innings, which ended 48 runs short of the target, giving the Pakistanis a rare victory over their neighbours.
paras.zh: 这种趋势在印度的局中继续延续，最终以 48 分的成绩落后于目标，使巴基斯坦队罕见地战胜了邻国。

paras.en: In the stands, though, the supporters were following a different script.
paras.zh: 然而，在看台上，支持者却遵循着不同的剧本。

paras.en: It took a few hours for the West End International Cricket Stadium to fill up – with Sunday being the first working day of the week in Qatar – but towards the second half of the match, the attendance came close to its 10,000-person capacity.
paras.zh: 西区国际板球体育场花了几个小时才坐满观众——周日是卡塔尔一周的第一个工作日——但到了比赛的下半场，观众人数已接近体育场的10000人容纳上限。

paras.en: Supporters of both countries, as well as neutral cricket fans, mingled in the stands while wearing their respective teams’ shirts, waving their own countries’ flags and chanting their players’ names.
paras.zh: 两国的支持者以及中立的板球迷在看台上混在一起，穿着各自球队的球衣，挥舞着各自国家的国旗，高呼各自球员的名字。

paras.en: For many, such as Abrar Hussain and Mohammed Saeed Khan, there didn’t seem to be a need for segregation while watching a sport both nations follow with equal fervour.
paras.zh: 对于阿布拉尔·侯赛因（Abrar Hussain）和穆罕默德·赛义德·汗（Mohammed Saeed Khan）等许多人来说，在观看两国同样热衷的体育运动时似乎没有必要进行种族隔离。

paras.en: “We have been friends for over six years,” Khan told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “我们已经成为朋友六年多了，”汗告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: Wearing a replica blue shirt of the Indian team, Khan sat next to his Pakistani friend Hussain, dressed in Pakistan’s shirt.
paras.zh: 汗穿着印度队的蓝色球衣复制品，坐在他的巴基斯坦朋友侯赛因旁边，他穿着巴基斯坦队的球衣。

paras.en: “We share accommodation, meals and a love for the game that goes beyond any rivalry,” the man from India’s southern port metropolis of Mumbai explained.
paras.zh: “我们共享住宿、膳食，并且对这项运动有着超越任何竞争的热爱，”这位来自印度南部港口城市孟买的男子解释道。

paras.en: Khan and Hussain, who are teammates in a weekend cricket league in Doha, expressed their disappointment at the “politicisation of the sport.”
paras.zh: 汗和侯赛因是多哈周末板球联赛的队友，他们对“这项运动的政治化”表示失望。

paras.en: “Politics should stay out of the game,” said Hussain, a native of Pakistan’s largest city, Karachi.
paras.zh: “政治不应该参与其中，”来自巴基斯坦最大城市卡拉奇的侯赛因说。

paras.en: “The game of cricket is very close to our heart. We don’t want anything spoiling our game.”
paras.zh: “板球运动非常贴近我们的心。我们不希望任何事情破坏我们的比赛。”

paras.en: Recent cricket encounters between the two nations – at all levels, from senior men’s teams to women’s sides, as well as age-group teams – have been heavily politicised following their intense four-day conflict last May.
paras.zh: 去年五月，两国之间为期四天的激烈冲突之后，最近两国之间的板球比赛——从成年男子队到女子队以及年龄组球队的各个级别的比赛都被严重政治化。

paras.en: Four months after both countries returned from the brink of all-out war, their cricket teams met in the Men’s Asia Cup 2025 and seemed to carry the bitterness of the conflict onto the field.
paras.zh: 两国从全面战争的边缘回归四个月后，两国板球队在 2025 年男子亚洲杯上相遇，似乎将冲突的苦涩带到了赛场上。

paras.en: India’s players avoided shaking hands with Pakistanis, who made gestures linked to the cross-border aerial fight. The tournament ended with the victorious Indian team refusing to accept the trophy from the Pakistani head of the Asian Cricket Council.
paras.zh: 印度球员避免与巴基斯坦人握手，巴基斯坦人做出了与跨境空战有关的手势。比赛结束时，获胜的印度队拒绝接受亚洲板球理事会巴基斯坦主席颁发的奖杯。

paras.en: The pattern has followed every India-Pakistan cricket encounter and even found its way into the Under-19 Asia Cup, where Indian players’ behaviour after sealing a win was heavily criticised.
paras.zh: 这种模式出现在每次印度与巴基斯坦板球比赛中，甚至在U-19亚洲杯中也出现过，印度球员在获胜后的行为受到了严厉批评。

paras.en: Indian cricket fan Khan believes many players don’t want to partake in such aggression but are “forced into the act” at the behest of politicians and the younger generation is following suit.
paras.zh: 印度板球迷汗认为，许多球员并不想参与这种侵略行为，而是在政客的要求下“被迫采取行动”，而年轻一代也在效仿。

paras.en: “Cricket boards should take disciplinary action against [such] players and ensure that this behaviour is not passed on to the next generation.”
paras.zh: “板球委员会应该对[此类]球员采取纪律处分，并确保这种行为不会遗传给下一代。”

paras.en: Khan’s teammate and good friend, Hussain, agreed.
paras.zh: 可汗的队友兼好友侯赛因对此表示同意。

paras.en: “It is a worrying sign for the sport,” he said of the on-field antics.
paras.zh: “这对这项运动来说是一个令人担忧的迹象，”他谈到场上的滑稽动作时说道。

paras.en: “Politics has poisoned cricket and the fact that young cricketers show this behaviour is not good for the future of the game.”
paras.zh: “政治毒害了板球运动，年轻板球运动员表现出这种行为对这项运动的未来不利。”

paras.en: The venue for the tournament in Qatar is in the heart of Asian Town, a Doha suburb inhabited by migrants from South Asia who work in the capital’s Industrial Area.
