articles.title: This Philosopher Was One of the First People to Donate His Body to Science. Nearly 200 Years Later, Researchers Are Still Learning From It

paras.en: As a young man, English philosopher Jeremy Bentham vowed to donate his body to science, becoming one of the first people on record to make such a declaration. And he made good on his promise. After Bentham died at age 84, his remains were publicly dissected, then transformed into an “auto-icon”—a lifelike display featuring his skeleton dressed in one of his suits, which has been preserved by the University College London (UCL) ever since.
paras.zh: 英国哲学家杰里米·边沁（Jeremy Bentham）年轻时发誓要将自己的遗体捐献给科学，成为有记录以来最早做出这一声明的人之一。他兑现了他的诺言。边沁 84 岁去世后，他的遗体被公开解剖，然后变成了一个“汽车图标”——一个栩栩如生的展示，展示了他穿着一套西装的骨架，此后一直由伦敦大学学院 (UCL) 保存。

paras.en: Now, nearly two centuries later, Bentham’s body is still yielding new scientific insights.
paras.zh: 现在，近两个世纪过去了，边沁的身体仍在产生新的科学见解。

paras.en: UCL researchers recently revisited Bentham’s remains, using computed tomography (CT) scanning to create a detailed, 3D model of his mummified head. They share the process and their findings in a short film called Bentham Revealed.
paras.zh: 伦敦大学学院的研究人员最近重新审视了边沁的遗骸，使用计算机断层扫描 (CT) 扫描创建了他木乃伊头部的详细 3D 模型。他们在一部名为“Bentham Revealed”的短片中分享了这一过程和他们的发现。

paras.en: Born in 1748 in London, Bentham was a precocious child who enrolled at Oxford University at just 12 years old. Though he trained as a lawyer, he ultimately devoted his life to philosophy and writing. Bentham became best known as the founder of utilitarianism, a philosophy built around the idea that the best actions are those that produce the greatest happiness for the greatest number of people.
paras.zh: 边沁 1748 年出生于伦敦，是一个早熟的孩子，年仅 12 岁就进入牛津大学。尽管他接受过律师培训，但他最终将一生奉献给了哲学和写作。边沁因功利主义的创始人而闻名，功利主义的哲学建立在这样的理念之上：最好的行动是为最大多数人带来最大幸福的行动。

paras.en: He applied this principle to a wide range of issues, advocating for prison reform, animal welfare, women’s rights, the decriminalization of homosexuality and the abolition of slavery—positions that were considered radical in 18th- and 19th-century Britain. His ideas inspired the founding of UCL, which opened to students in 1826.
paras.zh: 他将这一原则应用于广泛的问题，倡导监狱改革、动物福利、妇女权利、同性恋非刑罪化和废除奴隶制——这些立场在 18 世纪和 19 世纪的英国被认为是激进的。他的想法启发了伦敦大学学院的成立，该学院于 1826 年向学生开放。

paras.en: But perhaps Bentham’s most radical act was his decision to donate his body to science. In his will, he bequeathed his corpse to his friend, British physician Thomas Southwood Smith, and asked him to arrange a public dissection of his body. Smith obliged, tasking anatomist Richard Dugard Grainger with carrying out the procedure five days after Bentham’s death in June 1832, according to a university statement. Smith then created the auto-icon, which he kept at his house until 1850, when he donated it to UCL. It’s currently on view at UCL’s student center.
paras.zh: 但也许边沁最激进的行为是他决定将自己的遗体捐献给科学。在他的遗嘱中，他将自己的尸体遗赠给了他的朋友、英国医生托马斯·索斯伍德·史密斯，并要求他安排对他的尸体进行公开解剖。根据一份大学声明，史密斯在 1832 年 6 月边沁去世五天后，责成解剖学家理查德·杜加德·格兰杰 (Richard Dugard Grainger) 执行手术。史密斯随后创作了这个自动图标，并将其一直保留在自己的家里，直到 1850 年他将其捐赠给伦敦大学学院。目前它正在伦敦大学学院的学生中心展出。

paras.en: Bentham coined the term auto-icon himself, defining it as “self image” or “self representation.” He hoped to inspire others to follow suit. “He imagined a future where people were making auto-icons to keep their dead relatives around,” Tannis Davidson, who led the recent research and serves as a curator at UCL's Grant Museum of Zoology, tells Live Science’s Tom Metcalfe.
paras.zh: 边沁自己创造了“自动偶像”这个词，将其定义为“自我形象”或“自我表现”。他希望激励其他人效仿。 “他想象了一个未来，人们会制作汽车图标来让死去的亲人留在身边，”最近这项研究的领导者、伦敦大学学院格兰特动物学博物馆馆长坦尼斯·戴维森告诉《生活科学》的汤姆·梅特卡夫。

paras.en: Smith tried to preserve Bentham’s head for the auto-icon, but his efforts ultimately failed, leading him to commission a wax replica instead. Bentham’s real head was displayed at the feet of the auto-icon for years, until it was stolen and held ransom for several days in 1975. After that, it was stashed away for safe keeping.
paras.zh: 史密斯试图为汽车偶像保留边沁的头部，但他的努力最终失败了，导致他委托制作蜡像复制品。边沁的真实头像在汽车图标脚下展示了多年，直到 1975 年被盗并被勒索了几天赎金。此后，它被藏起来以确保安全。

paras.en: Bentham requested that his head be preserved in “the New Zealand manner.” He was referring to the preserved heads, or mokomokai, of the Māori, New Zealand’s indigenous inhabitants.
paras.zh: 边沁要求以“新西兰方式”保存他的头颅。他指的是新西兰原住民毛利人保存完好的头颅，或称为 mokomokai。

paras.en: - Starting in the late 18th century, tattooed, decapitated and dried mokomokai became collector’s items in Britain. Since 2003, the government of New Zealand has mandated that such remains be repatriated.
paras.zh: - 从 18 世纪末开始，纹身、斩首和风干的 mokomokai 在英国成为收藏品。自2003年以来，新西兰政府已下令将这些遗骸遣返。

paras.en: Bentham’s head is still used for research today. The team’s recent CT scans revealed that Bentham was missing several teeth and had advanced arthritis in his lower jaw, which likely caused excruciating pain. His tooth problems aren’t particularly surprising, given that the importance of regular dental hygiene was not yet widely understood. “Dentistry 200 years ago was a very different kettle of fish than it is today,” Davidson tells Live Science.
paras.zh: 边沁的头颅至今仍用于研究。该团队最近的 CT 扫描显示，边沁缺失了几颗牙齿，下颌患有晚期关节炎，这可能会导致极度疼痛。鉴于定期牙齿卫生的重要性尚未得到广泛认识，他的牙齿问题并不特别令人惊讶。 “200 年前的牙科与今天的牙科完全不同，”戴维森告诉《生活科学》杂志。

paras.en: It’s not clear whether Bentham knew about the arthritis in his jaw, but he was fully aware of his dental issues. He confided in an 1830 letter that he had “never been fond of having my teeth [extracted], but I have more than once submitted to the momentary torment to rid myself of the enduring one.” Bentham also described some of his home remedies, writing in another 1830 letter about heating a knitting needle, then applying it directly to an exposed nerve.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚边沁是否知道他下巴的关节炎，但他完全意识到自己的牙齿问题。他在 1830 年的一封信中透露，他“从来不喜欢[拔掉]牙齿，但我不止一次地忍受暂时的折磨，以摆脱持久的牙齿。”边沁还描述了他的一些家庭疗法，在另一封 1830 年的信中写道，加热一根织针，然后将其直接应用于裸露的神经。

paras.en: The recent investigation also sheds light on Smith’s attempts to preserve Bentham’s head for the auto-icon. He appears to have removed most of Bentham’s brain, but he left behind some of the dura mater, the thick, outermost membrane. Additionally, he drilled a hole through the top of Bentham’s skull, which was meant to attach it to the auto-icon using a metal rod. Smith also added highly detailed glass eyes—complete with an anatomically correct optic nerve—to the preserved head.
paras.zh: 最近的调查还揭示了史密斯试图为汽车偶像保留边沁头部的情况。他似乎切除了边沁的大部分大脑，但留下了一些硬脑膜，即最外层的厚膜。此外，他还在边沁的头骨顶部钻了一个孔，目的是使用金属棒将其连接到自动图标上。史密斯还在保存下来的头部上添加了高度精细的玻璃眼睛，以及解剖学上正确的视神经。

paras.en: One of the team’s primary goals was to learn more about the mummification process, according to Bentham Revealed. They also hoped the CT imagery might serve as a baseline for monitoring the head’s condition over time and determining how best to preserve it.
paras.zh: 据边沁透露，该团队的主要目标之一是更多地了解木乃伊化过程。他们还希望 CT 图像可以作为监测头部长期状况并确定如何最好地保存头部的基线。

paras.en: But, beyond that, they say the model of Bentham’s head could prove useful to a wide range of professionals, from healthcare providers and archaeologists to museum specialists. For example, a 3D-printed replica of Bentham’s skull could one day support teaching, research and conservation efforts.
paras.zh: 但除此之外，他们表示边沁的头部模型可能对从医疗保健提供者、考古学家到博物馆专家等广泛的专业人士有用。例如，边沁头骨的 3D 打印复制品有一天可以支持教学、研究和保护工作。

paras.en: And what would Bentham himself have thought of this modern study of his remains? That’s something the team seriously considered before embarking on the project, given the ethical sensitivities around studying human remains
paras.zh: 边沁本人会对他遗骸的现代研究有何看法？考虑到研究人类遗骸的伦理敏感性，这是团队在开始该项目之前认真考虑的事情

paras.en: Given his beliefs about scientific inquiry and the specific directives in his will, Bentham likely would have “strongly approved,” Tim Causer, a philosopher who leads the university’s Bentham Project, says in the statement.
paras.zh: 领导该大学边沁项目的哲学家蒂姆·考瑟（Tim Causer）在声明中表示，考虑到边沁对科学探究的信念以及遗嘱中的具体指示，边沁可能会“强烈支持”。

paras.en: “Bentham was of the view that you can’t advance knowledge without experimentation and observation,” Causer adds.
paras.zh: “边沁认为，如果没有实验和观察，就无法增进知识，”考瑟补充道。

articles.title: See the Rare Baby Rhinoceros Born at England's Chester Zoo, an Adorable Boost for Its Vulnerable Species

paras.en: A zoo in England is welcoming an enormous new baby: a greater one-horned rhino. Video footage captured the moment of the calf’s birth at Chester Zoo on October 11, and since then, animal care teams have delighted in watching the baby grow.
paras.zh: 英国的一家动物园正在迎来一只巨大的新生婴儿：一头更大的独角犀牛。视频片段捕捉到了 10 月 11 日切斯特动物园小牛出生的那一刻，从那时起，动物护理团队就很高兴地看着小宝宝长大。

paras.en: “The new calf is gorgeous, big and active,” Emma Evison, team manager for rhinos at Chester Zoo, tells Smithsonian magazine. “Every step of the process so far has been brilliant … and it’s a pleasure to see the calf becoming more confident and curious.”
paras.zh: 切斯特动物园犀牛团队经理艾玛·埃维森 (Emma Evison) 告诉《史密森尼》杂志：“这头新生的小犀牛非常漂亮、体型庞大且活跃。” “到目前为止，这个过程的每一步都非常出色……很高兴看到小牛变得更加自信和好奇。”

paras.en: It will be a few years before the calf gets its namesake horn, but otherwise, newborn greater one-horned rhinos “come out as almost perfect miniatures of their parents,” Evison says. Their skin folds into plates in a way that resembles a coat of armor, and learning how to inhabit their bulky bodies takes some time.
paras.zh: 埃维森说，小犀牛要过几年才能长出同名的角，但除此之外，新生的大独角犀“几乎是父母的完美缩影”。它们的皮肤以类似于盔甲的方式折叠成板，学习如何居住在它们庞大的身体中需要一些时间。

paras.en: “For the first few days, young rhinos have to work out how their legs are supposed to operate,” she adds. “There’s a bit of wobbliness.”
paras.zh: “在最初的几天里，小犀牛必须弄清楚它们的腿应该如何运作，”她补充道。 “有一点不稳定。”

paras.en: The baby is healthy, though its sex and weight haven’t yet been announced. Greater one-horned rhino calves are typically around 99 pounds, per a statement from the zoo, and by the time it’s an adult, the animal will be about six feet tall at the shoulder.
paras.zh: 婴儿很健康，但性别和体重尚未公布。根据动物园的一份声明，大独角犀牛幼崽通常重约 99 磅，当它成年时，肩高约为 6 英尺。

paras.en: The birth marks the fourth calf born to parents Asha and Beni at Chester Zoo. But after siring the calf, Beni died earlier this year from a sudden illness. “It’s lovely to know that his legacy lives on through this calf,” Tom Garland, assistant manager of the rhino team at Chester Zoo, says in the statement. And Asha “has been a brilliant mum to all her youngsters,” he adds. This most recent pregnancy lasted 15 months.
paras.zh: 这是切斯特动物园父母阿莎和贝尼生下的第四只小牛。但在生下小牛后，贝尼于今年早些时候因突发疾病去世。切斯特动物园犀牛队助理经理汤姆·加兰在声明中表示：“很高兴知道他的遗产通过这头小牛得以延续。”他补充道，阿莎“对她所有的孩子来说都是一位出色的妈妈”。最近一次怀孕持续了 15 个月。

paras.en: Tracking a rhinoceros pregnancy isn’t an easy task. With such thick skin, rhinos are tough targets for ultrasound machines. But caretakers were able to follow Asha’s reproductive cycle by measuring fertility- and pregnancy-related hormones—like estrogen and progesterone—in her dung.
paras.zh: 追踪犀牛怀孕并不是一件容易的事。由于皮肤如此厚，犀牛成为超声波机器的棘手目标。但看护人员能够通过测量阿莎粪便中与生育和怀孕相关的激素（如雌激素和黄体酮）来跟踪阿莎的生殖周期。

paras.en: This technique also showed them when Asha was ready to breed, allowing them to safely introduce her to Beni. Rhinos are typically solitary animals outside the mating season, so knowing when they can come together is helpful for zoo scientists hoping to increase their population.
paras.zh: 这项技术还向他们展示了阿莎何时准备好繁殖，从而使他们能够安全地将她介绍给贝尼。犀牛在交配季节之外通常是独居动物，因此了解它们何时可以聚集在一起对于希望增加犀牛数量的动物园科学家很有帮助。

paras.en: Greater one-horned rhinos once lived throughout the northern region of the Indian subcontinent. But at the start of the 20th century, after widespread habitat loss and relentless hunting driven in part by demand for their horns, only about 200 were left in the wild.
paras.zh: 大独角犀牛曾经生活在印度次大陆的北部地区。但到了 20 世纪初，由于对角的需求导致栖息地大面积丧失和无情的狩猎，野生动物只剩下约 200 只。

paras.en: Thanks to decades of conservation efforts and strict protections, the rhinos have come back from the edge of extinction, with some 4,000 of them now living in the wetlands, forests and grasslands of northern India and Nepal.
paras.zh: 经过几十年的保护努力和严格保护，犀牛已经从灭绝的边缘复活，目前约有4000头犀牛生活在印度北部和尼泊尔的湿地、森林和草原上。

paras.en: The species remains vulnerable to extinction, however, and the animals still face risks. Between January 2021 and December 2024, poachers killed nine greater one-horned rhinos in India, and another four were killed in Nepal, Spoorthy Raman reported for Mongabay last year. Many of the wild rhinos are concentrated in only a few national parks, a distribution that “makes them vulnerable to illness and environmental changes,” Mark Brayshaw, the Chester Zoo’s head of mammals, says in the statement. Though the rhinos have more conservation guardrails than they once did, he notes, “they still need people to love and protect them.”
paras.zh: 然而，该物种仍然容易灭绝，动物仍然面临风险。据《Spoorthy Raman》去年为 Mongabay 报道，2021 年 1 月至 2024 年 12 月期间，偷猎者在印度杀死了 9 头大独角犀，在尼泊尔又杀死了 4 头。切斯特动物园哺乳动物负责人马克·布雷肖(Mark Brayshaw)在声明中表示，许多野生犀牛只集中在几个国家公园内，这种分布“使它们容易受到疾病和环境变化的影响”。他指出，尽管犀牛比以前有了更多的保护护栏，“它们仍然需要人们的爱护和保护”。

paras.en: Chester Zoo belongs to a breeding project across Europe that’s working to conserve the rhino species. And this calf is a key part of that effort, since it belongs to a genetically valuable lineage.
paras.zh: 切斯特动物园属于整个欧洲的一个繁殖项目，致力于保护犀牛物种。这头小牛是这项努力的关键部分，因为它属于具有遗传价值的血统。

paras.en: “Asha is an important rhino, because her genetic line is not over-represented in this population,” Evison says. Even though her species has seen recent success in the wild, “you don’t know what might happen down the line, so it’s important to have that insurance population of healthy individuals in human care.”
paras.zh: “阿莎是一头重要的犀牛，因为她的遗传系在这个种群中并没有过多，”埃维森说。尽管她的物种最近在野外取得了成功，“你不知道接下来会发生什么，所以让人类照顾的健康个体的保险群体很重要。”

paras.en: “Every birth is important for the future of this species,” Garland says in the statement, “and it’s wonderful to see another healthy arrival.”
paras.zh: 加兰在声明中说：“每一次出生对于这个物种的未来都很重要，很高兴看到另一个健康的到来。”

articles.title: Harvard Returns Two Skulls Likely Belonging to Enslaved Individuals, More Than 150 Years After They Were Taken From Brazil for Eugenics Studies

paras.en: More than a century and a half after their remains were removed from Brazil, sent to the United States and used in eugenics studies at Harvard University, the skulls of two people of African descent have finally returned to Brazil.
paras.zh: 在两个非洲人后裔的遗体被从巴西运回美国并用于哈佛大学优生学研究一个半世纪后，两个非洲人后裔的头骨终于回到了巴西。

paras.en: Last week, the Brazilian government formally repatriated the remains from Harvard’s Peabody Museum of Archaeology and Ethnology, marking the transfer with official ceremonies in the cities of Rio de Janeiro and Salvador, according to a statement. The skulls were carried aboard flights in padded boxes inside reinforced suitcases by Brazilian diplomats, concluding a four-year recovery campaign, the Guardian’s Tiago Rogero reports.
paras.zh: 一份声明称，上周，巴西政府正式从哈佛大学皮博迪考古与民族学博物馆归还了遗骸，并在里约热内卢和萨尔瓦多举行了官方仪式，标志着这一转移。据《卫报》的蒂亚戈·罗杰罗报道，巴西外交官将这些头骨装在加固手提箱内的软垫盒子里带上飞机，结束了为期四年的恢复行动。

paras.en: “The repatriation of human remains represents a fundamental step towards recognizing the memory, history and dignity of the Black population of our country,” Brazil’s minister of human rights and citizenship, Janine Mello, said at the ceremony, according to the Art Newspaper’s Gabriella Angeleti. “More than a century after they were taken from Brazil, these remains will return to the country to receive the dignified treatment to which they are entitled, in a process built on respect for memory, religious traditions and the communities involved.”
paras.zh: 据《艺术报》的加布里埃拉·安杰莱蒂报道，巴西人权和公民事务部长珍妮·梅洛在仪式上表示：“遗骸的归还代表着向承认我国黑人的记忆、历史和尊严迈出了根本性的一步。” “在从巴西被带走一个多世纪后，这些遗骸将返回该国，在尊重记忆、宗教传统和相关社区的基础上，接受他们应有的有尊严的待遇。”

paras.en: During the trans-Atlantic slave trade, over four million enslaved Africans disembarked in Brazil—more than in any other destination in the Americas. Brazil was the last country in the Western Hemisphere to abolish slavery, in 1888.
paras.zh: 在跨大西洋奴隶贸易期间，超过 400 万被奴役的非洲人在巴西上岸，这一数字比美洲任何其他目的地都多。巴西于 1888 年成为西半球最后一个废除奴隶制的国家。

paras.en: Eugenics emerged in the 19th century as the racist, pseudoscientific belief in the selective breeding of human beings. Universities like Harvard at times supported the eugenics movement, with faculty conducting since-discredited research into racial hierarchies. Exploiting enslaved people and their remains under the guise of science was “widespread,” historians Ayah Nuriddin, Graham Mooney and Alexandre I.R. White wrote in a 2020 Lancet article. “American medical education relied on the theft, dissection and display of bodies, many of whom were Black.”
paras.zh: 优生学出现于 19 世纪，是对人类选择性育种的种族主义、伪科学信仰。像哈佛大学这样的大学有时会支持优生学运动，教员们对种族等级制度进行了后来不可信的研究。历史学家阿亚·努里丁 (Ayah Nuriddin)、格雷厄姆·穆尼 (Graham Mooney) 和亚历山大·I.R. (Alexandre I.R.) 认为，打着科学幌子剥削被奴役者及其遗体的现象“普遍存在”。怀特在 2020 年《柳叶刀》文章中写道。 “美国医学教育依赖于盗窃、解剖和展示尸体，其中许多是黑人。”

paras.en: The existence of the two Brazilian skulls at Harvard came to public light in 2022 through a book by historian Christopher D.E. Willoughby and reporting in the student-run Harvard Crimson, which found that the university held remains from at least 19 people likely enslaved in the United States, the Caribbean and Brazil, Rogero reported last year in the Guardian.
paras.zh: 2022 年，历史学家 Christopher D.E. 所著的一本书使哈佛大学存在两个巴西头骨的事实曝光。罗杰罗去年在《卫报》上报道称，威洛比和学生运营的《哈佛深红报》进行了报道，该报发现该大学保存着至少 19 具可能在美国、加勒比海和巴西被奴役的人的遗骸。

paras.en: While a 2022 university report recommended the repatriation of the remains and Brazilian researchers continued to push for the skulls’ return, negotiations only gained momentum after Brazil’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs joined the talks in late 2024, historian João José Reis told the Guardian last year.
paras.zh: 历史学家若昂·何塞·雷斯 (João José Reis) 去年告诉《卫报》，虽然 2022 年的一份大学报告建议归还遗骸，巴西研究人员也继续推动归还头骨，但在巴西外交部于 2024 年底加入谈判后，谈判才取得了进展。

paras.en: One of the skulls, transferred to the Federal University of Bahia in Salvador, is believed to belong to an enslaved man of Nagô, or Yoruba, origin who fought and died in the January 1835 Malê Revolt, the largest urban slave rebellion in Brazilian history. During that uprising roughly 600 enslaved and freed African Muslims attempted to take control of Salvador before police suppressed the revolt, killing 70 participants. After the man died of his wounds at a Salvador hospital, U.S. diplomat and sugar trader Gideon T. Snow allegedly took his head and shipped it to Boston alongside a note laden with eugenicist beliefs, describing the unnamed man as “one of the chiefs in the affair,” per the Guardian.
paras.zh: 其中一个头骨被转移到萨尔瓦多的巴伊亚联邦大学，据信属于一名来自纳戈（即约鲁巴）的奴隶，他在 1835 年 1 月的马莱起义中战斗并死亡，这是巴西历史上最大的城市奴隶起义。在那次起义中，大约 600 名被奴役和获得自由的非洲穆斯林试图控制萨尔瓦多，但警察镇压了起义，造成 70 名参与者死亡。据《卫报》报道，这名男子在萨尔瓦多一家医院因伤去世后，美国外交官兼糖商吉迪恩·T·斯诺据称将他的头颅运往波士顿，并附上一张载有优生学信仰的字条，将这名未透露姓名的男子描述为“这起事件的主要负责人之一”。

paras.en: Members of the Bahia Islamic Cultural Center in Salvador and the advocacy group Arakunrin campaigned for his return so he could receive a proper burial. “He is our brother and deserves to be buried under Islamic rites,” Sheikh Abdul Hameed Ahmad, the founder of the center, told the Guardian in 2025. Funeral rituals were often denied to enslaved individuals who died in Brazil, per researcher Hannah Romã Bellini Sarno.
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦多巴伊亚伊斯兰文化中心和倡导组织 Arakunrin 的成员呼吁他返回，以便他能得到适当的埋葬。该中心创始人谢赫·阿卜杜勒·哈米德·艾哈迈德 (Sheikh Abdul Hameed Ahmad) 在 2025 年告诉《卫报》：“他是我们的兄弟，应该按照伊斯兰仪式安葬。”研究员汉娜·罗曼·贝利尼·萨尔诺 (Hannah Romã Bellini Sarno) 表示，在巴西死去的奴隶常常被拒绝举行葬礼。

paras.en: Less is known about the second skull, which was entrusted to the National Museum of the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro. It had been held at the Peabody Museum since 1870, following a transfer from Harvard’s Museum of Comparative Zoology. Museum records indicate that it was obtained by Walter Hunnewell, a Harvard graduate who served as photographer on an 1865-1866 expedition to Brazil led by naturalist Louis Agassiz, with an accompanying note stating the remains had been “exhumed in the streets of Rio de Janeiro,” per the Art Newspaper.
paras.zh: 关于第二个头骨，人们知之甚少，它被托付给里约热内卢联邦大学国家博物馆。自 1870 年起，该展览从哈佛大学比较动物学博物馆转移到皮博迪博物馆举办。博物馆记录显示，该遗骸由哈佛大学毕业生沃尔特·亨内维尔 (Walter Hunnewell) 获得，他在 1865 年至 1866 年博物学家路易斯·阿加西 (Louis Agassiz) 率领的巴西探险队中担任摄影师，并附有一张注释，据《艺术新闻》报道，遗骸是“在里约热内卢的街道上挖掘出来的”。

paras.en: Based on the skull’s size, Harvard researchers suggested it likely belonged to an adult woman. By cross-referencing 19th-century diaries, letters and maps, Bruno Véras, a historian at the University of Toronto Mississauga, concluded the remains may have been taken from Rio’s Cemitério dos Pretos Novos, a burial ground for newly arrived Africans who died during or shortly after arriving in Brazil. “To steal a skull and take it to another country was violent even in the context of racist research,” Veras tells the Guardian.
paras.zh: 根据头骨的大小，哈佛大学的研究人员认为它可能属于一名成年女性。通过交叉参考 19 世纪的日记、信件和地图，多伦多大学密西沙加分校的历史学家布鲁诺·维拉斯 (Bruno Véras) 得出结论，这些遗骸可能是从里约热内卢的新墓地 (Cemitério dos Pretos Novos) 中取出的，这是一个埋葬在抵达巴西期间或抵达后不久死亡的新抵达的非洲人的墓地。 “即使在种族主义研究的背景下，偷走头骨并将其带到另一个国家也是暴力行为，”维拉斯告诉卫报。

paras.en: “This return represents a historical responsibility for the museum,” Juliana Sayão, deputy director of the national museum, said during the Rio ceremony, per the Art Newspaper. “We are confronted with the story of a person whose life was shaped by enslavement and the removal of her body from Brazil. Beyond assuming temporary custody, we are committed to treating this history with respect and responsibility.”
paras.zh: 据《艺术新闻》报道，国家博物馆副馆长朱莉安娜·萨亚奥 (Juliana Sayão) 在里约开幕式上表示：“这次回归代表了博物馆的历史责任。” “我们面临着一个人的故事，她的生活因奴役和被从巴西运走而改变。除了暂时拘留之外，我们还致力于以尊重和负责任的态度对待这段历史。”

paras.en: Neither skull will be publicly exhibited or have its image released. Forensic anthropologists at the two Brazilian universities will conduct measurements and microscopic examinations—and, if authorized, genetic or dating analyses—to confirm the individuals’ sex and origins before both are laid to rest with religious rites.
paras.zh: 这两个头骨都不会公开展示，也不会发布其图像。巴西两所大学的法医人类学家将进行测量和显微镜检查，并在获得授权的情况下进行基因或年代测定分析，以确认个体的性别和起源，然后再以宗教仪式安葬这两个人。

paras.en: For Brazilian officials, the return marks both a reckoning and a beginning. “This history of slavery cannot be undone,” Irina Feisthauer Silveira, one of the diplomats who escorted the remains back to Brazil, tells the Guardian. “But acknowledging the mistakes of the past with transparency is a first step towards building a more equal, just and less violent future.”
paras.zh: 对于巴西官员来说，回归既是一次清算，也是一个开始。 “这段奴隶制的历史无法挽回，”护送遗体返回巴西的外交官之一伊琳娜·费斯托尔·西尔维拉 (Irina Feisthauer Silveira) 告诉《卫报》。 “但以透明的方式承认过去的错误是建立一个更加平等、公正和更少暴力的未来的第一步。”

articles.title: Best Gifts for Mom (2026): Digital Wall Calendars, Better Bags, Personalized Jewelry, and More
articles.author: Nena Farrell

paras.en: Moms give the best gifts, so it stands to reason that you should get the best gifts for Mom when you're shopping for her in any scenario. That includes Mother's Day, her birthday, Christmas, Hanukkah, or any other holiday in your family's life that includes gift-giving. The holiday season is now upon us, and I've added a few gift ideas with that time of year in mind.
paras.zh: 妈妈会送出最好的礼物，所以在任何情况下，当你为妈妈购物时，你都应该为妈妈买最好的礼物。这包括母亲节、她的生日、圣诞节、光明节或家庭生活中任何其他需要赠送礼物的节日。假期即将来临，我根据一年中的这个时间添加了一些礼物创意。

paras.en: If you're worried you're going to give her a disappointing gift or something she already has, fear not: I've gathered the coolest things we recommend here at WIRED that just about any mom will love. From wellness gadgets that can improve her skin to the best tote bags I've tried, and even a device that puts her digital calendar in an IRL device, moms everywhere can get a ton out of these gifts. Many of these are items I've given to my mother, or other WIRED staffers have given to theirs. Or they might be at the top of my own wish list as a mother of a 4-year-old.
paras.zh: 如果您担心会给她一份令人失望的礼物或她已经拥有的东西，请不要担心：我在《连线》杂志上收集了我们推荐的最酷的东西，几乎所有妈妈都会喜欢。从可以改善皮肤的健康小工具到我尝试过的最好的手提袋，甚至是可以将她的数字日历放入现实生活中的设备，世界各地的妈妈都可以从这些礼物中获益匪浅。其中许多物品是我送给我母亲的，或者《连线》其他工作人员送给他们的。或者，作为一个 4 岁孩子的母亲，它们可能是我自己的愿望清单中的首位。

paras.en: Updated November 2026: I've added Therabody's Theraface Mask Glo, Omnilux's Contour Gloves, WanderFull's HydroBag, and Nuuly's clothing subscription as new gifts to this guide.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月更新：我已将 Therabody 的 Theraface Mask Glo、Omnilux 的 Contour 手套、WanderFull 的 HydroBag 和 Nuuly 的服装订阅添加为本指南的新礼物。

paras.en: The must-have gadget for women of almost any age is an LED mask. These masks promise to use red light to erase wrinkles, brighten your skin, and keep acne at bay. I haven't seen much change in my wrinkles in my year-plus of regularly using a red-light mask, but I can confirm it makes my skin brighter and calms down acne and scars much faster when I'm regularly treating my skin, and I always get compliments on how nice my skin looks when I'm regularly using it. Therabody's TheraFace Mask Glo has a range of treatments with both red and blue light, a unique vibration therapy feature, and removable eye shields if you don't want the light in your eyes.
paras.zh: 几乎任何年龄段的女性必备的小玩意就是 LED 面罩。这些面膜承诺利用红光消除皱纹、提亮肤色并预防粉刺。在我定期使用红光面膜的一年多时间里，我的皱纹并没有看到太大的变化，但我可以确认，当我定期治疗我的皮肤时，它会让我的皮肤变得更明亮，并更快地平息痤疮和疤痕，而且当我定期使用它时，我总是会得到关于我的皮肤看起来多么漂亮的赞美。 Therabody 的 TheraFace Mask Glo 具有一系列红光和蓝光治疗功能、独特的振动治疗功能以及可拆卸的眼罩（如果您不希望光线进入眼睛）。

paras.en: Look, nothing says mom life like looking for the perfect bag. I'm in a massive tote phase of my life; I somehow need to either lug an armload of items for myself and my son (or just myself!) or I only need a tiny belt bag. There's no in between.
paras.zh: 看，没有什么比寻找完美的包更能体现妈妈的生活了。我正处于人生的一个大手提包阶段；我不知何故需要要么为自己和我的儿子（或只是我自己！）拖一大堆物品，要么我只需要一个小腰包。两者之间没有任何关系。

paras.en: The Yardsale Day Bag has been my go-to for a variety of needs, from a colorful personal item for a flight to a gym bag to the aerial studio. It's got a waterproof bottom that makes me happy to bring it to the zoo's splash pad, and a magnetic middle separator you can flex to separate the middle of the bag into two medium sections to better divide all your items. Plus, there are a handful of side pockets inside, but none are large enough for my massive Owala water bottle. I have the 30L in Butter, but there's also a smaller 20L version if you're looking for something a little more compact.
paras.zh: Yardsale Day Bag 一直是我满足各种需求的首选，从飞行时的彩色个人物品到健身包再到空中工作室。它有一个防水底部，让我很高兴把它带到动物园的防溅垫上，还有一个磁性中间分离器，您可以弯曲将包的中间分成两个中等部分，以更好地分隔您的所有物品。另外，里面有几个侧袋，但没有一个足够大，可以容纳我巨大的奥瓦拉水瓶。我有 30L 黄油装，但如果您正在寻找更紧凑的东西，还有更小的 20L 版本。

paras.en: If your mom wants something a little more stylish, the Alex Mill totes are always on my mind. They come in a variety of gorgeous colors and are made of coated canvas, so they can put up with daily adventures, and you can customize them with your mom's initials (or even just the word “mom”!) with Alex Mill's hand-painted letter service. It's a simpler tote with no other pockets, but you can use the top snaps to let out the sides or tuck them in, depending on how much space Mom needs on a given day. The weathered color and vibe of these bags also feel perfect for the fall season.
paras.zh: 如果你妈妈想要更时尚一点的东西，Alex Mill 手提包总是在我的脑海中。它们有各种华丽的颜色，由涂层帆布制成，因此可以承受日常冒险，并且您可以通过 Alex Mill 的手绘字母服务，用妈妈的姓名首字母（甚至只是“妈妈”这个词！）来定制它们。这是一款比较简单的手提包，没有其他口袋，但您可以使用顶部的按扣将两侧露出或塞进去，具体取决于妈妈在某一天需要多少空间。这些包袋的风化色彩和氛围也非常适合秋季。

paras.en: My latest favorite family planning gadget is a digital wall calendar. These handy devices take the Google Calendar I live by (and just about any other digital calendar, if your mom isn't a Google girl) and put it on a physical device I can quickly tap into without needing to grab my phone or bark at Alexa. The Skylight Calendar 2 is my favorite, because it not only includes to-do lists, meal planning, and a recipe book but also doubles as a digital photo frame. That means it displays cute photos of my family most of the time, and then, with a simple tap, it opens the calendar or whatever page I was last on to show me what's on my family's schedule. It does have a subscription fee, though, to get the digital photo frame feature and a few other options, like meal planning. But I think it's well worth it to get so many features in a single device. You can also gift her kiddo a Skylight Buddy ($140) so that she doesn't have to remind them to check the main calendar for their chores; it'll appear on their own device if they have a Buddy.
paras.zh: 我最近最喜欢的计划生育小工具是数字挂历。这些方便的设备将我赖以生存的 Google 日历（以及几乎任何其他数字日历，如果你妈妈不是 Google 女孩）放在物理设备上，我可以快速使用，而无需拿起手机或对 Alexa 吠叫。 Skylight Calendar 2 是我的最爱，因为它不仅包含待办事项列表、膳食计划和食谱书，还可以兼作数码相框。这意味着它大部分时间都会显示我家人的可爱照片，然后，只需轻按一下，它就会打开日历或我上次访问的任何页面，以显示我家人的日程安排。不过，它确实需要付费才能获得数码相框功能和一些其他选项，例如膳食计划。但我认为在一个设备中获得如此多的功能是非常值得的。你还可以送给她的孩子一个 Skylight Buddy（140 美元），这样她就不必提醒他们检查主日历上的家务活；如果他们有好友，它就会出现在他们自己的设备上。

paras.en: To me, motherhood is all about change. It's most obvious at the start of motherhood, when your body changes a lot over the course of nine months, but motherhood encompasses the rest of our lives, and our bodies and style change a lot over that time. One of the biggest giveaways that time has gone by is our clothes—how well they fit for our current stage, whether they reflect the time of our life right now, and if we're bored out of our skull with everything but don't want to buy an entirely new closet.
paras.zh: 对我来说，母性意味着改变。这在母亲刚开始的时候最为明显，在九个月的时间里，你的身体发生了很大的变化，但母亲的身份涵盖了我们的余生，我们的身体和风格在这段时间里发生了很大的变化。时间流逝的最大赠品之一就是我们的衣服——它们是否适合我们当前的阶段，它们是否反映了我们现在生活的时代，以及我们是否对一切感到厌倦，但不想买一个全新的衣柜。

paras.en: I've been loving renting from Nuuly this pregnancy because the brand has an entire maternity section that lets me find pieces to fit me in this short—but very different size—season of my life. My older mother also loves having a clothing subscription because she gets bored of her outfit options to wear into the office, and I loved it for the same reason when I had my first clothing subscription right out of college. If Mom has been talking about wanting some new looks but feels overwhelmed about what she wants to invest in, these rental services are a fun way to get a lot of new clothes in your life without having to store them or spend as much as you would have (some of my favorite maternity clothes I've gotten through Nuuly would have cost me $200 apiece!) The service costs $98 a month, but your first month is discounted to just $60. There's one piece I miss already that might drive me to pick up a second subscription, which would genuinely be cheaper than buying the piece I want brand new.
paras.zh: 这次怀孕期间，我一直很喜欢从 Nuuly 租用衣服，因为该品牌有一个完整的孕妇装专区，可以让我找到适合我生命中这个短暂但尺寸截然不同的季节的衣服。我年长的母亲也喜欢订阅服装，因为她厌倦了穿去办公室的服装选择，当我大学毕业后第一次订阅服装时，我也出于同样的原因喜欢它。如果妈妈一直在谈论想要一些新造型，但对她想投资的东西感到不知所措，那么这些租赁服务是一种有趣的方式，让您可以在生活中获得很多新衣服，而无需存储它们或花很多钱（我通过 Nuuly 购买的一些我最喜欢的孕妇装每件要花费 200 美元！）该服务每月费用为 98 美元，但您的第一个月折扣仅为 60 美元。我已经错过了一件作品，这可能会促使我继续订阅，这确实比购买我想要的全新作品便宜。

paras.en: For years, the go-to gift for a woman in my family, mother or not, was shopping in the jewelry section of a department store. My mom even helped orchestrate this for the rest of the aunties and grandmas, but now, as a mom myself, I find myself interested in jewelry that tells a story about my family and children instead of just any old set. (Except extra earrings for my earring stack, a gift I'm thrilled to get, because there's never enough.)
paras.zh: 多年来，我家女性的首选礼物，无论是否为母亲，都是在百货公司的珠宝区购物。我妈妈甚至帮助其他阿姨和奶奶精心策划了这个活动，但现在，作为一名妈妈，我发现自己对讲述我的家庭和孩子故事的珠宝感兴趣，而不仅仅是任何旧的珠宝。 （除了我的耳环堆中的额外耳环，这是我很高兴收到的礼物，因为永远都不够。）

paras.en: I love these pieces from Gorjana and BaubleBar that you can customize. Gorjana has a ton of charms you can add to its necklaces or bracelets to reflect Mom’s kids’ initials, birthstones, or anything else; I paired a charm of my son’s first initial ($50) with the Wilshire Adjustable Necklace ($68). If she's more of a ring gal, BaubleBar's Toi et Moi ring ($78) lets you choose two birthstones to display. I chose my and my son's birthstones, but luckily his sibling-to-be will also have a red birthstone, so it'll remain a perfect reflection of my kids and me for years to come.
paras.zh: 我喜欢 Gorjana 和 BaubleBar 的这些可以定制的作品。 Gorjana 有大量饰物，您可以将其添加到项链或手链上，以反映妈妈孩子名字的首字母、生日石或其他任何东西；我将儿子名字首字母的饰物（50 美元）与 Wilshire 可调节项链（68 美元）搭配在一起。如果她更喜欢戒指女孩，BaubleBar 的 Toi et Moi 戒指（78 美元）可以让您选择两颗生日石来展示。我选择了我和我儿子的生日石，但幸运的是，他的未来兄弟姐妹也将拥有一颗红色生日石，因此在未来的岁月里，它仍将是我和孩子们的完美反映。

paras.en: This item was literally made for sports moms: a padded stadium cushion with a wearable blanket inside. My son plays on three sports teams, so I do a lot of sitting outside on bleachers and turf sidelines—and often at night, when it’s freezing. I’ve tried many things to keep warm, from heated jackets to HotHands, but nothing has worked as well as this water-resistant blanket, which unfurls to 50 x 70 inches and sports a clip at the front so you can wear it like a cape. It can also be used for picnics or as a spot for younger siblings to sit and read during tournaments. It’s also not hard to fold it back up and fit it inside the seat part (which is 1 inch thick without the blanket inside). It comes in six colors, so you can be sure to find one that matches your giftee’s kid’s team or school colors. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: 这款产品实际上是为运动妈妈们设计的：一款带衬垫的体育场坐垫，里面有一条可穿戴的毯子。我儿子在三个运动队打球，所以我经常坐在露天看台和草坪边上——而且经常是在晚上，天很冷的时候。我尝试过很多保暖措施，从加热夹克到 HotHands，但没有什么比这条防水毯更有效的了，它展开后尺寸为 50 x 70 英寸，前面有一个夹子，这样你就可以像斗篷一样穿着它。它还可以用于野餐或作为弟弟妹妹在比赛期间坐下来读书的地方。将其折叠起来并放入座椅部分（内部没有毯子时厚度为 1 英寸）也不难。它有六种颜色，因此您一定能找到一款与受赠者孩子的球队或学校颜色相匹配的颜色。 ——凯特·默克

paras.en: As a mom, I take a lot of photos of my family. A lot. And sometimes it feels like all those great photos of my son's milestones go to my camera roll and photo storage to die. There are two solutions I love for this that are incredibly giftable: a digital photo frame she can instantly upload images to, and a printed photo book where you can take the best of the best and put them at her fingertips. I have and love both for different reasons.
paras.zh: 作为一个妈妈，我拍了很多家人的照片。很多。有时感觉就像我儿子的里程碑的所有精彩照片都进入了我的相机胶卷和照片存储中一样消失了。有两种解决方案是我喜欢的，而且非常适合作为礼物：一个是她可以立即上传图像的数码相框，另一个是印刷相册，您可以在其中挑选最好的照片，并将它们放在她的指尖。我出于不同的原因拥有并热爱两者。

paras.en: I love the digital photo frame to add all the photos from a fun weekend at the San Diego Zoo or Renaissance Pleasure Faire for me to relive again and again, but I also love being able to pull a photo book from the bookshelf and relive a specific moment I know is waiting there for me. Aura makes my favorite digital photo frames (followed by Skylight's Calendar 2 if you want a multipurpose device, but Aura has no subscription fee if you only want photos), while Mixbook has been a favorite of mine for a while when it comes to printing photos, and has great starting prices for its photo books.
paras.zh: 我喜欢用数码相框添加在圣地亚哥动物园或文艺复兴游乐园度过的一个有趣的周末的所有照片，让我一次又一次地重温，但我也喜欢能够从书架上拿出一本相册，重温我知道正在等待着我的特定时刻。 Aura 制作了我最喜欢的数码相框（如果你想要多功能设备，那么可以选择 Skylight 的 Calendar 2，但如果你只想要照片，Aura 没有订阅费），而 Mixbook 在打印照片方面一直是我的最爱，并且其相册的起价也很优惠。

paras.en: The graduation from diaper-bag-carrying mom to tote-full-of-snacks-and-clothes-changes mom to an adult who only needs to carry their own stuff is a parenting milestone that deserves celebration. This is my favorite grown-up mom bag, which holds only the essentials: water (because no matter how old your kids are, someone is going to get thirsty), cards, phone, and keys. The thick strap makes it comfortable to carry, and there’s a color, material, or theme for just about anyone’s vibe, including a new line of clear stadium versions. All WanderFull bags will hold any handle-less water bottle up to 11 inches tall and 3.5 inches in diameter. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: 从背着尿布袋的妈妈，到装满零食和衣服的妈妈，再到只需要携带自己的东西的成年人，这是一个值得庆祝的育儿里程碑。这是我最喜欢的成年妈妈包，里面只装必需品：水（因为无论你的孩子多大，总有人会口渴）、卡片、电话和钥匙。厚肩带携带舒适，颜色、材质或主题适合任何人的氛围，包括新系列的透明体育场版本。所有 WanderFull 包均可容纳任何高 11 英寸、直径 3.5 英寸的无把手水瓶。 ——凯特·默克

paras.en: Once my kiddo is asleep, you can find me parked on the couch playing video games. I upgraded to a Nintendo Switch 2 ($499) earlier this summer so I could finally buy and play Pokopia ($70), since it's exclusive to the new console, and now my husband and I are completely hooked on the Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time ($60) remake that came out a few weeks ago. It's also quickly become an experience I can share with my son now that he's 4; he was been helping me and my husband replay Tears of the Kingdom, but now he's dubbed Ocarina of Time as “Big Little Link” and is obsessed with using the grappling hook and using up all of our arrows.
paras.zh: 一旦我的孩子睡着了，你就会发现我把车停在沙发上玩电子游戏。今年夏天早些时候，我升级到了 Nintendo Switch 2（499 美元），这样我终于可以购买并玩 Pokopia（70 美元）了，因为它是新游戏机独有的，现在我和我的丈夫完全迷上了几周前推出的《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版（60 美元）。现在我儿子已经四岁了，这也很快成为我可以与他分享的经历；他一直在帮助我和我丈夫重玩《王国之泪》，但现在他将《时之笛》称为“大小连环”，并沉迷于使用抓钩并耗尽我们所有的箭。

paras.en: If you're not looking to upgrade her console just yet but need a Switch-friendly cozy game for her, Stardew Valley has another big update in the works and only costs $15. I'm also hoping we see Fields of Mistria ($14) come to the Switch eventually, but the full launch came out in August for Steam users and has major quality-of-life improvements if she has played Stardew one time too many. My husband also upgraded his gaming setup this summer with a Steam Machine (from $1,049), and I have big plans to start using it often for Fields of Mistria. If your mom loves games, she'll love any one of these new devices or new games, especially if she already got herself the new gadget as I did.
paras.zh: 如果你还不打算升级她的主机，但需要为她设计一款适合 Switch 的舒适游戏，《星露谷物语》还有另一项重大更新正在进行中，只需 15 美元。我也希望我们能看到《密斯特利亚之田》（售价 14 美元）最终登陆 Switch，但完整版本已于 8 月面向 Steam 用户推出，如果她玩《星露谷物语》太多次的话，生活质量会得到重大改善。今年夏天，我丈夫还用 Steam 机器升级了他的游戏设置（起价 1,049 美元），我有一个宏伟的计划，要开始在《密斯特里亚的旷野》中经常使用它。如果你的妈妈喜欢游戏，她一定会喜欢这些新设备或新游戏中的任何一款，特别是如果她已经像我一样拥有了新的小工具。

paras.en: If a mom in your life is exploring her nonalcoholic drink options, The Zero Proof has some gift sets perfect to give so she can try out several things at once. I'm currently grounded from drinking any cocktails while I'm pregnant, but moms (and people in general) can have all kinds of reasons to want to explore unique, interesting drinks that are sans alcohol. I really liked this set for how many cool drinks it exposed me to, from bottles of nonalcoholic wine to knockoff cocktails. If you're looking to spend a little less, my favorites so far have been the Château del Ish Non-Alcoholic Sparkling Espumante ($20) and Lapo's Non-Alcoholic Melograno Mule ($20 for four).
paras.zh: 如果您生活中的一位妈妈正在探索她的非酒精饮料选择，零证明有一些完美的礼品套装，这样她就可以同时尝试多种饮料。目前，我在怀孕期间禁止喝任何鸡尾酒，但妈妈们（以及一般人）可能有各种各样的理由想要探索独特、有趣的不含酒精的饮料。我真的很喜欢这个套装，因为它让我喝了很多清凉饮料，从瓶装无酒精葡萄酒到仿冒鸡尾酒。如果你想少花一点钱，到目前为止我最喜欢的是 Château del Ish 无酒精起泡泡沫 (20 美元) 和 Lapo's 无酒精 Melograno Mule (4 美元 20 美元)。

paras.en: Look, I love a Kindle, but if you want to get the best e-reader for your buck (or maybe she just wants an e-reader that isn't a Kindle), the answer is actually a Kobo. My favorite is the Kobo Libra Colour. It's cheaper than the Kindle Colorsoft and can also double as a digital notebook if you add on the $70 stylus. I also prefer Kobo's annotating options: You can write right on the pages instead of in weird pop-up margins and boxes only on Kindle. Kobo also has a page-turner remote ($34), which I love to pair with a pillow stand holder so I can lean back and relax without holding up my e-reader while I read. I gave a similar pillow stand to my mom, and now I can spot her last reading spot easily because that pillow is resting there.
paras.zh: 听着，我喜欢 Kindle，但如果你想买到物有所值的最好的电子阅读器（或者也许她只是想要一个不是 Kindle 的电子阅读器），那么答案实际上是 Kobo。我最喜欢的是 Kobo Libra 颜色。它比 Kindle Colorsoft 便宜，如果加上 70 美元的手写笔，还可以兼作数字笔记本。我也更喜欢 Kobo 的注释选项：您可以直接在页面上书写，而不是仅在 Kindle 上在奇怪的弹出式边距和框中书写。 Kobo 还有一个翻页遥控器（34 美元），我喜欢将其与枕头架搭配使用，这样我就可以向后靠并放松，而无需在阅读时举起电子阅读器。我给了我妈妈一个类似的枕头架，现在我可以很容易地找到她最后一个阅读的地方，因为那个枕头就放在那里。

paras.en: You could also gift her one of the new Kindles if she's a Kindle addict. Many of my friends are drooling over the new purple Ube color of the 12th-gen Kindle ($150), but my personal favorite is the Kindle Aluminum (I just wish it were cheaper!). There's also finally Kindle page-turn remote, the Kindle Click ($35).
paras.zh: 如果她是 Kindle 爱好者，您还可以送给她一台新的 Kindle。我的许多朋友都对第 12 代 Kindle（150 美元）的新紫色宇部颜色垂涎欲滴，但我个人最喜欢的是 Kindle Aluminium（我只是希望它更便宜！）。最后还有 Kindle 翻页遥控器，Kindle Click（35 美元）。

paras.en: If the mom you know is into LED red-light therapy, she probably already knows about face masks and hair growth devices like the one we recommend above, but there’s one area she’s probably neglecting: her hands. With aging comes loss of collagen, subcutaneous fat, and cumulative effects of UV exposure. I spent the first 26 years of my life living in California, where I rarely remembered to put sunscreen on the tops of my hands. Twenty years later, it shows—they’re wrinkly and have age spots and look like they belong to someone 15 years my senior. Trust me; no mom wants this. I’ve been using Omnilux’s FDA-cleared red-light glove for the past few months to try to mitigate some of the damage, and while I haven’t seen any changes yet (Omnilux says changes happen in four to six weeks, but in my experience with red-light masks, it typically takes much longer to see results), I very much enjoy using this device on its own. The soft silicone glove is comfortable to wear and warms as it heats up, so it feels good and works to reduce joint pain. It’s easy to do while I’m reading or watching TV—just three 10-minute sessions per week—and the rechargeable battery (USB-C) lasts a little over a week. If your giftee already spends 10 minutes at the end of the day relaxing in an LED face mask, she’ll know exactly what to do here. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: 如果您认识的妈妈热衷于 LED 红光疗法，她可能已经了解口罩和毛发生长设备（如我们上面推荐的那样），但她可能忽略了一个区域：她的手。随着年龄的增长，胶原蛋白、皮下脂肪会流失，紫外线照射也会产生累积效应。我人生的前 26 年是在加利福尼亚度过的，在那里我很少记得要在手上涂抹防晒霜。二十年后，它显示出——它们满是皱纹，有老年斑，看起来像是比我大 15 岁的人。相信我；没有妈妈想要这个。在过去的几个月里，我一直在使用 Omnilux 经 FDA 批准的红光手套，试图减轻一些伤害，虽然我还没有看到任何变化（Omnilux 说变化会在四到六周内发生，但根据我使用红光面罩的经验，通常需要更长的时间才能看到结果），我非常喜欢单独使用这个设备。柔软的硅胶手套佩戴舒适，加热时会变暖，因此感觉良好，有助于减轻关节疼痛。当我阅读或看电视时，这很容易做到——每周只需 3 次每次 10 分钟的课程——而且充电电池 (USB-C) 可持续使用一周多一点。如果您的受赠者在一天结束时已经戴着 LED 面罩放松了 10 分钟，她就会确切地知道在这里该做什么。 ——凯特·默克

paras.en: If you know a mom who loves to bird-watch (I know one!), you can upgrade her bird feeder to a smart one. Smart bird feeders add a camera to the feeder so she can see a close-up feed of the birds that come to hang out in her yard, and they're adorable to boot, for a little smart curb appeal. WIRED reviewer Kat Merck recommends the original Birdfy feeder as a great gift; it's her favorite smart bird feeder and comes in adorable colors to brighten your mom's yard and catch the eye of neighborhood birds. But the one she and I both have our eye on (her for her mother, me for myself) is the Birdfy Nest Duo, which is actually a birdhouse with two cameras so you can see the birds entering the nest outside and raising a family inside.
paras.zh: 如果您认识一位喜欢观鸟的妈妈（我就认识一个！），您可以将她的喂鸟器升级为智能喂鸟器。智能喂鸟器在喂鸟器上添加了一个摄像头，这样她就可以看到在她院子里闲逛的鸟儿的特写饲料，而且它们很可爱，有点聪明的路边吸引力。 《连线》评论家 Kat Merck 推荐原版 Birdfy 喂食器作为一份很棒的礼物；这是她最喜欢的智能喂鸟器，颜色可爱，可以照亮你妈妈的院子，吸引邻居鸟类的注意。但她和我都关注的一个（她代表她的母亲，我代表我自己）是 Birdfy Nest Duo，它实际上是一个带有两个摄像头的鸟舍，这样你就可以看到鸟儿进入外面的鸟巢，并在里面养育一个家庭。

paras.en: I love a backpack when I'm on the move with my 4-year-old, but one thing that annoys me is that things are hard to find inside, because packs are typically so deep. That's why I adore the Mina Baie Emmy Diaper Bag: It's a wide, shallow bag instead of a long one, making it easy to open and see most of what I store in it without digging around. I'm not toting diapers at the moment, but I've used it to pack a ton of snacks, toys, and spare clothing for my kid.
paras.zh: 当我和 4 岁的孩子一起出行时，我喜欢背包，但让我恼火的是很难找到里面的东西，因为背包通常都很深。这就是我喜欢 Mina Baie Emmy 尿布包的原因：它是一款又宽又浅的包，而不是长包，可以轻松打开并看到我存放在里面的大部分物品，而无需四处翻找。我现在没有带尿布，但我用它为我的孩子装了大量的零食、玩具和备用衣服。

paras.en: I'm intrigued to see how using it with two kids goes—I chose the Emmy Midi, which is the midsize bag, but if you're a pumping parent or need to carry a ton of bottles with formula, you might want to try the larger Emmy Full. The stylish bag is made of vegan leather and can be converted from crossbody to tote to backpack mode, depending on which straps you use. Mina Baie doesn't include a changing kit, but sells one separately ($59) if you'd like to include it in your gift (or buy that as the gift to upgrade their existing bag of choice).
paras.zh: 我很想知道如何与两个孩子一起使用它 - 我选择了 Emmy Midi，这是中型包，但如果您是吸奶的父母或需要携带大量配方奶瓶，您可能想尝试更大的 Emmy Full。这款时尚的包采用纯素皮革制成，可根据您使用的肩带从斜挎包、手提包到背包模式转换。 Mina Baie 不包括换尿布套件，但如果您想将其包含在礼物中（或购买它作为礼物来升级他们现有的选择包），则可以单独出售一套（59 美元）。

paras.en: If Mom loves entertaining—or just being festive—but doesn’t want to have to store a million different dishes, Nora Fleming’s modular serving-tray system is for her. First, pick a base—there are trays, baking dishes, utensil crocks, and even salt and pepper shakers. Then, pick one of dozens of hand-painted “Minis,” or ceramic accents (sold separately). There are holiday themes, sports team themes, and even ones for specific events like mah-jongg or BBQs.
paras.zh: 如果妈妈喜欢娱乐，或者只是喜欢节日，但又不想储存一百万种不同的菜肴，诺拉·弗莱明的模块化托盘系统就适合她。首先，选择一个底座——有托盘、烤盘、陶罐，甚至还有盐瓶和胡椒瓶。然后，从数十种手绘“迷你”或陶瓷装饰（单独出售）中挑选一种。有节日主题、运动队主题，甚至还有针对麻将或烧烤等特定活动的主题。

paras.en: Each base has a hole into which you can attach the Mini with a little rubber stopper. I tested the cracker tray with a harvest-themed Mini, and you wouldn’t know the tray didn’t come with the accent already attached. At the end of next month, I plan to swap it out for a Christmas tree Mini, and so on. Best part is that if Mom likes this setup, you’ll be set on gifts for the foreseeable future, provided you can keep finding new Minis you think she’ll like. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: 每个底座都有一个孔，您可以使用小橡胶塞将 Mini 安装在其中。我用收获主题的 Mini 测试了饼干托盘，你不会知道托盘上没有已经附有的装饰。下个月底我打算把它换成圣诞树Mini等等。最棒的是，如果妈妈喜欢这个设置，在可预见的将来，只要您能不断找到您认为她会喜欢的新迷你玩具，您就会收到礼物。 ——凯特·默克

paras.en: I'm expecting again, and this time I'm on a mission to find a good pregnancy pillow. I tried a large body pillow on the advice of another site for my first pregnancy, and it was honestly an awful experience—the pillow was too large and firm for me to comfortably use, let alone have room for both it and my growing midsection in my bed. Plus, it was heavy, which is annoying when your body already feels too cumbersome to move around.
paras.zh: 我又怀孕了，这次我的任务是找到一个好的怀孕枕头。在我第一次怀孕时，我根据另一个网站的建议尝试了一个大的身体枕头，老实说，这是一次糟糕的经历——枕头太大太硬，让我无法舒适地使用，更不用说有空间容纳它和我床上不断增长的腹部了。另外，它很重，当你的身体已经感觉太笨重而无法移动时，这很烦人。

paras.en: So far, using the Wildbird Pregnancy Pillow has been the opposite. It's slim and light with just enough squish to add a little support under or around my belly without being difficult to get comfortable. It’s beautiful and easy to maneuver around. Wildbird also suggests it for other support positions postpartum, and I'm curious if those will work for me. But it makes for a beautiful gift for any expecting mom and will be one she's excited to put on her bed and curl up with at night.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，使用 Wildbird 怀孕枕头的情况恰恰相反。它又薄又轻，有足够的挤压力，可以在我的腹部下方或周围增加一点支撑，而不会很难感到舒适。它很漂亮而且很容易操纵。 Wildbird 还建议将其用于其他产后支撑位置，我很好奇这些是否适合我。但这对任何准妈妈来说都是一份美丽的礼物，她会很兴奋地把它放在床上，晚上蜷缩起来。

paras.en: For most moms, showers are sacred—especially for moms of babies or younger kids. However, heavy metals, sediments, chlorine, and PFAS can cause health problems not just in drinking water but in water that touches the skin, as well. They can also cause buildup on hair and shower surfaces, making them harder to clean. Many municipalities—including mine—treat water with chlorine, and when I asked him which filter he'd recommend for my own shower, former WIRED reviewer Matthew Korfhage suggested the Weddell Duo. It's the only US filter he's found that has certification for chlorine and lead removal from NSF International, and it also cites third-party testing by IAPMO R&T showing it can remove PFAS, though there's no corresponding certification.
paras.zh: 对于大多数妈妈来说，淋浴是神圣的——尤其是对于婴儿或年幼孩子的妈妈。然而，重金属、沉积物、氯和 PFAS 不仅会在饮用水中引起健康问题，还会在接触皮肤的水中引起健康问题。它们还会导致头发和淋浴表面积聚，使它们更难清洁。许多城市（包括我的城市）都用氯处理水，当我问他会推荐哪种过滤器用于我自己的淋浴时，《连线》前评论家马修·科尔夫哈格（Matthew Korfhage）建议使用威德尔二重奏（Weddell Duo）。这是他发现的唯一一款获得 NSF International 去除氯和铅认证的美国过滤器，它还引用了 IAPMO R&T 的第三方测试，表明它可以去除 PFAS，尽管没有相应的认证。

paras.en: Still, the Duo has a 2.5-gallon-per-minute flow rate and can remove most chlorine from over 8,000 gallons' worth of showers. It's an in-line filter, so it's easy to install in minutes—just screw it in between your pipe and showerhead. It even comes with a little roll of waterproof tape to ensure a leak-free fit, and because of the horizontal orientation, installation won't affect the showerhead height. The filter needs to be replaced every three months, but refills only run about $25 each, compared with competitors like Filterbaby or Rorra, which can cost $40 to $45. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: 尽管如此，Duo 的流量为每分钟 2.5 加仑，可以去除超过 8,000 加仑的淋浴中的大部分氯。它是一款在线过滤器，因此只需几分钟即可轻松安装 - 只需将其拧入管道和淋浴喷头之间即可。它甚至还配有一小卷防水胶带，以确保无泄漏贴合，并且由于水平方向，安装不会影响淋浴头的高度。该过滤器需要每三个月更换一次，但每个补充装仅需 25 美元左右，而 Filterbaby 或 Rorra 等竞争对手的售价为 40 至 45 美元。 ——凯特·默克

articles.title: 8 Best Travel Adapters (2026): 20+ Models Tested
articles.author: Simon Hill

paras.en: Whether planning a country-hopping odyssey or a quick business trip, your journey will go more smoothly with the best travel adapters that allow you to safely charge all your gadgets wherever you land. After many work trips and family vacations I’ve tested several—both universal and basic options—and my favorites will work in most parts of the world.
paras.zh: 无论是计划一次跨国旅行还是一次快速的商务旅行，有了最好的旅行适配器，您的旅程都会更加顺利，无论您到达何处，都可以安全地为您的所有小工具充电。经过多次工作旅行和家庭度假后，我测试了几种（通用和基本选项），我最喜欢的将在世界大部分地区使用。

paras.en: The best adapters make great gifts for travelers and deserve a place in your carry-on, but check out our other travel guides, like the Best Travel Essentials, Best Travel Tech for Families, Best Travel Pillows, and Best USB-C Cables.
paras.zh: 最好的适配器是送给旅行者的绝佳礼物，值得在随身携带的行李中占有一席之地，但请查看我们的其他旅行指南，例如最佳旅行必需品、最佳家庭旅行技术、最佳旅行枕头和最佳 USB-C 电缆。

paras.en: Updated November 2026: I added a Mukiya travel charger and a Mophie Travel Kit, removed some discontinued devices, and updated links and prices.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月更新：我添加了 Mukiya 旅行充电器和 Mophie 旅行套件，删除了一些已停产的设备，并更新了链接和价格。

paras.en: Travel Adapters: Your Questions, Answered
paras.zh: 旅行适配器：您的问题已得到解答

paras.en: There are 15 plug types in use across the world. Universal adapters tend to cover all of these types.
paras.zh: 世界各地使用的插头类型有 15 种。通用适配器往往涵盖所有这些类型。

paras.en: - Type A and Type B are used in the US, Canada, Mexico, and Japan.
paras.zh: - A 型和 B 型用于美国、加拿大、墨西哥和日本。

paras.en: - Type C is common across Europe, South America, and Asia.
paras.zh: - C 型在欧洲、南美和亚洲很常见。

paras.en: - Type E and Type F are found across Europe in places like Germany, Russia, and France.
paras.zh: - E 型和 F 型遍布欧洲的德国、俄罗斯和法国等地。

paras.en: - Type G is used in the United Kingdom, Ireland, and a handful of other places.
paras.zh: - G 型用于英国、爱尔兰和其他一些地方。

paras.en: - Type I is used in Australia, New Zealand, China, and Argentina.
paras.zh: - I 型用于澳大利亚、新西兰、中国和阿根廷。

paras.en: Some countries are not usually covered by universal adapters, such as India (Type D), Israel (Type H), and South Africa (Type M or N). You'll need to buy specific plug adapters for those places. To avoid any surprises when you land, double-check what type you need before you travel.
paras.zh: 有些国家/地区通常不受通用适配器覆盖，例如印度（D 型）、以色列（H 型）和南非（M 型或 N 型）。您需要为这些地方购买特定的插头适配器。为避免着陆时出现意外，请在出行前仔细检查您需要的类型。

paras.en: If you're visiting just one destination, a basic plug adapter that caters to one plug type is all you need. For trips to multiple destinations or for frequent flyers, a universal travel adapter can prove more versatile. The universal adapters I recommend here have the bonus of including multiple USB ports for charging several mobile devices from a single outlet.
paras.zh: 如果您只访问一个目的地，那么您只需要一款适合一种插头类型的基本插头适配器。对于前往多个目的地的旅行或经常乘坐飞机的人来说，通用旅行适配器可以提供更多功能。我在这里推荐的通用适配器的优点是包含多个 USB 端口，可以从一个插座为多个移动设备充电。

paras.en: Voltage converters are big, heavy, and expensive, and they don’t always work—so it’s probably best to avoid them. The reason you might think you need one is that the AC sockets on all of our recommended travel adapters do not convert the voltage coming from the socket. This means plugging into a UK socket will deliver 220 volts at 50 hertz, which is very different from the 120 volts at 60 hertz you can expect in the US. Don't worry! Your gear won’t get fried. You just need to make sure anything you plug into one of these universal travel adapters has something like this printed on it:
paras.zh: 电压转换器又大又重又贵，而且并不总是有效，所以最好避免使用它们。您可能认为自己需要一个的原因是我们推荐的所有旅行适配器上的交流插座都不会转换来自插座的电压。这意味着插入英国插座将提供 220 伏、50 赫兹的电压，这与您在美国所期望的 120 伏、60 赫兹的电压有很大不同。不用担心！你的装备不会被烧坏。您只需确保插入这些通用旅行适配器之一的任何东西都印有类似以下内容：

paras.en: That should include most modern gadgets. If your device or charger can’t handle a variable voltage, it’s probably best to leave it at home. Most places provide hair dryers, irons, and kettles, so there’s no need to take them with you. It’s also often cheaper to buy a set with the correct plug at your destination and save the luggage space and hassle.
paras.zh: 这应该包括大多数现代小工具。如果您的设备或充电器无法处理可变电压，最好将其留在家里。大多数地方都提供吹风机、熨斗和水壶，因此无需随身携带。在目的地购买带有正确插头的套件通常也更便宜，并且可以节省行李空间并减少麻烦。

paras.en: If you are determined to try a voltage converter (again, I don’t recommend doing so), the Ceptics 2,000-watt Travel Voltage Converter ($70) seems to work well. It has a special 2,000-watt outlet for hair dryers, but only ones that work via a mechanical switch (anything with an electronic circuit board for automatic switch-off or temperature control won’t work and is at risk of being fried if plugged in). It also has two outlets that go up to 200 watts, one USB-C port, and three USB-A ports, though the ports do not support fast charging.
paras.zh: 如果您决定尝试使用电压转换器（再次强调，我不建议这样做），Ceptics 2,000 瓦旅行电压转换器（70 美元）似乎效果很好。它有一个专门用于吹风机的 2,000 瓦插座，但只有通过机械开关工作的插座（任何带有自动关闭或温度控制的电子电路板的插座都无法工作，并且如果插入就有被炸毁的危险）。它还配有两个功率高达 200 瓦的插座、1 个 USB-C 端口和 3 个 USB-A 端口，但这些端口不支持快速充电。

paras.en: Travel adapters and chargers usually state the wattage they can deliver for USB-C and USB-A ports, retractable cables, and wireless charging. If you're interested in getting the fastest rates possible, you’ll want a charger and cable that can deliver the maximum wattage to your device. A laptop might want 100 watts, while a phone only needs 30 watts. There's no need to worry if the charger can deliver more wattage than is required because the device will dictate how much power to draw. If the wattage is lower than required, most devices will simply charge slowly. You can find out more about charging standards like Power Delivery (PD), Quick Charge (QC), and others in my guide on how to fast charge your phone.
paras.zh: 旅行适配器和充电器通常会标明它们可以为 USB-C 和 USB-A 端口、可伸缩电缆和无线充电提供的功率。如果您有兴趣获得尽可能快的速率，您将需要一个能够为您的设备提供最大功率的充电器和电缆。笔记本电脑可能需要 100 瓦，而手机只需要 30 瓦。无需担心充电器是否可以提供比所需更多的功率，因为​​设备将决定消耗多少功率。如果瓦数低于要求，大多数设备充电速度会很慢。您可以在我的有关如何为手机快速充电的指南中找到有关充电标准（例如供电 (PD)、快速充电 (QC) 等）的更多信息。

paras.en: Yes, you can pack travel adapters in your suitcase. It may be wise to bring one in your hand luggage for easy access should you need to charge up a device when you arrive at your destination. In fact, devices like power banks with lithium batteries (must be capped at 27,000 mAh) must go in hand luggage, not checked bags.
paras.zh: 是的，您可以将旅行适配器放入手提箱中。如果您在到达目的地时需要为设备充电，最好在手提行李中携带一个设备，以便于使用。事实上，诸如带有锂电池的移动电源（必须上限为 27,000 mAh）之类的设备必须放入手提行李中，而不是托运行李。

paras.en: Can I Buy Travel Adapters at the Airport or Hotel?
paras.zh: 我可以在机场或酒店购买旅行适配器吗？

paras.en: You certainly can buy travel adapters at the airport, but like all other goods you buy at kiosks between connecting flights, they will be far more expensive than necessary, and your choice will be limited.
paras.zh: 您当然可以在机场购买旅行适配器，但与您在转机航班之间的售货亭购买的所有其他商品一​​样，它们的价格将远远高于所需的价格，并且您的选择将受到限制。

paras.en: Some hotels have travel adapters, and some even have wall outlets for other countries (or USB-A and USB-C ports), but most do not, so don’t bank on it. You can always check with your hotel or accommodation before you depart, but it’s safer to bring a travel adapter with you.
paras.zh: 有些酒店有旅行适配器，有些甚至有其他国家的墙壁插座（或 USB-A 和 USB-C 端口），但大多数酒店没有，所以不要指望它。您可以在出发前随时咨询您的酒店或住宿地点，但随身携带旅行适配器会更安全。

paras.en: Should You Test Your Travel Adapter Before You Go?
paras.zh: 您应该在出发前测试您的旅行适配器吗？

paras.en: Seriously, nothing is worse than thinking you’re being very clever by packing light only to get to your hotel and discover that your gadgets refuse to charge. Between the adapter, cable, and your device, plenty can go wrong, so do a quick test on your wall outlet at home with everything you are taking before you set off on an international trip.
paras.zh: 说真的，没有什么比认为自己很聪明，轻装上阵，到了酒店却发现你的电子设备无法充电更糟糕的了。适配器、线缆和您的设备之间可能会出现很多问题，因此在出发国际旅行之前，请对家里的墙上插座以及您所携带的所有设备进行快速测试。

paras.en: Anytime I fly for work or vacation, I take a few travel adapters and chargers with me to test. I also test them for longer periods at home in the UK. I have power stations and power strips with US and EU outlets to test those plugs. I test each charger with a variety of devices (iPhone, Pixel, iPad, MacBook, AirPods). I try charging with every port and outlet simultaneously to see if the charger gets warm. I assess the charging rates, durability, size, weight, and usability of each device. If there are any special features, I test them too.
paras.zh: 每当我乘飞机去工作或度假时，我都会随身携带一些旅行适配器和充电器进行测试。我还在英国的家里对它们进行了更长时间的测试。我有带有美国和欧盟插座的发电站和电源板来测试这些插头。我使用各种设备（iPhone、Pixel、iPad、MacBook、AirPods）测试了每个充电器。我尝试同时使用每个端口和插座充电，看看充电器是否变热。我评估每台设备的充电速率、耐用性、尺寸、重量和可用性。如果有什么特殊的功能，我也会测试它们。

paras.en: There is an endless amount of travel adapters out there you could buy. While I wholeheartedly recommend one of the options above, there are some other travel adapters I've tested that just barely miss the mark.
paras.zh: 您可以购买无数的旅行适配器。虽然我全心全意地推荐上述选项之一，但我测试过的其他一些旅行适配器几乎没有达到目标。

paras.en: Epicka Pulse for $30: The beveled edges of this travel adapter from Epicka make it more comfortable to hold. The sliders work well and lock in place securely to cover you in around 200 countries. A pair of USB-C and two USB-A ports provide a good mix of port options. This adapter can deliver up to 45 watts from either USB-C port, while the USB-A ports top out at 18 watts. I also tested the newer Epicka Pulse Duo ($130), which can deliver up to 140 watts across three USB-C and one USB-A ports, has an extra US or Japanese socket in the side and boasts a smart display that shows you the current charging status, wattage, and temperature. Cool as it is, it's overkill for most folks and kinda pricey.
paras.zh: Epicka Pulse 售价 30 美元：Epicka 旅行适配器的斜角边缘使其握持更舒适。滑块工作良好并牢固锁定到位，可覆盖约 200 个国家/地区。一对 USB-C 和两个 USB-A 端口提供了良好的端口选项组合。该适配器可从任一 USB-C 端口提供高达 45 瓦的功率，而 USB-A 端口的最高功率为 18 瓦。我还测试了较新的 Epicka Pulse Duo（130 美元），它可以通过三个 USB-C 和一个 USB-A 端口提供高达 140 瓦的功率，侧面有一个额外的美国或日本插座，并拥有一个智能显示屏，可以显示当前的充电状态、瓦数和温度。尽管它很酷，但对大多数人来说有点太过分了，而且有点贵。

paras.en: Tessan Travel Adapter 009 for $20: This is a similar design to the Epicka Air I recommend above, but the prongs don’t stay in place as securely when unfolded, and you can only draw a maximum of 20 watts from the one USB-A and two USB-C ports. But it is affordable and compact. Tessan also makes good, traditional, slider universal adapters: There's a 140-watt model ($70), and the most powerful travel adapter I’ve tested, the Voyager 205 ($128), which has six USB-C ports and one USB-A to deliver up to 205 watts. If you don’t care about charging speed, Tessan's 20W model ($23) is very reasonably priced and offers two USB-A and two USB-C ports in a small package.
paras.zh: Tessan 旅行适配器 009，售价 20 美元：这与我上面推荐的 Epicka Air 设计类似，但展开时插脚不能牢固地固定在适当的位置，而且您只能从一个 USB-A 和两个 USB-C 端口汲取最大 20 瓦的功率。但它价格实惠且结构紧凑。 Tessan 还生产优质的传统滑盖通用适配器：有一款 140 瓦型号（70 美元），以及我测试过的最强大的旅行适配器 Voyager 205（128 美元），它有 6 个 USB-C 端口和 1 个 USB-A，可提供高达 205 瓦的功率。如果你不关心充电速度，Tessan 的 20W 型号（23 美元）价格非常合理，在一个小包装中提供两个 USB-A 和两个 USB-C 端口。

paras.en: UGreen Travel Plug Adapter for £17: This travel adapter is for UK folks visiting Europe, and it’s a solid option with a fixed plug (no mechanism). It has only two USB-A and one USB-C port for smaller devices, and it’s very bulky. I prefer the OneBeat above for this type of design.
paras.zh: UGreen 旅行插头适配器售价 17 英镑：这款旅行适配器适用于访问欧洲的英国人，它是带有固定插头（无机制）的可靠选择。它只有两个 USB-A 和一个 USB-C 端口，适用于较小的设备，而且体积非常庞大。对于这种类型的设计，我更喜欢上面的 OneBeat。

paras.en: Statik SmartCharge Pro for $80: This is a nice combo device that includes a 15,000 mAh power bank and a 60-watt wall charger. There are fold-out US prongs and slide-on adapters for the UK, EU, and AU. You also get one USB-A port, one USB-C port, a fold-out USB-C cable, and a wireless charging pad on top that works with your iPhone or Apple Watch.
paras.zh: Statik SmartCharge Pro 售价 80 美元：这是一款不错的组合设备，包括 15,000 mAh 移动电源和 60 瓦壁式充电器。有适用于英国、欧盟和澳大利亚的折叠式美式插脚和滑入式适配器。您还可以获得一个 USB-A 端口、一个 USB-C 端口、一根折叠式 USB-C 线缆以及顶部的无线充电板，可与您的 iPhone 或 Apple Watch 配合使用。

paras.en: D-Link 65W Multi-Port GaN Charger (DCP-651) for $30: If two USB-C ports and a USB-A port are enough for your travel needs, this affordable D-Link charger could be for you. It comes with interchangeable plugs for different countries. The 65-watt limit is enough for overnight charging a laptop and a couple of smartphones.
paras.zh: D-Link 65W 多端口 GaN 充电器 (DCP-651) 售价 30 美元：如果两个 USB-C 端口和一个 USB-A 端口足以满足您的旅行需求，那么这款经济实惠的 D-Link 充电器可能适合您。它配备了适用于不同国家/地区的可互换插头。 65 瓦的限制足以为一台笔记本电脑和几部智能手机过夜充电。

paras.en: Arsmel VisaPro All-in-One Travel Adapter for $80: This chunky power adapter can charge laptops or multiple small devices with a whopping 170-watt maximum output. It works with any outlet in the US, UK, or EU, thanks to sliding plugs that slot in securely, and you can spin the prongs on the US plug to support the total number of countries (more than 200). I love the mecha-inspired paint job, too. There are four ports along the bottom: two USB-C ports rated at 140 watts, with the third USB-C and USB-A ports rated at 18 watts. It supports PD 3.1, QC 3.0, PPS, FCP, and SCP, and has a 10-amp fuse.
paras.zh: Arsmel VisaPro 一体式旅行适配器售价 80 美元：这款厚重的电源适配器可以为笔记本电脑或多个小型设备充电，最大输出功率高达 170 瓦。它可与美国、英国或欧盟的任何插座配合使用，这要归功于可牢固插入的滑动插头，并且您可以旋转美国插头上的插脚以支持所有国家/地区（超过 200 个）。我也喜欢机甲风格的涂装工作。底部有四个端口：两个 USB-C 端口的额定功率为 140 瓦，第三个 USB-C 和 USB-A 端口的额定功率为 18 瓦。它支持 PD 3.1、QC 3.0、PPS、FCP 和 SCP，并配有 10 安培保险丝。

paras.en: Satechi GaN Travel Charger for $120: If you only take small gadgets with you when you travel, a compact, multi-port wall charger is all you need and a great way to pack light. It plugs directly into the wall and comes with four interchangeable travel adapters for the EU, UK, and Australia, plus a mesh bag to store them. There are four USB-C ports that you can plug your gadgets into, including laptops like the MacBook Pro, tablets, phones, and wearables. With support for Power Delivery 3.1, the first two ports can supply up to 140 watts, and the bottom two ports up to 45 watts. However, the maximum output when all four ports are in use is 145 watts.
paras.zh: Satechi GaN 旅行充电器，售价 120 美元：如果您在旅行时只携带小玩意儿，那么紧凑的多端口壁式充电器就可以满足您的需求，并且是轻装上阵的好方法。它可直接插入墙壁，并配有四个适用于欧盟、英国和澳大利亚的可互换旅行适配器，以及一个用于存放它们的网袋。有四个 USB-C 端口可供您插入小工具，包括 MacBook Pro 等笔记本电脑、平板电脑、手机和可穿戴设备。通过支持 Power Delivery 3.1，前两个端口可提供高达 140 瓦的功率，底部两个端口可提供高达 45 瓦的功率。然而，四个端口全部使用时的最大输出为 145 瓦。

paras.en: Baseus 70W Universal Travel Adapter With Retractable Cable for $40: This excellent travel adapter is almost identical to our top pick from Ceptics, offering up to 70 watts, sliding prongs to cover more than 200 countries, and a built-in retractable USB-C cable, not to mention a USB-C port and two USB-A ports. It also has a snazzy black-and-yellow finish. It only misses out because it’s slightly more expensive, but if you can snag one on sale or prefer the colors, it’s a solid option.
paras.zh: Baseus 70W 通用旅行适配器，带可伸缩电缆，售价 40 美元：这款出色的旅行适配器几乎与我们从 Ceptics 购买的首选产品相同，功率高达 70 瓦，滑动插脚可覆盖 200 多个国家，并内置可伸缩 USB-C 电缆，更不用说一个 USB-C 端口和两个 USB-A 端口。它还具有时髦的黑黄色饰面。它只是因为价格稍贵而错过了，但如果你能在打折时买到一件或者更喜欢颜色，那么它是一个不错的选择。

paras.en: Epicka Universal Travel Adapter for $20: This travel adapter from Epicka is still a solid option. The sliding plugs cover 150 countries, and there are four USB-A ports on the bottom and a 15-watt USB-C port on the side. There’s also an 8-amp fuse with a spare, and this adapter is RoHS-, CE-, and FCC-certified.
paras.zh: Epicka 通用旅行适配器，售价 20 美元：Epicka 的这款旅行适配器仍然是一个不错的选择。滑动插头覆盖150个国家，底部有四个USB-A端口，侧面有一个15瓦USB-C端口。还有一个带备用的 8 安培保险丝，并且该适配器已通过 RoHS、CE 和 FCC 认证。

paras.en: Masterplug Visitor to UK Travel Adapter (3 Pack) for £12: For visitors to the UK, this simple trio of adapters accepts European, American, Australian, and Asian plugs. They are single-outlet adapters with 13-amp fuses inside, and they work perfectly. These are the adapters I use for long-term testing of devices from the US and elsewhere that lack UK plugs. If you forgot to buy an adapter before arriving in the UK, you can find this affordable three-pack at any Argos store.
paras.zh: Masterplug 前往英国的游客旅行适配器（3 件装）售价 12 英镑：对于前往英国的游客来说，这款简单的三件套适配器可接受欧洲、美国、澳大利亚和亚洲插头。它们是单插座适配器，内部带有 13 安培保险丝，并且工作完美。这些是我用来对来自美国和其他地区缺乏英国插头的设备进行长期测试的适配器。如果您在抵达英国之前忘记购买适配器，您可以在任何 Argos 商店找到这款价格实惠的三件装适配器。

paras.en: Anker European Travel Plug Adapter for $16: One of our favorite portable charger brands, Anker, also makes travel adapters. This one plugs into most European outlets to provide a single grounded US outlet, a USB-A port, and two USB-C ports. Unfortunately, the three USB ports max out at 15 watts total, so it’s best for overnight gadget charging, but I appreciate the temperature and overload protection. There is also a UK version ($16).
paras.zh: Anker 欧洲旅行插头适配器售价 16 美元：Anker 是我们最喜欢的便携式充电器品牌之一，也生产旅行适配器。该插座可插入大多数欧洲插座，提供一个接地的美国插座、一个 USB-A 端口和两个 USB-C 端口。不幸的是，三个 USB 端口的最大总功率为 15 瓦，因此最适合夜间小工具充电，但我很欣赏它的温度和过载保护功能。还有英国版（16 美元）。

paras.en: Epicka Hybrid European Travel Plug Adapter for $26: This handy adapter turns one outlet into four and includes four USB ports (two A and two C). It has fold-out Type A prongs, but you can also slide on a fold-out Type C plug for use in Europe. While the USB ports support QC 3.0 or PD 3.0, they max out at 20 watts in total. I prefer the OneBeat adapters recommended above.
paras.zh: Epicka 混合欧洲旅行插头适配器售价 26 美元：这款方便的适配器可将一个插座变成四个插座，并包括四个 USB 端口（两个 A 和两个 C）。它具有折叠式 A 型插脚，但您也可以滑入折叠式 C 型插头以在欧洲使用。虽然 USB 端口支持 QC 3.0 或 PD 3.0，但它们的最大总功率为 20 瓦。我更喜欢上面推荐的 OneBeat 适配器。

paras.en: You can do better than these travel adapters.
paras.zh: 您可以比这些旅行适配器做得更好。

paras.en: EZQuest WorldTravel GaN 5 Port With PD Wall Charger: This travel adapter has a generous four USB-C ports and one USB-A port with a familiar slide-out prong design that covers more than 150 countries. There’s also a built-in 10-amp fuse and a spare. It has RoHS, CE, and FCC certification. It works fine, but it's kinda boxy, and the sliders don't lock in place as securely as some of our other picks. There's also a 65W version ($60).
paras.zh: 带 PD 壁式充电器的 EZQuest WorldTravel GaN 5 端口：这款旅行适配器具有宽敞的 4 个 USB-C 端口和 1 个 USB-A 端口，采用熟悉的滑出式插脚设计，覆盖 150 多个国家/地区。还有一个内置 10 安培保险丝和一个备用保险丝。它具有 RoHS、CE 和 FCC 认证。它工作得很好，但有点四四方方，而且滑块不像我们的其他一些镐那样牢固地锁定到位。还有 65W 版本（60 美元）。

paras.en: Rolling Square Pocket Travel Adapter: I admire any attempt to shrink down travel adapters in size, but the three-pronged UK plugs are usually the obstacle. Rolling Square’s solution is to have a flip-out third prong, but you’ll need a good fingernail to unhitch it. This charger has a single USB-C port capable of delivering up to 30 watts and is a compact option that covers the US, UK, and Europe.
paras.zh: 滚动方形袖珍旅行适配器：我钦佩任何缩小旅行适配器尺寸的尝试，但英国三孔插头通常是障碍。 Rolling Square 的解决方案是使用一个可翻转的第三个插脚，但你需要一个好的指甲才能将其解开。该充电器具有单个 USB-C 端口，能够提供高达 30 瓦的功率，是一款覆盖美国、英国和欧洲的紧凑型选择。

paras.en: Ceptics 65W World Travel Adapter: This versatile adapter comes with Type A, B, C, E/F, G, and I slide-on plugs. They fit onto the rectangular brick and plug directly into the outlet, or you can attach them to the optional five-foot cable. The brick has one grounded US outlet and a second non-grounded outlet, with one USB-A (30-watt) and two USB-C (65- and 33-watt) ports at the other end. It works fine, and it's affordable, but it's bulky and ugly.
paras.zh: Ceptics 65W 世界旅行适配器：这款多功能适配器配有 A、B、C、E/F、G 和 I 型滑入式插头。它们安装在矩形砖上并直接插入插座，或者您可以将它们连接到可选的五英尺电缆。该砖有一个接地的美国插座和第二个非接地插座，另一端有一个 USB-A（30 瓦）和两个 USB-C（65 瓦和 33 瓦）端口。它工作得很好，而且价格实惠，但它又笨重又丑陋。

articles.title: Here’s Where to Watch the Miami Dolphins vs. Buffalo Bills Game Live Online
articles.author: Rudie Obias

paras.en: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.
paras.zh: 所有特色产品和服务均由编辑独立选择。然而，Billboard 可能会收到通过其零售链接下的订单的佣金，并且零售商可能会收到某些用于会计目的的可审计数据。

paras.en: For NFL week 11, two AFC East teams battle each other to see which team is going to dominate the game. Plus, there might be one or two celebrity sightings during the game.
paras.zh: NFL 第 11 周，两支 AFC 东区球队将互相较量，看看哪支球队将主导比赛。另外，比赛期间可能会出现一两个名人。

paras.en: How to Watch Miami Dolphins vs. Buffalo Bills Live Online, at a Glance:
paras.zh: 如何在线观看迈阿密海豚队对阵布法罗比尔队的比赛直播：

paras.en: - Matchup: Miami Dolphins vs. Buffalo Bills
paras.zh: - 比赛：迈阿密海豚队 vs 布法罗比尔队

paras.en: - Online Streaming: DirecTV, Fubo, Hulu + Live TV, Paramount+
paras.zh: - 在线流媒体：DirecTV、Fubo、Hulu + 直播电视、派拉蒙+

paras.en: When Does Miami Dolphins vs. Buffalo Bills Start?
paras.zh: 迈阿密海豚队对阵布法罗比尔队什么时候开始？

paras.en: The NFL game takes place on Sunday (Nov. 22) with the Miami Dolphins (1-8) taking on the Buffalo Bills (8-1) at Highmark Stadium in Orchard Park, New York. Kickoff is at 1 p.m. ET/10 a.m. PT.
paras.zh: NFL 比赛将于周日（11 月 22 日）在纽约果园公园的海马克体育场举行，迈阿密海豚队 (1-8) 迎战布法罗比尔队 (8-1)。开球时间为下午 1 点。美国东部时间/太平洋时间上午 10 点

paras.en: What TV Network Features Miami Dolphins vs. Buffalo Bills?
paras.zh: 哪个电视网络播出迈阿密海豚队对阵布法罗比尔队的比赛？

paras.en: In 2026, the Dolphins-Bills game broadcasts on TV on CBS, while the game livestreams on Paramount+.
paras.zh: 2026 年，海豚队与比尔队的比赛在 CBS 电视上转播，而比赛则在 Paramount+ 上进行直播。

paras.en: Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances Miami Dolphins vs. Buffalo Bills?
paras.zh: 哪些名人出现在迈阿密海豚队对阵布法罗比尔队的比赛中？

paras.en: The NFL is known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance during the game. Artists who have been known to appear at games in the past include Buffalo Bills fans Hailee Steinfeld (QB Josh Allen’s wife), Benny the Butcher, Westside Gunn and others.
paras.zh: NFL 以名人出镜而闻名，因此比赛期间可能会有许多著名演员和唱片艺术家到场观看。过去曾出现在比赛中的艺术家包括布法罗比尔队球迷海莉·斯坦菲尔德（四分卫乔什·艾伦的妻子）、屠夫本尼、韦斯特赛德·冈恩等。

paras.en: Where to Watch Miami Dolphins vs. Buffalo Bills Online for Free
paras.zh: 哪里可以免费在线观看迈阿密海豚队对阵布法罗比尔队的比赛

paras.en: For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch the NFL game if you don’t have cable, especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial, while other streaming services also offer free trials, so you can watch the game for free.
paras.zh: 对于掐线者来说，如果您没有有线电视，有几种方法可以观看 NFL 比赛，特别是如果您想免费观看的话。 DirecTV 有五天的免费试用期，而其他流媒体服务也提供免费试用，因此您可以免费观看比赛。

paras.en: Paramount+ has the Dolphins-Bills game on CBS streaming online (for those who live in the metro Miami and Buffalo areas), as well as past seasons. If you don’t already have a Paramount+ subscription, the streaming service plan goes for $8.99 per month (or $89.99 per year). With Paramount+, you’ll get access to a wide selection of TV shows and movies, live sports, 24-hour news with CBS News and more.
paras.zh: Paramount+ 在哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 上在线直播海豚队与比尔队的比赛（适用于居住在迈阿密都会区和布法罗地区的人们）以及过去的赛季。如果您还没有订阅 Paramount+，流媒体服务计划的价格为每月 8.99 美元（或每年 89.99 美元）。通过 Paramount+，您可以观看各种电视节目和电影、体育直播、CBS 新闻的 24 小时新闻等等。

paras.en: Broadcast network CBS is available to watch with Hulu + Live TV. Prices for the cable alternative start at $99.99 per month for more than 100 live channels, while each plan comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Select at no additional cost. Hulu + Live TV might be best for those who want all of these streaming services together in one package.
paras.zh: 广播网络 CBS 可通过 Hulu + Live TV 观看。有线替代方案的起价为每月 99.99 美元，可观看 100 多个直播频道，而每个套餐都附带 Hulu、Disney+ 和 ESPN Select，无需额外付费。对于那些希望将所有这些流媒体服务集中在一个包中的人来说，Hulu + 直播电视可能是最好的选择。

paras.en: On Sunday (Nov. 22), the Dolphins-Bills game broadcasts live on CBS. One of the best ways to watch live is with Paramount+.
paras.zh: 周日（11 月 22 日），哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 直播海豚队与比尔队的比赛。观看现场直播的最佳方式之一是使用 Paramount+。

articles.title: Selena Gomez Helps Couple With Baby’s Sex Reveal at Spurs Game, ‘With No Hesitation’
articles.author: Ashley Iasimone

paras.en: Selena Gomez happily announced whether a boy or girl is to be expected for a pregnant fan she ran into at the Spurs-Pelicans basketball game this weekend in San Antonio.
paras.zh: 赛琳娜·戈麦斯 (Selena Gomez) 高兴地宣布，她本周末在圣安东尼奥举行的马刺队与鹈鹕队的篮球比赛中遇到了一名怀孕的球迷，她的孩子是男孩还是女孩。

paras.en: A short video of the precious moment from Saturday night’s (Nov. 21) NBA match between San Antonio and New Orleans started popping up across social media on Sunday. Filmed at the Texas city’s Frost Bank Center, the footage was originally posted online by the expectant couple around midnight local time. The clip shows Gomez opening a sealed envelope containing the big reveal.
paras.zh: 周日晚上（11 月 21 日）NBA 圣安东尼奥队和新奥尔良队之间的 NBA 比赛的珍贵时刻的短视频开始在社交媒体上出现。这段视频是在德克萨斯州弗罗斯特银行中心拍摄的，最初是这对准夫妇在当地时间午夜左右在网上发布的。这段视频显示戈麦斯打开了一个密封的信封，里面有一个大的秘密。

paras.en: Carefully scanning over the paper that listed the sex assigned to the baby, a smiling Gomez slowly said, “You’re … How do I know? … FEMALE!” Then she gave the mom and dad a big hug.
paras.zh: 戈麦斯仔细地浏览着列出婴儿性别的纸，微笑着缓缓说道：“你……我怎么知道？……女！”然后她给了爸爸妈妈一个大大的拥抱。

paras.en: “I cannot put into words just how special this night was!” wrote game attendee/mom @laurenicoleramz on Instagram. “We are expecting baby #4 so soon, already starting the third trimester & planning to wait until birth for our last to find out our gender. We decided to bring our envelope in case we could get someone to open it for us, & the sweetest @selenagomez did that with no hesitation!!”
paras.zh: “我无法用语言形容这个夜晚有多么特别！”比赛参加者/妈妈@laurenicoleramz 在 Instagram 上写道。 “我们很快就要迎来第四个宝宝了，已经开始了第三个三个月，并计划等到最后一个宝宝出生时才知道我们的性别。我们决定带上信封，以防有人帮我们打开，最可爱的@selenagomez 毫不犹豫地这么做了！！”

paras.en: Captioning the snapshot and personal video clip with Gomez (seen here), she shared: “She was so sweet & it felt so natural just to talk to her because of her gentle & kind personality. Thank you @selenagomez & @spurs for making this a night to remember!! Swipe to see/hear what baby #4 is!! So thankful to God for this sweet baby that will complete our family!!”
paras.zh: 她在与戈麦斯的快照和个人视频剪辑的字幕（见此处）中分享道：“她很可爱，因为她温柔善良的性格，与她交谈感觉很自然。谢谢@selenagomez 和 @spurs 让这个夜晚成为难忘的夜晚！滑动即可看到/听到#4 宝宝是什么！！非常感谢上帝赐予这个可爱的宝宝，让我们的家庭更加完整！！”

paras.en: Gomez also posed for a picture during their meeting, resting her hand on the mama’s belly.
paras.zh: 戈麦斯还在会面期间摆好姿势拍了一张照片，把手放在妈妈的肚子上。

paras.en: The star appeared to be in good spirits at the game, where she was also gifted a jersey by the San Antonio Spurs Coyote, the team’s official mascot.
paras.zh: 这位球星在比赛中看起来精神状态很好，她还收到了圣安东尼奥马刺队官方吉祥物狼队赠送的一件球衣。

paras.en: The Spurs defeated the Pelicans 114-91. When Spurs forward Victor Wembanyama was asked about Gomez’s appearance watching the game Saturday night, he quipped, “I had to show off for Selena, you know.”
paras.zh: 马刺队以114-91击败鹈鹕队。当热刺前锋维克多·温班亚马被问及戈麦斯周六晚上观看比赛的表现时，他打趣道：“你知道，我不得不为赛琳娜炫耀。”

paras.en: Gomez’s new trailer for season six of Only Murders in the Building — this season with an Only Murders in London theme — co-starring Steve Martin and Martin Short, arrived last week. The hit Hulu crime comedy returns with its season premiere on Dec. 8.
paras.zh: 戈麦斯的《大楼谋杀案》第六季的新预告片于上周发布，本季以伦敦谋杀案为主题，由史蒂夫·马丁和马丁·肖特联合主演。这部热门 Hulu 犯罪喜剧将于 12 月 8 日回归，并进行季首播。

articles.title: Miley Cyrus & Maxx Morando’s Wedding Photos Are Here
articles.author: Ashley Iasimone

paras.en: Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando’s wedding pictures are here. The bride and groom shared the first official look at their marriage ceremony on Sunday, the day after their intimate Saturday (Nov. 21) event in Palm Springs, Calif.
paras.zh: 麦莉·赛勒斯 (Miley Cyrus) 和 Maxx Morando 的结婚照在这里。周日，也就是周六（11 月 21 日）在加利福尼亚州棕榈泉举行亲密活动的第二天，新娘和新郎在婚礼上首次正式亮相。

paras.en: Cyrus posted four wedding photos on Instagram along with the caption “M + M 11.21.26” surrounding a white heart emoji. Photographer Jose Villa was credited for the images.
paras.zh: 赛勒斯在 Instagram 上发布了四张结婚照，并附有标题“M + M 11.21.26”，周围是一个白色的心形表情符号。摄影师何塞·维拉 (Jose Villa) 拍摄了这些照片。

paras.en: The newlyweds’ portraits are in black and white, matching the timeless elegance of Cyrus’ long-sleeved, silk Saint Laurent gown with a train and Morando’s classic black tux — which he accessorized with his signature dark shades. The couple are seen embracing in the romantic shots, and in one photo they’re joined by a presumed member of the family: a sweet dog lying comfortably at their feet.
paras.zh: 这对新婚夫妇的肖像画是黑白的，与赛勒斯长袖真丝圣罗兰拖裾礼服和莫兰多经典黑色晚礼服的永恒优雅相匹配——他用他标志性的深色色调装饰了礼服。在浪漫的照片中，这对夫妇拥抱在一起，在一张照片中，一位被认为是家庭成员的人也加入了他们的行列：一只可爱的狗舒服地躺在他们的脚边。

paras.en: Paparazzi footage of Cyrus, 33, and Morando, 28, getting married poolside, at a former residence of Frank Sinatra — that captured an apparently emotional Cyrus wiping away tears as she and her soon-to-be husband stood in front of their loved ones to say “I do” — made it online Saturday night.
paras.zh: 狗仔队拍摄的 33 岁的赛勒斯和 28 岁的莫兰多在弗兰克·辛纳屈 (Frank Sinatra) 故居的池畔举行婚礼的镜头在周六晚上在网上流传，视频中赛勒斯显然很激动，她擦着眼泪，和她即将成为丈夫的人站在他们所爱的人面前说“我愿意”。

paras.en: Other family members from the Cyrus family spotted at the wedding were Miley’s dad, Billy Ray with partner Elizabeth Hurley; her mom, Tish, with husband Dominic Purcell, and her sister Noah.
paras.zh: 出现在婚礼上的赛勒斯家族的其他家庭成员包括麦莉的父亲比利·雷和伴侣伊丽莎白·赫尔利；她的妈妈蒂什（Tish）和丈夫多米尼克·珀塞尔（Dominic Purcell）以及她的妹妹诺亚（Noah）。

paras.en: Flaming Lips frontman Wayne Coyne, a longtime collaborator and friend of Cyrus, reportedly served as officiant at the ceremony.
paras.zh: 据报道，Flaming Lips 主唱 Wayne Coyne 是 Cyrus 的长期合作者和朋友，他担任了仪式的司仪。

paras.en: Cyrus’ wedding dress was designed by Anthony Vaccarello for Saint Laurent; Morando also wore Saint Laurent.
paras.zh: Cyrus 的婚纱是由 Anthony Vaccarello 为 Saint Laurent 设计的； Morando也穿过Saint Laurent。

paras.en: Cyrus was first linked to Morando, who’s the drummer for Los Angeles rock band Liily, in 2021. He co-starred in the music video for Miley’s “Let’s Get Married,” a single from the star’s latest No. 1, her Billboard 200 chart-topping 2026 album Bass Persuades.
paras.zh: 赛勒斯于 2021 年首次与莫兰多联系在一起，莫兰多是洛杉矶摇滚乐队 Liily 的鼓手。他与麦莉共同主演了《Let’s Get Married》的音乐视频，这首单曲出自麦莉最新的排名第一、她在 2026 年公告牌 200 强排行榜上的专辑《Bass Persuades》中。

paras.en: See Miley and Maxx’s wedding photos by Jose Villa on Instragram here.
paras.zh: 在这里查看 Jose Villa 在 Instagram 上拍摄的 Miley 和 Maxx 的结婚照。

articles.title: Tom Jackson, Denver Broncos’ All-Pro Linebacker and ESPN Analyst, Dies at 75
articles.author: Mike Barnes

paras.en: Tom Jackson, who parlayed a 14-season stint as a stalwart linebacker on the Denver Broncos’ famed “Orange Crush” defense into a long career as a popular football analyst on ESPN, has died. He was 75.
paras.zh: 汤姆·杰克逊 (Tom Jackson) 去世了，他在丹佛野马队 (Denver Broncos) 著名的“橙色粉碎”防守中担任了 14 个赛季的坚定线卫，并在 ESPN 上担任受欢迎的足球分析师，度过了漫长的职业生涯。他75岁了。

paras.en: Jackson died Friday, his family told the network. No cause was announced.
paras.zh: 杰克逊的家人告诉网络，杰克逊于周五去世。没有公布原因。

paras.en: Jackson was best known for his work alongside Chris Berman on the ESPN shows NFL Primetime and Sunday NFL Countdown, where the pair would deliver their humorous, entertaining take on highlights from games.
paras.zh: 杰克逊因与克里斯·伯曼一起在 ESPN 节目《NFL 黄金时段》和《周日 NFL 倒计时》中合作而闻名，两人将在节目中以幽默、有趣的方式讲述比赛的精彩片段。

paras.en: “All of us are stunned,” Berman said in a statement. “I’m stunned, we’re stunned and you’re stunned. We’ve lost one of the best human beings ever to walk the planet, Tom Jackson. I was fortunate to work side by side with Tom for 30 years … It was a labor of love for our whole team, both in front of the camera and behind it. We always hoped our viewers enjoyed the shows as much as we did bringing it to them every week.”
paras.zh: “我们所有人都惊呆了，”伯曼在一份声明中说。 “我很震惊，我们很震惊，你也很震惊。我们失去了这个星球上最优秀的人之一，汤姆·杰克逊。我很幸运能与汤姆并肩工作 30 年……这是我们整个团队的爱的劳动，无论是在镜头前还是在镜头后。我们一直希望我们的观众能够像我们每周为他们带来的节目一样喜欢这些节目。”
