articles.title: Trump calling Putin ‘my friend’ at APEC summit sparks backlash
articles.author: Abigail Williams

paras.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine, is wanted by the International Criminal Court on allegations of war crimes, and is accused of overseeing a yearslong campaign of election interference, sabotage and cyberattacks against the West.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京对乌克兰发动了全面入侵，因涉嫌战争罪而被国际刑事法院通缉，并被指控监督了长达数年的针对西方的选举干预、破坏和网络攻击活动。

paras.en: So when President Donald Trump pointed to the Russian leader and declared, “He’s my friend,” at the historic Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in China on Thursday, the reaction from some of America’s closest European allies was one of alarm and disbelief.
paras.zh: 因此，当唐纳德·特朗普总统周四在中国举行的历史性亚太经济合作峰会上指着俄罗斯领导人并宣称“他是我的朋友”时，美国一些最亲密的欧洲盟友的反应是震惊和难以置信。

paras.en: “God, protect us from such friends,” Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk posted to X shortly afterward.
paras.zh: “上帝，请保护我们免受这些朋友的伤害，”波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克不久后在 X 上发帖说。

paras.en: “The optics of embracing Putin and calling him a friend cause us some concern,” Poland’s foreign minister, Radosław Sikorski, told a news conference Thursday. He added that it posed the question of whom Trump considered a closer friend, Putin or Poland, and “if push came to shove, which friend would he choose?”
paras.zh: 波兰外交部长拉多斯瓦夫·西科尔斯基在周四的新闻发布会上表示：“拥抱普京并称他为朋友的做法引起了我们的一些担忧。”他补充说，这提出了特朗普认为谁是更亲密的朋友，普京还是波兰的问题，“如果到了紧要关头，他会选择哪个朋友？”

paras.en: Their comments came hours before Poland’s defense minister, Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz, accused Russia of violating the country’s airspace overnight with three objects that were probably two missiles and a drone. Elsewhere, Estonia said it would close its road border crossings with Russia on security grounds for at least six months.
paras.zh: 在他们发表上述言论的几个小时前，波兰国防部长瓦迪斯瓦夫·科西尼亚克-卡梅什指责俄罗斯在一夜之间用三件物体（可能是两枚导弹和一架无人机）侵犯了该国领空。在其他地方，爱沙尼亚表示，出于安全原因，它将关闭与俄罗斯的公路过境点至少六个月。

paras.en: Much of the criticism of Trump’s remark has come from Poland, historically one of Washington’s closest allies in Europe but whose officials have grown increasingly wary of Trump’s dealings with Russia. The country, which borders Ukraine, Russia and Moscow’s close ally Belarus, has long been among the most outspoken European governments warning about the threat of Russian aggression. Its security strategy also relies heavily on the United States and NATO.
paras.zh: 对特朗普言论的大部分批评来自波兰，该国历史上是华盛顿在欧洲最亲密的盟友之一，但其官员对特朗普与俄罗斯的交往越来越警惕。该国与乌克兰、俄罗斯和莫斯科的亲密盟友白俄罗斯接壤，长期以来一直是对俄罗斯侵略威胁发出最直言不讳的欧洲政府之一。其安全战略也严重依赖美国和北约。

paras.en: More broadly, the word “friend” also caused fresh alarm among other European governments, some of which are openly warning that Putin may expand his aggression beyond Ukraine and attack them, too.
paras.zh: 更广泛地说，“朋友”一词也引起了其他欧洲国家政府的新警觉，其中一些国家公开警告普京可能会将其侵略扩大到乌克兰以外并攻击他们。

paras.en: Ultimately, there is widespread concern that elevating Putin alongside Trump and China’s Xi Jinping will legitimize and embolden a leader whom Western governments have sought to isolate over his record of grave human rights abuses and aggression against other countries, allegations he has routinely denied.
paras.zh: 最终，人们普遍担心，让普京与特朗普和中国国家主席习近平一起提拔，将使这位领导人合法化并更加大胆。西方国家政府一直试图孤立这位领导人，因为他有严重侵犯人权和侵略其他国家的记录，而他经常否认这些指控。

paras.en: The joint declaration made by Trump, Putin and Xi after their meeting made no mention of Ukraine but condemned the International Criminal Court, which has issued a warrant for Putin’s arrest over the alleged unlawful deportation of Ukrainian children to Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普、普京和习近平会晤后发表的联合声明没有提及乌克兰，但谴责了国际刑事法院，该法院因涉嫌非法将乌克兰儿童驱逐到俄罗斯而对普京发出逮捕令。

paras.en: Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen said it was “very incomprehensible” that Trump would meet with Putin, while German Chancellor Friedrich Merz was among those who warned against the meeting becoming a rerun of the Yalta Conference of 1945. The summit toward the end of World War II saw President Franklin D. Roosevelt, British Prime Minister Winston Churchill and Soviet leader Joseph Stalin effectively carve up occupied Germany and other parts of Europe.
paras.zh: 丹麦首相梅特·弗雷德里克森表示，特朗普会见普京“非常难以理解”，而德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨等人也警告这次会议不要成为 1945 年雅尔塔会议的重演。在二战即将结束时的峰会上，美国总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福、英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔和苏联领导人约瑟夫·斯大林实际上瓜分了被占领的德国和欧洲其他地区。

paras.en: Others, including British Prime Minister Andy Burnham, were more restrained. Asked whether Trump had “fallen for Putin’s charm offensive,” he replied that it was “quite the opposite” and that Trump had “talked about the horrific loss of life, including the loss of young Russian lives, and he spoke quite passionately about that subject.”
paras.zh: 其他人，包括英国首相安迪·伯纳姆，则更加克制。当被问及特朗普是否“被普京的魅力攻势所迷惑”时，他回答说，情况“恰恰相反”，特朗普“谈到了可怕的生命损失，包括俄罗斯年轻人的生命损失，他非常热情地谈论了这个话题。”

paras.en: NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte also defended the principle of nuclear powers meeting to pursue diplomacy.
paras.zh: 北约秘书长马克·吕特也捍卫了核大国会议寻求外交的原则。

paras.en: Burnham and Rutte were speaking at a meeting in Berlin of the “Coalition of the Willing,” a group of nearly 40 countries working to support Ukraine and provide security guarantees.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆和吕特在柏林举行的“意愿联盟”会议上发表讲话，该联盟由近 40 个国家组成，致力于支持乌克兰并提供安全保障。

paras.en: They were joined by Steve Witkoff and Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner, the U.S. envoys tasked with brokering peace between Moscow and Kyiv.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·威特科夫（Steve Witkoff）和特朗普的女婿贾里德·库什纳（Jared Kushner）也加入了他们的行列，他们都是负责促成莫斯科和基辅之间和平的美国特使。

paras.en: Trump called into a meeting of dozens of European leaders and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Thursday, telling the group that Putin was ready to end the war, according to five European officials briefed on the discussions. He also encouraged the Europeans to make a deal so they can stop spending money on Ukraine and spend it on their own countries, the officials said.
paras.zh: 据了解讨论情况的五名欧洲官员透露，特朗普周四召集了数十名欧洲领导人和乌克兰总统泽连斯基举行会议，告诉与会者普京已准备好结束战争。官员们表示，他还鼓励欧洲人达成协议，这样他们就可以停止在乌克兰上花钱，而把钱花在自己的国家上。

paras.en: Kushner also mentioned the call in a post on X but said it was up to the president to reveal what he said.
paras.zh: 库什纳还在X上的一篇帖子中提到了这次通话，但表示是否透露通话内容由总统决定。

paras.en: “Trump wants to make a deal with Europe by his side. He’s not looking to impose anything unilaterally,” Kushner said. “Any deal we do will be in close consultation with Ukraine and with Europe. That’s something that he also asked us to come here today and reassure people in that regard.”
paras.zh: “特朗普希望与欧洲达成协议。他不打算单方面强加任何东西，”库什纳说。 “我们达成的任何协议都将与乌克兰和欧洲密切协商。他还要求我们今天来到这里，在这方面让人们放心。”

paras.en: The White House did not immediately respond to an overnight request for comment on the criticisms about Trump’s comment about Putin. But Trump defended his description of the Russian president in an interview with Reuters, saying that “it’s nice to have people that have 4,000 nuclear weapons as a friend as opposed to an enemy.”
paras.zh: 白宫没有立即回应隔夜就特朗普对普京评论的批评请求发表评论。但特朗普在接受路透社采访时为自己对俄罗斯总统的描述进行了辩护，称“与拥有 4000 枚核武器的人成为朋友而不是敌人真是太好了。”

paras.en: This is far from the first time Trump has spoken warmly about Putin, joking in 2013 about becoming his “new best friend.” Once in office, Trump said in 2018 that the pair “got on very well,” and in 2022, he described Putin’s initial moves against Ukraine as “genius” and “savvy.” In 2023 and again in 2024, Trump recounted telling Putin, “We’re friends.”
paras.zh: 这远非特朗普第一次热情谈论普京，2013 年他还开玩笑说要成为他的“新最好的朋友”。特朗普在 2018 年上任后表示，两人“相处得很好”，2022 年，他将普京针对乌克兰的最初举措描述为“天才”和“精明”。特朗普在 2023 年和 2024 年两次对普京说：“我们是朋友。”

paras.en: However, this week was the first time Trump made the declaration to Putin’s face, in front of television cameras at one of the most hotly anticipated meetings of recent years.
paras.zh: 然而，本周是特朗普首次在电视摄像机前当着普京的面做出这一声明，这是近年来最受期待的会议之一。

paras.en: “It’s one thing to say in an interview, ‘We get on,’ as Trump has in the past; it’s quite another to see him crossing a room in the hotel in China with an effusive smile on his face and gushing about ‘my friend,’” said Jonathan Eyal, international director of the Royal United Services Institute, a London-based think tank. “It all felt very natural and very real.”
paras.zh: 伦敦智库皇家联合三军研究所国际主任乔纳森·埃亚尔表示：“像特朗普过去那样，在接受采访时说‘我们相处融洽’是一回事；而看到他满脸热情地微笑着穿过中国酒店的一个房间，滔滔不绝地谈论‘我的朋友’，那就完全是另一回事了。” “这一切感觉非常自然、非常真实。”

paras.en: Mara Karlin, who was assistant secretary of defense for strategy, plans and capabilities under President Joe Biden, told NBC News that while Trump’s past actions on Greenland and Ukraine have provoked outcry, “referring to Putin as a ‘friend’ seems to evoke a visceral reaction because it is both entirely believable and inconceivable for any other American president to embrace a Russian leader so literally.”
paras.zh: 乔·拜登总统领导下负责战略、计划和能力的助理国防部长玛拉·卡林告诉美国全国广播公司新闻，虽然特朗普过去在格陵兰岛和乌克兰问题上的行动引起了强烈抗议，但“将普京称为‘朋友’似乎会引起内心的反应，因为任何其他美国总统如此真实地拥抱俄罗斯领导人都是完全可信的，也是不可思议的。”

paras.en: The condemnation was not confined to one side of the Atlantic.
paras.zh: 谴责并不局限于大西洋的一侧。

paras.en: In the United States, Democrats were openly scathing. Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer of New York called Trump’s words “embarrassing, despicable, and quite frankly pathetic,” while Sen. Jeanne Shaheen of New Hampshire, the top Democrat on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, described Trump’s “friend” as a “murderous war criminal.”
paras.zh: 在美国，民主党人公开严厉批评。纽约州参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默称特朗普的言论“令人尴尬、卑鄙，而且坦率地说是可悲的”，而参议院外交关系委员会民主党领袖、新罕布什尔州参议员珍妮·沙欣则将特朗普的“朋友”描述为“凶残的战犯”。

paras.en: Sen. Mark Kelly of Arizona said: “Putin is not my friend. He’s not your friend. He’s not a friend of this country, and when the president of the United States refers to him in that way, it emboldens him.”
paras.zh: 亚利桑那州参议员马克·凯利说：“普京不是我的朋友。他不是你的朋友。他不是这个国家的朋友，当美国总统这样提到他时，这让他更加大胆。”

paras.en: Republicans were more circumspect. Sen. Rick Scott of Florida called Putin a “thug” but acknowledged that Trump needed to work with him.
paras.zh: 共和党人则更加谨慎。佛罗里达州参议员里克·斯科特称普京为“暴徒”，但承认特朗普需要与他合作。

paras.en: Bill Browder, a British American financier who spearheaded the international campaign for Russian sanctions and has become one of Putin’s most prominent critics, also described his “revulsion and disgust” at hearing Trump’s words.
paras.zh: 英裔美国金融家比尔·布劳德(Bill Browder)是国际社会制裁俄罗斯运动的带头人，也是普京最著名的批评者之一，他也描述了他听到特朗普言论后的“反感和厌恶”。

paras.en: “He’s a guy who’s a geopolitical menace, and he should not get any kind of respect, let alone from the American head of state,” Browder told NBC News in a telephone interview. “To be elevated to the top table with genuine superpowers is an unbelievable symbolic position to sit in.”
paras.zh: 布劳德在接受 NBC 新闻电话采访时表示：“他是一个地缘政治威胁，他不应该得到任何形式的尊重，更不用说来自美国国家元首的尊重了。” “凭借真正的超能力登上最高席位是一个令人难以置信的象征性地位。”

paras.en: When asked about Trump’s comment at the end of the news conference following the “Coalition of the Willing” meeting in the German capital, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy only shrugged and walked offstage.
paras.zh: 在德国首都“意愿联盟”会议结束后的新闻发布会上，当被问及特朗普的评论时，乌克兰总统泽连斯基只是耸耸肩，走下台。

articles.title: COP31 climate talks break down after angry dispute over fossil fuels
articles.author: Freddie Clayton

paras.en: International climate talks in Turkey broke down Sunday after the European Union and other nations rejected a draft agreement that had cut all references to fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 周日在土耳其举行的国际气候谈判破裂，此前欧盟和其他国家拒绝了一项削减所有化石燃料提及的协议草案。

paras.en: Negotiations in the Mediterranean resort city of Antalya fell apart two days after the United Nations’ COP31 conference was meant to end, after delegates from 196 countries and the European Union struggled to agree on new pledges for climate action and how to deliver on previous promises.
paras.zh: 联合国 COP31 会议原定结束两天后，地中海度假城市安塔利亚的谈判破裂，来自 196 个国家和欧盟的代表难以就气候行动的新承诺以及如何兑现之前的承诺达成一致。

paras.en: COP31 President Murat Kurum said Sunday that there would be no new climate agreement draft after a fourth draft was rejected.
paras.zh: COP31主席穆拉特·库鲁姆周日表示，在第四份草案被拒绝后，不会再有新的气候协议草案。

paras.en: “There is nothing to do. We did all that we could,” said Kurum, who is host nation Turkey’s environment minister. “We will not be carrying out work on a new text in an environment where there is no consensus.”
paras.zh: “无事可做。我们已尽力而为，”东道国土耳其环境部长库鲁姆说。 “我们不会在没有达成共识的环境中开展新案文的工作。”

paras.en: He later added that he had wanted a a “much stronger outcome” from the summit.
paras.zh: 他后来补充说，他希望峰会取得“更强有力的成果”。

paras.en: Chris Bowen, COP31’s president of negotiations, told reporters that there were “unbridgeable red lines” in the discussions.
paras.zh: COP31 谈判主席克里斯·鲍文 (Chris Bowen) 告诉记者，讨论中存在“不可逾越的红线”。

paras.en: “The situation coming into this COP was the most complicated and fraught geopolitical environment in living memory,” the Australian minister said. “Things that were manageable in the past, in previous COPs like the last two where people wanted certain words mentioned but didn’t get them, it became a red line this time,” Bowen added.
paras.zh: “本届缔约方大会召开之际，地缘政治环境之复杂和紧张程度堪称有史以来之最。”这位澳大利亚部长表示。“过去在历届缔约方大会上，包括最近两届，有些事情是可以处理的，比如人们希望提及某些措辞，但没有如愿，而这一次，这些事情就成了红线。”鲍恩补充道。

paras.en: The latest draft agreement, released on Sunday, had set out proposed measures for countries to accelerate climate action, but the 12-page document drew immediate criticism over its failure to mention a move away from fossil fuels, a key demand of the E.U. and other nations.
paras.zh: 周日发布的最新协议草案提出了各国加速气候行动的拟议措施，但这份长达 12 页的文件立即招致批评，因为它没有提及摆脱化石燃料，而这是欧盟的一项关键要求。和其他国家。

paras.en: Irish minister Darragh O’Brien, representing the E.U. in Antalya, said the bloc “strongly objects” to the deal, which he called “greenwashing.”
paras.zh: 代表欧盟的爱尔兰部长达拉·奥布莱恩 (Darragh O’Brien)在安塔利亚，欧盟“强烈反对”这项交易，他称之为“绿色清洗”。

paras.en: “These decisions go nowhere near the level of ambition needed to tackle climate change,” O’Brien said. “It is unconscionable that we would have a climate pact that makes no mention of fossil fuels.”
paras.zh: “这些决定远未达到应对气候变化所需的雄心水平，”奥布莱恩说。 “我们制定的气候协议中没有提及化石燃料，这是不合理的。”

paras.en: Panama also rejected the deal, saying it didn’t go far enough, as did the Marshall Islands, a low-lying Pacific nation that faces an existential threat from sea-level rise.
paras.zh: 巴拿马也拒绝了这项协议，称其力度还不够，马绍尔群岛也是如此，马绍尔群岛是一个地势低洼的太平洋国家，面临海平面上升的生存威胁。

paras.en: Kate Hughes, the spokesperson for the United Kingdom delegation, called the draft text the “lowest common denominator.”
paras.zh: 英国代表团发言人凯特·休斯称草案文本为“最低公分母”。

paras.en: All countries had to agree on the text for it to pass. The talks were the longest in COP history, surpassing the delay in negotiations at COP25 in Madrid.
paras.zh: 所有国家必须就文本达成一致才能通过。此次会谈是 COP 历史上最长的一次，超过了马德里 COP25 谈判的延误时间。

paras.en: The summit began on Nov 9. A first draft was circulated a week later and mentioned “fossil fuel” or “fossil fuels” six times. But a second draft, published Thursday, had removed all references, to the anger of many countries.
paras.zh: 峰会于11月9日开始。一周后分发了初稿，其中六次提到“化石燃料”或“化石燃料”。但周四发布的第二稿删除了所有提及的内容，这引起了许多国家的愤怒。

paras.en: The conference officially ended on Friday without an agreement. Members have continued talks in a bid to find a resolution, but a fourth draft released Sunday still contained no mention of fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 会议于周五正式结束，但未达成任何协议。成员们继续进行谈判，以寻求解决方案，但周日发布的第四份草案仍然没有提及化石燃料。

paras.en: Countries like Saudi Arabia, Russia and India have pushed back on including any reference to the words in the text, amid concerns that phasing out fossil fuels, central to their economies, could pose a financial risk.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯、俄罗斯和印度等国已拒绝在文本中提及这些词语，因为他们担心逐步淘汰对其经济至关重要的化石燃料可能会带来财务风险。

paras.en: The United States, one of the largest emitters of greenhouse gases, is officially absent from the conference, having withdrawn from a series of international climate commitments under President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 美国是最大的温室气体排放国之一，退出了唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下的一系列国际气候承诺，正式缺席此次会议。

paras.en: The latest draft started by “recalling the United Arab Emirates Consensus in its entirety,” a reference to COP28 in the UAE, where countries agreed for the first time to “transition away” from fossil fuels in energy systems.
paras.zh: 最新草案首先“全面回顾阿拉伯联合酋长国共识”，指的是在阿联酋举行的第 28 次缔约方会议，各国首次同意在能源系统中“放弃”化石燃料。

paras.en: Panama’s environment minister, Juan Carlos Navarro, said the world was “being held hostage by the petroleum mafia.”
paras.zh: 巴拿马环境部长胡安·卡洛斯·纳瓦罗表示，世界“正被石油黑手党劫持”。

paras.en: “We love the petroleum guys,” he told a press conference on Wednesday. “We can’t live without them, and they are so smart, they have convinced us that they are doing this for our own good.”
paras.zh: “我们喜欢石油人，”他在周三的新闻发布会上说。 “没有他们我们就活不下去，他们非常聪明，他们让我们相信他们这样做是为了我们好。”

paras.en: Mohamed Adow of Power Shift Africa called COP31 the “worst ever.”
paras.zh: Power Shift Africa 的 Mohamed Adow 称 COP31 是“有史以来最糟糕的一次”。

paras.en: “The collapse of climate talks at COP31 in Antalya needs to be a wake-up call for the world,” he wrote in a statement. “Rich nations and polluting governments cannot keep arriving empty-handed and expecting a carefully worded declaration to get them off the hook.”
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中写道：“安塔利亚 COP31 气候谈判的失败应该给世界敲响警钟。” “富裕国家和污染严重的政府不能总是空手而归，指望一份措辞谨慎的声明让他们摆脱困境。”

paras.en: United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres said he was “deeply disappointed that COP31 has ended without consensus on an overarching outcome.”
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯表示，他“对 COP31 未能就总体结果达成共识而结束深感失望”。

paras.en: “But this setback does not change the facts,” he posted on X. “There may be no consensus in the negotiating room. There is no ambiguity in the science.”
paras.zh: “但这次挫折并没有改变事实，”他在X上发帖称，“谈判室里可能没有达成共识。科学上没有任何含糊之处。”

paras.en: The latest draft also acknowledged that the goal set by the 2015 Paris Agreement of keeping the rise in global temperatures below 1.5 degrees Celsius is going to be missed.
paras.zh: 最新草案还承认，2015年《巴黎协定》设定的将全球气温上升控制在1.5摄氏度以下的目标将无法实现。

paras.en: As warming goes beyond 1.5 C, the impacts of climate change, including extreme heat and other weather events, are expected to ramp up significantly.
paras.zh: 随着气温升高超过 1.5°C，气候变化（包括极端高温和其他天气事件）的影响预计将显着加剧。

paras.en: As the talks break down, Kurum could choose to convene a follow-up meeting or delay decisions until next year’s conference, hosted by Ethiopia.
paras.zh: 随着谈判破裂，库鲁姆可以选择召开后续会议，或者将决定推迟到明年由埃塞俄比亚主办的会议。

paras.en: Talks last failed at COP6 at The Hague in the Netherlands in 2000.
paras.zh: 上次谈判于 2000 年在荷兰海牙举行的第六届缔约方会议 (COP6) 上失败。

articles.title: Families of children with epilepsy worried after loss of neurologist
articles.author: Adam Shirley

paras.en: Lachie's parents sleep with one eye open every night.
paras.zh: 拉奇的父母每天晚上都睁着一只眼睛睡觉。

paras.en: Lachie has lived with a complex form of epilepsy for five years, his condition first being detected as a young child.
paras.zh: Lachie 患有一种复杂的癫痫症已经五年了，他的病情第一次被发现是在他还是个小孩子的时候。

paras.en: "Our son suffers from three different types of epilepsy" Rob Kominek, Lachie's father, said.
paras.zh: “我们的儿子患有三种不同类型的癫痫症”，拉奇的父亲罗布·科米内克 (Rob Kominek) 说。

paras.en: He said during some severe seizures, Lachie has stopped breathing.
paras.zh: 他说，在几次严重的癫痫发作期间，拉奇已经停止了呼吸。

paras.en: "He does and has turned blue on numerous occasions,"
paras.zh: “他确实这么做了，并且多次变蓝。”

paras.en: "For us as a family, this journey has been extremely traumatic."
paras.zh: “对于我们一家人来说，这段旅程是极其痛苦的。”

paras.en: Sometimes Lachie will be in the middle of a regular task, such as eating breakfast or playing outside, when he will experience an intense seizure.
paras.zh: 有时，Lachie 会在执行日常任务时，例如吃早餐或在外面玩耍，此时他会经历剧烈的癫痫发作。

paras.en: When it happens while he is standing, walking or jogging, Lachie will fall without anything to stop him, and the physical damage can be acute.
paras.zh: 当他在站立、行走或慢跑时发生这种情况时，Lachie 会在没有任何东西阻止的情况下跌倒，并且身体损伤可能会很严重。

paras.en: "There's blood coming out of his nose, out of his ears. He's broken his nose, his teeth," Rob said.
paras.zh: “血从他的鼻子、耳朵里流出来。他的鼻子、牙齿都被打断了，”罗布说。

paras.en: Like several areas of specialist health care in the ACT, expert practitioners in paediatric epilepsy are in short supply, and the queue to see one is lengthy.
paras.zh: 与首都领地的几个专科医疗保健领域一样，小儿癫痫领域的专家也供不应求，而且看诊的队伍也很长。

paras.en: "We have long wait lists and to see any sort of [epilepsy] specialist in Canberra is tough, so paediatric is even harder," Epilepsy ACT chief executive Fiona Allardyce said.
paras.zh: Epilepsy ACT 首席执行官 Fiona Allardyce 表示：“我们的等候名单很长，在堪培拉看任何类型的（癫痫）专家都很困难，因此儿科就更难了。”

paras.en: "Getting care for your epilepsy at an early age can make a big difference in just brain development, understanding and managing the condition.
paras.zh: “在很小的时候就接受癫痫治疗可以对大脑发育、理解和控制病情产生很大的影响。

paras.en: "So having someone who knows what they're talking about means everything to not just the child with epilepsy, but their families and everyone around them, including schools and community."
paras.zh: “因此，拥有一个知道自己在说什么的人意味着一切，不仅对癫痫儿童，而且对他们的家人和周围的每个人，包括学校和社区，都意味着一切。”

paras.en: Rob said his son Lachie had a rare, complex form of epilepsy called cryptogenic Lennox-Gastaut syndrome.
paras.zh: 罗布说，他的儿子拉奇患有一种罕见、复杂的癫痫症，称为隐源性 Lennox-Gastaut 综合征。

paras.en: "There are not many paediatric neurologists around that are familiar with that," he said.
paras.zh: “周围没有多少儿科神经科医生熟悉这一点，”他说。

paras.en: The family has managed to build relationships with a specialist care team over the years, including paediatric neurologist John Lawson, who has specific experience treating the kind of epilepsy Lachie lives with.
paras.zh: 多年来，这个家庭成功地与一个专业护理团队建立了关系，其中包括儿科神经科医生约翰·劳森(John Lawson)，他在治疗拉奇所患的癫痫症方面拥有丰富的经验。

paras.en: "It's because of their ready availability to assist and provide us with support that we've been able to mentally get through day-to-day; these guys are angels," Rob said.
paras.zh: “正是因为他们随时为我们提供帮助和支持，我们才能够在精神上度过每一天；这些人都是天使，”罗布说。

paras.en: But Lachie's future care has become even more uncertain, as Canberra Health Services (CHS) has told patients of Dr Lawson — including Lachie — that it will cease using him to provide clinics in the capital.
paras.zh: 但拉奇未来的护理变得更加不确定，因为堪培拉卫生服务中心 (CHS) 告诉劳森医生的患者——包括拉奇——将停止使用他在首都提供诊所。

paras.en: The ABC sought an interview with Canberra Health Services to ask why it was not continuing to use Dr Lawson to treat patients, how existing patients would be impacted and what alternatives there might be.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚广播公司寻求对堪培拉卫生服务中心进行采访，询问为什么不继续使用劳森医生来治疗患者、现有患者将受到怎样的影响以及可能有哪些替代方案。

paras.en: A spokesperson said CHS was "unable to facilitate an interview".
paras.zh: 一位发言人表示，CHS“无法协助采访”。

paras.en: "Patients who were previously under the care of Dr John Lawson have been advised that he will no longer be providing paediatric neurology clinics at Canberra Health Services.
paras.zh: “之前接受约翰·劳森医生护理的患者已被告知，他将不再在堪培拉卫生服务中心提供儿科神经科诊所服务。

paras.en: "These patients can continue to receive care publicly by specialist paediatric neurologists who provide outreach services as part of the Sydney Children's Health Network, who are appropriately qualified to care for paediatric patients with epilepsy and other neurological disorders. They can also elect to continue to receive care from Dr John Lawson privately.
paras.zh: “这些患者可以继续接受专业儿科神经科医生的公开护理，这些专家是悉尼儿童健康网络的一部分，提供外展服务，他们有适当的资格来护理患有癫痫和其他神经系统疾病的儿科患者。他们还可以选择继续接受 John Lawson 医生的私下护理。

paras.en: "Canberra Health Services cannot comment on individual employee matters."
paras.zh: “堪培拉卫生服务部门无法对个别员工的问题发表评论。”

paras.en: But Ms Allardyce said the impact of Dr Lawson ceasing public clinics would put significant pressure on this already-stretched area.
paras.zh: 但阿勒代斯女士表示，劳森医生停止公共诊所的影响将为这个已经捉襟见肘的地区带来巨大压力。

paras.en: "It's going to flow on to everyone. The other neurologists we have, our GPs, our hospital care, emergency even,"
paras.zh: “这将影响到每个人。我们的其他神经科医生、我们的全科医生、我们的医院护理，甚至是急诊室，”

paras.en: "There's going to be effects that we probably aren't aware of yet."
paras.zh: “这将会产生我们可能还没有意识到的影响。”

paras.en: For Rob, having to take Lachie to Sydney for treatment more than he already does, or to try and find a new specialist with the understanding and expertise of Lachie's condition, does not bear thinking about.
paras.zh: 对于 Rob 来说，必须带 Lachie 去悉尼接受比他现在更多的治疗，或者尝试寻找一位了解 Lachie 病情并具有专业知识的新专家，这些都是不值得考虑的。

paras.en: "To start that journey again would be not only horrific for us and quite concerning, but what would the ramifications be for our son? And how would that affect his epilepsy?" Rob asked.
paras.zh: “再次开始这段旅程不仅对我们来说是可怕的，而且非常令人担忧，而且会对我们的儿子产生什么影响？这会对他的癫痫症产生什么影响？”罗布问道。

paras.en: He is calling on decision makers to "have some empathy or some consideration" of the ramifications of their decisions.
paras.zh: 他呼吁决策者对其决策的后果“抱有一定的同理心或考虑”。

paras.en: And he hopes the call to stop public clinics with Dr Lawson is somehow reversed.
paras.zh: 他希望劳森医生停止公共诊所的呼吁能够以某种方式扭转。

paras.en: "It would be absolutely wonderful, not only on our behalf, but we know of so many other families who are in the same situation," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这绝对是一件好事，不仅对我们来说，而且我们知道还有很多其他家庭也有同样的情况。”

articles.title: Live: Wall Street crashes to correction territory and ASX set to fall
articles.author: Stephen Letts

paras.en: Markets live updates: Wall St crashes to correction territory and ASX set to fall
paras.zh: 市场实时更新：华尔街崩盘至修正区域，澳大利亚证券交易所将下跌

paras.en: Wall Street's week-long slump accelerated on Friday, with the S&P 500 shedding almost 4 per cent and the tech sector erasing all the gains it made for the year.
paras.zh: 周五，华尔街持续一周的跌势加速，标准普尔 500 指数下跌近 4%，科技股抹去了今年的所有涨幅。

paras.en: ASX futures point to yet another decline — which would be its seventh straight losing session — today, with the miners expected to come under more selling pressure following key commodities being swept up in last week's global flight from risk.
paras.zh: 今天，澳大利亚证券交易所期货将再次下跌，这将是连续第七个交易日下跌，随着上周全球避险情绪席卷主要大宗商品，矿商预计将面临更大的抛售压力。

paras.en: Follow the day's financial news and insights from our specialist business reporters on our live blog.
paras.zh: 在我们的实时博客上关注我们的专业商业记者当天的财经新闻和见解。

paras.en: Disclaimer: this blog is not intended as investment advice.
paras.zh: 免责声明：本博客无意作为投资建议。

paras.en: - ASX 200 futures: -0.6% to 8,556 points
- ASX 200 (Friday): -1.6% to 8,593 points
- Australian dollar: -0.6% to 66.15 US cents
- Wall Street (Friday): S&P 500 -3.7%, Dow -1.9%, Nasdaq -5.3%
paras.zh: - 华尔街（周五）：标准普尔 500 指数 -3.7%，道指 -1.9%，纳斯达克指数 -5.3%

paras.en: - Europe (Friday): Dax -2.6%, FTSE -1.0%, Eurostoxx600 -2.0%
paras.zh: - 欧洲（周五）：Dax -2.6%、FTSE -1.0%、Eurostoxx600 -2.0%

paras.en: - Oil: Brent futures +0.6% to $US92.57/barrel, WTI futures +0.9% to $US83.98/barrel
paras.zh: - 石油：布伦特原油期货 +0.6% 至 92.57 美元/桶，WTI 期货 +0.9% 至 83.98 美元/桶

paras.en: - Iron ore (Friday): flat at $US90.35/tonne
paras.zh: - 铁矿石（周五）：持平于 90.35 美元/吨

paras.en: - Copper (LME): -2.9% to $US12,160/tonne
- 10-year bonds: US 4.95% Australia 4.95%
paras.zh: - 10年期债券：美国4.95% 澳大利亚4.95%

paras.en: Choose what information you see below by using filters
paras.zh: 使用过滤器选择您在下面看到的信息

paras.en: Good morning and welcome to another day on the ABC markets and finance blog.
paras.zh: 早上好，欢迎来到 ABC 市场和金融博客的新一天。

paras.en: Stephen Letts from ABC business team limbering up for a blow-by-blow coverage of the day’s events, where every post is hopefully a winner, but none should be construed as financial advice.
paras.zh: 美国广播公司 (ABC) 业务团队的史蒂芬·莱茨 (Stephen Letts) 正在为当天活动的详细报道做好准备，每一篇文章都有望成为赢家，但没有一篇文章不应被视为财务建议。

paras.en: Wall Street endured a particularly ugly close to the week with the benchmark S&P 500 shedding almost 4% and the tech-centric Nasdaq down more than 5%. It's now given up all its gains for the year, plus a bit more.
paras.zh: 华尔街在本周收盘时经历了特别难看的情况，基准标准普尔 500 指数下跌近 4%，以科技股为中心的纳斯达克指数下跌超过 5%。现在它已经放弃了今年的所有收益，甚至还多了一点。

paras.en: Futures trading points to more modest losses of around 0.6% on the ASX this morning, but falling commodity prices across base and precious metals on Friday look likely to weigh on the miners again.
paras.zh: 期货交易显示，今天上午澳大利亚证券交易所的跌幅较为温和，约为 0.6% 左右，但周五基础金属和贵金属大宗商品价格的下跌似乎可能会再次给矿商带来压力。

paras.en: The game’s afoot, so let’s get blogging.
paras.zh: 比赛正在进行中，所以让我们开始写博客吧。

articles.title: Live: Greens 'optimistic' about deal on digital duty of care
articles.author: Courtney Gould

paras.en: Federal politics live: Greens 'optimistic' about deal on digital duty of care
paras.zh: 联邦政治直播：绿党对数字谨慎义务协议持“乐观”态度

paras.en: The Greens are optimistic a deal can be struck with the government over its digital duty of care legislation by the end of the week.
paras.zh: 绿党乐观地认为，本周末可以与政府就数字谨慎责任立法达成协议。

paras.en: Follow all the updates in our live blog.
paras.zh: 关注我们实时博客中的所有更新。

paras.en: Government confirms small businesses will be exempt from digital duty of care
paras.zh: 政府确认小企业将免除数字谨慎义务

paras.en: Communications Minister Anika Wells has confirmed small businesses will be exempt from the proposed digital duty of care, following concerns from business groups.
paras.zh: 鉴于商业团体的担忧，通信部长阿尼卡·威尔斯 (Anika Wells) 确认，小企业将免除拟议的数字谨慎义务。

paras.en: The Australian Chamber of Commerce and Industry yesterday voiced concerns that small businesses may be caught up in the government's digital duty of care bill, which would require companies to prevent harm on their online platforms.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚工商会昨天表示担心小型企业可能会受到政府数字谨慎责任法案的影响，该法案要求企业防止其在线平台受到损害。

paras.en: ACCI chief executive Andrew McKellar said businesses were unsure what steps they needed to take to comply with the laws.
paras.zh: ACCI 首席执行官安德鲁·麦凯勒 (Andrew McKellar) 表示，企业不确定需要采取哪些措施来遵守法律。

paras.en: "A small business should not have to engage lawyers simply to work out whether its website is caught by a regime carrying penalties of more than $100 million. The answer should be in black and white in the legislation," McKellar said.
paras.zh: “小企业不应该仅仅为了确定其网站是否被处罚超过 1 亿美元的政权而聘请律师。答案应该在立法中白纸黑字写下来，”麦凯勒说。

paras.en: But in a statement, Wells confirmed small businesses will be exempt.
paras.zh: 但威尔斯在一份声明中证实，小企业将获得豁免。

paras.en: "A low-risk website for a café or bookkeeper is unlikely to cause harm to its users so, once the Digital Duty of Care starts, they will be exempt from the law," she said.
paras.zh: “咖啡馆或簿记员的低风险网站不太可能对其用户造成伤害，因此，一旦数字谨慎义务开始，他们将免受法律的约束，”她说。

paras.en: "The intention of the Digital Duty of Care is to put the onus on tech companies to protect Australians from online harms before they occur — not to create additional burden for low-risk small businesses".
paras.zh: “数字谨慎责任的目的是让科技公司有责任在网络伤害发生之前保护澳大利亚人免受网络伤害，而不是给低风险的小企业造成额外的负担”。

paras.en: Greens 'optimistic' on passing digital duty of care laws this week
paras.zh: 绿党对本周通过数字注意义务法持“乐观”态度

paras.en: Greens senator Sarah Hanson-Young says she is "working hard" to try and get a deal done on the government's digital duty of care bill before the end of the week.
paras.zh: 绿党参议员莎拉·汉森-杨表示，她正在“努力”，争取在本周末之前就政府的数字护理责任法案达成协议。

paras.en: The Albanese government is hoping to pass the laws — which would put an onus on big tech companies to prevent foreseeable harms online — before parliament wraps up for the year.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚政府希望在今年议会结束之前通过这些法律——这将使大型科技公司有责任防止可预见的网络伤害。

paras.en: But they'll need the Greens support to do so.
paras.zh: 但他们需要绿党的支持才能做到这一点。

paras.en: Hanson-Young says she is "optimistic" about her conversations with the government, including on the Greens' non-negotiable amendment to enable Australians to sue tech companies if they are harmed.
paras.zh: 汉森-杨表示，她对与政府的对话感到“乐观”，包括绿党不可谈判的修正案，该修正案允许澳大利亚人在受到伤害时起诉科技公司。

paras.en: "I'm hopeful that we are getting somewhere with the government on this," she said.
paras.zh: “我希望我们能与政府在这方面取得进展，”她说。

paras.en: "We've seen them open to door to allowing for individuals and organisations to take big tech to court".
paras.zh: “我们看到他们敞开大门，允许个人和组织将大型科技告上法庭”。

paras.en: Hanson-Young says "the ball is in the governments court" to deliver amendments that will strengthen the laws.
paras.zh: 汉森-杨表示，“球在政府法庭上”，以提出加强法律的修正案。

paras.en: "If we can come to an agreement, that is great, if it has to wait until next year, so be it".
paras.zh: “如果我们能够达成协议，那就太好了，如果必须等到明年，那就这样吧”。

paras.en: Hello friends. Welcome to our politics live blog. I'm Courtney Gould from the ABC's Parliament House team, here to guide you through the day.
paras.zh: 大家好。欢迎来到我们的政治直播博客。我是来自美国广播公司 (ABC) 国会大厦团队的考特尼·古尔德 (Courtney Gould)，我将在这里为您提供指导。

paras.en: It's the final sitting week of the year, can you believe it? The parliament (well, the Senate) will have a busy week as it tries to land a deal on several bills the government wants passed by the end of the week.
paras.zh: 这是今年的最后一周，你能相信吗？议会（好吧，参议院）将度过忙碌的一周，因为它将试图就政府希望在本周末通过的几项法案达成协议。

paras.en: From the gas reservation scheme, digital duty of care, trusts and the capital gains discount, and private health insurance, there's still a lot to resolve before MPs fly home for the year.
paras.zh: 从汽油预订计划、数字注意义务、信托和资本利得折扣，以及私人健康保险，在议员们今年飞回家之前仍有很多问题需要解决。

paras.en: In addition to all of that, Foreign Minister Penny Wong is expected to this week elevate AI as a national security challenge. Elsewhere, the government is still insisting all is fine with AUKUS. More on both of those stories shortly.
paras.zh: 除此之外，外交部长黄英贤预计本周将把人工智能提升为国家安全挑战。在其他地方，政府仍然坚称 AUKUS 一切正常。稍后将详细介绍这两个故事。

paras.en: Grab a coffee and settle in. Let's get blogging!!
paras.zh: 喝杯咖啡，坐下来。让我们开始写博客吧！

articles.title: Fire at Indonesian candy factory leaves 3 dead, dozens of workers missing

paras.en: Fire at Indonesian candy factory leaves 3 dead, dozens of workers missing
paras.zh: 印尼糖果厂火灾造成3人死亡、数十名工人失踪

paras.en: Survivors said the fire originated from a cooling unit on the third floor
paras.zh: 幸存者称火灾源自三楼的冷却装置

paras.en: A fire swept through a candy factory in Indonesia's Banten province, killing at least three workers and leaving 36 others unaccounted for, officials said Sunday.
paras.zh: 官员周日表示，印度尼西亚万丹省一家糖果厂发生火灾，造成至少 3 名工人死亡，另有 36 人下落不明。

paras.en: The blaze broke out at the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia factory in the Serang district of Banten province, which borders the capital, Jakarta, at 5 p.m. local time on Saturday.
paras.zh: 下午 5 点，位于万丹省 Serang 区的 PT Fonusa Agung Mulia 工厂发生火灾，该地区与首都雅加达接壤。当地时间周六。

paras.en: Flames engulfed the three-storey factory, sending thick black smoke into the sky, television reports showed. Debris littered the floor of the burned-out structure, including twisted metal and blackened, corrugated iron roofing.
paras.zh: 电视报道显示，火焰吞没了这座三层楼的工厂，浓浓的黑烟冲上天空。被烧毁的建筑物的地板上散落着碎片，包括扭曲的金属和发黑的波纹铁屋顶。

paras.en: A company representative said Sunday 300 workers were inside when the blaze started. He added 54 were initially missing, but 15 have since been rescued. The rescued included four injured workers, the National Search and Rescue Agency said in a statement.
paras.zh: 一名公司代表周日表示，火灾发生时，有 300 名工人在里面。他补充说，最初有 54 人失踪，但后来有 15 人获救。国家搜救局在一份声明中称，获救者包括四名受伤工人。

paras.en: The remains of the three killed were transferred to a hospital in seven black body bags for identification.
paras.zh: 三名遇难者的遗体被装在七个黑色尸袋中转移到医院进行辨认。

paras.en: The cause of the fire was not immediately known. Survivors said the fire originated from a cooling unit on the third floor, local media reported.
paras.zh: 起火原因尚不清楚。据当地媒体报道，幸存者称火灾源自三楼的冷却装置。

paras.en: Rescuers inspect a candy factory in Cikande following a fire, which killed at least three workers and left 36 others unaccounted for, officials said Sunday. (The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 官员周日表示，救援人员正在检查 Cikande 的一家糖果厂，火灾导致至少 3 名工人死亡，另有 36 人下落不明。 （美联社）

paras.en: Although the blaze had largely been contained as of Sunday, firefighters were still carrying out intensive cooling operations before they could access all parts of the factory, said Tubagus Mahfud, operations chief of the Serang fire department, adding that the remaining hotspots were concentrated in the central and rear sections of the building.
paras.zh: 西冷消防局行动负责人图巴古斯·马福德 (Tubagus Mahfud) 表示，尽管截至周日火势已基本得到控制，但消防队员仍在进行密集的冷却作业，然后才能进入工厂的所有区域。他补充说，剩余的热点集中在建筑物的中部和后部。

paras.en: "We are conducting sweeps in the areas that have already been brought under control," Mahfud said. "Parts of the structure had collapsed, while poor lighting conditions required firefighters to proceed cautiously."
paras.zh: 马福德说：“我们正在对已经受到控制的地区进行清理。” “部分结构已经倒塌，而照明条件不佳，需要消防员谨慎行事。”

paras.en: He also said the factory's production materials could cause the fire to reignite, making it critical to complete cooling operations.
paras.zh: 他还表示，工厂的生产材料可能会导致火灾重燃，因此完成冷却操作至关重要。

paras.en: Rizky Dwianto, an operations official at the Banten Search and Rescue Agency, said 15 fire trucks, supported by water cannons, were deployed to battle the flames in several parts of the facility more than 12 hours after the fire began. A joint rescue team, including police, the military, the Indonesian Red Cross and volunteers, was at the scene.
paras.zh: 万丹搜救局行动官员里兹基·德维安托 (Rizky Dwianto) 表示，火灾发生 12 个多小时后，在水炮的支援下，部署了 15 辆消防车，在该设施的多个地方扑灭大火。由警察、军队、印度尼西亚红十字会和志愿者组成的联合救援队已赶赴现场。

paras.en: "Authorities continue to co-ordinate with families and the company to determine the whereabouts of employees believed to have been inside the factory when the fire broke out," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“当局继续与家属和公司协调，以确定火灾发生时据信在工厂内的员工的下落。”

paras.en: Anxious relatives waited for news outside the burnt-out factory.
paras.zh: 焦急的亲属在被烧毁的工厂外面等待消息。

paras.en: The factory produces Milkita, an Indonesian brand of milk-based candies and snack products.
paras.zh: 该工厂生产印度尼西亚品牌 Milkita 的牛奶糖果和零食产品。

paras.en: Indonesia has experienced a series of deadly industrial fires in recent years, raising concerns about workplace safety standards and emergency preparedness at manufacturing facilities.
paras.zh: 近年来，印度尼西亚经历了一系列致命的工业火灾，引发了人们对工作场所安全标准和制造设施应急准备的担忧。

articles.title: COP31 climate talks collapse after member states reject deal for not mentioning fossil fuels
articles.author: Anya Zoledziowski

paras.en: COP31 climate talks collapse after member states reject deal for not mentioning fossil fuels
paras.zh: COP31气候谈判因成员国拒绝未提及化石燃料的协议而破裂

paras.en: It's the first time since 2009 that the UN's annual climate summit ended without an agreement
paras.zh: 这是自2009年以来联合国年度气候峰会首次在没有达成协议的情况下结束

paras.en: Climate talks collapsed on Sunday at COP31 in Turkey, ending the longest ever UN climate summit with no deal to show for it.
paras.zh: 周日，在土耳其举行的第 31 届联合国气候变化框架公约 (COP31) 上，气候谈判破裂，结束了有史以来最长的联合国气候峰会，但没有达成任何协议。

paras.en: For more than two weeks, representatives from nearly 200 countries, scientists, businesses and more gathered in Antalya, Turkey, for this year's COP31 conference. The annual UN climate change conference brings together member states to negotiate — and ideally commit to — climate policies that aim to curb global warming. It's the main vehicle through which countries co-ordinate climate action.
paras.zh: 两周多来，来自近 200 个国家的代表、科学家、企业等齐聚土耳其安塔利亚，参加今年的 COP31 会议。一年一度的联合国气候变化会议将成员国聚集在一起，就旨在遏制全球变暖的气候政策进行谈判，并在最好的情况下做出承诺。它是各国协调气候行动的主要工具。

paras.en: But this year, no agreement was met — despite extending heavily into overtime this weekend following Friday's deadline — after the European Union and others rejected the draft put forward by Turkey and Australia.
paras.zh: 但今年，在欧盟和其他国家拒绝了土耳其和澳大利亚提出的草案后，尽管周五截止日期后的本周末大幅延长至加时赛，但仍未达成任何协议。

paras.en: "There is nothing to do, we did all that we could. Since there are 196 countries, they will make the decision and we will respect their decision," said Turkey's COP31 president Murat Kurum. "There will be no new text from now on."
paras.zh: “没有什么可做的，我们已经尽力了。由于有 196 个国家，他们将做出决定，我们将尊重他们的决定，”土耳其 COP31 主席穆拉特·库鲁姆 (Murat Kurum) 表示。 “从现在开始就不会再有新的文字了。”

paras.en: The lack of a deal means there will be no new action on climate disaster and adaptation financing for developing countries hardest hit by the impacts of climate change as the world is expected to overshoot the 1.5 C target set by the 2015 Paris Agreement, nor any further attempts to rein in the main human drivers of the climate crisis.
paras.zh: 由于预计世界将超过 2015 年《巴黎协定》设定的 1.5 摄氏度目标，因此缺乏协议意味着不会对受气候变化影响最严重的发展中国家采取新的气候灾难行动和适应融资，也不会进一步尝试控制气候危机的主要人类驱动因素。

paras.en: It's the first time UN climate talks have failed since 2009, when the conference was held in Copenhagen for COP15.
paras.zh: 这是自2009年在哥本哈根举行第15次缔约方会议(COP15)以来联合国气候谈判首次失败。

paras.en: Fossil fuels weren't mentioned in final draft
paras.zh: 最终草案中没有提及化石燃料

paras.en: Multiple members said the proposed agreement didn't go far enough to match the gravity of the climate crisis — in part because there was no mention of fossil fuels anywhere in the text, despite scientific consensus that they drive global warming.
paras.zh: 多名成员表示，拟议的协议还不足以应对气候危机的严重性，部分原因是文本中没有提及化石燃料，尽管科学界一致认为化石燃料会导致全球变暖。

paras.en: "At a point where the world urgently needs action to avert disastrous levels of global warming, the draft cover decision falls short," said a joint European Union statement, delivered by Ireland's Environment Minister Darragh O'Brien and Wopke Hoekstra, European commissioner for climate, net zero and clean growth.
paras.zh: 爱尔兰环境部长达拉·奥布莱恩 (Darragh O'Brien) 和欧盟气候、净零和清洁增长专员沃普克·霍克斯特拉 (Wopke Hoekstra) 在欧盟联合声明中表示，“在世界迫切需要采取行动避免灾难性的全球变暖的时刻，覆盖决定草案还不够。”

paras.en: "We will not endorse a cover decision that does not even mention fossil fuels, the driver of climate change.... And we will not accept a COP that greenwashes fossil fuels."
paras.zh: “我们不会支持一项甚至不提及气候变化驱动因素化石燃料的封面决定……我们也不会接受一个对化石燃料进行‘绿色清洗’的缔约方大会。”

paras.en: - Canada presented itself as a global leader in methane reductions at COP31. But is Alberta holding it back?
paras.zh: - 加拿大在 COP31 上展示了自己在甲烷减排方面的全球领导者地位。但艾伯塔省会阻止它吗？

paras.en: - Fossil fuel limits cut from latest draft of UN climate deal
paras.zh: - 联合国气候协议最新草案削减了化石燃料限制

paras.en: Kurum voiced his disagreement with the decision, saying "you should not hurt people in the world who really expect something out of this by just being hung up on one word or phrase."
paras.zh: 库鲁姆表达了他对这一决定的不同意见，他说：“你不应该仅仅因为一个词或短语而伤害世界上那些真正希望从中得到一些东西的人。”

paras.en: Oil-producing nations like Saudi Arabia reportedly lobbied to leave out mentions of fossil fuels and instead pushed for the deal to focus on carbon capture and storage technologies.
paras.zh: 据报道，沙特阿拉伯等产油国游说不提及化石燃料，而是推动协议重点关注碳捕获和储存技术。

paras.en: A representative for the Saudi delegation told the summit he was surprised that member states voiced resistance to the technology, which is heavily pushed by industry lobbyists.
paras.zh: 沙特代表团的一名代表在峰会上表示，令他感到惊讶的是，成员国对这项受到行业游说者大力推动的技术表示抵制。

paras.en: "If indeed the climate challenge, as some have mentioned today, is so important, it makes no sense that solutions, concrete solutions ... will be taken off the table," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果气候挑战确实像今天一些人提到的那样如此重要，那么解决方案、具体解决方案……就没有意义了。”

paras.en: Environmentalists have long voiced concerns about overreliance on the tech, saying it could prolong global reliance on fossil fuels. Experts have also warned that carbon capture, while important, can't roll back global warming on its own.
paras.zh: 环保人士长期以来一直对过度依赖这项技术表示担忧，称这可能会延长全球对化石燃料的依赖。专家还警告说，碳捕获虽然很重要，但它本身并不能遏制全球变暖。

paras.en: Russia was also against mentioning fossil fuels in the agreement.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯也反对在协议中提及化石燃料。

paras.en: Panama said it rejected the deal because it failed to acknowledge the scale and urgency of the climate crisis, while Norway's Climate Minister Sigrun Gjerløw Aasland said the draft "takes us backwards."
paras.zh: 巴拿马表示拒绝该协议，因为它未能承认气候危机的规模和紧迫性，而挪威气候部长西格伦·杰洛夫·阿斯兰表示，该草案“让我们倒退”。

paras.en: Developing countries, many of which are already struggling with the worst effects of global warming, said the deal didn't allocate enough money to adequately respond to the climate crisis.
paras.zh: 发展中国家表示，该协议没有分配足够的资金来充分应对气候危机，其中许多国家已经在与全球变暖的最严重影响作斗争。

paras.en: "Climate finance must be fully mobilized to drive needed scale and speed in mitigation, adaptation, technology transfer, capacity building and loss and damage," the Philippines delegation said. "A target without means is a promise without a pathway."
paras.zh: 菲律宾代表团表示：“必须充分调动气候融资，以推动减缓、适应、技术转让、能力建设以及损失和损害所需的规模和速度。” “没有手段的目标就是没有途径的承诺。”

paras.en: Kenya echoed the concern and said Africa wasn't adequately represented.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚也表达了同样的担忧，并表示非洲没有充分代表。

paras.en: "Africa is not named. The decision rightly speaks of least developed countries and small island states, but not once of Africa's special needs and circumstances," said Kenya's delegation. "Those who took the lead in emissions must take the lead in support. We ask our partners to bring the finance that makes this ambition possible."
paras.zh: 肯尼亚代表团表示：“没有点名非洲。该决定正确地提到了最不发达国家和小岛屿国家，但没有提到非洲的特殊需求和情况。” “那些带头减排的人必须带头提供支持。我们要求我们的合作伙伴提供资金，使这一雄心成为可能。”

paras.en: Reactions from officials, activists and experts already started flooding the internet early Sunday, with many supporting the EU's decision to reject the deal.
paras.zh: 周日早些时候，官员、活动人士和专家的反应已经开始充斥互联网，其中许多人支持欧盟拒绝该协议的决定。

paras.en: "Countries from across regions were right to reject the colossal betrayal that the COP31 co-presidencies tried to pass off as climate action," wrote Amnesty International climate justice policy adviser Ann Harrison. "They refused to accept a deeply unjust text that failed even to name fossil fuels while opening the door to risky technologies that could prolong their use."
paras.zh: 国际特赦组织气候正义政策顾问安·哈里森写道：“各地区国家拒绝接受 COP31 联合主席试图冒充气候行动的巨大背叛是正确的。” “他们拒绝接受一份极其不公正的文本，该文本甚至没有提及化石燃料的名称，但却为可能延长化石燃料使用的危险技术打开了大门。”

paras.en: The UN Secretary General António Guterres wrote on X that he's "deeply disappointed" that COP31 ended without consensus.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯在 X 上写道，他对 COP31 未能达成共识而结束“深感失望”。

paras.en: "I share the very profound frustration of all those who expected governments to rise to the moment the climate crisis demands. But the setback does not change the facts," he wrote. "The take-home message from COP31 is clear: The world must do much more to confront the climate crisis."
paras.zh: 他写道：“我和所有那些期望政府在应对气候危机时采取行动的人一样感到非常沮丧。但挫折并没有改变事实。” “第三十一届缔约方大会传达的重要信息很明确：世界必须采取更多行动来应对气候危机。”

paras.en: Notably, this year's summit was the first to take place after the UN's environmental body in October confirmed the rise in global temperature was set to exceed 1.5 C — a threshold countries agreed at Paris climate talks over a decade ago to try not to exceed, and beyond which extreme weather impacts intensify, including through heat waves, floods and droughts.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，今年的峰会是联合国环境机构十月份确认全球气温上升将超过 1.5 摄氏度之后举行的首次峰会。这是十多年前各国在巴黎气候谈判上商定的阈值，尽量不超过这一阈值，超过这个阈值，极端天气影响就会加剧，包括热浪、洪水和干旱。

paras.en: But it's also marked by competing priorities that threaten to sideline climate action. The collapse this time is against the backdrop of competing crises, including wars and public outcry over the cost of living, that have distracted political attention from the problems of a warming climate largely caused by human activity.
paras.zh: 但它的另一个特点是相互竞争的优先事项有可能导致气候行动的边缘化。这次崩溃是在相互竞争的危机背景下发生的，包括战争和公众对生活成本的强烈抗议，这些危机分散了政治注意力，使人们不再关注主要由人类活动引起的气候变暖问题。

paras.en: That's it for COP31. The annual summit requires consensus when finalizing agreements. That means: no consensus, no deal. Existing frameworks and agreements established in previous years are still in effect.
paras.zh: 这就是 COP31 的内容。年度峰会在敲定协议时需要达成共识。这意味着：没有共识，就没有协议。前几年建立的现有框架和协议仍然有效。

paras.en: The next UN climate summit will take place next year in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
paras.zh: 下一届联合国气候峰会将于明年在埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴举行。

articles.title: UN-affiliated athlete swims in dangerous Strait of Hormuz to highlight Iran war's impact on wildlife

paras.en: UN-affiliated athlete swims in dangerous Strait of Hormuz to highlight Iran war's impact on wildlife
paras.zh: 联合国附属运动员在危险的霍尔木兹海峡游泳，以强调伊朗战争对野生动物的影响

paras.en: British endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh spent three days last week swimming parts of the dangerous waterway
paras.zh: 英国耐力游泳运动员刘易斯·普 (Lewis Pugh) 上周在危险水道的部分区域游泳了三天

paras.en: British endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh has swum in the North Pole and Antarctica to draw attention to environmental causes. But battling freezing waters and extreme conditions hasn't prepared him for his latest challenge: swimming the Strait of Hormuz while tankers are attacked and blown up nearby.
paras.zh: 英国耐力游泳运动员刘易斯·皮尤在北极和南极洲游泳，以引起人们对环境问题的关注。但与冰冷的海水和极端的条件作斗争并没有让他做好迎接最新挑战的准备：在霍尔木兹海峡游泳，而附近的油轮遭到袭击和炸毁。

paras.en: Pugh, who is a United Nations Patron of the Oceans, spent three days last week swimming parts of the dangerous waterway to highlight how the Iran war threatens the area's habitat and wildlife.
paras.zh: 皮尤是联合国海洋赞助人，他上周花了三天时间在危险水道的部分区域游泳，以强调伊朗战争如何威胁该地区的栖息地和野生动物。

paras.en: Wearing only swimming trunks, goggles and a cap bearing the UN logo, the athlete started from the Musandam peninsula, on the southern tip of the strait, and ended by rounding the Cape of Hormuz, completing about 15 kilometres in total. Pugh is believed to be the first person to undertake a long-distance swim there since the war started.
paras.zh: 运动员只穿着泳裤、泳镜和印有联合国标志的帽子，从海峡南端的穆桑达姆半岛出发，绕霍尔木兹角结束，全程约15公里。皮尤被认为是自战争开始以来第一个在那里进行长距离游泳的人。

paras.en: The swimmer said that minutes after he entered the water on Monday, he heard two loud explosions that rocked the sea.
paras.zh: 这名游泳者说，周一他入水几分钟后，他听到两声巨大的爆炸声，震动了大海。

paras.en: A crew member aboard a boat accompanying endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh looks toward a burning liquefied petroleum gas tanker in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday. (Lewis Pugh Foundation/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周二，耐力游泳运动员刘易斯·皮尤 (Lewis Pugh) 的船上一名船员在霍尔木兹海峡看着一艘燃烧的液化石油气油轮。 （刘易斯·皮尤基金会/美联社）

paras.en: "I looked up and I could see that an oil tanker about four kilometres away had been hit," he told The Associated Press after he returned to London. "The explosion was so loud, two booms, and then fighter jets coming in. And at that moment I realized we have to get out of here right now."
paras.zh: “我抬头一看，发现大约四公里外的一艘油轮被击中了，”他返回伦敦后告诉美联社。 “爆炸声非常大，两声巨响，然后战斗机飞来。那一刻我意识到我们必须立即离开这里。”

paras.en: Pugh, 56, managed to finish his feat after more stops and starts, including passing another vessel that sent fireballs into the sky after it was attacked.
paras.zh: 56 岁的普格在多次停靠和出发后成功完成了自己的壮举，其中包括超越另一艘在受到攻击后向天空发射火球的船只。

paras.en: "Most people, when they think about the Strait of Hormuz, they think of a shipping lane," he said. "But it is also one of the most beautiful places I have ever been … it's one of the treasure troves of the natural world."
paras.zh: “大多数人，当他们想到霍尔木兹海峡时，他们会想到一条航道，”他说。 “但它也是我去过的最美丽的地方之一......它是自然世界的宝库之一。”

paras.en: "With all these ships being sunk, this area is under severe threat," he added. "It’s going to take years, decades for this area to recover."
paras.zh: “随着所有这些船只被击沉，该地区受到严重威胁，”他补充道。 “这个地区需要几年、几十年的时间才能恢复。”

paras.en: Oil pollution from damaged tankers threatens dolphins and mangroves
paras.zh: 受损油轮造成的石油污染威胁着海豚和红树林

paras.en: Iran has in recent weeks increased attacks on vessels that it claims travelled along unauthorized routes in the strait as it seeks to impose its control on the crucial waterway, where a fifth of all oil traded passed through before the U.S. and Israel launched the war on Feb. 28.
paras.zh: 最近几周，伊朗加大了对船只的攻击力度，声称这些船只在该海峡未经授权的航线上航行，试图对这一重要水道实施控制。在美国和以色列 2 月 28 日发动战争之前，五分之一的石油贸易都经过该水道。

paras.en: Pugh adjusts his goggles before diving into the Strait of Hormuz last week. Over the course of the week he completed about 15 kilometres in total. (Lewis Pugh Foundation/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 皮尤上周在潜入霍尔木兹海峡之前调整了护目镜。一周内他总共完成了约 15 公里。 （刘易斯·皮尤基金会/美联社）

paras.en: Several tankers have also struck sea mines laid by Tehran, in some cases exploding and bursting into flames, among them one that was carrying over two million barrels of oil last month.
paras.zh: 几艘油轮还击中了德黑兰埋设的水雷，在某些情况下发生爆炸并起火，其中一艘上个月装载了超过 200 万桶石油。

paras.en: Pugh warned of how oil leaking from the dozens of tankers damaged since February could create lasting problems for the region's animals, as well as its coastlines, coral reefs and mangrove forests.
paras.zh: 普格警告说，自二月份以来数十艘受损油轮的石油泄漏可能会给该地区的动物、海岸线、珊瑚礁和红树林带来持久的问题。

paras.en: He described seeing large numbers of dolphins following his boat as he sailed in, as well as turtles and ospreys. He also marvelled at the hundreds of turtles he saw during a swim along the Omani coast before the war.
paras.zh: 他描述说，当他航行时，看到大量海豚跟随他的船，还有海龟和鱼鹰。他还对战前在阿曼海岸游泳时看到的数百只海龟感到惊讶。

paras.en: "When oil gets in there, when chemical pollution gets in there, it becomes very, very difficult to clean up," he said. "It lasts for generations."
paras.zh: “当石油进入那里，当化学污染进入那里时，清理就变得非常非常困难，”他说。 “它会持续几代人。”

paras.en: Swim challenge took place as vessels were attacked
paras.zh: 船只遭到袭击时举行游泳挑战

paras.en: To stay safe, Pugh swam the strait in sections over three days, with a total of about six and a half hours of swimming. The athlete recalled seeing a gas carrier being struck as he returned to the harbour on the second day.
paras.zh: 为了安全起见，皮尤在三天内分段游过海峡，总共游了大约六个半小时。这名运动员回忆说，第二天他返回港口时看到一艘天然气运输船被击中。

paras.en: Smoke rises from a burning liquefied petroleum gas tanker in the Strait of Hormuz — an area described by Pugh as 'one of the most beautiful places' he has ever seen. (Lewis Pugh Foundation via The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡一艘燃烧的液化石油气油轮冒出浓烟，皮尤称该地区是他见过的“最美丽的地方之一”。 （刘易斯·皮尤基金会来自美联社）

paras.en: "I'll never ever forget going past that gas carrier, the smell of the chemicals and then the flames, they were literally like fireballs going up into the sky. Around the ship, the water was on fire," Pugh said.
paras.zh: “我永远不会忘记经过那艘天然气运输船时，化学物质的气味，然后是火焰，它们实际上就像火球一样升到天空。船周围的水着火了，”皮尤说。

paras.en: "The impact which a casualty like this has on nature — it was very, very acute."
paras.zh: “这样的伤亡对自然造成的影响非常非常严重。”

paras.en: Pugh has spent much of the past 40 years swimming in places from Antarctica to the Red Sea and the English Channel to urge more action to protect marine environments from climate change, pollution and loss of biodiversity.
paras.zh: 过去 40 年中，皮尤花了大部分时间在从南极洲到红海和英吉利海峡的地方游泳，敦促采取更多行动，保护海洋环境免受气候变化、污染和生物多样性丧失的影响。

paras.en: He was the first athlete to swim across the North Pole and complete a long-distance swim in every one of the world’s oceans. In 2023, he swam all 507 kilometres of the Hudson River in New York state to highlight the importance of clean rivers.
paras.zh: 他是第一个游过北极并在世界各大洋完成长距离游泳的运动员。 2023年，他游遍了纽约州哈德逊河507公里，以强调清洁河流的重要性。

paras.en: "My message is very simple," he said. "We've got to stop the war. We’ve got to open the strait, and we’ve got to clean up the pollution."
paras.zh: “我的信息非常简单，”他说。 “我们必须停止战争。我们必须开放海峡，我们必须清理污染。”

paras.en: Pugh is pictured underwater while he swims in the Strait of Hormuz. He's believed to be the first person to undertake a long-distance swim there since the war started. (Lewis Pugh Foundation/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 皮尤在霍尔木兹海峡游泳时在水下拍摄的照片。据信，他是自战争开始以来第一个在那里进行长距离游泳的人。 （刘易斯·皮尤基金会/美联社）

articles.title: Repression against Iranian lawyers increases

paras.en: UN human rights experts have called on the Iranian authorities to end the escalating persecution of independent lawyers. They warn that limiting access to legal representation increases the risk of arbitrary detention, coerced confessions and unfair trials.
paras.zh: 联合国人权专家呼吁伊朗当局停止对独立律师不断升级的迫害。他们警告说，限制获得法律代表的机会会增加任意拘留、逼供和不公平审判的风险。

paras.en: "Independent lawyers are increasingly being prosecuted and intimidated for their professional work and for defending human rights," the experts said in a statement in mid-November.
paras.zh: 专家们在 11 月中旬的一份声明中表示：“独立律师越来越多地因其专业工作和捍卫人权而受到起诉和恐吓。”

paras.en: They said that between September 2025 and September 2026, at least 135 lawyers were issued with a summons, arrested, detained, suspended, dismissed or banned from traveling. In January and February 2026, 23 lawyers, including five women, were reportedly arrested after nationwide protests.
paras.zh: 他们表示，2025年9月至2026年9月期间，至少有135名律师被发出传票、逮捕、拘留、停职、解雇或禁止旅行。据报道，2026 年 1 月和 2 月，包括 5 名女性在内的 23 名律师在全国范围内的抗议活动后被捕。

paras.en: Defending the politically persecuted is becoming dangerous
paras.zh: 捍卫政治迫害者正变得危险

paras.en: A current example is the case of Amirsalar Davoudi, a human rights lawyer who was arrested in October in the central Iranian city of Isfahan, where he was defending a client in the Revolutionary Court. According to Iran Human Rights (IHRNGO), he was taken to hospital on November 9 after suffering a heart attack in custody.
paras.zh: 当前的一个例子是人权律师 Amirsalar Davoudi 的案件，他于 10 月在伊朗中部城市伊斯法罕被捕，当时他正在革命法院为一名当事人辩护。据伊朗人权组织（IHRNGO）称，他在拘留期间心脏病发作，于 11 月 9 日被送往医院。

paras.en: "There is a long history to the persecution of and coercive measures taken against lawyers," Sina Yousefi, a 41-year-old lawyer and human rights activist, told DW.
paras.zh: “对律师的迫害和强制措施由来已久，”41岁的律师兼人权活动人士西娜·尤瑟菲(Sina Yousefi)告诉德国之声。

paras.en: In October 2022, Yousefi was arrested by security forces in Tabriz during the nationwide "Woman Life Freedom" protests. Later, he was sentenced to six months' imprisonment for "propaganda against the system." He has since left Iran, and now lives in the German capital Berlin.
paras.zh: 2022 年 10 月，尤瑟菲在全国“妇女生命自由”抗议活动期间在大不里士被安全部队逮捕。后来，他因“反体制宣传”被判处六个月监禁。此后他离开了伊朗，现在住在德国首都柏林。

paras.en: "The pressure was already increasing on lawyers back then, because they were undertaking the defense of people who were arrested and publicly expressing their support for the demonstrators," said Yousefi. "The security services, judiciary, and criminal prosecution apparatus increasingly used targeted mechanisms to move against independent lawyers."
paras.zh: 尤瑟菲说：“当时律师面临的压力已经越来越大，因为他们正在为被捕者辩护，并公开表达对示威者的支持。” “安全部门、司法部门和刑事起诉机构越来越多地使用有针对性的机制来对付独立律师。”

paras.en: Even renowned and internationally known lawyers such as Nasrin Sotoudeh, who was co-awarded the Sakharov Prize in 2012, have been affected by this repression. In 2026, Sotoudeh was awarded the Vaclav Havel Human Rights Prizeafter being repeatedly arrested and imprisoned.
paras.zh: 即使是国际知名律师，如 2012 年共同获得萨哈罗夫奖的纳斯林·索托德 (Nasrin Sotoudeh)，也受到了这种镇压的影响。 2026年，索托德在多次被捕入狱后被授予瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔人权奖。

paras.en: Yousefi said arrests and threats against lawyers working on political and human rights cases not only curtailed the rights of those accused to a defense, but also discouraged other lawyers from accepting such briefs. This, he added, compromised the fairness of trials.
paras.zh: 尤瑟菲表示，针对处理政治和人权案件的律师的逮捕和威胁不仅限制了被告的辩护权利，而且也阻碍了其他律师接受此类陈述。他补充说，这损害了审判的公平性。

paras.en: Criminal proceedings have also been instigated, or other measures taken, against lawyers who undertook to represent demonstrators. Comments on social media about the violation of civil rights can also be cited as grounds for investigation and judicial proceedings.
paras.zh: 针对代表示威者的律师也已启动刑事诉讼或采取其他措施。社交媒体上有关侵犯公民权利的评论也可以作为调查和司法程序的依据。

paras.en: Restrictions on the right to choose a lawyer
paras.zh: 选择律师权利的限制

paras.en: Yousefi also warned against tightening restrictions on a person's right to choose their own lawyer. According to the note to Article 48 of Iran's Code of Criminal Procedure, for people arrested on certain charges, access to lawyers of their own choosing is already restricted during the investigation phase. Defendants must resort to lawyers approved by the head of the judiciary. In some cases, even these lawyers are not granted access to all the files and evidence.
paras.zh: 尤瑟菲还警告不要收紧对个人选择律师权利的限制。根据伊朗刑事诉讼法第48条的说明，对于因某些指控而被捕的人，在调查阶段与自己选择的律师接触已经受到限制。被告必须求助于司法机关负责人批准的律师。在某些情况下，即使这些律师也无权查阅所有文件和证据。

paras.en: According to Yousefi, in many cases in which charges have been brought against demonstrators, lawyers have only been granted access to the files "when the preliminary investigations have been concluded and the evidence for the prosecution has been gathered — including confessions made during their imprisonment." Even then, he said, "their access to the records is limited and they have little time to prepare the defense."
paras.zh: 尤瑟菲表示，在许多针对示威者提出指控的案件中，只有“初步调查结束并收集了起诉证据——包括他们在监禁期间的供词”后，律师才被允许查阅档案。他说，即便如此，“他们获取记录的机会也很有限，而且他们几乎没有时间准备辩护。”

paras.en: "In many cases," Yousefi added, "the judges ascribe greater importance to reports by security agents than to the defense. Verdicts are handed down predominantly on the basis of this."
paras.zh: “在许多情况下，”尤瑟菲补充道，“法官更重视安全人员的报告，而不是辩方。主要以此为依据作出判决。”

paras.en: Shabnam Moinipour, the program director at the Center for Supporters of Human Rights (CSHR) in the UK, sees the independence of the bar as a fundamental precondition for the effective defense of citizens. The organization monitors the situation of lawyers in Iran, documenting violations of their rights, and following up at an international level.
paras.zh: 英国人权支持者中心 (CSHR) 项目主任沙布南·莫尼普尔 (Shabnam Moinipour) 认为，律师的独立性是有效保护公民的基本前提。该组织监测伊朗律师的状况，记录侵犯其权利的行为，并在国际层面采取后续行动。

paras.en: "A lawyer must be able to call into question the charges brought by the public prosecutor and the credibility of the security agencies' reports without fear of criminal prosecution," Moinipour told DW. "Because when a lawyer's freedom and professional activity are threatened, their client's right to defense is impaired."
paras.zh: 莫伊尼普尔告诉德国之声：“律师必须能够对检察官提出的指控和安全机构报告的可信度提出质疑，而不必担心受到刑事起诉。” “因为当律师的自由和职业活动受到威胁时，客户的辩护权就会受到损害。”

paras.en: In Moinipour's view, when the decision as to which lawyers are approved is made by the most senior representative of the same court authority, it raises serious questions about the independence of the bar.
paras.zh: 莫尼普尔认为，当批准哪些律师的决定是由同一法院权力机构的最高级代表做出时，就会引发对律师协会独立性的严重质疑。

paras.en: "This restriction has psychological as well as legal consequences," she stressed. "For the accused, it may reinforce a sense of being unprotected, as well as feelings of fear and mistrust. It can also prevent them from disclosing details of threats, torture, and illegal behavior."
paras.zh: “这种限制会产生心理和法律后果，”她强调。 “对于被告来说，这可能会强化一种不受保护的感觉，以及恐惧和不信任的感觉。它还可以阻止他们披露威胁、酷刑和非法行为的细节。”

paras.en: Moinipour considers this practice incompatible with Iran's obligations as a member of the UN Human Rights Committee. International law stipulates that people must have immediate access to a lawyer of their own choosing, be able to communicate with them in confidence and be supplied with sufficient means to mount a defense.
paras.zh: 《穆尼普尔》认为这种做法不符合伊朗作为联合国人权委员会成员的义务。国际法规定，人们必须能够立即联系自己选择的律师，能够与他们进行秘密沟通，并获得足够的手段进行辩护。

paras.en: Referring to a joint report by the Tehran-based Defenders of Human Rights Center and the International Bar Association's Human Rights Institute (IBAHRI), as well as the recent statement by UN human rights experts, Moinipour said: "Even without mass arrests, the actions taken against a limited number of lawyers can send a threatening message to others and restrict their professional activity. This phenomenon is described as a chilling or deterrent effect."
paras.zh: 莫伊尼普尔在提到总部位于德黑兰的人权捍卫者中心和国际律师协会人权研究所（IBAHRI）的联合报告以及联合国人权专家最近的声明时表示：“即使没有大规模逮捕，针对有限数量的律师采取的行动也可能向其他人发出威胁信息并限制他们的职业活动。这种现象被描述为一种令人寒心或威慑的效果。”

paras.en: However, Moinipour stressed that, despite this pressure, "many lawyers in Iran continue to defend the rights of their clients and accept the risk of arrest, criminal prosecution, and professional restrictions. In doing so, they are prepared, if necessary, to pay a high price for this resistance."
paras.zh: 然而，莫尼普尔强调，尽管面临这种压力，“伊朗的许多律师仍然继续捍卫客户的权利，并接受逮捕、刑事起诉和职业限制的风险。在这样做的过程中，如果有必要，他们准备为这种抵制付出高昂的代价。”

paras.en: This article was originally written in Persian.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用波斯语写的。

articles.title: China, ASEAN countries struggle over South China Sea code of conduct

paras.en: It was supposed to be a breakthrough year. The Philippines had intended to set up a code of conduct with China for the South China Sea during its 2026 ASEAN presidency. However, at the summit in Manila in mid-November they had to abandon their goal. Some 80% of the text had been negotiated, declared Philippine Foreign Secretary Theresa Lazaro, but the key areas of dispute had remained unsolved.
paras.zh: 这本应是突破性的一年。菲律宾原本打算在担任2026年东盟轮值主席国期间与中国制定南海行为准则。然而，在11月中旬的马尼拉峰会上，他们不得不放弃目标。菲律宾外交大臣特蕾莎·拉扎罗宣称，约 80% 的文本已经通过谈判，但关键争议领域仍未解决。

paras.en: Much more than diplomatic wording is at stake. The South China Sea is one of the world's most important shipping routes, it is rich in fishing grounds and may harbor significant oil and gas reserves. Primarily, however, it's a region of strategic competition: With its so-called Nine-Dash Line (often drawn in red), China claims a large portion of the sea. Its claims overlap with those of the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Brunei.
paras.zh: 所涉及的不仅仅是外交措辞。南海是世界上最重要的航线之一，渔场丰富，可能蕴藏着大量石油和天然气储量。然而，这主要是一个战略竞争区域：中国通过所谓的九段线（通常用红色绘制）声称拥有大部分海域的主权。它的主张与菲律宾、越南、马来西亚和文莱的主张重叠。

paras.en: A code of conduct is to set up rules for parties dealing with one another and prevent incidents at sea from escalating. However, opinions differ, particularly with regard to its binding nature and its geographic scope.
paras.zh: 行为准则是​​为各方交往制定规则，防止海上事件升级。然而，意见不同，特别是在其约束性和地理范围方面。

paras.en: "The basic problem with establishing such a code of conduct is that China is supremely powerful and has no real interest in a legally binding agreement," said political scientist Andreas Ufen, Southeast Asia expert at the German Institute of Global and Area Studies (GIGA). Beijing had little incentive to impose restrictions on itself as long as it was able to pursue its interests in the region even without such an agreement, Ufen told DW.
paras.zh: 德国全球与地区研究所（GIGA）东南亚问题专家、政治学家安德烈亚斯·乌芬（Andreas Ufen）表示：“建立这样一套行为准则的基本问题是，中国拥有至高无上的实力，并且对达成具有法律约束力的协议没有真正的兴趣。”乌芬告诉德国之声，只要北京能够在该地区追求自己的利益，即使没有这样的协议，北京也没有动力对自己施加限制。

paras.en: Mere recommendations or legally binding set of rules?
paras.zh: 仅仅是建议还是具有法律约束力的规则？

paras.en: The Paracel Islands serve as an example of just how difficult the unresolved issues are. In China, the group of islands is known as Xisha, in Vietnam as Hoang-Sa. Hanoi apparently wants to include them in the code's geographic scope, but China rejects this. An agreement within the ASEAN framework could indirectly affect the territorial claims of the parties involved.
paras.zh: 西沙群岛就是一个例子，说明未解决的问题有多么困难。在中国，该群岛被称为西沙，在越南被称为黄沙。河内显然希望将它们纳入该准则的地理范围，但中国拒绝了这一点。东盟框架内的协议可能会间接影响有关各方的领土主张。

paras.en: "A fundamental problem is that so far there's no consensus on whether the code of conduct should be legally binding," said Felix Heiduk, head of research division Asia at the German Institute for International and Security Affairs (SWP). China and the ASEAN nations have been negotiating an agreement for 12 years without major progress so far.
paras.zh: 德国国际与安全事务研究所（SWP）亚洲研究部主任菲利克斯·海杜克（Felix Heiduk）表示：“一个根本问题是，迄今为止，对于行为准则是​​否应具有法律约束力尚未达成共识。”中国与东盟国家的协议谈判已经12年，至今没有取得重大进展。

paras.en: There were reservations about such a treaty not only in China but also in other ASEAN countries. They would subsequently have to ratify a legally binding agreement under international law in their own countries. A non-binding code of conduct, by contrast, would be little more than a voluntary declaration of intent, Ufen told DW.
paras.zh: 不仅中国国内，其他东盟国家也对这一条约持保留态度。随后，他们必须在自己的国家批准一项根据国际法具有法律约束力的协议。乌芬告诉德国之声，相比之下，不具约束力的行为准则只不过是一份自愿的意向声明。

paras.en: The definition of an "incident" is controversial as well. Are coast guard missions with use of water cannons included? Or blockades of supply vessels? Or is the code only applicable when military force is involved? This will determine which actions will be covered by the regulations in the future.
paras.zh: “事件”的定义也存在争议。是否包括使用水炮的海岸警卫队任务？还是封锁补给船？或者该准则仅适用于涉及军事力量的情况？这将决定未来法规将涵盖哪些行为。

paras.en: "These are by no means just technical details. Their clarification determines to a great extent whether the code of conduct will in fact be effective or will ultimately remain only a non-binding declaration of intent," Heiduk said. An agreement without valid commitments would bring about little change.
paras.zh: “这些绝不只是技术细节。他们的澄清在很大程度上决定了行为准则是​​否实际上有效，或者最终只是一个不具约束力的意向声明，”海杜克说。没有有效承诺的协议不会带来什么改变。

paras.en: Ufen views China's attitude as a strategic calculation. "I believe that China is interested in keeping the conflict simmering, so to speak, without having to commit itself to a truly binding legal regulation," he said. In this way, Beijing could strengthen its position in the South China Sea without limiting its room for maneuver.
paras.zh: 乌芬将中国的态度视为战略考量。他说：“可以这么说，我相信中国有意让冲突持续发酵，而不必致力于制定真正具有约束力的法律法规。”这样，北京就可以在不限制其回旋余地的情况下加强其在南海的地位。

paras.en: At the same time there are also diverging interests within the ASEAN group. The 11 member states are by no means united. The Philippines and Vietnam are particularly vocal in their opposition to China. Malaysia and Indonesia pursue a more restrained approach. Cambodia and Laos have close economic ties with Beijing and don't have any territorial claims in the South China Sea.
paras.zh: 与此同时，东盟集团内部也存在利益分歧。 11个成员国并不团结。菲律宾和越南尤其强烈反对中国。马来西亚和印度尼西亚采取更为克制的做法。柬埔寨和老挝与北京有着密切的经济联系，并且在南中国海没有任何领土主张。

paras.en: "From the start of the negotiations, the lack of unity within ASEAN has been a problem. In a way, it's a permanent obstacle," Heiduk said. The group makes decisions based on the consensus principle, which basically means that every member state can block a unified position. Recurring confrontations between China and the Philippines exacerbated the problem by undermining trust and making it more difficult to reach compromises.
paras.zh: “从谈判一开始，东盟内部缺乏团结就是一个问题。在某种程度上，这是一个永久的障碍，”海杜克说。该组织根据共识原则做出决策，这基本上意味着每个成员国都可以阻止统一立场。中国和菲律宾之间反复发生的对抗破坏了信任并使达成妥协变得更加困难，从而加剧了问题。

paras.en: Ufen also believes that diverging interests are a key impediment. "Reconciling them is extremely difficult," he said. China could take advantage of the discord. Beijing preferred bilateral negotiations with individual countries rather than dealing with an entire, united group of nations.
paras.zh: 乌芬还认为，利益分歧是一个主要障碍。 “调和它们是极其困难的，”他说。中国可以利用这种不和。北京更愿意与个别国家进行双边谈判，而不是与整个、联合的国家集团打交道。

paras.en: A study published by the Singapore-based Yusof Ishak Institute (ISEAS)reaches similar conclusions. Not only China but internal divisions within ASEAN stalled negotiations. The authors warn against exclusively relying on a comprehensive, legally binding treaty. Initially, partial agreements — for example, on crisis communication, rescue operations at sea or maritime environment protection — could be a first step. Developing the 2002 agreement on a non-binding Declaration on the Conduct of Parties in the South China Sea could also be an intermediate step.
paras.zh: 新加坡尤索夫伊萨研究所 (ISEAS) 发表的一项研究得出了类似的结论。不仅中国，东盟内部的分歧也导致谈判陷入僵局。作者警告不要完全依赖一项全面的、具有法律约束力的条约。最初，部分协议——例如关于危机沟通、海上救援行动或海洋环境保护的协议——可能是第一步。制定2002年关于南海各方行为宣言的不具约束力的协议也可能是一个中间步骤。

paras.en: Ufen doubts whether Beijing is interested in a binding result. "For this reason, I can't really imagine that China has a real interest in a code of conduct that includes legally binding regulations," he said.
paras.zh: 乌芬怀疑北京是否对具有约束力的结果感兴趣。 “出于这个原因，我真的无法想象中国对包含具有法律约束力的法规的行为准则有真正的兴趣，”他说。

paras.en: Heiduk warns against overestimating the significance of a potential agreement. "Even if the code of conduct was signed at some point, in whichever shape, that would in no way solve the conflict in the South China Sea," he said. The code could regulate how to handle incidents, but it could not eliminate territorial disputes and competing claims to maritime areas.
paras.zh: 海杜克警告不要高估潜在协议的重要性。他说：“即使在某个时候签署了行为准则，无论以何种形式，都无法解决南海冲突。”该准则可以规范如何处理事件，但无法消除领土争端和对海域的相互主张。

paras.en: This constitutes the dilemma for ASEAN nations as well, whose foreign policy oscillates between China and US ties: An agreement that's as binding as possible could fail because China and individual member states have reservations. A weak, non-binding code, however, could give the impression everyone agreed but would hardly change conduct at sea.
paras.zh: 这也给东盟国家带来了困境，其外交政策在中美关系之间摇摆不定：一项尽可能具有约束力的协议可能会因为中国和个别成员国的保留而失败。然而，薄弱的、不具约束力的准则可能会给人一种大家都同意的印象，但很难改变海上行为。

paras.en: The American Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) summed up the situationafter the summit in Manila: "Whatever progress was made this year, it is almost certain that the hardest sticking points remain unresolved."
paras.zh: 美国战略与国际研究中心（CSIS）对马尼拉峰会后的形势进行了总结：“无论今年取得什么进展，几乎可以肯定的是，最棘手的问题仍然没有得到解决。”

paras.en: Negotiations will be continued in 2027 under Singapore's chairmanship. Whether this will turn into more than just another diplomatic effort will depend on whether China is prepared to submit itself to regulations which limit its scope of action and whether ASEAN will be able to reach a consensus.
paras.zh: 谈判将于 2027 年在新加坡主持下继续进行。这是否会不仅仅是又一次外交努力，将取决于中国是否准备好接受限制其行动范围的规定，以及东盟是否能够达成共识。

paras.en: This article was originally published in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表。

articles.title: ‘Horrific’ and ‘chilling’: Officials condemn ICE arrests at Seattle airport

paras.en: Democrats and state officials have denounced a now-viral immigration arrest in Washington state, which took place on an airport jet bridge as passengers were boarding a flight to Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 民主党人和州政府官员谴责了华盛顿州一场正在疯传的移民逮捕事件，这起事件发生在机场登机桥上，当时乘客正在登上飞往洛杉矶的航班。

paras.en: “What we’ve seen happening in Washington is atrocious,” said Nevada’s Governor-elect Aaron Ford, a Democrat, in an interview with the news outlet MS NOW on Sunday.
paras.zh: “我们在华盛顿看到的事情是残酷的，”内华达州当选州长、民主党人亚伦·福特周日在接受新闻媒体 MS NOW 采访时表示。

paras.en: He added that he supported safeguards to restrict the actions taken by United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents.
paras.zh: 他补充说，他支持采取保障措施来限制美国移民和海关执法局（ICE）人员采取的行动。

paras.en: “ We need some control over these vigilante ICE agents who come en masse in terrorising neighbourhoods, at airports included,” Ford said.
paras.zh: 福特说：“我们需要对这些聚集在一起恐吓社区（包括机场）的 ICE 特工进行控制。”

paras.en: The two arrests unfolded on Saturday morning at Seattle-Tacoma international airport, as passengers boarded Alaska Airlines Flight 1306.
paras.zh: 周六早上，当乘客登上阿拉斯加航空 1306 号航班时，两名乘客在西雅图-塔科马国际机场被捕。

paras.en: Videos recorded by passengers showed immigration agents in masks surrounding a man and a woman on the narrow jet bridge, forcing them to the ground as other travellers looked on.
paras.zh: 乘客录制的视频显示，在狭窄的登机桥上，戴着口罩的移民官员包围了一名男子和一名女子，迫使他们倒在地上，而其他旅客则在一旁观看。

paras.en: Passengers could be heard asking the officers to identify themselves, while a woman repeatedly shouted that she and her family had work permits.
paras.zh: 可以听到乘客要求警察表明自己的身份，而一名妇女则反复大喊她和她的家人有工作许可证。

paras.en: In one video, a young girl can be heard screaming as officers remove a man through a side door. In another part of the footage, an officer appeared to shove a bystander who tried to intervene.
paras.zh: 在一段视频中，当警察从侧门带走一名男子时，可以听到一名年轻女孩的尖叫声。在视频的另一部分，一名警察似乎推搡了一名试图干预的旁观者。

paras.en: The flight was delayed, eventually departing about three hours later than expected.
paras.zh: 航班延误，最终比预计晚了大约三个小时起飞。

paras.en: The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) defended the operation, saying ICE had conducted a targeted enforcement action to arrest Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, a Mexican national who the agency said had overstayed his visa.
paras.zh: 美国国土安全部 (DHS) 为此次行动进行了辩护，称 ICE 采取了有针对性的执法行动，逮捕了墨西哥公民里卡多·拉隆多·门多萨 (Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza)，该机构称他的签证逾期居留。

paras.en: DHS alleged that other travellers began obstructing and assaulting officers during the arrest, including one passenger who allegedly “hurled hot coffee on the officers”.
paras.zh: 国土安全部称，其他旅客在逮捕期间开始阻碍和袭击警察，其中一名乘客据称“向警察扔热咖啡”。

paras.en: The woman who was arrested, identified as Sofia Hernandez Mejia, was also found to have overstayed her visa, the department said, adding that she would be charged with assaulting a federal officer.
paras.zh: 该部门表示，被捕的女子索菲亚·埃尔南德斯·梅希亚也被发现签证逾期，并补充说她将被指控袭击联邦官员。

paras.en: The agency did not say where the two were taken.
paras.zh: 该机构没有透露两人被带到哪里。

paras.en: The footage prompted sharp condemnation from Washington Governor Bob Ferguson, who called ICE “completely and totally out of control” and described the video as “horrific” and “chilling” at a news conference on Saturday.
paras.zh: 这段视频引起了华盛顿州州长鲍勃·弗格森的强烈谴责，他在周六的新闻发布会上称 ICE“完全失控”，并称这段视频“可怕”和“令人毛骨悚然”。

paras.en: Ferguson also questioned whether the agents violated a Washington state law he signed in March that restricts law enforcement officers from wearing facial coverings.
paras.zh: 弗格森还质疑这些特工是否违反了他三月份签署的华盛顿州法律，该法律限制执法人员佩戴面部遮盖物。

paras.en: “Masked agents who do not identify themselves drag screaming individuals off a jetway as they’re about to do something very ordinary in our country: board a flight. There is no justification for this brutality,” Ferguson said during the news conference.
paras.zh: 弗格森在新闻发布会上表示：“蒙面特工不肯透露自己的身份，他们将尖叫的人从飞机跑道上拖下来，因为他们正要做一件在我们国家非常普通的事情：登机。这种暴行没有任何道理。”

paras.en: He added that state officials were investigating the circumstances of the arrests, including how the agents accessed the jet bridge.
paras.zh: 他补充说，州政府官员正在调查逮捕的情况，包括特工如何进入登机桥。

paras.en: Ferguson also urged Alaska Airlines and other carriers to demand that federal immigration agents leave airports.
paras.zh: 弗格森还敦促阿拉斯加航空公司和其他航空公司要求联邦移民人员离开机场。

paras.en: Alaska Airlines said it did not receive advance notice of the enforcement operation and was working with Ferguson and the Port of Seattle to determine whether established protocols had been followed.
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加航空公司表示，它没有收到执法行动的提前通知，正在与弗格森和西雅图港合作，以确定是否遵守了既定协议。

paras.en: The Port of Seattle, which manages the airport, said in a statement that it has raised its concerns with the relevant federal authorities about whether regulations were breached.
paras.zh: 管理该机场的西雅图港在一份声明中表示，已向相关联邦当局提出对是否违反规定的担忧。

paras.en: At Saturday’s news conference, Port of Seattle Commissioner Hamdi Mohamed characterised the arrests as particularly distressing because of when they took place.
paras.zh: 在周六的新闻发布会上，西雅图港专员哈姆迪·穆罕默德表示，由于逮捕发生的时间，这些逮捕行动特别令人痛苦。

paras.en: “We are entering the holidays. That is one of the most heartbreaking things about this moment today. There are so many people in that airport that are travelling to go and connect with their families,” Mohamed said. “And that family is separated.”
paras.zh: “我们即将进入假期。这是今天这一刻最令人心碎的事情之一。机场里有很多人前往与家人团聚，”穆罕默德说。 “那个家庭已经分开了。”

paras.en: Seattle Mayor Katie Wilson also condemned the operation, describing the agents’ tactics as “unacceptable and un-American”.
paras.zh: 西雅图市长凯蒂·威尔逊（Katie Wilson）也谴责了这次行动，称这些特工的策略“令人无法接受，也不符合美国精神”。

paras.en: Protesters gathered at the airport on Saturday evening, in the hours after the confrontation, to condemn the arrests and call for accountability from federal authorities.
paras.zh: 周六晚上，冲突发生后几个小时内，抗议者聚集在机场，谴责逮捕行动，并呼吁联邦当局追究责任。

paras.en: Disapproval of Trump’s immigration crackdown
paras.zh: 不赞成特朗普的移民镇压

paras.en: The arrests come as President Donald Trump continues to pursue what he has promised will be the largest deportation effort in US history.
paras.zh: 此次逮捕行动正值唐纳德·特朗普总统继续推行他所承诺的美国历史上最大规模的驱逐行动之际。

paras.en: But voters have expressed concern about the tactics used during his immigration crackdown. Some experts believe the topic became a political liability for Republicans in the November 3 midterm elections.
paras.zh: 但选民对他镇压移民期间使用的策略表示担忧。一些专家认为，这个话题成为共和党在 11 月 3 日中期选举中的政治负担。

paras.en: A Fox News poll from September found that 53 percent of registered voters believed the administration’s immigration enforcement had gone too far. The figure rose to 60 percent among independent voters and two-thirds of Hispanic respondents.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻 9 月份的一项民意调查发现，53% 的登记选民认为政府的移民执法太过分了。在独立选民和三分之二的西班牙裔受访者中，这一比例上升至 60%。

paras.en: In a November 8 interview with the CBS News television programme 60 Minutes, Trump acknowledged that his administration’s deportation policies may have been too aggressive, saying, “I think it might be too tough, yeah.”
paras.zh: 在 11 月 8 日接受哥伦比亚广播公司新闻电视节目《60 分钟》采访时，特朗普承认他的政府的驱逐政策可能过于激进，他说：“我认为这可能太严厉了，是的。”

paras.en: In the midterms, the Democratic Party won majorities in both the US House of Representatives and the Senate, flipping both chambers from Republican control.
paras.zh: 在中期选举中，民主党赢得了美国众议院和参议院的多数席位，使参众两院摆脱了共和党的控制。

paras.en: In the wake of that victory, several high-profile members of the left-wing party have pledged to seek reforms to immigration enforcement operations in the US.
paras.zh: 这场胜利之后，左翼政党的几位知名成员承诺寻求对美国移民执法行动进行改革。

paras.en: Senators Alex Padilla and Jacky Rosen, for instance, have introduced legislation that would prevent ICE from carrying out arrests at or near airports without a judicial warrant first.
paras.zh: 例如，参议员亚历克斯·帕迪拉（Alex Padilla）和杰基·罗森（Jacky Rosen）提出立法，禁止 ICE 在没有司法令的情况下在机场或机场附近实施逮捕。

paras.en: Patty Murray, another Democratic senator, also said she was demanding answers from DHS and warned in a post on X that the administration would face consequences when the incoming Congress is sworn in early next year.
paras.zh: 另一位民主党参议员帕蒂·默里也表示，她正在要求国土安全部给出答案，并在 X 上的一篇帖子中警告称，明年初即将上任的国会宣誓就职时，政府将面临后果。

paras.en: “Trump answers to a Democratic Congress on January 3rd – there WILL be accountability,” she wrote.
paras.zh: “特朗普将在 1 月 3 日向民主党国会做出回应——将会追究责任，”她写道。

articles.title: Aber Kawas becomes first Palestinian in New York state Senate history
