articles.title: Christmas gifts she'll actually use (and love)

paras.en: It's never too early to start holiday shopping for the women in your life. From cute pajamas and a new wrislet to a classic perfume and diamond earrings, we handpicked Christmas gifts she’ll actually use and appreciate, starting at $10.
paras.zh: 为您生活中的女性开始节日购物永远不会太早。从可爱的睡衣和新款手链到经典香水和钻石耳环，我们精心挑选了她会实际使用和欣赏的圣诞礼物，起价 10 美元。

paras.en: Eddie Bauer women's Cirruslite down vest: $50 (50% off)
paras.zh: Eddie Bauer 女式 Cirruslite 羽绒背心：50 美元（50% 折扣）

paras.en: Lands' End CashTown slouchy winter beanie: $12 (50% off)
paras.zh: Lands' End CashTown 休闲冬季无檐小便帽：12 美元（50% 折扣）

paras.en: This simple wristlet is an amazing gift for anyone who hates toting around a big bag every day. It's a bit larger than a typical wallet, so there's plenty of room for all of your cards and cash. The pebbled leather is sleek and stylish to pair with any outfit.
paras.zh: 对于那些讨厌每天背着大包的人来说，这款简单的腕带是一份很棒的礼物。它比典型的钱包稍大一些，因此有足够的空间容纳您的所有卡片和现金。荔枝纹皮革时尚时尚，可搭配任何服装。

paras.en: If you’re giving pajamas for Christmas, they should feel like an upgrade. This Cozy Earth bamboo set is breathable, ultra-soft and comfortable enough to wear long after the holiday.
paras.zh: 如果你在圣诞节送睡衣，它们应该感觉像是升级版。这款 Cosy Earth 竹制套装透气、超柔软且舒适，适合假期后长时间穿着。

paras.en: Keep loved ones cozy this holiday season with this warm fleece jacket. It's an easy layering piece that's equally stylish and comfortable. The polyester is soft to the touch and easy to clean. The mock neck and stitching upgrade the simple zip-up.
paras.zh: 穿上这款温暖的羊毛夹克，让心爱的人在这个假期保持舒适。这是一款轻松叠搭的单品，同时又时尚又舒适。聚酯纤维触感柔软且易于清洁。小高领和缝线升级了简单的拉链。

paras.en: A little British charm goes a long way with this adorable Paddington Bear tote from Kurt Geiger. Part of the brand's Paddington collection, the roomy shopper bag has soft, teddy-like fabric and an embroidered Paddington. It's spacious enough to fit a 14-inch laptop, with an interior pocket for smaller essentials. It's a sweet gift for the woman who still has a soft spot for the beloved bear.
paras.zh: Kurt Geiger 这款可爱的帕丁顿熊手提袋散发着一点英国魅力。这款宽敞的购物包属于该品牌的帕丁顿熊系列，采用柔软的泰迪熊般面料，并绣有帕丁顿熊图案。它足够宽敞，可容纳一台 14 英寸笔记本电脑，内部设有一个口袋，可存放较小的必需品。对于仍然对心爱的小熊情有独钟的女士来说，这是一份甜蜜的礼物。

paras.en: These lab-grown diamond earrings make a statement without overdoing it. The half-carat stones shine in classic four-prong settings, available in 14-karat white, yellow or rose gold, as well as platinum.
paras.zh: 这些实验室培育的钻石耳环彰显个性而又不过分。半克拉宝石在经典的四爪镶中熠熠生辉，有 14 克拉白金、黄金或玫瑰金以及铂金可供选择。

paras.en: This gorgeous tennis bracelet from Swarovski features shining crystals connected together with rhodium plating for a stunning addition to your jewelry stack you can wear daily. It has an adjustable fit and a secure clasp to stay put all day long.
paras.zh: 这款华丽的施华洛世奇网球手链采用闪亮的水晶与镀铑连接在一起，为您日常佩戴的珠宝首饰增添了令人惊叹的魅力。它具有可调节贴合度和安全扣，可全天保持固定。

paras.en: Give the gift of family memories with an Aura digital picture frame. Your recipient can upload photos right from her phone and watch the continuous slideshow all day.
paras.zh: 使用 Aura 数码相框赠送家庭回忆的礼物。您的收件人可以直接从手机上传照片并全天观看连续的幻灯片。

paras.en: This Winter Night Stars candle helps set the mood for a cozy night in. Smell woody, flowery and snowy notes all winter long.
paras.zh: 这款 Winter Night Stars 蜡烛有助于营造舒适夜晚的氛围。整个冬天都能闻到木香、花香和雪香。

paras.en: Keurig K-Supreme coffee maker: $100 (47% off)
paras.zh: Keurig K-Supreme 咖啡机：100 美元（47% 折扣）

paras.en: Bartesian cocktail maker: $350 (13% off)
paras.zh: Bartesian 鸡尾酒调制器：350 美元（13% 折扣）

paras.en: This red-and-white-striped Anthropologie mug is a natural fit for Christmas. Add your recipient's initial for a personalized touch.
paras.zh: 这款红白条纹 Anthropologie 马克杯非常适合圣诞节。添加收件人姓名首字母以实现个性化。

paras.en: Shopping for a coffee lover who never finishes their drink before it goes cold? This self-heating mug keeps hot drinks at the right temperature from first sip to last. With simple one-button controls, a spill-resistant lid and a charging coaster, it’s a gift they’ll use daily.
paras.zh: 为那些在咖啡变冷之前永远喝不完的咖啡爱好者购买咖啡？这款自加热马克杯让热饮从第一口到最后一口都保持在合适的温度。配有简单的一键式控制、防溢盖和充电杯垫，这是他们每天都会使用的礼物。

paras.en: These adorable towels are the perfect addition to your kitchen this winter and make a lovely gift. They're absorbent, plush and will look undeniably cute all season long.
paras.zh: 这些可爱的毛巾是今年冬天厨房的完美补充，也是一份可爱的礼物。它们吸水性强、毛绒绒，整个季节都会显得无可否认的可爱。

paras.en: Gifting Le Creuset doesn't have to mean spending hundreds of dollars. This mini round cocotte is adorable and versatile for making cakes, soups and dips. The stoneware heats your food evenly and keeps it warm until it's ready to serve. When gifting, be sure to match your recipient's existing Le Creuset collection.
paras.zh: 赠送 Le Creuset 并不一定意味着要花费数百美元。这款迷你圆形 cocotte 非常可爱，用途广泛，可用于制作蛋糕、汤和蘸酱。炻器可以均匀地加热您的食物并保持其温暖，直到准备好上桌。赠送礼物时，请务必与收件人现有的 Le Creuset 系列相匹配。

paras.en: Therabody RecoveryTherm Cube: $125 (22% off)
paras.zh: Therabody RecoveryTherm Cube：125 美元（22% 折扣）

paras.en: If she has a workout routine (or wants to start one), these Bala Bangles are a smart holiday gift. The adjustable cuffs can be worn on the wrists or ankles to add extra resistance to workouts or walks.
paras.zh: 如果她有锻炼习惯（或想要开始锻炼），这些 Bala 手镯是一份明智的节日礼物。可调节袖口可以戴在手腕或脚踝上，以增加锻炼或散步的额外阻力。

paras.en: For the avid reader and traveler in your life, the Kindle Paperwhite makes it easy to take your library with you on the go. The battery lasts for up to 12 weeks, so it won't die during a cliffhanger. From the lighting to the text size, the waterproof device's display is easy to adjust.
paras.zh: 对于生活中的狂热读者和旅行者来说，Kindle Paperwhite 可以让您轻松随身携带图书馆。电池续航时间长达 12 周，因此不会在悬念中耗尽电量。从灯光到文字大小，防水设备的显示都很容易调整。

paras.en: OmniLux red-light therapy mask: $315 (20% off)
paras.zh: OmniLux 红光治疗面罩：315 美元（20% 折扣）

paras.en: Help her simplify her hair routine with the Shark FlexStyle. This powerful hair dryer transforms into a versatile styling tool, letting her straighten, curl or enhance her natural texture while drying quickly with gentle heat in a lightweight, compact design.
paras.zh: 使用 Shark FlexStyle 帮助她简化发型。这款功能强大的吹风机变身为多功能造型工具，可让她拉直、卷曲或增强自然纹理，同时采用轻巧紧凑的设计，以温和的热量快速吹干。

paras.en: For more deals, visit www.foxnews.com/deals
paras.zh: 欲了解更多优惠，请访问 www.foxnews.com/deals

paras.en: Chanel's Chance fragrance is soft and feminine. The blend of musk, cedarwood, iris and amber makes it ideal for daytime and nighttime wear.
paras.zh: 香奈儿的 Chance 香水柔和而女性化。麝香、雪松、鸢尾花和琥珀的混合使其非常适合白天和夜间佩戴。

paras.en: Need more gift ideas? Shop the official Fox News Deals gift guide, trending gifts and gifts for men.
paras.zh: 需要更多礼物创意吗？购买官方福克斯新闻优惠礼品指南、流行礼品和男士礼品。

articles.title: Three killed, one injured in shooting at Ohio baby shower, police say

paras.en: Three people were killed and another was injured during a shooting at a baby shower at an Ohio event venue Saturday evening, according to local reports.
paras.zh: 据当地报道，周六晚上，俄亥俄州一处活动场地的迎婴派对上发生枪击事件，造成三人死亡，一人受伤。

paras.en: The shooting occurred around 6 p.m. inside Pandora's Magical Events Venue, located at 5331 Ridge Road in Parma, Ohio, according to a statement released by the Parma Police Department.
paras.zh: 枪击事件发生在下午 6 点左右。根据帕尔马警察局发布的一份声明，位于俄亥俄州帕尔马市里奇路 5331 号的潘多拉魔法活动场地内。

paras.en: Responding officers determined that four people had been shot during an "exchange of gunfire."
paras.zh: 响应警察确定有四人在“交火”中被枪杀。

paras.en: A 17-year-old girl, a 19-year-old man and a 45-year-old man were found dead at the scene, according to police.
paras.zh: 据警方称，一名 17 岁女孩、一名 19 岁男子和一名 45 岁男子被发现当场死亡。

paras.en: Parma police Public Information Officer Scott Traxler told FOX 8/WJW that the 19-year-old victim was the unborn child's father and the 45-year-old victim was the pregnant woman's father. Police identified the 19-year-old man as one of those involved in the exchange of gunfire.
paras.zh: 帕尔马警方公共信息官员斯科特·特拉克斯勒 (Scott Traxler) 告诉 FOX 8/WJW，19 岁的受害者是未出生孩子的父亲，45 岁的受害者是孕妇的父亲。警方确认这名 19 岁男子是参与交火的人之一。

paras.en: A fourth victim, a 39-year-old woman, suffered a gunshot wound to the leg that was considered non-life-threatening, police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，第四名受害者是一名 39 岁的女性，腿部中枪，但没有生命危险。

paras.en: Police also said a 29-year-old man allegedly involved in the exchange of gunfire was taken into custody following the shooting. Authorities have not publicly identified the man in custody or announced a possible motive.
paras.zh: 警方还表示，枪击事件后，一名涉嫌参与交火的 29 岁男子被拘留。当局尚未公开确认该男子的身份或公布可能的动机。

paras.en: Traxler told Fox News Digital that authorities were continuing to verify additional details surrounding the shooting.
paras.zh: 特拉克斯勒告诉福克斯新闻数字媒体，当局正在继续核实有关枪击事件的更多细节。

paras.en: Multiple firearms were recovered from the scene, according to police.
paras.zh: 据警方称，现场起获多把枪支。

paras.en: In a social media post, the Parma Police Department said officers were investigating a shooting involving multiple victims in the 5300 block of Ridge Road.
paras.zh: 帕尔马警察局在社交媒体帖子中表示，警方正在调查发生在 Ridge Road 5300 街区的一起涉及多名受害者的枪击事件。

paras.en: "Parma Police Department extends its deepest condolences to the families and loved ones of those who lost their lives in this tragic incident," the department wrote.
paras.zh: 帕尔马警察局写道：“帕尔马警察局向在这起悲惨事件中丧生的人的家人和亲人致以最深切的哀悼。”

paras.en: "There is no danger to the public," police added.
paras.zh: 警方补充说：“公众没有危险。”

paras.en: Police said the families of those killed have been notified.
paras.zh: 警方表示，已通知遇难者家属。

paras.en: The Parma Police Department's Detective Bureau is investigating the shooting.
paras.zh: 帕尔马警察局侦探局正在调查这起枪击事件。

paras.en: This is a developing story. Check back for updates.
paras.zh: 这是一个发展的故事。请回来查看更新。

articles.title: Georgia has top College Football Playoff seed in sight with dominating road win over No 21 South Carolina

paras.en: Georgia showed exactly why it is the top-ranked team in college football on Saturday.
paras.zh: 佐治亚州在周六准确地展示了为什么它是大学橄榄球排名第一的球队。

paras.en: The Bulldogs beat No. 21 South Carolina 34-6 at Williams-Brice Stadium, as the Georgia defense suffocated the Gamecocks' offense. With the win, Georgia now has the top spot in the College Football Playoff firmly in their grasp.
paras.zh: 斗牛犬队在威廉姆斯-布莱斯体育场以 34-6 击败排名第 21 的南卡罗来纳州队，佐治亚州的防守压制了雄斗鸡队的进攻。凭借这场胜利，乔治亚州现在牢牢掌握了大学橄榄球季后赛的头名位置。

paras.en: South Carolina had just 218 yards of offense on the day. South Carolina star quarterback LaNorris Sellers was held in check, as he completed just 10 of 18 passes for 87 yards and a touchdown.
paras.zh: 南卡罗来纳州当天的进攻码数仅为 218 码。南卡罗来纳州明星四分卫拉诺里斯·塞勒斯（LaNorris Sellers）受到了限制，他 18 次传球仅完成 10 次，推进 87 码并达阵。

paras.en: While South Carolina's offense never quite got out of the gate, it took Georgia a little bit of time to get things rolling.
paras.zh: 虽然南卡罗来纳州的进攻从未完全起步，但佐治亚州花了一点时间才开始行动。

paras.en: The Gamecocks opened the game with a field goal, and the Bulldogs responded with a first-quarter field goal of their own, tying the game 3-3. South Carolina also converted a field goal on their second drive, going up 6-3.
paras.zh: 雄斗鸡队以一记射门拉开比赛序幕，而斗牛犬队在第一节也以一记射门回应，将比分扳成3-3平。南卡罗来纳州在第二次进攻中也投进一球，以 6-3 领先。

paras.en: The Bulldogs' offense didn't find the end zone until later in the second quarter, when it capped off a 10-play, 88-yard drive with a Nate Frazier touchdown, giving Georgia a 10-6 lead going into halftime.
paras.zh: 直到第二节晚些时候，斗牛犬队的进攻才找到达阵区，内特·弗雷泽 (Nate Frazier) 达阵完成 10 次进攻，完成 88 码冲球，乔治亚队在半场结束时以 10-6 领先。

paras.en: Georgia got the ball to begin the third quarter, and they broke through with an explosive play. On third-and-2, quarterback Gunner Stockton found tight end Jaden Reddell for a 66-yard completion that brought Georgia to South Carolina's 1-yard line.
paras.zh: 乔治亚队在第三节开始时拿到球权，他们以爆发力的表现取得突破。在第三和第二处，四分卫枪手斯托克顿找到了近端锋贾登·雷德尔，完成了 66 码的射门，将佐治亚州带到了南卡罗来纳州的 1 码线。

paras.en: A couple of plays later, Frazier punched the ball into the end zone for his second touchdown of the game, putting Georgia up 17-6. Later in the third quarter, the Bulldogs tacked on another field goal to go up 20-6.
paras.zh: 几次比赛后，弗雷泽将球击入达阵区，完成本场比赛的第二次达阵，乔治亚队以 17-6 领先。第三节晚些时候，斗牛犬队再进一球，以20-6领先。

paras.en: The Bulldogs effectively put the game away when they marched down the field with an 11-play, 91-yard touchdown drive in the fourth quarter. Wide receiver Craig Dandridge scored a 14-yard touchdown on a play fake that had South Carolina's defense fooled, putting Georgia up 27-6.
paras.zh: 斗牛犬队在第四节以 11 次进攻、91 码达阵冲锋，有效地结束了比赛。外接手克雷格·丹德里奇 (Craig Dandridge) 假动作完成 14 码达阵，愚弄了南卡罗来纳州的防守，乔治亚州以 27-6 领先。

paras.en: Georgia tacked on another touchdown at the end of the fourth quarter to go up 34-6, as they scored 31 unanswered points after falling behind 6-3.
paras.zh: 乔治亚队在第四节结束时再次达阵，以34-6领先，在6-3落后的情况下拿下31分。

paras.en: Frazier had 23 carries for 94 yards and two touchdowns on the day for Georgia.
paras.zh: 弗雷泽当天为佐治亚队完成 23 次冲球推进 94 码并两次达阵。

paras.en: Georgia plays rival Georgia Tech in their next game on Saturday, and a win would all but guarantee the top seed in the College Football Playoff.
paras.zh: 佐治亚州将在周六的下一场比赛中迎战对手佐治亚理工学院，如果获胜，几乎就能保证大学橄榄球季后赛的头号种子。

articles.title: Police say man whose body lay undiscovered in Sydney bushland for 12 days was killed in suspected hit-and-run
articles.author: Australian Associated Press

paras.en: The twin brother of a man whose body lay undiscovered for 12 days after he was killed in a suspected hit and run in Sydney says it has left him feeling like half a person.
paras.zh: 一名男子在悉尼涉嫌肇事逃逸事件中丧生，尸体长达 12 天无人发现，他的双胞胎兄弟表示，这让他感觉自己像个半人。

paras.en: Joshua Howard was last seen at a bus interchange in Parramatta, in western Sydney, about 10pm on 7 November.
paras.zh: 约书亚·霍华德最后一次出现是在 11 月 7 日晚上 10 点左右，出现在悉尼西部帕拉马塔的一个公交车换乘站。

paras.en: The 31-year-old was reported missing the following day and detectives later established he had been walking along Garfield Street East in Rouse Hill, in the city’s north-west, about 12.45 that morning.
paras.zh: 据报道，这名 31 岁的男子第二天失踪，侦探们后来证实，那天早上 12 点 45 分左右，他一直在该市西北部劳斯山的加菲尔德东街散步。

paras.en: An extensive search for began in the Rouse Hill area on Thursday with help from Blue Mountains Rescue, the New South Wales State Emergency Service and the Rural Fire Service.
paras.zh: 周四，在蓝山救援队、新南威尔士州紧急服务局和乡村消防局的帮助下，劳斯山地区开始了广泛的搜寻工作。

paras.en: His body was found by police in a bushland gully near Windsor Road in Rouse Hill about 2.45pm on Friday.
paras.zh: 周五下午2点45分左右，警方在劳斯山温莎路附近的丛林沟壑中发现了他的尸体。

paras.en: Superintendent Jason Joyce said police believe Howard was hit by a car as he was making his way home from a friend’s Diwali party.
paras.zh: 警司杰森·乔伊斯表示，警方相信霍华德在从朋友的排灯节派对回家的路上被车撞了。

paras.en: “We believe he’s been walking along the side of the road and then been struck, and that’s propelled him over the guardrail into the bushland,” Joyce told reporters on Sunday.
paras.zh: 乔伊斯周日告诉记者：“我们相信他当时沿着路边行走，然后被撞了，这导致他越过护栏进入丛林。”

paras.en: “Based on his injuries … we believe there was some level of force of him being struck by the vehicle.”
paras.zh: “根据他的伤势……我们相信他被车辆撞击时受到了一定程度的力量。”

paras.en: It took police 11 days to start the land search because they were initially trying to track Howard’s movements through CCTV footage and doorknocking houses in the area, Joyce said.
paras.zh: 乔伊斯说，警方花了 11 天才开始土地搜查，因为他们最初试图通过闭路电视录像和该地区的敲门房屋来追踪霍华德的行踪。

paras.en: Howard’s parents, Peter and Sue, described him as a loving son and sibling to his twin David and older brother Matthew.
paras.zh: 霍华德的父母彼得和苏形容他是双胞胎大卫和哥哥马修的慈爱儿子和兄弟姐妹。

paras.en: He was a talented artist who graduated from the National Art School and always carried a sketchbook and pen with him, they said.
paras.zh: 他们说，他是一位才华横溢的艺术家，毕业于国立艺术学校，总是随身带着素描本和笔。

paras.en: “When he was missing, David went through his room to see whether all those books were gone,” Sue Howard told reporters.
paras.zh: “当他失踪时，大卫检查了他的房间，看看所有的书是否都消失了，”苏·霍华德告诉记者。

paras.en: “But they were all there, indicating he was coming home that night.”
paras.zh: “但他们都在那里，表明他那天晚上就要回家了。”

paras.en: She said her family was heartbroken to learn they had likely driven past him the day after he was killed, without knowing his body was there.
paras.zh: 她说，当她的家人得知他们很可能在他被杀的第二天开车经过他时，不知道他的尸体就在那里，他们伤心欲绝。

paras.en: “Our poor boy was there for 12 days,” she said.
paras.zh: “我们可怜的男孩在那里呆了 12 天，”她说。

paras.en: She said David was particularly devastated, telling her: “I feel as if I’m half a person now.”
paras.zh: 她说大卫特别伤心，告诉她：“我感觉我现在好像是半个人了。”

paras.en: Peter Howard pleaded for anyone with information about the suspected hit and run to contact police.
paras.zh: 彼得·霍华德恳求任何有关于涉嫌肇事逃逸信息的人与警方联系。

paras.en: “We don’t want Joshua’s passing to be wasted,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们不希望约书亚的去世被浪费，”他说。

paras.en: “We want drivers to know the impact of speeding or whatever happened.
paras.zh: “我们希望司机知道超速或发生任何事情的影响。

paras.en: “Think of others. Stop. Ring triple zero and take responsibility for [your] own actions.”
paras.zh: “为他人着想。停下来。按三个零，为自己的行为负责。”

articles.title: Europe is entering a ‘supercycle’ of national elections. Their outcomes could shake the EU’s foundations
articles.author: Jon Henley Europe correspondent

paras.en: In late 1998, Tony Blair was prime minister of Britain, Lionel Jospin was prime minister of France, and Gerhard Schröder had just been elected chancellor of Germany. The EU had 15 member states and pro-European, centre-left parties were in power – either alone or in coalitions – in all but two of them.
paras.zh: 1998年底，托尼·布莱尔担任英国首相，莱昂内尔·若斯潘担任法国总理，格哈德·施罗德刚刚当选德国总理。欧盟有 15 个成员国，除两个成员国外，所有成员国均由亲欧洲的中左翼政党单独或联合执政。

paras.en: Brisk economic growth was lifting living standards. Eastward enlargement was under way. In Washington, Bill Clinton was pursuing the same brand of “third way” centrism as a middle path between free-market capitalism and traditional socialism. The EU felt like it had the tide of history behind it.
paras.zh: 强劲的经济增长正在提高生活水平。东扩正在进行中。在华盛顿，比尔·克林顿追求的是同样品牌的“第三条道路”中间主义，作为自由市场资本主义和传统社会主义之间的中间道路。欧盟感觉自己背后有历史的潮流。

paras.en: Not quite three decades later, the continent’s politics once again seem to be tilting in a single direction – except this time, the momentum appears to belong to the nationalist far right, and could bring a significant unpicking of the postwar European consensus that built the EU.
paras.zh: 不到三十年后，欧洲大陆的政治似乎再次向单一方向倾斜——只不过这一次，这一势头似乎属于民族主义极右翼，并可能导致战后建立欧盟的欧洲共识遭到重大破坏。

paras.en: Between the end of this month and the end of next year, an extraordinary electoral sequence will sweep the bloc. Voters in four of the EU’s five biggest member states, by population and economy, head to the polls, with parliamentary elections also due in Estonia, Finland, Greece and Slovakia, and regional ballots in Germany.
paras.zh: 从本月底到明年年底，欧盟将迎来一系列非同寻常的选举。按人口和经济计算，欧盟五个最大成员国中的四个国家的选民将前往投票站，爱沙尼亚、芬兰、希腊和斯洛伐克也将举行议会选举，德国也将举行地区投票。

paras.en: Spain kicks off the cycle with a snap general election on 29 November, with prime minister Pedro Sánchez’s socialist coalition facing probable defeat to rightwing parties in the shape of the conservative People’s party (PP) and far-right Vox, which already govern together in some Spanish regions.
paras.zh: 西班牙于 11 月 29 日提前举行大选，拉开了这一周期的序幕，首相佩德罗·桑切斯领导的社会主义联盟可能会输给保守派人民党 (PP) 和极右翼 Vox 等右翼政党，这两个政党已经在西班牙一些地区共同执政。

paras.en: Next come presidential and parliamentary elections in France in the spring. The clear frontrunner in the presidential race is Marine Le Pen of far-right the National Rally (RN), well ahead of the far-left firebrand Jean-Luc Mélenchon and a hopelessly divided mainstream opposition.
paras.zh: 接下来是法国春季的总统和议会选举。总统竞选中明显的领跑者是极右翼全国集会（RN）的马琳·勒庞（Marine Le Pen），远远领先于极左煽动者让-吕克·梅朗雄（Jean-Luc Mélenchon）和分裂严重的主流反对派。

paras.en: When Poland votes later next year, nationalist parties that between them command nearly half the national vote could well unseat the liberal coalition of prime minister, Donald Tusk, despite recent splits. And in Italy, Giorgia Meloni, whose Brothers of Italy party has far-right roots, hopes to secure a second term in elections due before the end of 2027 – while facing pressure on her right flank from the upstart National Future party.
paras.zh: 当波兰明年晚些时候进行投票时，尽管最近出现了分裂，但占据全国近一半选票的民族主义政党很可能会推翻总理唐纳德·图斯克领导的自由派联盟。在意大利，乔治亚·梅洛尼（Giorgia Meloni）的意大利兄弟党有着极右根源，她希望在 2027 年底前举行的选举中获得连任，同时她的右翼面临来自新贵国家未来党的压力。

paras.en: Paradoxically, this nationalist surge arrives amid strong public support for the EU. Shocked by the chaos of Brexit and seeking reassurance in an increasingly alarming world, a record 74% of Europeans say their country benefits from membership, and very few Eurosceptic parties now advocate leaving outright.
paras.zh: 矛盾的是，这种民族主义浪潮却是在公众对欧盟的强烈支持之际出现的。由于对英国脱欧的混乱感到震惊，并在日益令人担忧的世界中寻求安慰，创纪录的 74% 的欧洲人表示，他们的国家从英国脱欧中受益，而且现在很少有欧洲怀疑论政党主张彻底脱欧。

paras.en: The Eurosceptics and nationalists do, however, still view the bloc as a top-down project that undermines national sovereignty, and aim to transform it into an altogether looser association of sovereign nation-states. In the words of the Italian political scientist Natalie Tocci, that means this coming electoral supercycle could “dramatically change the face of Europe” – triggering not simply “a slow erosion of the European project but a hollowing out, if not an outright implosion”.
paras.zh: 然而，欧洲怀疑论者和民族主义者仍然认为欧盟是一个自上而下的项目，会损害国家主权，并旨在将其转变为一个完全松散的主权民族国家联盟。用意大利政治学家娜塔莉·托奇的话说，这意味着即将到来的选举超级周期可能“极大地改变欧洲的面貌” — — 不仅引发“欧洲计划的缓慢侵蚀，而且即使不是彻底的内爆，也会造成空心化”。

paras.en: All elections differ and national specifics loom large. But analysts agree the underlying forces at work here are connected: sluggish growth, ageing populations, strained public finances and a spiralling cost of living have chipped away at support for Europe’s traditional catch-all centre-left and centre-right parties. The wave of youth-led protests sweeping Europe is only the most visible sign of deep voter discontent.
paras.zh: 所有选举都不同，国家具体情况也很突出。但分析人士一致认为，这里起作用的潜在力量是相互关联的：增长缓慢、人口老龄化、公共财政紧张以及生活成本不断上升，削弱了对欧洲传统的中左翼和中右翼政党的支持。席卷欧洲的青年主导的抗议浪潮只是选民深感不满的最明显迹象。

paras.en: Meanwhile, nationalist parties have become increasingly adept at conjuring and exploiting an ever-evolving list of supposed threats and crises, from migration and vaccines to the green transition, support for Ukraine, globalisation, international elites and supranational institutions – narratives bolstered by Russian disinformation and overt backing for “patriotic” parties from Donald Trump’s White House. As a result, politics has fragmented, and polarised: nearly one in four voters now backs far-right parties – a share that has grown almost fivefold since the mid-1990s.
paras.zh: 与此同时，民族主义政党越来越善于制造和利用一系列不断变化的所谓威胁和危机，从移民和疫苗到绿色转型、对乌克兰的支持、全球化、国际精英和超国家机构 — — 这些说法得到了俄罗斯虚假信息和唐纳德·特朗普白宫对“爱国”政党的公开支持。结果，政治出现了分裂和两极分化：现在有近四分之一的选民支持极右翼政党 — — 这一比例自 20 世纪 90 年代中期以来几乎增长了五倍。

paras.en: The rise has not been linear: over the past year or so, while the far-right Alternative für Deutschland scored a historic regional election victory in eastern Germany, in the Netherlands Geert Wilders’s Freedom party lost nearly a third of its seats, Viktor Orbán’s Fidesz was soundly beaten in Hungary and the far-right Sweden Democrats shed support for the first time in 16 years.
paras.zh: 这种上升并不是线性的：在过去一年左右的时间里，虽然极右翼的德国新选择党在德国东部取得了历史性的地区选举胜利，但在荷兰，基尔特·维尔德斯的自由党失去了近三分之一的席位，维克多·欧尔班的青民盟在匈牙利惨败，极右翼的瑞典民主党16年来首次失去支持。

paras.en: But the underlying upward trend appears clear – fuelled above all, political scientists argue, by media normalisation and mainstreaming of far-right ideas, most notably on immigration. Centre-right parties are gradually dismantling “firewalls” that once barred cooperation with the radical right. At the European level, the centre-right European People’s party has increasingly turned to farther-right groups to roll back parts of the European green deal and tighten migration rules.
paras.zh: 但潜在的上升趋势似乎很明显 — — 政治学家认为，这首先是由媒体正常化和极右思想主流化（尤其是在移民问题上）推动的。中右翼政党正在逐步拆除曾经禁止与极右翼合作的“防火墙”。在欧洲层面，中右翼欧洲人民党越来越多地转向极右翼团体，以推翻欧洲绿色协议的部分内容并收紧移民规则。

paras.en: For the EU, the biggest impact of this election supercycle could be in the European Council of national leaders, which now features just three centre-left heads of government out of 27. If Eurosceptic leaders in France, Spain and Poland join those of Czechia, Italy, Romania, Slovakia and Slovenia by the end of 2027, they would not have the numbers to rewrite EU law – but they would constitute a formidable blocking minority.
paras.zh: 对于欧盟来说，这次选举超级周期的最大影响可能是由国家领导人组成的欧洲理事会，目前该理事会的 27 名政府首脑中只有 3 名中左翼政府首脑。如果法国、西班牙和波兰的疑欧派领导人在 2027 年底前加入捷克、意大利、罗马尼亚、斯洛伐克和斯洛文尼亚的行列，他们将没有足够的人数来重写欧盟法律 — — 但他们将构成强大的阻碍性少数派。

paras.en: EU budget negotiations, future enlargement, aid to Ukraine and deeper integration in essential fields such as defence, energy, finance and technology could all face paralysis, analysts warn.
paras.zh: 分析人士警告称，欧盟预算谈判、未来扩员、对乌克兰的援助以及国防、能源、金融和技术等重要领域的更深层次一体化都可能面临瘫痪。

paras.en: Safety in numbers, notes Tocci, could change current leaders’ behaviour in the council. Meloni’s relative restraint has been dictated, in part, by her relative isolation among mainstream peers such as Tusk, Sánchez and France’s Emmanuel Macron (alongside Rome’s reliance on €200bn in EU recovery funds).
paras.zh: 托奇指出，人数安全可以改变现任领导人在理事会中的行为。梅洛尼的相对克制部分是由于她在图斯克、桑切斯和法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙等主流同行中相对孤立（此外罗马还依赖 2000 亿欧元的欧盟复苏基金）。

paras.en: If she were instead sitting down with the likes of Le Pen, Poland’s far-right Law and Justice (PiS) leader, Jarosław Kaczyński, and a Vox-backed Spanish government, with National Future’s hardline Roberto Vannacci breathing down her neck at home and those EU funds winding down, she might have less incentive to play pro-EU ball.
paras.zh: 如果她与勒庞、波兰极右翼法律与正义（PiS）领导人雅罗斯瓦夫·卡钦斯基（Jarosław Kaczyński）以及Vox支持的西班牙政府坐在一起，而“国家未来”的强硬派罗伯托·万纳奇（Roberto Vannacci）在国内对她进行紧逼，而那些欧盟资金也逐渐减少，她可能就没有动力支持欧盟了。

paras.en: Analysts agree, though, that the decisive battleground is France. Le Pen’s election platform sets her on a collision course with Brussels: she aims to cut €11bn from France’s EU budget contribution, hold a constitutional referendum to proclaim the supremacy of French over European law, and breach various single-market rules.
paras.zh: 不过，分析人士一致认为，决定性的战场是法国。勒庞的选举纲领让她与布鲁塞尔发生冲突：她的目标是削减法国向欧盟的预算贡献110亿欧元，举行宪法公投以宣布法国对欧洲法律的至高无上，并违反各种单一市场规则。

paras.en: And France “carries very significant influence over the EU”, said Mujtaba Rahman of the Eurasia Group consultancy. Compared with Orbán, he notes, a president Le Pen would have “far more leverage to carry out the far-right playbook of subverting the EU’s law-based, supranational architecture”.
paras.zh: 欧亚集团咨询公司的穆吉塔巴·拉赫曼表示，法国“对欧盟具有非常重大的影响力”。他指出，与欧尔班相比，勒庞总统将“拥有更大的影响力来实施颠覆欧盟基于法律的超国家架构的极右策略”。

paras.en: Until now, Brussels has contained disruptors such as Orbán largely because there were rarely more than two or three round the table. A cohesive Eurosceptic bloc would leave the EU unable to enforce rule-of-law standards, further integrate economic and security policies or, indeed, agree on anything much at all. The first victim would very probably be Ukraine, with Le Pen leading a blocking caucus against further aid.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，布鲁塞尔一直遏制着欧尔班这样的破坏者，很大程度上是因为参加会议的人很少超过两到三个。一个有凝聚力的欧洲怀疑论集团将使欧盟无法执行法治标准、进一步整合经济和安全政策，或者实际上无法就任何事情达成一致。第一个受害者很可能是乌克兰，勒庞领导的党团会议反对进一步的援助。

paras.en: Three decades on from 1998, Europe’s coming elections, concluded Stefan Lehne of the Carnegie Europe thinktank, could well turn into “key tests of the EU’s resilience”. The threat to the bloc might not be immediate or existential, he said, but the medium-term risks were significant.
paras.zh: 卡内基欧洲智库的斯特凡·莱恩 (Stefan Lehne) 总结道，自 1998 年以来的三十年过去了，欧洲即将举行的选举很可能会成为“对欧盟韧性的关键考验”。他表示，对欧盟的威胁可能不是直接的或存在的，但中期风险是巨大的。

paras.en: “A stronger role for the radical right may be unlikely to dismantle the EU as it exists today,” Lehne said, but could “prevent it from becoming what it needs to be to deal with the challenges of the future”. And gradually but inevitably, prolonged failure to act collectively as and where needed would lead a “loss of relevance”.
paras.zh: 莱恩表示：“激进右翼发挥更强大的作用可能不太可能解散现有的欧盟，但可能会“阻止它成为应对未来挑战所需的样子”。逐渐但不可避免的是，长期未能在需要时采取集体行动将导致“失去相关性”。

articles.title: ‘Serious error of judgment’: outrage over military AI event at Berlin arts complex
articles.author: Philip Oltermann European culture editor

paras.en: With their cavernous post-industrial venues, teeth-grinding four-by-four beats and bouncers that look like Blade Runner extras, Berlin’s nightclubs trade on a reputation for bleakness. A recent event at one of the city’s most legendary clubland institutions, however, has proven too dystopian even for seasoned techno-heads.
paras.zh: 柏林的夜总会有着巨大的后工业场所、令人咬牙切齿的四乘四节拍和看起来像银翼杀手的临时演员，柏林的夜总会以暗淡着称。然而，最近在这座城市最具传奇色彩的俱乐部机构之一举办的一场活动，即使对于经验丰富的技术头脑来说，也被证明过于反乌托邦。

paras.en: On 11 November, the Kraftwerk Berlin arts complex had its central hall transformed into what visitors described as something resembling a war room, with maps and aerial footage projected on to concrete walls, drones hanging from the ceiling, and guards in flak jackets patrolling the premises with sniffer dogs.
paras.zh: 11 月 11 日，柏林发电站艺术中心的中央大厅被改造成了游客所说的类似作战室的地方，地图和航拍镜头投射到混凝土墙上，无人机悬挂在天花板上，身着防弹衣的警卫带着嗅探犬在场内巡逻。

paras.en: Those who flocked to the venue – which hosts the experimental music festival Atonal and is part of the same complex as the techno club Tresor – had come for the launch of Clarity, an AI targeting system developed by the German arms startup Helsing.
paras.zh: 那些涌入该场地的人是为了观看 Clarity 的发布会，该场地是实验音乐节 Atonal 的举办地，与科技俱乐部 Tresor 属于同一综合体。Clarity 是由德国军火初创公司 Helsing 开发的人工智能瞄准系统。

paras.en: Kraftwerk Berlin this week apologised for a “serious error of judgment” and vowed to revise its commercial rental department’s booking policy, after outrage over the event rippled through Berlin’s music scene. The row has raised uncomfortable questions about the commercialisation of the German capital’s famed nightlife, and the culture sector’s traditional pacifism at a time of growing security threats.
paras.zh: 柏林发电厂本周为“严重判断错误”道歉，并誓言要修改其商业租赁部门的预订政策，此前该活动激起了柏林音乐界的愤怒。这场争吵引发了人们对德国首都著名夜生活的商业化以及在安全威胁日益严重的情况下文化部门传统和平主义的质疑。

paras.en: The Munich-based Helsing was founded in 2021 and counts the Swedish tech entrepreneur and Spotify co-founder Daniel Ek among its investors and board co-chairs. On its website, it describes Clarity as an agentic intelligence platform designed to use drone, satellite and sensor data to lock on to targets.
paras.zh: 总部位于慕尼黑的 Helsing 成立于 2021 年，其投资者和董事会联合主席包括瑞典科技企业家、Spotify 联合创始人 Daniel Ek。在其网站上，它将 Clarity 描述为一个代理情报平台，旨在使用无人机、卫星和传感器数据锁定目标。

paras.en: It claims that human operators remain responsible for approving any strikes.
paras.zh: 它声称人类操作员仍然负责批准任何罢工。

paras.en: Helsing says Clarity is “developed and built in Europe under European control”. The market leader for battlefield software is Palantir’s Maven, the system that has powered US military strikes on Iran this year. European governments have been scrambling for alternatives to US-developed systems. France’s domestic intelligence service has already announced it is dropping Palantir for a homegrown rival.
paras.zh: 赫尔辛表示，Clarity 是“在欧洲控制下在欧洲开发和建造的”。战场软件的市场领导者是 Palantir 的 Maven，该系统为美国今年对伊朗的军事打击提供了动力。欧洲各国政府一直在努力寻找美国开发系统的替代品。法国国内情报部门已经宣布放弃 Palantir，转而采用本土竞争对手。

paras.en: But European governments’ boosting of their arms industries is also clashing with an anti-militaristic cultural consensus – nowhere more so than in the former cold war pressure cooker of Berlin, where nightclubs became spaces to dance away the anxieties of the arms race.
paras.zh: 但欧洲各国政府发展军火工业的做法也与反军国主义的文化共识相冲突 — — 尤其是在前冷战高压锅柏林，那里的夜总会成为人们通过跳舞来消除军备竞赛焦虑的场所。

paras.en: “The fact there is a war in Europe and that Ukraine needs German support should not mean that we switch off all our critical faculties,” said Michail Stangl, a Berlin-based music curator and DJ. “We are already seeing how AI-driven targeting systems are being used in Gaza, and it’s hard to imagine that once a company like Helsing develops a successful arms system, it would not sell it on to authoritarian regimes, domestic police, or organisations like Frontex to be used against migrants.”
paras.zh: 柏林音乐策展人兼 DJ 米哈伊尔·斯坦格尔 (Michail Stangl) 表示：“欧洲正在发生战争，乌克兰需要德国的支持，但这并不意味着我们要关闭所有关键能力。” “我们已经看到人工智能驱动的瞄准系统如何在加沙使用，很难想象一旦像 Helsing 这样的公司开发出成功的武器系统，它不会将其出售给独裁政权、国内警察或 Frontex 等组织来用来对付移民。”

paras.en: Speaking to the German broadcaster RBB at its launch event, a Helsing spokesperson said none of its military systems were designed to identify persons, and that Clarity was built to seek out objects such as radar systems, launch pads and ships.
paras.zh: 赫尔辛发言人在德国广播公司 RBB 的发布会上表示，其军事系统都不是为了识别人员而设计的，而 Clarity 是为了寻找雷达系统、发射台和船只等物体而设计的。

paras.en: It also said Clarity’s agents specialised in “looking for patterns of behaviour”, which could be interpreted as relating to human activity. Helsing did not respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 它还表示，Clarity 的特工专门从事“寻找行为模式”，这可以解释为与人类活动有关。赫尔辛没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: The Clarity launch event was condemned in the strongest terms by Tresor, a nightclub and record label that acted as a bridge between post-Wall Berlin and Detroit’s electronic music scene in the 1990s. “It has no place in the spaces our community has built,” it said in a statement.
paras.zh: Clarity 发布会遭到了 Tresor 最强烈的谴责，Tresor 是一家夜总会和唱片公司，在 20 世纪 90 年代充当了柏林墙后和底特律电子音乐界之间的桥梁。它在一份声明中表示：“它在我们社区建造的空间中没有立足之地。”

paras.en: Tresor’s founder, the Berlin nightlife entrepreneur Dietmar-Maria “Dimitri” Hegemann, is also the managing director of Kraftwerk Berlin. Hegemann has called the booking “unacceptable”, saying it was done by “a staff member at the company responsible for Kraftwerk’s commercial rental business”, without him being consulted. Given his central role at the arts complex, and the level of planning usually required for such a high-security event, this has surprised some Berlin clubland insiders.
paras.zh: Tresor 的创始人是柏林夜生活企业家 Dietmar-Maria “Dimitri” Hegemann，同时也是柏林 Kraftwerk 的董事总经理。赫格曼称这次预订“不可接受”，并称这是“负责 Kraftwerk 商业租赁业务的公司的一名工作人员”在没有咨询他的情况下完成的。考虑到他在艺术综合体中的核心作用，以及这种高度安全的活动通常所需的规划水平，这让一些柏林俱乐部内部人士感到惊讶。

paras.en: That Berlin’s former underground music venues are rented out for commercial purposes is no longer a deviation from the norm. As recently as 19 October, Kraftwerk Berlin hosted an investment summit organised by the German government and featuring a podium discussion between the chancellor, Friedrich Merz, and the chip manufacturer Nvidia’s then chief executive, Jensen Huang.
paras.zh: 柏林以前的地下音乐场所被出租用于商业目的，这已不再是一种偏离常态的现象。就在 10 月 19 日，柏林发电站主办了一场由德国政府组织的投资峰会，德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨 (Friedrich Merz) 和芯片制造商英伟达 (Nvidia) 时任首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 在讲台上进行了讨论。

paras.en: In a Q&A released after the Clarity row, Kraftwerk Berlin said it had declined a proposed Palantir-sponsored event in 2022 after consulting its cultural teams.
paras.zh: 在 Clarity 事件后发布的问答中，Kraftwerk Berlin 表示，在咨询其文化团队后，该公司拒绝了 Palantir 于 2022 年赞助的活动。

paras.en: Defenders of such commercial usages point out that many of Berlin’s nightclubs are struggling with rising rents and plummeting bar revenues. Kraftwerk Berlin may not be one of them, however. The total assets of its operating company, Schaltraum Berlin, were reported in June as having a value of €4.3m (£3.6m).
paras.zh: 此类商业用途的捍卫者指出，柏林的许多夜总会都在面临租金上涨和酒吧收入直线下降的困境。然而，柏林发电厂可能不是其中之一。据 6 月份报道，其运营公司 Schaltraum Berlin 的总资产价值为 430 万欧元（360 万英镑）。

articles.title: Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out

paras.en: A Mexican drug lord who was on the FBI's 10 most wanted list has been arrested following a shoot-out with Mexican authorities.
paras.zh: 美国联邦调查局十大通缉名单上的一名墨西哥毒枭在与墨西哥当局发生枪战后被捕。

paras.en: Fausto Isidro "Chapo Isidro" Meza Flores and seven others were detained by Mexican special forces in Guasave, Sinaloa on Friday, Mexico's defence secretariat said.
paras.zh: 墨西哥国防部秘书处称，福斯托·伊西德罗·“矮子伊西德罗”·梅萨·弗洛雷斯和其他七人周五在锡那罗亚州瓜萨维被墨西哥特种部队拘留。

paras.en: Seven suspects were killed in the operation, as were four members of the Mexican army who were travelling to reinforce security in Guasave, the secretariat added.
paras.zh: 秘书处补充说，七名嫌疑人在行动中被打死，四名前往瓜萨韦加强安全的墨西哥军队成员也被打死。

paras.en: Meza Flores was wanted in Mexico on organised crime charges, while he has been accused of "flooding the US with fentanyl, cocaine, heroin and other deadly drugs" by the FBI. The US is seeking his extradition.
paras.zh: 梅萨·弗洛雷斯因有组织犯罪指控在墨西哥被通缉，而联邦调查局则指控他“向美国大量输送芬太尼、可卡因、海洛因和其他致命毒品”。美国正在寻求引渡他。

paras.en: Mexico has stepped up efforts to tackle drug-related crime after coming under pressure from US President Donald Trump since he returned to the White House.
paras.zh: 自美国总统唐纳德·特朗普重返白宫以来，墨西哥在其压力下加大了打击毒品相关犯罪的力度。

paras.en: Meza Flores, the leader of the Meza Flores Organisation, also known as the Guasave Cartel, is thought to have been active in the drug trafficking trade since the 1990s but managed to evade authorities till now by maintaining a relatively low profile.
paras.zh: 梅萨·弗洛雷斯 (Meza Flores) 是梅萨·弗洛雷斯组织 (Meza Flores Organization)（又名 Guasave 卡特尔）的领导人，据信自 20 世纪 90 年代以来一直活跃于贩毒行业，但迄今为止一直保持相对低调，设法逃避当局的追捕。

paras.en: Using US intelligence on his whereabouts, Mexican special forces descended on his location using "stealth and surprise", establishing a perimeter to prevent him from escaping and reinforcements arriving, Mexico's defence secretariat said.
paras.zh: 墨西哥国防秘书处表示，墨西哥特种部队利用美国关于他行踪的情报，以“秘密和突然”方式袭击了他的所在地，建立了一个边界，以防止他逃跑和增援部队抵达。

paras.en: However, they "came under attack from gunfire and explosives" before entering the property and arresting Meza Flores, the secretariat continued.
paras.zh: 然而，秘书处继续说，他们在进入该房产并逮捕梅萨·弗洛雷斯之前“遭到枪击和爆炸物的袭击”。

paras.en: Videos circulating online appear to show helicopters firing streams of bullets towards the ground in Guasave. Others appear to show people at a baseball stadium fleeing as they hear shooting sounds.
paras.zh: 网上流传的视频似乎显示，直升机向瓜萨韦的地面发射子弹流。其他照片似乎显示棒球场里的人们听到枪声后纷纷逃跑。

paras.en: Eight people in total were arrested, including Meza Flores' second-in-command, who is also his cousin, and his brother-in-law, who is the group's financial operator, the secretariat added.
paras.zh: 秘书处补充说，共有八人被捕，其中包括梅萨·弗洛雷斯的二号人物（也是他的表弟）和他的妹夫（该组织的金融运营商）。

paras.en: Meza Flores, his cousin, and his brother-in-law were flown to Mexico City to face prosecution, the defence secretariat said. The other five remained in the state of Sinaloa.
paras.zh: 国防部秘书处称，梅萨·弗洛雷斯、他的表弟和姐夫已飞往墨西哥城接受起诉。另外五个留在锡那罗亚州。

paras.en: Authorities also said they had seized multiple weapons during the operation, including a grenade launcher, as well as drugs and cash.
paras.zh: 当局还表示，他们在行动中缴获了多件武器，包括榴弹发射器，以及毒品和现金。

paras.en: The US Consulate General in the city of Hermosillo said it was "monitoring reports of ongoing security operations, armed clashes, road blockades, and vehicle fires that occurred overnight in Ahome, GuamÃºchil, Guasave, and Navolato" following the arrest of Meza-Flores.â¯
paras.zh: 美国驻埃莫西约市总领事馆表示，在梅萨-弗洛雷斯被捕后，它正在“监测阿霍姆、瓜马奇尔、瓜萨韦和纳沃拉托夜间发生的安全行动、武装冲突、道路封锁和车辆火灾的报告”。

paras.en: It advised US citizens to remain alert for potential violence in the area and for residents to remain sheltered in place.
paras.zh: 它建议美国公民对该地区潜在的暴力保持警惕，并建议居民留在原地避难。

paras.en: When Meza Flores was added to the FBI's most-wanted list in 2025, he was accused of "heinous crimes" including kidnapping, extortion and torture.
paras.zh: 2025 年，当梅萨·弗洛雷斯 (Meza Flores) 被列入联邦调查局 (FBI) 通缉名单时，他被指控犯有绑架、勒索和酷刑等“令人发指的罪行”。

paras.en: Then-acting FBI director Brian Driscoll said Meza Flores and his organisation had also unleashed a "scourge of illicit drugs" into the US via its southern border with Mexico.
paras.zh: 时任联邦调查局代理局长布莱恩·德里斯科尔表示，梅萨·弗洛雷斯和他的组织还通过美国南部与墨西哥的边境向美国释放了“非法毒品祸害”。

paras.en: He was initially charged with drug trafficking in the US in 2012 before being charged again in 2019.
paras.zh: 他最初于 2012 年在美国被指控犯有贩毒罪，然后于 2019 年再次受到指控。

paras.en: The 44-year-old is alleged to have conspired to manufacture and distribute large quantities of cocaine, heroin, methamphetamine and marijuana between 2005 and 2019.
paras.zh: 这名 44 岁的男子被指控在 2005 年至 2019 年间密谋制造和分销大量可卡因、海洛因、甲基苯丙胺和大麻。

paras.en: Meza Flores was originally a high-ranking member of the BeltrÃ¡n Leyva Organization, but a split between rival factions led to a surge of violence and prompted him to establish his own cartel by 2013.
paras.zh: 梅萨·弗洛雷斯原本是贝尔特兰·雷瓦组织的高级成员，但敌对派系之间的分裂导致暴力事件激增，并促使他在 2013 年建立了自己的卡特尔。

paras.en: His organisation has also engaged in what US officials described as an "extremely violent turf war" with the Sinaloa Cartel, one of the most powerful drug trafficking gangs, which operates in the same region.
paras.zh: 他的组织还与锡那罗亚贩毒集团进行了美国官员所说的“极其暴力的地盘争夺战”，锡那罗亚贩毒集团是在同一地区活动的最强大的贩毒团伙之一。

paras.en: Meza Flores was added to the FBI's most-wanted list after Mexican authorities reportedly linked his cartel to 20 million fentanyl pills they seized in 2024.
paras.zh: 据报道，墨西哥当局将梅萨·弗洛雷斯 (Meza Flores) 的贩毒集团与 2024 年查获的 2000 万粒芬太尼药丸联系起来，之后梅萨·弗洛雷斯 (Meza Flores) 被列入联邦调查局 (FBI) 的头号通缉名单。

paras.en: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum has taken a tougher stance on the country's cartels in a bid to resist US intervention on Mexican soil. Mexico has welcomed closer collaboration but resisted US boots on the ground.
paras.zh: 墨西哥总统克劳迪娅·谢因鲍姆对该国卡特尔采取了更强硬的立场，以抵制美国对墨西哥领土的干预。墨西哥欢迎更密切的合作，但拒绝美国的实地介入。

paras.en: Trump made stemming the flow of drugs into the US across its southern border one of his key election pledges.
paras.zh: 特朗普将阻止毒品越过南部边境流入美国作为他的主要竞选承诺之一。

articles.title: Dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory

paras.en: At least three people have been killed and 36 were still missing after a fire at a confectionary factory in western Java on Saturday.
paras.zh: 周六爪哇西部一家糖果厂发生火灾，造成至少 3 人死亡、36 人失踪。

paras.en: Firefighters were still tackling some flames on Sunday, while rescuers searched for the missing in parts of the damaged building where workers were believed to be trapped.
paras.zh: 周日，消防队员仍在扑灭部分大火，救援人员则在受损建筑的部分区域寻找失踪人员，据信那里有工人被困。

paras.en: Indonesia's National Search and Rescue Agency said on Sunday 15 survivors had been located, and four others taken to hospital and a local clinic with undisclosed injuries.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚国家搜救机构周日表示，已找到 15 名幸存者，另外四人被送往医院和当地一家诊所，伤势不明。

paras.en: The factory is in Serang district, Banten province, about 50km west of Jakarta. Authorities have not yet determined the fire's cause.
paras.zh: 该工厂位于万丹省Serang区，距雅加达以西约50公里。当局尚未确定起火原因。

paras.en: Banten Governor, Andra Soni, told media about 60 people were believed to be inside the factory when it caught fire.
paras.zh: 万丹省长安德拉·索尼 (Andra Soni) 告诉媒体，工厂起火时，据信约有 60 人在工厂内。

paras.en: Photos and footage of the scene showed the large factory taken over by flames during the night, firefighters battling the flames, and first responders retrieving at least one body from the wreckage on Sunday morning.
paras.zh: 现场的照片和录像显示，这家大型工厂在夜间被大火吞噬，消防队员正在与火焰搏斗，周日早上，急救人员从废墟中找到了至少一具尸体。

paras.en: "All members of the joint SAR team are making every effort to locate the missing victims while prioritising the safety of personnel on the ground," the rescue agency said.
paras.zh: 救援机构表示：“联合搜救队的所有成员正在尽一切努力寻找失踪的遇难者，同时优先考虑地面人员的安全。”

paras.en: Relatives of the missing workers had gathered outside the factory waiting for updates, according to local broadcasts cited by AFP.
paras.zh: 据法新社援引当地广播报道，失踪工人的亲属聚集在工厂外等待最新消息。

paras.en: Firefighters had been called to the building at 1630 local time (0930 GMT) but it was already engulfed in flames, broadcaster Kompas TV reported, citing fire official Tubugas Machfudz.
paras.zh: 据广播公司 Kompas TV 援引消防官员 Tubugas Machfudz 的话说，消防队员于当地时间 1630 点（格林尼治标准时间 0930）被呼叫到该建筑，但该建筑已被火焰吞没。

paras.en: "When we arrived (on location)... a large area was already on fire. So we could not determine whether the company's protection system was functioning properly or not," he said.
paras.zh: “当我们到达（现场）时......一大片区域已经着火。因此我们无法确定公司的保护系统是否正常运行，”他说。

paras.en: The factory is owned by PT Fonusa Agung Mulia, according to search and rescue authorities.
paras.zh: 据搜救部门称，该工厂归 PT Fonusa Agung Mulia 所有。

paras.en: On LinkedIn the company describes itself as a subsidiary of UNIFAM, one of Indonesia's largest food and beverage companies.
paras.zh: 在 LinkedIn 上，该公司将自己描述为 UNIFAM 的子公司，UNIFAM 是印度尼西亚最大的食品和饮料公司之一。

articles.title: New draft deal aims to avert collapse of talks at climate summit

paras.en: Talks were set to resume at the UN COP31 summit on Sunday for a second day of overtime as countries struggled to reach a new global climate deal.
paras.zh: 由于各国努力达成新的全球气候协议，谈判定于周日在联合国 COP31 峰会上恢复，进入加班第二天。

paras.en: A new draft agreement was published in the early hours of Sunday which the Turkey and Australia co-hosts hoped would bridge the divide between nations.
paras.zh: 周日凌晨公布了一份新的协议草案，土耳其和澳大利亚共同主办国希望该草案能够弥合国家之间的分歧。

paras.en: Although it still includes no specific reference to "transitioning away from fossil fuels" - an omission in the previous draft that sparked threats of walkouts - it does acknowledge a previous commitment made by countries to do just that three years ago.
paras.zh: 尽管它仍然没有具体提到“摆脱化石燃料”——上一份草案中的这一遗漏引发了罢工威胁——但它确实承认了各国在三年前做出的承诺。

paras.en: And it includes for the first time a recognition that the world is on track to miss the crucial goal of keeping temperatures below 1.5C of warming.
paras.zh: 它还首次认识到世界可能无法实现将气温上升幅度控制在 1.5 摄氏度以下的关键目标。

paras.en: The president of the talks, Turkey's Environment Minister Murat Kurum, told the BBC he was "hopeful" of a breakthrough as he entered the summit on Sunday.
paras.zh: 会谈主席、土耳其环境部长穆拉特·库鲁姆告诉英国广播公司，他在周日参加峰会时“希望”取得突破。

paras.en: "We will be happy soon enough," he said.
paras.zh: “我们很快就会幸福的，”他说。

paras.en: But that outlook was not shared by the EU, which the BBC understands considers the new text to be a backward step.
paras.zh: 但欧盟并不认同这一观点，据英国广播公司了解，欧盟认为新文本是一种倒退。

paras.en: The EU and Pacific states had been arguing against the removal of fossil fuels from the draft text. The EU has not yet reacted to this latest draft.
paras.zh: 欧盟和太平洋国家一直反对从草案文本中删除化石燃料。欧盟尚未对最新草案做出反应。

paras.en: The Africa Group is likely to be disappointed at this latest iteration as it includes no specific figure on money for adaptation and instead kicks that decision to future meetings.
paras.zh: 非洲集团可能会对最新的版本感到失望，因为它没有包含适应资金的具体数字，而是将这一决定留到未来的会议上。

paras.en: Countries were expected to reconvene at 09:00 local time (06:00GMT) to decide whether to approve a new deal, but that meeting has now been delayed further.
paras.zh: 各国原定于当地时间 09:00（格林威治标准时间 06:00）再次召开会议，决定是否批准新协议，但该会议现已进一步推迟。

paras.en: These talks are approaching the longest-running in the COP history.
paras.zh: 这些会谈即将成为缔约方会议历史上持续时间最长的一次。

paras.en: If countries cannot reach consensus - as required by the UN's climate talks process - the negotiations could be suspended until next year. This has only happened once before since countries started holding COP climate meetings in 1995.
paras.zh: 如果各国无法按照联合国气候谈判进程的要求达成共识，谈判可能会暂停到明年。自 1995 年各国开始召开 COP 气候会议以来，这种情况只发生过一次。

paras.en: Just hours before the new text was published, EU Commissioner for Climate Wopke Hoekstra said if the bloc could not get "what is needed in terms of climate action... then there's no deal."
paras.zh: 就在新文本发布前几个小时，欧盟气候专员沃普克·霍克斯特拉(Wopke Hoekstra)表示，如果欧盟无法获得“气候行动所需的东西……那么就没有达成协议。”

paras.en: Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh, the UK's chief negotiator, struck a more hopeful tone, saying her team was still working to get an agreement.
paras.zh: 英国首席谈判代表、能源大臣米亚塔·法恩布拉(Miatta Fahnbulleh)的语气更加充满希望，称她的团队仍在努力达成协议。

paras.en: A draft deal unveiled earlier this week called for a faster phase-out of fossil fuels, but a second, pared-down version released on Thursday stripped away all mentions of coal, oil and gas - sparking threats of a walk out.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候公布的一项协议草案呼吁更快地淘汰化石燃料，但周四发布的第二个精简版本删除了所有提及煤炭、石油和天然气的内容，引发了退出的威胁。

paras.en: The fallout led to the summit in Antalya blowing past the original deadline of Friday. On Saturday negotiating teams who had Sunday morning flights were rescheduling them - a sign a deal was still not in sight, and raising the risk that as teams eventually had to leave, the meeting could lose the critical numbers needed to pass an agreement.
paras.zh: 其后果导致安塔利亚峰会超出了原定周五的最后期限。周六，原本有周日早上航班的谈判团队正在重新安排行程——这表明仍看不到达成协议的迹象，这增加了风险：随着团队最终不得不离开，会议可能会失去通过协议所需的关键数字。

paras.en: As part of a last ditch effort to produce an acceptable text, the European Union and Saudi Arabia - who were deeply divided over the future of fossil fuels - were brought together on Saturday to seek a compromise.
paras.zh: 作为制定可接受文本的最后努力的一部分，欧盟和沙特阿拉伯——在化石燃料的未来问题上存在严重分歧——于周六聚集在一起寻求妥协。

paras.en: COP31 President and Turkish Environment Minister Murat Kurum told delegates in the early hours of Sunday he believed concerns had been addressed.
paras.zh: COP31 主席兼土耳其环境部长穆拉特·库鲁姆 (Murat Kurum) 在周日凌晨告诉代表们，他相信担忧已经得到解决。

paras.en: "We ask you to look at this decision carefully," Kurum said. "We are closer than ever to agreement on the remaining issues."
paras.zh: “我们请你仔细考虑这个决定，”库鲁姆说。 “我们比以往任何时候都更接近就剩余问题达成一致。”

paras.en: Ministers from Panama, Solomon Islands, Cote d'Ivoire and the EU were fighting to have a commitment to move away from fossil fuels put back into the final agreement, after fossil fuel producers led by Saudi Arabia pushed for its removal.
paras.zh: 在以沙特阿拉伯为首的化石燃料生产国推动取消化石燃料承诺后，巴拿马、所罗门群岛、科特迪瓦和欧盟的部长们正在努力争取将取消化石燃料的承诺重新纳入最终协议中。

paras.en: "It is not acceptable to have a COP or a cover decision that does not even mention fossil fuels and we simply will not put up with it," said Juan Carlos Navarro, Panama's minister for the environment.
paras.zh: 巴拿马环境部长胡安·卡洛斯·纳瓦罗表示：“缔约方大会或封面决定甚至不提及化石燃料，这是不可接受的，我们根本不会容忍。”

paras.en: Tuvalu's Climate Minister Maina Talia told reporters it was a "red line" for the low-lying Pacific nation: "We're talking about the root cause of all of this".
paras.zh: 图瓦卢气候部长马伊纳·塔利亚告诉记者，对于这个地势低洼的太平洋国家来说，这是一条“红线”：“我们正在谈论这一切的根本原因”。

paras.en: France's Minister of Ecological Transition, Monique Barbut, took aim at several references in the text to carbon capture, use and storage (CCUS) - the technology that takes emissions when they are released and stores them underground - as a licence for other countries to keep burning oil and gas.
paras.zh: 法国生态转型部长莫妮克·巴布(Monique Barbut)将文中多次提到的碳捕获、利用和储存(CCUS)——一种在排放时吸收排放物并将其储存在地下的技术——作为其他国家继续燃烧石油和天然气的许可证。

paras.en: "We cannot be announcing to the world that we are now getting to 1.5 increase in the temperature and do business like nothing was happening," Barbut said.
paras.zh: 巴布特说：“我们不能向世界宣布气温已上升 1.5 度，却又像什么都没发生一样开展业务。”

paras.en: In the latest text the commitments to CCUS have been reduced, which may be enough to alleviate the EU's concerns.
paras.zh: 在最新的文本中，对CCUS的承诺有所减少，这可能足以缓解欧盟的担忧。

paras.en: For the first time at a COP, the agreement - known officially as the Antalya Accords - could acknowledge that the goal set under the Paris climate accord of keeping global temperature rise below 1.5C has been missed.
paras.zh: 该协议（正式名称为《安塔利亚协议》）首次在缔约方会议上承认，《巴黎气候协议》设定的将全球气温上升控制在 1.5 摄氏度以下的目标已经实现。

paras.en: The world is entering a period called "overshoot".
paras.zh: 世界正在进入一个被称为“超调”的时期。

paras.en: Beyond this point scientists warn millions more people will be exposed to sea level rise and extreme heat.
paras.zh: 超过这一点，科学家警告说，数百万人将面临海平面上升和极端高温的影响。

paras.en: But Australia's Climate Change and Energy Minister, Chris Bowen, who is leading negotiations, pushed back on the need to include language on fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 但领导谈判的澳大利亚气候变化和能源部长克里斯·鲍文（Chris Bowen）反对纳入有关化石燃料的措辞的必要性。

paras.en: He argued the summit was about implementation, and should focus on the move towards clean energy sources.
paras.zh: 他认为这次峰会是关于实施的，应该重点关注向清洁能源的发展。

paras.en: One of the other key issues raised by developing nations - the lack of money - appears unresolved in the latest draft agreement.
paras.zh: 发展中国家提出的其他关键问题之一——缺乏资金——在最新的协议草案中似乎没有得到解决。

paras.en: Earlier versions of the text included an agreement to ramp up money for adaptation to $120bn (Â£91bn) by 2035 - a figure that was then removed.
paras.zh: 该文本的早期版本包括一项协议，即到 2035 年将适应资金增加到 1200 亿美元（910 亿英镑），但该数字随后被删除。

paras.en: "We did not come here to beg, we came here to claim what is rightfully ours for our people who are suffering the brunt of anthropogenic activities of developed countries," said Zanetor Agyeman Rawlings, Ghana's Environment Minister and chair of the African Group of negotiators.
paras.zh: 加纳环境部长兼非洲谈判小组主席扎内托·阿吉曼·罗林斯表示：“我们不是来这里乞讨的，我们来这里是为了为我们的人民索取应有的东西，这些人民正遭受发达国家人为活动的冲击。”

paras.en: Climate activists and environmental groups, who are observers to these talks, have slammed negotiations.
paras.zh: 作为这些谈判观察员的气候活动人士和环保组织对谈判进行了猛烈抨击。

paras.en: "I can tell you without any doubt that this has been the worst COP ever," said Mohamed Adow of Powershift Africa.
paras.zh: Powershift Africa 的穆罕默德·阿多 (Mohamed Adow) 表示：“我可以毫无疑问地告诉你，这是有史以来最糟糕的一次缔约方大会。”

articles.title: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

paras.en: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

Have you ever wondered what enables everything from roaring construction machinery to agricultural machinery plowing the fields to industrial equipment shuttling through factories—the precise starting, smooth operation, and reliable braking they achieve?

The answer lies in a seemingly insignificant yet crucial core component: friction material. It acts as the "safety guard" and "power link" of machinery, ensuring every brake is safe and effective, and every power transmission is smooth and flawless.

Among the vast family of friction materials, wet friction materials are becoming the new favorite in modern machinery due to their exceptional reliability, safety, and exceptionally long lifespan. Among wet materials, paper-based friction materials stand out as a leading force thanks to their excellent overall performance, cost-effectiveness, and broad application prospects.
Today, let's delve deeper into the fascinating world of this "unsung hero"—paper-based friction materials.
What is Paper-Based Friction Material? — A Sponge-Like Power Core
Imagine a "sponge" with countless tiny pores—that's the most intuitive image of paper-based friction material.

It is a material with a reticular porous structure composed of three core components: reinforcing fibers, functional fillers, and a binder resin. This unique structure gives it extraordinary capabilities:
- Oil Storage Capacity: The porous structure acts like a miniature "oil depot," capable of storing large quantities of lubricant.

- Dynamic Lubrication: When the friction plate and mating plate engage and are subjected to pressure, the lubricant within the material is instantly squeezed onto the friction surface, forming a tough lubricant film, enabling smooth, gentle "wet" friction.
- Self-Recovery: When the friction plates separate, the material rebounds like memory foam, "absorbing" the lubricant back into the pores, ready for the next operation.

It is this dynamic cycle of "oil storage-oil squeezing-oil return" that allows paper-based friction materials to perform well in an oil bath environment, achieving a perfect combination of high durability and stable friction performance.
Exploring Core Performance: How Do Three Key Factors Affect It?

The performance of paper-based friction materials is not static. Like a top athlete, its performance is influenced by the "field," "equipment," and "condition." Let's examine how these three key factors shape its performance.
Factor 1: The "Stage Effect" of Lubricants

Paper-based friction materials are highly sensitive to lubricants, and different lubricants create distinct "stages" for their performance. Even the same friction material can exhibit significantly different friction characteristics (especially the kinetic friction coefficient) when exposed to different lubricants.
Figure 1: Kinetic friction coefficient curve for a paper-based friction material in gear oil
Figure 2: Dynamic friction coefficient curve of the same material in hydraulic oil

Interpretation: The above chart clearly shows that the same material behaves very differently in gear oil and hydraulic fluid. Furthermore, various additives added to lubricating oils (such as dispersants and anti-wear agents) can interact complexly with the material surface, further affecting its friction properties. Therefore, choosing the right oil for paper-based friction materials is the first step in achieving optimal performance.
Density is a trump card for paper-based friction materials. It is directly related to the material's porosity, leading to a delicate balancing act in terms of performance.

High density (low porosity) means a denser material, resulting in better strength and thermal conductivity, lower wear rate, and longer life. However, the downside is reduced oil storage capacity, which can lead to a lower coefficient of friction and compromise power transmission.

Low density (high porosity) means the material is more porous, resulting in greater oil storage capacity and a higher coefficient of friction, which can provide greater braking force or transmit torque. However, the downside is reduced mechanical strength and wear resistance, shortening service life.
Figure 3: Comparison of the dynamic coefficient of friction for materials of varying densities (Type 2 to Type 6, increasing density)
Figure 4: Comparison of wear rates of materials with different densities

Interpretation: Figures 3 and 4 vividly illustrate this balancing act. There's no such thing as absolute good or bad, only suitability. When selecting a paper-based friction material, the optimal trade-off between friction coefficient and durability must be determined based on specific application requirements (e.g., high torque versus long life).
Factor 3: Extreme Challenges of Operating Conditions

In addition to oil type and density, actual operating conditions, such as surface pressure, sliding speed, and oil temperature, pose extreme challenges to paper-based friction materials. These factors directly affect the temperature of the friction interface, the thickness and stability of the oil film, and thus dynamically alter the coefficient of friction.

Therefore, please remember: the coefficient of friction of a particular paper-based friction material is not a fixed value, but rather a performance range determined through extensive and repeated testing under specific operating conditions.
Broad Applications: Injecting a Powerful "Heart" into Machinery

Thanks to its excellent overall performance and customizability, Carlisle Brake & Friction's paper-based friction materials have been successfully applied to the core components of various heavy-duty machinery, becoming their powerful and reliable "heart."
We understand that different machines and applications require significantly different friction materials. For example:
- Service brakes for construction machinery (such as excavators and loaders) require materials that provide a stable, powerful braking force under high loads to ensure safety.
- Powershift transmissions for agricultural machinery (such as tractors) require materials that provide smooth engagement and excellent heat resistance to handle frequent shifting.
- Clutches for industrial machinery require materials that respond quickly and have a long lifespan to ensure continuous and efficient operation of production lines.

To this end, Carlisle Brake & Friction has developed a series of special paper-based friction materials for different application scenarios, providing each customer with the most suitable and reliable solution.
Continuous Innovation, Driving the Future
Technological advancement is endless. To meet increasingly demanding application requirements and broaden market prospects, Carlisle Brake & Friction remains at the forefront of innovation.

We are not only continuously optimizing the formulation and processing of paper-based friction materials to push their performance limits, but are also actively exploring next-generation wet friction materials with even higher performance. These R&D efforts have made significant progress, aiming to provide global customers with more diverse and advanced options, driving the infinite possibilities of future machinery.

articles.title: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees

paras.en: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees

MEDINA, OHIO — September 24, 2025 — Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF), a global leader in the development and manufacture of high-performance brake and friction solutions, today welcomed Medina Mayor Dennis Hanwell, Economic Development Director Kimberly Marshall, and Executive Director of the Medina Chamber of Commerce Jaclyn Ringstmeier, for a special photo op at the company’s headquarters, located at 920 Lake Road. The event was a commemorative celebration of CarlisleCBF’s 100-year anniversary and its enduring presence in the Medina community.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The photo op featured Mayor Hanwell alongside Carlisle’s Operations Leader, David Smith, and a number of employees who have been with the company for decades. The occasion honored CarlisleCBF’s century of innovation and its deep roots in the Medina area, where it has been a significant employer and community partner.

"We are incredibly proud of our history and our strong connection to the city of Medina," said David Smith. "This milestone is a testament to the hard work and dedication of our employees, many of whom have been with us for decades. We are grateful for the continued support of Mayor Hanwell and the entire Medina community."

The photo op followed a recent employee and family event at the Medina plant that celebrated the 100-year milestone. The celebration was filled with games, face painting, food, and fun for all ages, reinforcing the company's commitment to its employees and their families.

Mayor Hanwell expressed his gratitude for CarlisleCBF’s presence in the city. “Carlisle has been a part of the Medina community for nearly 65 years, providing good jobs and a strong economic foundation,” said Mayor Hanwell. "We are proud to celebrate their 100-year anniversary and recognize the significant role they have played in our city’s growth and prosperity."
CarlisleCBF, a brand of CentroMotion, was founded in 1925 and has grown to become a global leader in its field, serving a wide range of markets including agriculture, construction, and mining.

Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a leading global provider of highly engineered and integrated brake and friction solutions for a wide range of industrial applications. With over 100 years of experience, the company is dedicated to delivering innovative, reliable, and high-performance products to its customers worldwide.

articles.title: WIN Opens Nominations for 2027 Founding Mothers Award
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Women’s Industry Network (WIN) announced that nominations are now open for the second annual 2027 Founding Mothers Award. The honor was established earlier this year to celebrate the six “founding mothers” of WIN and the organization’s creation and mission within the collision repair industry.

Created and presented by WIN’s Founding Mothers — Frederica Carter, Geri Kottschade, Gigi Walker, Patricia Serratore, Kathy Mello and Marcy Tieger — the award recognizes women making their mark in their shops and communities while advancing the WIN mission of supporting and connecting women in collision repair.

The Founding Mothers Award honors women who are active as technicians or painters on the shop floor and demonstrate passion, perseverance and purpose. Haylie Colby, a painter with Nuss Collision Center in East Bethel, Minn., became the first recipient of WIN’s inaugural Founding Mothers Award and was presented the honor at WIN’s annual conference in May 2026. Colby has quickly established herself as a top painter at Nuss Collision Center in just three-plus years.

WIN was founded 21 years ago by these six aforementioned women who saw a need for connection, mentorship and opportunity in the automotive collision industry. For this award, Founding Mothers Kottschade, Carter and Tieger have actively provided input.

“When WIN was created, they had a goal in mind of creating a safe space where shop females were welcomed, giving shops a voice and to show shops can be leaders in the collision repair industry’s organizations,” said Laura Kottschade, chair of WIN. “Key considerations for this still new, prestigious award include excellence in their craft, as well as mentoring others to success in repair excellence. The Founding Mothers Award is open to all women and annually recognizes an individual that is ‘intently involved with the true craft of collision repair, as their skills need to be still active on the shop floor — either as a hands-on refinish technician and/or painter.’

articles.title: SHOWA Goes Off-Road with New High-Performance Shocks
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Astemo Americas, Inc. has launched the SHOWA Performance premium shock brand, its first product offering built for four-wheel vehicles, bringing a podium-proven, 60-plus-year legacy from two-wheel racing to the off-road truck and SUV market.

Available in early 2027, the new line ranges from entry-level to race-ready shocks, with applications for today’s most popular off-road vehicles and custom builds. Designed and manufactured in the USA, every single SHOWA Performance product delivers on one core principle: “Control. Mastered.”

“SHOWA has spent decades winning on two wheels, and everything we’ve learned is built into these shocks,” said Nathan Beskow, general manager of SHOWA Performance. “Enthusiasts want to push hard on the trails, dunes, rocks and track – and they want more control and consistency from their shocks. We’re bringing that knowledge to four wheels, and we’ll keep innovating every step of the way.”

As the products roll out across North America in 2027, the SHOWA Performance brand will be proving its technology at many popular off-road races and events, including King of the Hammers, the Ultra4 series and Jeep Jamboree USA. The brand’s racing program will be led by Director of Motorsport Brian Novak.

“We’re ready to write racing history in the four-wheel world with SHOWA Performance,” said Novak. “It all starts at the 2027 King of the Hammers with a SHOWA-equipped 4600-class rig driven by Sergio Pinillos.”

Built to the same standards that put SHOWA on the podium, the new SHOWA Performance shock absorber line for lifted trucks and SUVs includes entry-level to race-ready shocks such as ORC off-road control monotube shocks, PSD position-sensitive damping shocks and SPIRE high-performance, adjustable and rebuildable monotubes.

SHOWA Performance ORC 2.0 monotube shocks feature a premium corrosion-resistant, Cerakote-finished1 steel body design that includes a large 45mm bore and precision-engineered internals to deliver more control and fast, precise response. These shocks also include a graphite-impregnated floating piston band to help deliver a better shock response on any type of terrain.

SHOWA PSD 2.25 shocks include a Cerakote-finished, 57mm-diameter steel body for maximum heat dissipation and fade resistance even in the harshest off-road conditions. The units also feature patented Hydraulic Compression Stop (HCS) and Hydraulic Rebound Stop (HRS), exclusive innovations that increase damping force near full compression and full rebound to cushion hard bottom-outs and help prevent top-outs. Combined, HCS and HRS provide greater control over how the suspension absorbs impacts and recovers, improving ride comfort, vehicle stability and off-road performance. PSD shocks also feature an 18mm hardened chrome rod for extreme durability, long service life and corrosion resistance.

These shocks are available in universal and application-specific configurations. Universal units come in 12- to 14-inch stroke lengths for custom builds, with piggyback and remote reservoir options in both coilover and non-coilover styles. Application-specific shocks are tuned for popular stock and lifted trucks and SUVs.

articles.title: Tool Time Podcast: Launch Tech USA
articles.author: Eric Garbe

paras.en: In this conversation between Eric Pagliughi, vice president of Launch Tech USA and TechShop’s Eric Garbe, learn how Launch Tech USA has evolved since 2002, expanding from its strengths in European and Asian vehicle diagnostics to comprehensive coverage for domestic vehicles, heavy-duty applications, powersports and electric vehicles.

The conversation explores the challenges facing today’s repair shops, including increasingly complex vehicle systems, access to OEM diagnostic information and the growing need for technician education. Pagliughi emphasizes that successful technology adoption requires more than purchasing equipment; technicians must understand how to maximize its capabilities.

Looking toward 2027, Launch Tech USA is introducing an expanded product lineup, including updated Pro line diagnostic scan tools, the X613 alignment system and X939 ADAS/alignment equipment. These solutions focus on affordability, simplified operation and helping shops expand their service capabilities.

A recurring theme throughout the episode is Launch Tech’s commitment to developing products around the real-world needs of shop owners and technicians. By integrating familiar repair information platforms, offering flexible equipment packages and expanding training opportunities, Launch Tech aims to make advanced automotive technology more accessible.

The episode concludes with Pagliughi outlining the company’s commitment to stronger technical support and expanded hands-on training in 2027, helping technicians improve diagnostic efficiency, maximize tool investments and confidently service increasingly sophisticated vehicles.
- Automotive Industry Challenges: OEM scan tools, emerging vehicle technologies, repair information access and technician training. (2:03)
- New Technology for 2027: Updated Pro line scan tools, alignment equipment and repair information integrations. (4:15)
- Alignment and ADAS Equipment: X613 enhancements, ground-level alignment capabilities and affordable ADAS calibration options. (7:12)
- Scan Tool Product Lineup: New DIY, professional, heavy-duty and powersports diagnostic solutions. (11:38)
- TPMS Technology: Universal sensors, integrated diagnostic tools and affordable service packages. (16:09)
- Battery Diagnostic Equipment: Bluetooth battery testing and scan tool integration. (19:47)
- Electric Vehicle Service: Scalable EV diagnostic solutions, battery service equipment and expanding shop capabilities. (21:44)
- Technician Training: Hands-on instruction, diagnostic education and training facilities on both coasts. (25:36)

articles.title: Got a Great Teaching Idea? NACAT Wants It
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Great automotive instructors know that some of the best teaching ideas come from sharing experiences with their peers. Whether it’s a new approach to explaining a complicated system, an innovative classroom exercise or a better way to prepare students for the realities of the service bay, those ideas deserve to be shared.

The North American Council of Automotive Teachers (NACAT) is inviting automotive educators and industry professionals to submit course proposals for the 2027 Automotive Educators Conference (AEC), scheduled for July 11-15, 2027, in Nashville, TN. But time is running out: The submission deadline is Wednesday, November 25, 2026.

The annual conference brings together automotive instructors from across North America to exchange ideas, strengthen technical skills and explore new approaches to automotive education. From emerging vehicle technologies and diagnostic procedures to curriculum development, hands-on training and student engagement, AEC offers opportunities for educators to learn from one another.

The 2026 Automotive Educators Conference demonstrated the value of that collaboration, emphasizing technical training, innovative teaching strategies and practical solutions that instructors can bring back to their classrooms.

Have you developed a lesson that consistently gets students engaged? Found a creative way to teach electrical diagnostics? Developed an effective approach to EV safety, ADAS or other emerging technologies? Perhaps you’ve discovered a better way to connect students with employers or build stronger relationships with local repair shops.
Those experiences could provide the foundation for a valuable conference session.

Presenting at AEC is an opportunity to showcase your expertise, connect with fellow educators and contribute to the professional development of the people preparing tomorrow’s automotive technicians. You don’t need to have all the answers to make a difference. Sometimes, sharing what has worked in your classroom can inspire another instructor to try something new.
The deadline for course submissions is Wednesday, November 25, 2026.
For additional information about presenting at the 2027 Automotive Educators Conference, contact Heather Sebben at [email protected] or 816-766-1515.
Your next great teaching idea might be exactly what another automotive educator needs to hear.
